tei:titleStmt.tei:title: pod 40 gsung 'bum/_tA ra nA tha/ （dpe bsdur ma/）

tei:div.tei:p: spyi khyab bsdu sgrig 'gan 'khur ba gtso bo/gzan dkar thub bstan nyi ma/bsdu sgrig 'gan 'khur gzhon pa dang /gtso sgrig pa/dme bde legs/gtso sgrig gzhon pa/'gro 'dul rdo rje/ bsdu sgrig pa/mun sel/thub bstan nyi ma/bstan 'dzin blo gros/zla ba bstan 'dzin/shes rab bzang po/zhu dag dang dkar chag sgrig mkhan/dpal ldan rgya mtsho/phur pa phrin las/dkon mchog bsam gtan/thub bstan nyi ma/bstan pa dar rgyas/par sgrig lag rtsal pa/tshe ring chos sgron/shes rab dpal g.yang /bsod nams 'byug rgyas/

〈mes po'i shul bzhag〉 cesapa'i dpe tshogs 'di ni dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang gisabasgrigs shing 'di ga dpe skrun khang dang mnyam 'brel gyisabaskrun pa'i dpe rnying dpe tshogs shig yin la/ de yang mkhas dbang gzan dkar rin po che thub bstan nyi ma mchog gisaspyi'i gtso skyong gnang ste/ dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang gisanye ba'i lo bcu tsam gyi ring la 'bad brtson chen pos bod kyi sa gnas gang sar bzhugasapa'i bod yig dpe rnying po ti khrir longs pa rang byung dang mi'i gnod 'tshes 'jig la nye ba'i nyen kha las bskyabs te legs par bsgrigs shing dkar chag tu btab/ dpe thum gsol/ dpe sgrom bzhengs te srung skyob mdzad gnang ba dang gnang musasu yod pa ni/rang re'i mes po'i shul nor srung skyob rgyun 'dzin dang bod rig pa'i gal che'i dpyad gzhi mkho 'don gyi dgos pa che ba ma zad/ rang rgyal mi rigs rig gnasanor mdzod dar rgyas dang srung skyob bgyi ba'i 'phrin las gal chen zhig red/nye char dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang dang 'di ga dpe skrun khang gnyisazhib gros byas mthar/ srol rgyun rig gnasasrung skyob dang bod rig pa'i dpyad yig myur skyob dang cha tshang du gtong ba'i dmigs yul ngos 'dzin gcig gyur thog 〈bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus〉 zhesapa'i dpe rnying dpe dkon gyi dpe tshogs chen mo zhig mu mthud nas legs sgrig dang dpe skrun byed bzhin yod pa dang / da char yang dmigs yul dgosapa gcig gyur thog 〈mesapo'i shul bzhag〉cesapa'i dpe rnying dpe dkon gal chen gyi dpe tshogs chen mo 'di nyid par skrun bya rgyu yin la/ de yang sngon byon mesapo mkhas dbang dam pa du mas shul du bzhag pa'i gsung 'bum dpe dkon gal chen rnams dang / 'thar 'thor du bzhugs pa'i dpe dkon gal chen dag phyogs gcig tu bsdus te bsgrigs pa 'di'i nang don thad la/ nang don rig pa dang / gso ba rig pa/ tshad ma rig pa/ sgra rig pa/ bzo rig pa/ lo rgyus/ rtsis rig sogs bcu phrag rig pa'i gnas kun 'dus pa'i dpe dkon nor bu dgos 'dod kun 'byung lta bu zhig yin/—1—

'a 'dra' dpe skrun mnyam las go skabs legs po nged cag dpe skrun khang la thob pa na tu skal ba bzang zhing gzi brdzid kyi 'os 'gan zhig tu sgrubartsisate lo 'ga'i dpe skrun 'char gzhi gtso bo'i nang du bkod zin cing / las gzhi 'di la krung go'i bod rig pa zhib 'jug lte gnas kyi dbu khrid dang rgyal khab phyi nang gi bod rig pa'i mkhas dbang du mas gdeng 'jog dang mthong chen gyis skul ma yang thob/〈mes po'i shul bzhag〉 gi ma phyi phal cher ni dbu med bris rnying sha stag yin pas/ ma dpe gsal mi gsal dang skung yig mang zhing bris tshugs 'dra min gyi dbang gis klog dka' ba'ang shin tu mang po 'dug 'on kyang dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang gis lo mang ring nyams myong bsdu len dang mkhas dbang du mar bka' 'dri zhus par brten yig gzugs gsar rgyag dang phyogs sgrig thub pa byung / par shing du 'khod yod pa rnams kyang dpe rnying gzhan pa dang bsdur te gtan la phab yod pa bcasate zhib cha deb so so'i bsdu sgrig gsal bshad du gzigs par zhu/dpe rnying srung skyob dang phyogs sgrig dpe skrun gyi las ka 'di la rgyab skyor dang thugs khur gnang mkhan gyi mkhas dbang rnams dang / lhag par du krung go'i bod rig pa zhib 'jug lte gnas kyi dbu khrid lhan rgyas dang / mkhas dbang thub bstan nyi ma rin po che mchog sogs kyis rgyab skyor dang mdzub ston gyi bka' drin bskyangs pa la snying thag pa nas thugs rje che zhu rgyu dang / dpal brtsegs zhib 'jug khang gi 'gan 'dzin pa lhan rgyas dang / zhu dag pa/ yig rgyag pa sogs mdor na las gzhi 'di la lhag bsam dang 'bad brtson chen pos zhabs phyi zhu mkhan rnams lasnying thag pa nas bka' drin che zhesazhu rgyu dang /dpe tshogs 'di'i dpe sgrig dang zhu dag thad la ha cang nan tan dang zhib tshags bgyi khul byas mod/'on kyang nga tshor shes tshad dman pa'i dbang gis nor 'chug mi nyung ba yod srid pas dpyod ldan dag gis nor bcos yo bsrang gi dgongs 'char lhug stsol gnang bar zhu zhu/zhes krung go'i bod rig pa dpe skrun khang nas/spyi lo 2007lo'i zla ba dang po'i tshes 10la/

de la 'dir rang cag kha ba can gyi zhing 'dir chos rgyal lo paṇa rnams dang / sa dge bka' rnying sogs kyi mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pa'i dam pa'i skyes bu rnams kyis/ bshad sgrub kyi shing rta chen po bco brgyad rjes 'brang dang bcas pa'i chos brgyud dang bka' srol mtha' dag dang / de dang rjes su 'brel ba'i thun mong gi rig gnas sum rtags snyan ngag mngon brjod sdeb sbyor/ skar rtsis 'byung rtsis sgra tshad bzo gso sogs mdo sngags rig gnas dang bcas pa'i gzhung lugs zab cing rgya che ba tshang la ma nor ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig 'chad nyan 'gyur gsum dang / bshad sgrub las gsum gyi sgo nas thog mar srol gtod/bar du gtan la phab/ rim bzhin dar rgyas btang ba sogs 'dzin skyong spel bar mdzad pa'i bka' drin bdag rkyen la brten nas/ dbus gtsang khams gsum du bzhugs so cog gi glegs bam thams cad gcig tu spungs na ri rab lhun po'i gtos dang mnyam zhing / chos tshan gyi rnam dbye ji snyed yod pa grangs su bgrangs na nam mkha'i gza' skar tshogs kyang skyengs par byed pa zhig mchis pa tsam du ma zad rgya bal hor sogs kyi yul gru kun tu'ang dar khyab che/da lta'i char bod rig pa'am bod kyi shes rig ces su grags pa 'di nyid 'dzam gling shar nub kyi yul gru dag tu'ang mched de/ dper na/ oka si phor dhi dang har lid lta bu yo rob dang / a ri sogs su grags chen gyi slob grwa chen mo —1—

rnams su bod yig gi dpe mdzod wo po yod par ma zad/ bod kyi chos dang rig gzhung slob gnyer byed sa'i sde tshan dang slob ma yang mi nyung ba yod/da ni gong du smras pa'i bshad sgrub shing rta wo po bco brgyad ces pa de gang dang gang yin pa'i ngo sprod mdo tsam zhu na/ de yang ji skad du/ 'jam mgon kong sprul rin po che'i zhal nas/ chos blon thon mi be+e ro ska cog zhang / /gnubs chen rin bzang rngog lo saskya pa/ /bu ston bshad rgyun 'degs pa'i ka chen bcu// zhes dang bod yul sgrub brgyud shing rta chen po brgyad/ /rnying ma bka' gdams lam 'bras bka' brgyud pa/ shangs pa zhi byed sbyor drug bsnyen sgrub bo/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ shes bya'i gzhung lugs sna tshogs kyi 'gyur khyad dang 'chad tshul gyi dbye bas bshad rgyun 'degs pa'i ka chen bcu dang / sgrub pa nyams su len tshul la brgyud pa'i khyad par dang man ngag gi dbye bas sgrub brgyud 'dren pa'i shing rta brgyad de/ bshad sgrub shing rta chen po bco brgyad rjes 'brang dang bcas pa'i gsung rab rgya mtsho lta bu zhig bdag cag gi yab mes gong ma rnams kyis gces pa'i lus srog longs spyod thams cad phangs pa med par btang ste/ phyi rabs rang re'i brgyud 'dzin rnams la 'phran yun phan bde'i dpal la dmigs nas bzhag pa'i nor bu rin po che yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal po mtha' yas pa zhig mchis/de dag las mang che ba rig gsar lo bcu'i god chag chen po sogasadus kyi rgud pa'i dbang gis sems med 'byung bzhi'i 'jig pa dang / sems ldan mi dang mi min gyi gnod pas nyams nyes chen por gyur pa ni rgya bod yongs grags ltar lags/—2

rig gnas gsar brje'i mjug sgril ba dang chabs cig tang gi yang dag pa'i srid jus kyi nyi 'od slar yang 'phros te/ tang dang rgyal khab kyis 'go khrid dang rtsa 'dzugs gnang nas/ dpe rnying 'thor bsdu dang / legasasgrig dpe skrun/ sgyur spel sogs kyi sgo nas rang rigs kyi rig gnas nyams pa sor chud dang / mi nyams gong 'phel gyi bya bar so so'i 'khos bstun gyi sri zhu sgrub pa'i skal ba bzang po'i dpal la longs su spyad du yod pa'i skabs 'dir/ rang re'i yab mes rnams kyis bzhag pa'i pha nor mang po zhig da dung yang nged cag gi bsod nams kyi bgo skal du lhag yod pa rnams la gces spras chen pos srung skyob dang dar spel byed rgyu ni mes rgyal gyis gnang ba'i las 'gan yin par ma zad/ 'u cag bod kyi rig gnas slob gso'i bya bar legs skyes 'bul mkhan gyi rgan dar 'bring gsum gyi shes yon can la mtshon na/ rang re'i phrag par bab pa'i gzhan dring mi 'jog pa'i gzi 'od bla na 'bar ba'i 'os 'gan mchog tu gyur pa zhig kyang yin par sems/der brten/ phyogs dang ris su ma chad pa'i skyes bu dam pa rnams kyisaljags rtsom gnang ba'i gsung rab/ bshad sgrub shing rta bco brgyad las grub pa'i mdo sngags kyi gzhung bshad dang / chos 'byung dang gdan rabs/ rnam thar dang gsan yig brda sprod dang snyan ngag /rtsis dang gso rig sogs dpe dkon 'thor ba rnams bsdus/ chad pa rnams bsab/ nyams pa rnams gsos/ 'khrugasapa rnams bsgrigs te dpe tshogs 'ga' rim pa bstar chags su par du bskrun pa dang bskrun rtsis las/—3

da lan 'dir jo nang rje bcun tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum dpe bsdur ma 'di rgya che'i gzigs pa po rnams kyi spyan lam du phul ba yin/'byung char nga tsho'i dpe tshogs dpar skrun zhu rgyu'i skor la lhag bsam ldan zhing mkhyen spyan yangs pa'i mkhas dbang rnams kyis dgongs 'char gyi bka' slob stsol gnang dang / dpe dkon gyi ma phyi g.yar gnang gi skyabs 'jug yong ba mkhyen mkhyen/ /zhor 'phros gsal 'debs zhu ba/ lhag par du da lta lus kyi lang tsho rgyas shing sems kyi blo gros bkra ba'i gzhon skyes rnams la mtshon na/ snying pos dben pa'i kha pho 'don pa las/ zol med(kyi lhag bsam dkar po snying la 'chang / don ldan gyi rnam dkar bya ba dang du len/ lhad med kyi chos dang rig gzhung slob gnyer byed/ 'khos bstun gyi sri zhu'i las ka cung zad re sgrub nus na/mes rgyal la zhabasatog 'grub/ rang rigs la legs skyes 'bul/ rang nyid kyi la rgya mngon thub pa zhig kyang 'ong ba ni mthong chos mngon gyur lags pas/ de bzhin dgongs dbyings su chub par zhu'o/ /phran 'brog rgan 'khyams po thub bstan nyi mas/spyi lo 2007pa'i zla tshes la gus phul/—4

bsdo/ sgrig gsal ngakhrind/da lam nga tsho'i jo nang rje btsun tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs te par skrun zhus pa 'di ni/ gzan dkar mchog sprul thub bstan nyi ma'i bka' slob dang bdag rkyen 'og byung ba zhig yin/de yang spyir khong la gsung 'bum pod mezhi bcu tsam zhig yod tshul phyis su bris pa'i rnam thar 'ga' las gsal yang / dngos su pod bzhi bcu'i dkar chag kha gsal zhig da sngon nga tsho'i mjal rgyu ma byung / da lam dngos su mjal rgyu byung ba'i pod bco lnga ni/ deng sang yongs grags su rtag brtan par ma zhes 'bod pa 'di ni/ bod rab byung bcu pa'i me 'brug (spyi lo1616) la/ mnga' ris smad kyi gung thang gi rgyal rabs nyi shu rtsa gsum pa'am/ yang lugs gcig la dmar po sde bsgrangs na nyi shu rtsa bzhi pa bsod nams dbang phyug sdes yon bdag byas/ tā ra nā tha'i dngos slob gnya' yi ban+de dkon mchog legs pas/ thog ma'i mtshams sbyor dang par byang 'bri ba sogs byas te/ dus 'khor sngags phreng dang skad gnyis shan sbyar sogs chos tshan bcu bzhi shing par du bkos pa/ rtag brtan dam chos gling du spyan drangs te bzhugs su gsol/ de'i steng du rtag brtan rang nas brkos pa bcas pod —1—

bco lnga tsam zhig yod pa de'i bu dpe par ma tshar gcig /rgyal dbang lnga pa chen pos 'bras spungs dpe mdzod khang du gdan drangs ba/ phyis dus 'gyur skabs su pe cing mi rigs pho brang du bzhugs kyang / deng seng bod ljongs dpe mdzod khang du spyan drangs te bzhugs pa de yin/yang gangs can mkhas grub rim byon gyi ming mdzod las/ khong la gsung rtsom shin tu mang po yod par grags kyang rgyal dbang lnga pa chen pos/gsung 'bum shing par rnams bka' rgya btab ste par mi chog pa mdzad pas da lta khong gi gsung rtsom rnams kha tshang ba ha cang dka'/ rgyal dbang lnga pa zhing du gshegs rjes/ blo gros brtan pas khong gi gsung 'bum la dkar chag bsdus pa zhig mdzad 'dug /de'i rjes zha lu ri phug sprul skus mdzad pa'i tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum dkar chag dwangs gsal me long zhes pa'i nang du/ pod ka nas tsa bar bcu bdun la chos tshan nyis brgya don gnyis dang / ldeb grangs bdun stong brgyad brgya lnga bcu bzhugs/da lta pe cing mi rigs pho brang du pod bcu bdun la chos tshan nyis brgya don brgyad dang / ldeb grangs bdun stong dgu brgya lnga bcu rtsa brgyad bzhugs zhes gsal yang nga tsho'i gong gi dkar chag gnyis po da sngon mjal rgyu ma rnyed/ de yang zha lu ri phug sprul skus dkar chag dwangs gsal me long zhes pa ljags rtsom gnang ste/ sngar rtag brtan gyi shing par dus zing dbang —2

gis nyams chag shor ba rnams/ kha gso mdzad tshul thos kyang zhib phra'i lo rgyus kha gsal mjal rgyu ma byung / da lta dgen 'jam dbyangs rnams rgyal gyi dpe mdzod du bzhugs pa'i par rnying pod bcu bdun 'di/ zha lu ri phug sprul skus nyams gso mdzad pa de yin nam snyams ste/ da lta rtag brtan gyi par rnying bod ljongs dpe mdzod khang du bzhugs pa pod bco lnga dang / pod grangs dang chos tshan mang nyung tshig mtshams sogs cung mi 'dra ba yod pa'i phyir/da lam nga tshos khong gi gsung 'bum glog klad nang du bcug skabs kyi thog ma'i ma dpe ni/ nye char bla ma yon tan bzang pos 'dzam thang du shing par la brkos pa'i glegs bam nyer bzhi can de la byas te zhu dag thengs gsum byas/ de rjes sngar jo nang rtag brtan du bzhugs pa rtsom pa po tā ra nā tha rang nyid kyi phyag dpe skabs 'gar phyag mchan yod pa/ da lta 'bras spungs gnas bcu lha khang nang bzhugs bris ma pod chung bcu la chos tshan43la bsdur gzhi dang / jo nang rtag brtan gyi par rnying pod bco lnga bod ljongs dpe mdzod khang du bzhugs pa dang / a ri ba dgen 'jam dbyangs rnam rgyal gyi dpe mdzod du bzhugs pa par rnying pod bcu bdun yod pa gnyis phyogs bsdoms kyis/ par rnying pod nyi shu tsam la chosatshan 314byung ba la sdur byed byas te dpe bsdur thengs dang po zhus/—3—

de nas rtag brtan gyi par pod nyi shu la bsdur gzhi dang / 'dzam thang gi par mas sdur byed byas te dpe bsdur theng gnyis pa zhus pa yin/ 'on kyang par ma snga phyi gnyis dang bris ma gcig bcas dpe gsum po rtsa ba'i cha nas gcig mtshungs su bzhugs pa las khyad par chen po mi 'dug /cho ga'i skor la mi 'dra ba cung zad yod pa ni mchan dkyus su shor ba yin 'dug pa rnams kyang / gug rtags nang du bcug te gsal po byas yod/ rtag brtan par rnying dang 'bras spungs bris ma gnyis su dpe ma bzhugs pa/ 'dzam thang par ma'i nang bzhugs gsung thor bu'i skor wa rtags can dang / zha rtags can gnyis dang / za rtags can dbu ma theg mchog gi zin bris rab byed drug pa yan chad/ tā ra nā tha'i zhal gsung slob ma ye shes rgya mtshos zin bris su bkod pa dang / rab byed bdun pa brgyad pa gnyis dza 'go'i dge bshes mchog grub rgya mtshos gsar du bsnan pa/ 'a rtags can nyang yul gyi lo rgyus tā ra nā thas zhabs btags mdzad par grags pa bcas chos tshan121la 'dzam thang gi par ma'i dpe gcig pu las/ rtag brtan par rnying dang 'bras spungs bris ma gnyis kyi bsdur gzhi ma rnyed/ rtag brtan par rnying gcig pu las gzhan gnyis la med pa chos tshan4/ yang rtag brtan dang 'dzam thang par ma gnyis char med pa/ 'bras spungs gnas bcu lha khang du bzhugs pa'i gral nas chos tshan bco brgyad la ldeb193gsar rnyed byung —4

ba bcas la/ zhu dag byas te kha skong gi tshul du bzhag yod pa bcas khyon bsdoms deb bzhi bcu zhe lnga la chos tshan900yod/ da lta nga tsho'i ma dpe g.yar rgyu ma rnyed pa sngon rtsom pa po'i phyag dpe'i gral nas yin pa/ 'bras spungs gnas bcu lha khang / dpe rtags phyi298nang bzhugs gtam du bya ba nor bu'i 'byung gnas ldeb6/ yang phyi508nang bzhugs 'khor lo gsum gyi rnam bzhag chos dbyings rgya mtsho'i rgyan rnam par bkod pa ldeb92/ ste lag bris kyi chos tshan gnyis po ma 'ongs par dpe g.yar thabs bya dgos/da lta nga tshos dpe bsdur dang zhu dag gi skabs su ma dpe rtsa 'dzin byas te/ dpe gsum mi 'dra ba'i tshe rtag brtan la〈〈rta〉〉rtags 'di dang /'dzam thang la rtags〈〈rja 〉〉'di/ dag cha nor bcos la gug rtag 'di/ 1dang / mchan rnams gug rtagang 〉'di'i nang du blug yod/gsal bshad zhu rgyu zhig la deb bzhi pa'i nang du/ kun mkhyen dol po pa'i gsung chosatshan bzhi/ rig 'dzin tshe dbang kun khyab kyi gsung lho sgo'i cho ga zhes pa'i chos tshan gcig bcas 'dzam thang par mar bzhag yoshe pa dang / yang sa bzang ma ti paṇa chen gyi gsung dus 'khor phyag rgya'i skor chos tshan gcig rtag brtan par rnying du yod pa rnams rang 'jag bzhag yod pa dang / khong gi rang rnam gtso bor gyur pa'i lo rgyus zhal gdams rnams su/gtsang gi yul skad yin nam snyam pa'i tha snyad go dka' ba mang po zhig —5

bed spyad gnang ba dag kyang rang sor bzhag yod/da lam bka' 'bum 'di rtsis 'khor nang du blugs pa'i 'gro song tsā 'dra tshogs pa nas zhus shing / par skrun tshar lnga brgya'i 'gro song bod rig pa dpe skrun khang nas bgyis/ tshar brgyad brgya'i 'gro song lhan sprin sogs kyi rgya'i sbyin bdag rnams kyis gnang zhing / tshar nyis brgya'i 'gro song tsā 'dra tshogs pa nas bgyis pa bcas kyi mthun rkyen las/ da lam dngos su par du bskrun thub pa byung ste rgya che'i klog pa po rnams kyi spyan lam du phul ba yin/las gzhi 'dir bod ljongs dpe mdzod khang nas ma dpe pod bco lnga g.yar gnang byung ba dang / 'dzam thang bla ma mun sel mchog nas kyang ma dpe btsal rogs dang / go rim sgrig rgyu/ zhu dag bcas la rogs ram gang mang gnang ba dang / khams sprul bsod nams don grub mchog nas nyang yul chos 'byung zhu dag gi rogs ram gnang ba dang / bla ma dpal ldan rgya mtshos zhu dag gi las ka spyi'i thugs 'gan che bzhes gnang ba bcas la thugs rje che zhu rgyu ba'o/ /dpal brtsegasabod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang nas rkarma bde legabangakyis/—6

khong ni slob dpon chen tshu shārnyi 'byeshaṃ r+shanas dang / paṇ+ḍi ta gha ya dha ra/gnyos lo tsā ba/ kha rag sgom chung sogs skyes chen mang pos byin gyis brlabs shing / bod skyong brtan ma bcu gnyis kyi nang tshan kha rag khyung btsun gyi gnas jo mo kha rag ces pa'i 'dabs/ chu bo chen po lo hi ta'i nye 'gram du rwa lo tsā ba chen po'i brgyud pa bar ma chad par byon pa la/ shar nub gnyis su gyes pa las shar ba kun dga' seng ge'i gdung brgyud/ sngags 'chang tshul khrims rgya mtsho'i sras rnam rgyal phun tshogs dgung lo bzhi bcu zhe dgu pa rje 'di'i yab dang /yum rdo rje bu dga' dgung lo bcu dgu pa gnyis kyi sras su bod rab byung bcu pa'i shing phag (spyi lo1575)la/ ngo mtshar ba'i ltas dang bcas sku 'khrungs te mes pos pad+ma sri gcod rdo rje zhes mtshan gsol/sku bltams te zla ba brgyad song rjes bzhengs nas gom pa spo thub pa dang / dgung lo gcig tsam nas gsung byon te nga bla ma kun dga' grol mchog yin zhes zhal gyis bzhes pa dang / gzhan yang sku gong ma'i rten gsum dang sbyin bdag / nye gnas sogs kyi lo rgyus gsal bar gsungs pa sogs kyis/jo nang bla ma kun dga' grol mchog gi yang srid 'khrul med du shes te/ dgung lo bzhi par jo nang mkhan chen lung rigs rgya mtsho dang / zhabs drung bkra shis —1—

stobs rgyas dbang po sogs rta pa brgya dang drug cu rtsa lnga tsam gdan 'dren du byung nas/ gtsang phyogs su gdan drangs te sku gong ma'i slob ma rdo ring kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ lha dbang grags pa/ mkhan chen lung rigs rgya ma31/ mkhas dbang byams pa lhun grub/ rje drung kun dga' dpal bzang sogs kyis chos lung byang rtser khri ston mdzad/ rdo ring pa chen po 'jam dbyangs kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyi drung du/ thog ma'i rten 'brel du sgrol dkar gyi rjes gnang dang / gshed dmar lha lnga'i dbang / lam 'bras gtso bor gyur pa'i dbang dang gdams pa mang po gsan/de nas dgung lo drug pa nas yi ge sbyor klog phul du phyin pa mkhyen te/dbang dang rjes gnang sogs yig thog nasaganang ba la dka' tshegs med pa byung /dgung lo brgyad par rje gong ma'i dngos slob mkhas dbang byams pa lhun grub yongs 'dzin du bsten nas/ tshad ma rigs gter sbyangs pas gzhung don la go ba rnyed rung blo 'dzin la zla ba lnga tsam 'gor/ gzhan yang mdo rgyud kyi gzhung lugs mang por gsan bsam mdzad pas mkhyen rtogs rgyas/ byudagung 31 brgyad la phebs skabs stag lung kun dga' bkra shis rgyal mtshan gdan drangs te thog mar bka' gdamasaglegs bam gyi lung zhus te/ de nas bod rab byung bcu pa'i chu rta khrums stod zla ba'i tshes lnga (spyi lo1582)la/ chos lung byang rtse'i mchod khang gi yang thog tu/ dpal stag lung pa chen po rje btsun kun dga' bkra shis rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i zhal snga nas kyi —2

mkhan po dang /'jam dbyangs kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos slob dpon dang / rje drung kun dga' dpal bzang pos dus go ba/chos rje mchod gnas pas grogs dan bgyis te yongs rdzogs dge bsnyen dang bar ma rab byung sngon du 'gro bas dge tshul gyi sdom pa bzhes te/ mtshan kun dga' snying po bkra shis rgyal mtshan zhes gsol/ dag pa'i gzigs snang du rgya gar gyi paṇa chen dz+wa la nā thas tā ra nā tha zhes pa'i mtshan gsol/chos rje brag stod pa lha dbang grags pa'i drung nas chos drug dang phyag chen sogs/ zab chos mang po gsan pas nang zab lam gyi rtogs pa mngon du gyur/ rje drung kun dga' dpal bzang las dus 'khor gtso bor gyur pa'i zab chos mang po gsan/ mkhan po lung rigs rgya mtsho'i mdun dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang dang rgyud bshad/ dpal rgyal ba jo nang pa'i lugs kyi sbyor drug gi zab khrid mtha' dag gsan te nyams len mdzad/ bu lugs kyi sbyor drug gi khrid kyang rdzogs par gsan/ gzhan yang jo zhal bla ma mang po'i gdams khrid dang bka' bstan sogs rgya gzhung gi man ngag mang po dang / kun mkhyen dol bo pa'i gsung 'bum sogs lung mang po gsan/ mkhas grub sangs rgyas ye shes/rdo rje 'dzin pa ye shes dbang po sogs rilas/ sa skya jo nang shangs pa zhwa lu 'brug pa kai tshang / stag lung sogs kyi chos skor bcas rgyud sde bzhi'i dbang khrid man ngag mtha' dag ma lus par gsan/ gzhan yang rgya gar gyi grub chen gu ru lho phyogs pa sangs rgyas sbas pa'i mgon po/ 'jam dbyangs kun dga'i mtshan can sogs bshes gnyen mang po'i zhabs la gtugs te/ zhang tshal pa'i chos —3—

skor dang / yang dgon pa'i bga' 'bum/ dwags po lha rje'i bka' 'bum/ ri chosam drug gi khrid/ mi tri bcu gsum ma'i dbang / sangs rgyas thod pa'i dbang /o rgyan bsnyen sgrub skor gyi khrid lung yongs rdzogs/ mar pa nas brgyud rngog pa'i bka' babasadagyes rdor yab yum/ gur rigs bsdus/ gdan bzhi yab yum/ ma hā mā ya ste drug : ti nas brgyud pa 'jam dpal gsang ldan bcas rngog dkyil bdun/rngog ṭīka rin chen rgyan 'dra'i mdzub khrid/brtag gnyis sa rngog gnyis ga'i bshad srol/ stag lung thang pa'i bka' 'bum/sgrub thabs brgya rtsa'i rjes gnang /nigu chos drug 'jam dkar gyi rjes gnang /'grel wo dri med 'od dang /rdo rje snying 'grel dang / dgyes pa rdo rje'i rgya gzhung / dgyes rdor skor la gtso che'i chosasna sum cu so dgu dang / gdan bzhi'i khrid tshul rgyasapa/ ār+ya de wa'i chosalnga sogasargya gzhung bcu/ sar ha'i chosalnga/nag po'i gzhung drug lha hi smad lnga/dril bu skor gsum/ gshed dmar bi rū pa'i gzhung brgyad/ ku ku ri pa'i chosabadun/ sgrub thabs mtsho skyes sogs dgyes rdor gyi gzhung shin tu mang po dang / dpe med 'tsho'i sbyor drug rtsa 'grel/dza lan+dha ri'i do ha/ sems kyi phyag rgya sogs mdo sngags spyi dang /byukhyad par du gsang sngags rgyud sde'i dbang bskyed rdzogasamatha' yas pa gsan/de nas dgung lo bcu bdun pa rab byung bcu pa'i lcags yos hor zla bcu gcig pa'i tshes bcu bdun (spyi lo1591)la/ 'jam dbyangs kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyis mkhan po/ bla ma byamasapa lhun grub kyis las kyi slob dpon/dge ba'i bshes gnyen blo bzang pa dang / rje drung kun dga' bsod nams —4

sogs kyis kha skong gnang ste bsnyen par rdzogs pa dge slong gi sdom pa bzhes te/ phyi ltar ngur smig gi rgyal mtshan 'chang ba'i dge slong 'dul ba 'dzin pa/nang ltar gzhan phan snying rje chen pos thugs rgyud yongs su brlan pa'i rgyal sras sems pa chen po/ gsang ba bskyed rdzogs kyi zab gnad la mnga' brnyes pa'i sngags 'chang rdo rje 'dzin pa zhig tu gyur/de nas bsam sdings su dpal ldan bla ma dam pa byams pa'i mtshan can gyi drung du rdo rje phreng ba'i dbang yongs rdzogs dang / dpal mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i dbang bcas zhus/ bla ma dpal ldan chos kyi bzang po'i zhal snga nas/ rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor la brten nas dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang yongs su rdzogs pa bdag po chen po'i mthar thug pa dang / gsang bdag 'khor lo chen po/dril bu lha lnga/ gzungasagrwa lnga/ dril bu lusadakyil sogasadabang mang po gsan/gzhan yang dge ba'i bshesaganyen rnams las/ gsang 'dusa'aphagasalugs dang / zhabs lugs/ gshin rje gshed dgra gdong 'jigs gsum/gshed dmar bram ze dpal 'dzin gyi lugs/ gdan bzhi'i gzhung bdun/sangs rgyas thod pa phyogs kyi rgya gzhung mang po dang /rgyud sde 'og ma ci rigs pa dang /grub pa sde bdun/ snying po skor drug yid la mi byed pa'i chos skor rnams dang / phreng ba skor gsum/rgyud 'grel grags can phal che ba dang /bslab btus dang / byang sa sogs gzhung mang por thos bsam gnang bas blo gros kyi lus stobs ches cher rgyas te gzhung lugs rab 'byams smra ba'i mkhas pa wo por gyur/—5

de nas bla ma kun dga'i mtshan can dang slob dpon rin po ches bka' bzhin/ rje 'di nyid dgung lo nyer gcig pa rab byung bcu pa'i shing lug hor zla brgyad pa'i tshes lnga(spyi lo1595)la/ ri khrod chen po jo mo nang gi gdan sa par bskos pa bzhin bla brang gi rtsis sprod rtsis len gnang rjes/ skyid phug tu zla gcig lhag tsam bcad mtshams la bzhugs te phag 31'i ljags bsnyen gnang skabs/ rmi lam du ngo bo slob dpon pad+ma yin pa'i rnal 'byor pa gzi brjid che ba zhig gi drung du/ dwags po rnyi ba rin po che dge bshes bgres song gi rnam par bzhugs 'dug pa las/ rnal 'byor pa'i zhal nas nga dang dol po pa ngo bo gcig yin gsung pa dang / bod kyi dge bshes bgres song des kyang nga yang ngo bo gcig yin gsung pa rmis pas/dang po pad 'byung gi rten 'brel de sad de sgom gyi sa bon thebs/ bar skabs su dwags po rin po ches chos kyis rtogs pa brnyes/ phyis kun mkhyen chen po'i bzhed dgongs ltar nyams su myong ba'i brda ru go / cade nas rgya gar gyi paṇ+ḍi ta pur+ṇa nan+da dang pra yā mā nan+da gnyis dang mjal 'phrad mdzad de gsung gleng gnang barmi/ khong gnyis grub mtha' nang par 'dug kyang pha mes kyi chos rig byed la yang zhen che bas/ phyi rol pa'i lha gcig gnyis bsten gyin 'dug pas dbang chos sogasani ma zhus/ rig pa'i gnas thams cad la shin tu mkhas par 'dug pas dogs gcod mang du bgyis shing bstan bcos kyang than thun bsgyur/ bha ra ta dang rā ma ya ṇa la sogs pa'i lo rgyus kyang mang du thos/ de skabs rā ma ya ṇa'i srung ma ha nu ma tha'i cho 'phrul lus —6

byang chen gyi ri dang mnyam pa'i spre'u dang / bha ra ta'i srung ma rgyal po sgyi ma dngos su mthong bas paṇ+ḍi ta na re/ khyod la 'go bar 'dug mthu dang snyan grags longs spyod chen po yong gsungs na yang / chos la mi dad pa'i lha 'dre bsten pas ci bya snyam nas yal bar dor ba yin zhes gsungs/lo dus chag med jo nang du sbyor drug gi khrid gsungs pas ngo ma 'phrod pa gcig kyang ma byung / rgya gar gyi slob dpon su ni r+pā ṇa shrī dang pud+dha badz+ra sogs las zab khrid kyi gdams pa mang po gsan/ jo nang du sgrub mchod la dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor bzhengs te/ 'dus pa bdun brgya tsam la dbang bcu gcig pa rdzogs par gnang / dgung grangs nyer drug skor rwa sgreng du phebs te tshogs su chos 'brel tsam dang / rje tsong kha pa'i bzhugs khri'i steng nas lam rim gsungs/dgung lo nyer dgu par jo nang du bzhugs skabs tho rengs shig la rje btsun byams pas zhal gzigs te/ khong rang la thim pa'i gzigs snang byung bas gzhan stong dbu ma'i grub mtha' la nges shes gting nas rnyed/ kun mkhyen dol po pas zhal yang yang gzigs nas lung bstan gnang ba dang /gzim lam du sham+bha lar phyin nas rigs ldan sprul pa'i sku dang mjal te chos gsan pa'i snang ba sogs gzigs snang mang po byung /dgung lo so dgu par chos 'khor lha sar phebs nas dar chen mang po bslangs te jo bo'i mdun thugs smon zab rgyas gnang / de nas kun mkhyen dol po pa'i sku brnyan gsung byon ma dang / thugasarje chen po/ tshe dpag med bcas —7

byin rlabs can gyi rten gsum po'i mdun du mchod 'bul dang thugs smon rgya chen gnang ste smon lam rgyal ba rgya mtsho yang brtsams/dgung lo zhe gcig pa rab byung bcu pa'i shing yos hor zla gnyis pa'i tshes bcu gcig (spyi lo1615)la/ gtsang pa sde srid phun tshogs rnam rgyal gyis chos gzhis dang / lha 'bangs sogs rgya cher phul nas mthun rkyen sbyar ba las/dpal rtag brtan dam chos gling nges don dga' ba'i tshal gyi gnas gzhi'i las grwa btsugs te/ phyi gtsug lag khang dang grwa khang brgya phrag tsam lcags ri dang bcas pa/ nang gi rten sangs rgyas rabs bdun dang / tshe dpag med/ sgrol ma/yum chen mo/ dzam bha la sogs gser zangs las grub pa mang po dang / dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i sku zhal phyag yongs rdzogs gser zangs las grub pa dang /bde gshegs mchod rten cha brgyad sogs rten gsum dpag tu med pa bzhengs/jo nang du yang lha khang gsar bzhengs dang nang rten byams chen thog tshad gnyis tsam gser zangs las grub pa sorges mang po bzhengs/ gzhan yang lha bzo sogs lag rtsal pa rnams dang po rgya bal sogs nas gdan drangs/ de nas bris pa dang / spar brko shing bzo sogasalag rtsal pa gso skyong gnang bas/las rigasalag rtsal pa rnams kyang gzhan la re mi dgos pa byung ste/ bka' bstan 'gyur ro cog tshar mang po dang / bka' 'bum skor po ti bzhi bcu shing par du brkos pa sogasarten gsum mang po gsar bzhengasaganang /skabs shig ri bo che nas rgya dpe pod bcu tsam zhig 'byor byung ba'i nang / yar klung lo tsā ba'i phyag dpe ngo ma dus 'khor 'grel chen pod gnyis—8

'dug dus 'khor rgyud kyi dpe de dbus phyogs nas snga mo zhig tu lag son byung ba dang / 'grel pa 'di skabs su rnyed pa la ya mtshan chen po byung ste thengs mang bklags pas zung sbyor la yang blo skyed chen po byung / gzhanayangadabang mdor bstan gyi 'grel pa don dam bsdus pa'i mdzad byang la nā ro pa'i mtshan yod pa dang / kyai rdo rje'i 'grel pa rdo rje'i tshig bsdus kyi mdzad byang du byang chub bzang po'i skad dod bo dhi bha dra zhes yod pa sogs mang po byung /yang skabs shig gtsang pa sde srid kyis sog po'i steng du dmag dpung chas rtsis la srung 'khor dang sku rim gnang ba'i tshe/ khong ni rje tsong kha pa chen por lhag tu dad pa che ba dang / khyad par du chos sde chen po 'bras spungs la nye sems kyi bag chags shin tu che ba zhig yod pas/ chos sde chen po de nyid dar zhing rgyas pa dang rtsod pa 'jam po'i sgo nas zhi ba'i smon lam btab kyang / nus pa ma thon pa ni phyogs gnyis ka las ngan gyi dbang gis ded pa la g.yol thabs bral zhes gsungs/ de nas dpal 'khor bde chen/ rtse chen chos sde/'jag bsam gnyis/ thar pa gling / rtag brtan chos 'phel sogs dbus gtsang gi chos sde mang por chos dang longs spyod kyi bsnyen bkur rgya chen gnang ste bskyangs/de nas dgung grangs re gcig bzhes pa rab byung bcu gcig pa'i shing phag (spyi lo1635)la/ rtag brtan dam chos gling nges don dga' ba'i tshal gyi gdan sa 'jam dbyangs sprul sku sangs rgyas rgya mtsho la gtad de/ chos lung rtse dang jo mo nang du dus khrid phyag len rgyas pa gnang nas/ da res ma gartags —9

'dir chos mi 'chad gsungs te bu slob rnams la zhal ta mang po gnang ste/ lo de'i nag pa zla ba'i tshes nyer brgyad la zhi bar gshegs so//slob ma/ sprul sku sangs rgyas rgya mtsho/ mkhas dbang ye shes rgya mtsho/mkhan chen rin chen rgya mtsho/ mkhas grub blo gros rnam rgyal rnams dang / sgam po sprul sku/ chos rje ngag dbang pa/ bla ma chu bo chung ba'i sku skye/ mkhan po kun dga' bkra shis rgyal mtshan/ sprul sku ngag gi dbang po/ tre bo sprul sku/chos rje rin stengs pa/ dus 'bor shar chen pa/ chos rje lha bo pa/ dge slong snying po mtha' yas/ byams pa yon tan mgon po/ ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams/ mi pham dkon mchog legs pa/ kun dga' 'phrin las dbang mo/gtsang gi rgyal sras kun dga' bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan sogs mang po byung /gzhan yang bstan pa'i sbyin bdag gtsang pa sde srid phun tshogs rnam rgyal/ byang bdag bkra shis stobs rgyal/ yar 'brog bstan 'dzin mi 'gyur dbang gi rgyal po sogs mang ngo/ /dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang nasapodze bde legs kyis/—10

rgyud sde spyi'i rnam bzhag gi zin bris bstan pa'i nor rdzas ceXs bya ba bzhugs/ 1bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa'i sgrub thabs rang byin rlabs pa'i man ngag bzhugs/ 98rje btsun seng ge sgra'i bsgom zlas bzhugs/ 113rje btsun seng ge sgra'i bstod pa bzhugs/ 114bla ma sgrub thabs rgya gar ba'i paṇa grub kyi zhal lung dri ma med pasnying por phyung ba bzhugs/ 115kyai rdo rje'i lus dkyil lam dus kyi dbang chog ces bya ba bzhugs/ 122kyai rdo rje'i bskyed rim kyi bshad pa bzhugs/ 136dpal kyai rdo rje'i bskyed rim gyi rnam bshad bzhugs/ 250

nor rdzas zhes bya ba bzhugs/oṃ gu ru gyu bo dhi satwa bh+yo na mo na maḥ gangs ri'i khrod 'dir nges don bstan pa'i bdag /'gran med dam pa'i chos kyi 'bor lo bskor/ /'jig rten mgon po'i rnam 'phrul jo nang pa/ /kun mkhyen chen po'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rigs kun bdag po ma lus 'khor lo'i mgon/ /gsang gsum zung 'jug bde chen rdo rje'i dngos/ /skyabs gnas thams cad gcig tu 'dus pa'i rje/ /kun dga' snying po'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes mchod par brjod nas/ 'dir bshad par bya ba la bzhi ste/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dge ba mtha' dag sangs rgyas kyi 'phrin las su sgrub pa dang / rgyal ba'i bstan pa kho na thar 'dod rnams kyi 'jug ngogs su bstan pa dang / de gdul bya mchog dman gyi dbang gis theg pa tha dad du 'gyur tshul dang / de las skabs su babs pa'i don bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ rgyal sras chen po zhi ba lhas/ ji ltar mtshan mo mun nag sprin rum na/ /glog 'gyu skad cig rab snang ston pa ltar/ /de bzhin sangs rgyas mthu yis rgya lam na/ /'jig rten bsod nams blo gros thang 'ga' 'byung / /zhes spyod 'jug las gsungs pa ltar/ grub mthas blo kha ma bsgyur ba'i sems can —1—

rnams chos dge ba la 'jug pa thams cad dang / chos 'di las phyi rol tu gyur pa rnams kyis dka' thub dang gtsang sbra la sogs pa dge ba'i chos la 'jug pa gang yod pa de dag thams cad kyang / sangs rgyas rnams kyis gang la gang 'dul gyi thugs rje'i 'jug pa yin par shes par bya'o/ // gnyis pa ni/ rgyal ba'i bstan pa las phyi rol tu gyur pa rnams la/thar pa bsgrub pa'i lam tshang la ma nor ba med pas/ sangs rgyas kyi dam pa'i chos kho na blang bar bya ba yin la/ de yang phyogs zhen tsam ni ma yin te/ phyi nang gi gzhus lugs mtha' dag la brtag pas/ rgyal ba'i bstan pa kho na sdig pa mtha' dag spangs pa dang / dge ba mtha' dag gis legs par brgyan pas/ngan song gi sgo khegs shing / mtho ris kyi go 'phang bde blag tu sgrub pa dang /tshul khrims dang / ting nge 'dzin dang / shes rab la sogs pa'i sgos thar pa bsgrub pa dang / bsam pa byang chub kyi sems dang / sbyor ba pha rol tu phyin pa bcu la sogs pa'i sgo nas thams cad mkhyen pa sgrub pa'i lam ston pa dang /gzhung lugs gzhan de dag las ni thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i lam ston pa lta ci zhig smos/ dkar nag rgyu 'bras kyi blang dor la brten nas/ mtho ris sgrub pa'i lam ston pa tsam yang shin tu dkon pa'i phyir ro/ /de skad du yang / bdag ni sangasargyasaphyogs mi 'dzin/ /ser skya sogs la mi sdang yang / /gang zhig rig par ldan pa'i tshig /de nyid 'ba' zhig kho bos len/ /zhes slob dpon bde byed bdag pos lha las phul byung gi bstod par bshad pa bzhin no/ / gsum pa ni/ de skad du yang / gtam bya rin chen phreng ba —2—

las/ brda' sprod pa dag ji lta bur/ /yi ge'i phyi ma glog 'jug ltar/ /de bzhin sangs rgyas sems can la/ /ji tsam bzod pa'i chos bstan to/ kha cig la ni sdig pa las/ /rnam par bzlog phyir chos bstan to/ kha cig bsod nams bsgrub bya'i phyir/ kha cig la ni gnyis brten pa/ kha cig la ni gnyis mi brten//zab mo 'khu 'khrig can 'jig pa/ /stong nyid snying rje'i snying po can/ /byang chub sgrub pa kha cig la'o/ /zhes pa ltar/ re zhig byang chub sgrub pa'i skal ba med pa rnams la/ las 'bras kyi blang dor tsam bstan nas mtho ris la 'jog pa dang /thar pa tsam sgrub pa'i skal ba yod kyang blo chung rnams la theg dman gyi sde snod bstan nas/ nyan rang gi sa la 'god pa dang / blo gros chen po rnams la theg pa chen po bstan cing / de la yang gdul bya gtso bo dang phal pa'i dbye bas/gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi nges don ston pa'i mdo so sor gsungs pa dang / blo gros ches che ba dbang po rnon po rab kyi phul du gyur pa rnams la sngags kyi theg pa bstan te/ de la rgyud sde bzhir yod pa/ de dag kyang so so'i mos pa'i dbang gis yin te/ rdo rje gur las/ dman pa rnams la bya ba'i rgyud/ /bya min rnal 'byor de lhag la/ /sems can mchog la rnal 'byor mchog/rnal 'byor bla med de lhag la'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /bzhi pa la/ theg pa mchog dman gyi lam gyi khyad par dang / theg mchog gsang sngags kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i lam gyi rnam bzhag dang / de las mthar thug gi 'bras bu ji ltar 'grub tshul te gsum las/ dang po la theg dman gyi lam dang 'bras bu'i rnam bzhag dang / pha rol tu phyin pa'i lam dang 'bras bu'i —3

rnam bzhag dang / de dag las gsang sngags khyad par 'phags pa'i tshul dang gsum las/ /dang po ni/ bsam pa khams gsum gyi sdug bsngal thams cad las dang nyon mongs pa las byung bar shes nas/ de las thar 'dod kyi sems bden zhen dang bcas pas/ lam gyi 'jug sgo thun mong gi skyabs 'gro dang /nyes spyod sdom pa ṅge brten nas lta ba gang zag gi bdag med dang / spyod pa gzhan gnod gzhi bcas las bzlog pa dang / sgom pa zhi gnas dang / lhag mthong nyams su blangs pas/ 'bras bu khams gsum gyi nyon mongs pa las grol ba'i phung po lhag med kyi myang 'das sgrub par byed do/ /de yang nyan thos rnams la ni yon tan gyi khyad par mang po thob pa dang / sems can gyi don ci rigs par spyod pa yod mod kyi/ /'on kyang nyan thos dgra bcom pa la yon to gyi khyad par de dag nges pa dgos pa ni ma yin te/ shes rab rkyang grol gyi dgra bcom pa la/ mngon shes lnga la sogs pa med pa dang / dgra bcom pa 'ga' zhig lung gi chos tshigs su bcad pa gcig tsam las mi mkhyen pa yang yod par bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /nyan rang dgra bcom pa gnyis car yang / khams gsum gyi nyon mongs pa sa bon dang bcas pa spangs pa ni yin mod kyang / de dag gi bag la nyal dang gnas ngan len spangs pa ma yin zhing / shebatabya'i sgrib pa yang ma spangs pas na/spangs pa mtha' dag ma rdzogs pa dang / ji lta ba dang ji snyed pa'i chos kyi gnas tshul ma lus pa mngon sum du ma rtogs pas/ rtogs pa'i yon tan mtha' dag ma rdzogs pa dang / sems can rnams la tshad med pa'i snying rje tsam 'jug pa —4

yod kyang / de dag bdag nyid kyis 'khor ba las sgrol bar brtson pa'i lhag pa'i bsam pa med pa dang / sems can nye tshe ba tsam ma gtogs/ phyogs dus tshad med pa'i sems can 'khor ba las sgrol bar nus pa ma yin no/ / gzhan yang nyan thos kyi theg pa'i sde snod gsum gyis kyang / bla na med pa'i byang chub kyi lam yongs su rdzogs par ma bstan te/ de ltar yang / rin chen phreng ba las/ nyan thos theg pa de las ni/ /byang chub sems dpa'i smon lam dang / /spyod pa yongs bsngo ma bshad de/ /byang chub sems dpar ga la 'gyur/ /zhes dang / mdo sde rgyan las kyang / bsam pa dang ni bstan pa dang / /sbyor ba dang ni ston pa dang / /dus 'gal phyir na dman pa gang / /de ni dman pa kho na yin/ /zhes gsungs so/ /rang rgyal rnams la yang / gzung ba chos kyi bdag med la gsal snang skyes pa la sogs pa'i lam gyi mngon rtogs kyi khyad par cung zad tsam ma gtogs/ lhag ma gzhan rnams nyan thos dang 'dra la/rang rgyal gyi lam ston pa'i sde snod la sogs pa zhig yod pa dang / med pa sna tshogs su gsungs pa la/ med pa ni rang re'i ston pa 'di nyid kyi bstan pa'i dbang du byas la/ yod pa ni bstan pa spyi'i dbang du byas so/ /gnyis pa/ pha rol du phyin pa'i lam dang 'bras bu bshad pa la/ de la pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa dngos ni theg pa chen po 'di nyid de/ slob dpon dpa' bos bstod pa brgya lnga bcu pa las/ bse ru lta bu rnams la ni/ /pha rol phyin pa'i ming yang med/ /bcom ldan nyag gcig pha rol phyin/ /drug gi spyi la bzhugs pa la/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /'on kyang theg pa dman pa rnams kyang —5

pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa'i phyogs mthun nam/ yan lag nye tshe ba tsam yin par ni shes so/ /'di la gsum ste/ pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa'i sde snod bshad pa dang /de theg dman las khyad par du 'phags pa'i tshul dang / pha rol tu phyin pa'i lam dang 'bras bu dngos bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ spyir rgyal ba'i bka' la gsung rab yan lag bcu gnyis su yod de de la yan lag bcu gnyis ni/brgyad stong pa'i 'grel pa snying po'i mchog las/ mdo sde dbyangs bsnyan lung du bstan/ /tshigs bcad ched brjod gling gzhi dang / /rtog brjod de lta bu byung dang / skyes rabs shin tu rgyas pa dang / /med byung gtan la dbab pa'i sde/ /zhes gsungs pa las/ shin tu rgyas pa'i sde ni theg chen thun mong ma yin pa'i mdo sde yin la/ lhag ma rnams la'ang theg pa chen po ci rigs pa ni yin mod kyi/ /phal cher thun mong yin la/ mdo sde la sogs pa gsung rab yan lag bcu gnyis ni/ nyung zhinganye tshe ba tsam yin la shin tu rgyas pa'i sde la ni/ mtha' med par bshad do/ /gnyis pa theg dman las khyad par 'phags pa'i tshul ni/ mdo sde rgyan las ji skad du/ dmigs pa che ba nyid dang ni/ /de bzhin sgrib pa gnyis dag dang / /ye shes brtson 'grus rtsom pa dang / /thabs la mkhas par gyur pa dang / /yang dag 'grub pa chen po dang / /sangs rgyas 'phrin las chen po ste/ /chen po bdun dang ldan pa'i phyir/ /theg chen zhes ni nges par brjod/ /ces theg pa chen po bdun dang ldan pa'i/ /lam dang 'bras bu'i sgo nas khyad par du 'phags pa dang / shin tu rgyas pa'i sde snod kyang theg dman gyi sde snod las khyad —6

par 'phags pa'i tshul ni/ theg bsdus las/ shes bya'i gnas dang mtshan nyid der 'jug dang / /de yi rgyu dang de rab dbye ba dang / /bslab pa gsum dang de 'bras spangs pa dang / /ye shes theg pa mchog gyur khyad par 'phags/ /bstan 'di 'di ltar gzhan la ma mthong la/ /'di dag byang chub mchog gi rgyu'i mthong bas/ /gnas bcu bstan pas khyad zhugs gang yin des/ theg pa chen po sangs rgyas bka' 'dod do/ /zhes gsungs shing / gzhan yang theg pa chen po mdo sde rgyan dang / dbu ma rin chen phreng ba dang / byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la 'jug pa dang / sa'i dngos gzhi la sogs pa nas kyang / theg pa mchog dman gyi khyad par dang / theg pa chen po bka' sgrub pa'i tshul mang du gsungs so/ /gsum pa pha rol du phyin pa'i lam dang 'bras bu dngos bshad pa ni/ de yang mdo sde rgyan las/ rigs dang chos la mos pa dang / /de bzhin sems ni bskyed pa dang / /sbyin la sogs pa bsgrub pa dang / /skyon med pa la 'jug nyid dang / /sems can rnams yongs smin byed dang / /zhing ni rnam par sbyong ba dang / /mi gnas mya ngan 'das pa dang / /byang chub mchog dang ston pa'o/ /zhes gsungs te/ de la dang po rigs ni/ sems rang bzhin gyi 'od gsal ba ni rang bzhin du gnas pa'i rigs dang / brgyad stong don bsdus las/ 'di ltar rnam shes rang bzhin rigs/ /bde dang shes rab bdag nyid yin/ /ces gsungs so/ /sems de nyid dge ba'i chos la goms pa las/ byang chub la nye bar gyur pa'i yon tan rgyas par 'gyur ba ni rgyas 'gyur gyi rigs sogs 'phags pa klu sgrub kyi zhal snga nas kyang / dka' spyod sna tshogs sbyin pa dang sogs/ rgyud bla —7

mar ji ltar myug sogs rim skye bas sogs/ mdo lugs lnga bcu pa sogs/ de phyir rang bzhin gnas rigs de gdod ma nas sangs rgyas yin kyang / de sad byed kyi rkyen gyis ma sad na lam du mi 'jug pa las/ de la skabs 'dir rigs sad pa ni lam gyi 'jug sgo thog ma yin no/ /rigs kyi rnam bzhag ni/ mdo sde rgyan las/ yod dang mchog dang mtshan nyid dang / /rtags dang rigs rab dbye ba dang / /nyes dmigs dang ni phan yon dang / /dpe rnams gnyis der rnam pa bzhi/ /zhes gsungs te/ de yang rigs tha dad pa du ma yod pa dang / rigs mchog dman gyi dbye ba dang / so so'i mtshan nyid dang rigs sad pa'i rtags dang / rigs kyi rab tu dbye ba dang / rigs sad pa la bar du gcod pa'i nyes dmigs dang / rigs sad pa'i phan yon dang / theg pa chen po'i rigs kyi dpe rnam pa gnyis dang / rig bzhi'i dbye ba la sogs pa rgyas par bshad do/ /rigs sad na mos pa'i blo skye bas/ de'i 'og tu mos pa bstan te/ de la mos pa ni/ dkar po'i chos thams cad kyi rtsa bar gsungs te/spyod 'jug las/ dge ba'i chos rnams thams cad kyi rtsa ba'ang mos par thub pas gsungs/ /zhes gsungs pa 'di la/ mos pa'i dbye ba/ bar chad phan yon/ mos pa'i 'bras bu'o/ /dang po la/ngo bo'i sgo nas/ sa'i sgo nas/ bdag po'i sgo nas/ chung 'bring gi sgo nas/ yul gyi/ lam gyi dbye ba ste drug las/dang po ni/ skye dang ma skyes zhes so/ /gnyis pa ni/ 'dzin dang bzung dang zhes so/ /gsum pa ni/ grogs blang bdag nyid dang ni nor pa dang / /ma nor gzhan dang mngon sum ma yin gzhan/ /sgra byung 'tshol ba dang ni lta ba'o/ /bzhi pa ni/—8 ci

'phrog dang 'dresadang mi mthun phyogs ma 'dres/ /zhes so/ /lnga pa ni/ dman dang rgya che zhes so/ /drug pa ni/ bsgribs dang ma bsgribs dang / brtson dang mi brtson bsags dang ma bsags dang / /brtan bzhugs ring du song ba'i mos pa'o/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa mos pa'i bar chad ni/ yid la mi byed pa mang ba dang / /zhes so/ /gsum pa phan yon ni/ bsod nams che dang 'gyod pa med/ /ces sogs so/ /bzhi pa 'bras bu ni/ de ltar 'phags pa chen po'i chos ni yangs gyur la/ /blo dang ldan pas rtag tu mos pa che bskyed na/ /bsod nams rgya chen rgyun mi 'chad dang de 'phel dang / /yon tan dpag tu med pa'i bdag nyid chen por 'gyur/ /zhes mos pa'i le'ur rgyas par bshad pa las shes par bya'o/ /mos pa la gnas pas sems bskyed par byed pas/ de'i 'og tu sems bskyed bstan te/ de'i rnam bzhag ni/ byang sa dang / mdo sde rgyan dang / bslab btus sogs las rgyas par bshad pas/ mdo sde rgyan las 'byung ba ltar mdo tsam brjod na/ mtshan nyid/ dbye ba/ bsdus te sems bskyed par gdams pa ste gsum las/ dang po ni/ spro ba che dang rtsom pa che/ /don che ba dang 'byung ba che/ /byang chub sems dpa'i sems dpa' ste/ /don gnyis ldan pa'i semasa'abyung ba/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa la sa mtshams kyi dbye ba/ rang bzhin gyi dbye ba/ che ba'i dpes dbye ba'o/ /dang po ni sems bskyed de ni sa rnams la/ /mos dang lhag bsam dag pa dang / /rnam par smin pa gzhan du 'dod/ /de bzhin sgrib pa spangs pa'o/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa la kun rdzob sems bskyed dang / don dam sems —9

bskyed gnyis so/ /dang po ni/ grogs stobs rgyu stobs rtsa ba'i stobs/ /thos stobs dge ba goms pa las/ /mi brtan pa dang brtan 'byung ba/ /gzhan gyi brtan pa'i sems bskyed bshad/ /ces so/ /gnyisapa ni/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rab brnyes bya/ /bsod nams ye shes tshogs rab bsags/ /chos la mi rtog ye shes ni/ /skyes phyir de bzhin dam par 'dod/ /ces so/ /gsum pa che ba'i dpes dbye ba ni/ /bskyed pa sa mtshungs pa ste/ /g.yin ni bzang po'i gser dang 'dra/ /zla ba yar gyi tshes pa bzhin/ /gzhan ni me dang 'dra shes bya/ /gzhan ni gter chen bzhin shes bya/ /gzhan ni rin chen 'byung gnas bzhin/ /rgya mtsho 'dra bar shes bya gzhan/ /rdo rje dang 'dra ri rab 'dra/ /sman gyi rgyal po 'dra ba ste/ /gzhan ni 'dza' chen 'drar shes bya/ /yid bzhin nor bu 'dra ba dang / /gzhan ni nyi ma 'drar shes bya/ /gzhan ni dri za'i dbyangs snyan bzhin/ / gzhan ni rgyal po ltar shes bya/ /de bzhin gzhan ni mdzod lta bu/ /lam po che dang 'drar shes bya/ /theg pa 'dra bar shes bya ste/ /sems bskyed bkod ma 'dra ba yin/ /kun gzhi'i sgra dang 'dra ba ste/ /klung chen rgyun dang 'dra ba'o/ /rgyal sras rnams kyi sems bskyed pa/ /sprin dang 'dra bar bstan pa ste/ /zhes so/ /gsum pa bsdus te sems bskyed par gdams pa ni/ de phyir der yon tan dbang phyug /sems ni dga' bas yang dag bskyed/ /ces 'byung ba ltar ro/ /bsam pa byang chub kyi sems brtan pas/ sbyor ba pha rol tu phyin pa la slob pa'i phyir/ de'i 'og tu pha rol tu phyin pa drug bstan te/ de la pha rol tu phyin pa — —10

drug gi rnam bzhag ni/ theg pa chen po mdo sde thams cad nas/ zad pa med par gsungs la/ mdo don snying por dril ba ni/ mdo sde rgyan las/ grangs dang de yi mtshan nyid go rim dang / /nges pa'i tshig dang goms pa'i yon tan dang / /de dag rab dbye bsdu dang mi mthun phyogs/ /yon tan phan tshun rnam nges yin shes bya/ /zhes rnam bzhag rnam pa bzhir gsungs la/ de'i don mdo tsam zhig brjod na/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug gi sgra don dang / go rim dang / yan lag dang / dbye ba dang / dngos btags kyi khyad par ste rnam pa lnga las/ dang po mdo sde rgyan las/ dbul ba 'dor bar byed pa dang / /bsil ba thob dang khro bzod dang / /mchog sbyor ba dang yid 'dzin dang / /don dam shes pa'i phyir bshad do/ /zhes gsungs/ gnyis pa ni/ yang de nyid las/ snga ma la brten phyi ma skye/ /dman dang mchog tu gnas phyir dang / /rags pa dang ni phra ba'i phyir/ /de dag rim par bstan pa yin zhes gsungs/ /gsum pa ni de nyid las/ /sbyin pa mi mthun phyogs nyams dang / /rnam par mi rtog ye shes ldan/ /'dod pa thams cad yongs rdzogs byed/ /sems can rnam smin byed rnam gsum/ /nas shes rab mi mthun phyogs nyams dang /nas byed rnam gsum zhes gsungs te/ de yang sbyin pa la mtshon na/ sbyin pa'i mi mthun phyogs ser sna nyams pa dang / sbyin pa sbyin bya/ len pa po gsum mi dmigs pa'i shes rab kyi zin pa dang / sbyin pa de nyid kyis sems can thams cad kyi 'dod pa yongs su rdzogs par byed pa dang / de la brten nas sems can rnams byang chub tu smin par byed pa ste/ khyad chos bzhi dang ldan pa'o/ /lhag —11—

ma rnams la'ang de bzhin du sbyar bas shesaso/ /bzhi pa ni sbyin pa la/ zang zing gi chos kyi mi 'jigs pa ste gsum/ tshul khrims la nyes spyod sdom pa'i dge ba chos sdud/ sems can don byed gsum/ bzod pa la sdug bsngal dang len gyi/gnod pa la ji mi snyam pa/ chos la nges par sems pa'i gsum/ brtson 'grus la/ go cha'i/ sbyor ba'i/ sems can don byed pa'i gsum/ bsam gtan la/mthong chos la bde bar gnas pa'i/ yon tan mngon par sgrub pa'i/ sems can don byed kyi gsum/ shes rab la/ kun rdzob shes pa'i/ don dam shes pa'i/ sems can gyi don shes pa'i shes rab ste gsum mo/ /pha rol tu phyin pa drug po de dag las/ dang po gsum bsod nams gyi tshogs dang / phyi ma gsum ye shes kyi tshogs su zla ba grags pas bshad de/ ji skad du/ sbyin sogasachos gsum de dag phal mo cher/ /bde bar gshegs pas khyim pa rnams la bsngags/ /bsod nams zhes bya'i tshogs kyang de dag ste/ /sangs rgyas gzugs kyi bdag nyid sku yi rgyud/ /cesagasungs zhing / rgyal tshab byams pas ni/ dang po gnyis bsod nams kyi tshogs dang / phyi ma ye shes kyi tshogs dang /bar pa gsum tshogs gnyis gas bsdus par gsungs te/ /de skad du yang mdo rgyan las/ sbyin dang tshul khrims bsod nams kyi/ /tshogs yin shes rab ye shes te/ /gsum po gzhan ni gnyis ga'i ste/ /lnga char yang ni ye shes tshogs/ /zhes dang / /gzhan yang rin chen phreng ba las/ tshul khrims sbyin pa gzhan gyi don/ /brtson 'grus bzod pa bdag nyid kyi/ /bsam gtan shes rab thar pa'i rgyu/ /snying brtse bas ni don kun 'grub/ /ces kyang gsungs so/ /gzhan yang —12

byang chub sems dpas gzhan gyi don spyod pa la bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi dgos te/ 'di'i rgyas bshad phar phyin le'u na yod/ de dag ni pha rol tu phyin pa drug po de dag las rdzas tha dad du med de/ de yang zang zing sbyin pa dang / chos kyi sbyin pa dang / phyin drug gi don la gzhan gzhug pa dang / rang nyid kyang 'jug pa ste/ rim pa bzhin du byin pa dang / snyan par smra ba dang / don spyod pa dang / don mthun pa rnams yin te/ byin mtshungs de ston len 'jug dang / /bdag nyid rjes su 'jug byed pa/ /snyan par smra dang don spyod dang / /don mthun nyid du 'dod pa yin/ /zhes sogs/ lnga pa dngos btags kyi khyad par la/ 'ga' zhig ni pha rol tu phyin pa dngos ni sangs rgyas kho na la yod pa dang / lam zhugs kyi sbyin sogs ni/ de'i sgrub pa yin pas btags pa ba dang / dbu ma la 'jug par ni/ rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi byang chub phyir dngos kyang / /gsum dmigs yod na de ni 'jig rten pa'i/ /dmigs pa med na de nyid sangs rgyas kyis/ /'jig rten 'das pa'i pha rol phyin ces bstan/ /ces so so'i skye bo'i lam na'ang phar phyin drug dngos yod par bshad yod kyi/ 'dir re zhig /mdo dang bstan bcos shas che ba'i dbang du byas na/ 'phags rgyud kyi de rnams dngos dang /tshogs sbyor gyi de rnams btags pa ba yin no zhes shes par bya'o/ /de lta mod kyi/ yan lag bzhi po dang mi ldan pa'i sbyin sogs ni pha rol tu phyin pa dngos dang btags pa gang du yang mi rung ngo / /de ltar na/ sbyor ba'i lam du pha rol tu phyin pa drug gi sgrub pa la gnas pas/ mthong ba'i lam skye bar 'gyur bas/ de 'og tu skyon med pa la 'jug pa ste/ mthong lam gyi rnam bzhag 'byung ngo / /de —13

nas sa bdun pa'i bar ni/ sems can rnams yongs su smin pa'i sa dang / sa brgyad pa dang / dgu pa gnyis ni zhing rnam par sbyong ba'i sa dang / sa bcu pa ni mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i sadang / bcu gcig pa kun tu 'od kyi sa'am/ sangs rgyas kyi sa ni byang chub mchog ste bdag nyid kyis rang don chos kyi sku mngon du byed pa dang / mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa ston te/gzugs kyi sku rnam pa gnyis kyis/ gzhan gyi don rgyun chad med par spyod pa'o /gsum pa de dag las gsang sngags khyad par du 'phags pa'i tshul la/spyir mdo sngags kyi khyad par dang / bye brag tu mdo las sngags lhag pa'i tshul gnyis las/ dang po la/ spyir mdo sde dang / rgyud sde zhes pa dang / mdo rgyud ces pa 'gal ba ni ma yin te/ gsang sngags kyi rgyud sde thams cad kyang mdo sde yin pa dang / cha shas tsam ston pa'i dbang du byas nas/ sde snod gsum char du gtogs pa dang / rig pa 'dzin pa'i sde snod ces kyang bya ba yin te/ de yang slob dpon sharnyi pas zab mo'i don bsdusate ston pas mdo sde'o/ /zhes pa dang /dpung bzang las/ gsang sngags mdo sde'i tshul du bshad kyis nyen/ /zhes pa dang / mdo sde 'di ni nyan byed na/ /zhes dang / gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbangapo'i rgyal po zhes sogs rgyud mang po la mdo sde'i mtshan yod pa'ang mang du 'byung ngo / /slob dpon a bha yā ka ra ni gsang sngags bslab pa gsum ka ston pas sde snod gsum ga'o/ /zhesapa dang / slob dpon arnya de ba ni rgyud sde rnams rig pa 'dzin pa'i sde snod ces pa sde snod bzhi pa yin no zhes dang / dpung —14

bzang las/ lha dang lha min rnams la phan gdags phyir/ /gsang sngags rig sngags rnam pa sna tshogs dag /bye ba phrag gsum dang ni 'bum phrag lnga/ /rig 'dzin sde snod du ni rgyal bas gsungs/ /zhes gsungs so/ /des na mdo dang bstan bcos tsam gyi dbang du byas na mu bzhi brtsir yod pa yin te/ mdo yin la rgyud ma yin pa ni/ gcig la 'phros pa la sogs pa phal che ba de dag dang /rgyud yin la mdo ma yin pa ni/ mkha' lding gi sbyor ba la sogs pa dang / mdo yang ma yin la rgyud kyang ma yin pa ni rtog ge la sogs pa'o/ /'on kyang rgyu pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa dang / 'bras bu sngags kyi theg pa'i khyad par ni/tshogs lam gyi gtso bor byed pa dang mi byed pa'i khyad par ro/ /sdom gsum rab dbyer yang mdo dang rgyud kyi khyad par ni/ cho ga'i bya ba yod med yin/ /zhes pa'i dgongs pa'ang don de bzhin bshad na skyon med par 'gyur ro/ /gzhan yang 'bras bu'i rnam pa lam du byed pa yod med kyi khyad par gyis/ rgyu dang 'bras bu'i theg par bzhag pa dang / sngags dang sbyor ba gtso bor ston mi ston gyi sgo nas/ mdo dang sngags kyi khyad par 'jog pa'am rung ste/ de dag ni sgra don gtso bor gyur pas so/ /gnyis pa mdo las sngags khyad par du 'phags tshul la/ spyir mdo las sngags khyad par du 'phags tshul dang / bye brag tu rgyud sde rnams kyang gong ma gong ma khyad par du 'phags tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ slob dpon tri pi ta ka ma la'i tshul gsum sgron me las/ don gcig na yang ma rmongs dang / /thabs mang dka' ba med pa dang / /dbangapo rnon po'i dbang byas nas/ /sngags kyi theg pa khyad —15

par 'phags/ /zhes so/ /rgya bod kyi slob dpon tha dad pa'i 'dod pa sna tshogs pa zhig yin mod kyi/ /de dag kyang phal che ba gtso bo'i don la rung ba kho na yin kyang / rang lugs ni/ rnam pa gsum gyi khyad par du 'phags pa yin te lam myur ba dang / lam bde ba dang / thabasal mkhas pa'i khyad par dang gsum mo/ /dang po lam myur bas khyad par du 'phags tshul la/ lam myur ba'i ngo bo ngosagazung ba dang / lam myur ba'i rgyu mtshan bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ skye ba 'di'am/ skye ba bcu drug gam/ bskal ba gsum mam/ bskal ba brgyad kyis byang chub thob pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni cho ga'i khyad par gyi lha rnams dngos su mchod pa len par yongs su spyad pa las byung ba'i bsod nams yod pa dang / sngags kyi mthus chu thig pa gcig la yang gaṅgā'i bye snyed kyi bsod nams 'byung ba dang /las dang po pas ma dag pa'i snang ba 'gog pa'i zhing sbyong ba'i ting nge 'dzin mngon du byed pa dang / sngags sam ting nge 'dzin gyi khyad par re res kyang sems can rnams smin pa'i rgyu khyad par can 'di dag /theg pa la zhugs pa tsam la yang yod pa dang / ting nge 'dzin gyi spyod yul gyi gzugs bden pa gnyis ga'i tshul gyis 'bras bu'i rnam pa la dmigs pa'i shes rab rnams/ dang po dang tha ma'i bar du yod pas na khyad par du 'phags pa'o/ /gnyis pa lam bde bas khyad par du 'phags tshul la/ lam bde ba'i ngo bo dang / bde bas lam bgrod pa'i rgyu mtshan bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ lus dang sems la tshor ba rtsub po med pas na bde ba nyid do/ /gnyis pa ni/ 'di la skal ba drug dang ldan pa'i lus kyang grub pa dang / rdzu 'phrul dang ting nge 'dzin —16

mang po thob pa dang / sngags kyi mthus sangs rgyas rnams mngon sum du bzhugs pa dang / sngags dang rgyud kyi sbyor bas 'gro ba'i bsam pa thams cad bsgrubs pas na'o/ /gan+da/ma pa/ thabs la mkhas pas khyad par du 'phags pa la/ bslab pa gsum gyi sgo nas dang / spyod yul du 'jug pa'i sgo nas khyad par du 'phags pa ste gnyis las/ dang po ni/ rig pa 'dzin pa rnams dang tshul khrims mnyam pas/lha dgyes pa dang / spyod yul khyad par can dang 'brel ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang /shes rab dang gsum mo/ /gnyis pa ni/ spyod yul thams cad du lha dang sngags kyi thabs khyad par can yod pas na/ thabs la mkhas pas khyad par du 'phags pa'o/ /de yang pha rol tu phyin pa'i tshul las bshad pa'i bslab pa gsum dang /spyod yul la 'jug pa'i thabs mkhas kyi khyad par de dag ni 'dir ciyod mod kyi/pha rol tu phyin pa la med pa'i khyad par de dag dang ldan pas na/ thabs la mkhas pa'i khyad par du gyur pa ste/ go rim bzhin du/ sgrol ma 'byung ba'i rgyud las/ bskal ba grangs med sum cu gnyis/ /'bad kyang da dung byang chub med/ /bde bas tshe 'dir 'grub 'gyur ba/ /de phyir 'dod chags chen po bstan/ /zhes dang / bde bsabade ba thob gyur te/ /sangs rgyas bde ba bde chen no/ /'bras bu dang mtshungs rgyu sgrub pa/ /ma tshang stong pas mya ngan 'das/ /zhes dang / ji skad du/ /sems can don kun legs bsgrub phyir/ /blo chen la ni thabs thams cad/ /dbye ba rnam bzhir tshul gyis mchog /'gro ba'i ston pas gsungs pa yin/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa rgyud sde rnams kyang gong ma gong ma khyad par du —17

'phags pa'i tshul ni/ de yang bya ba'i rgyud la gong du bshad pa'i khyad par 'phags chos de dag ni tshang ba yin kyang bdag bskyed kyi lha'i bsnyems pa med pa dang / bris sku la sogs pa'i rten 'ga' zhig lhar sgom pa dang / dkyil 'khor du lha spyan 'dren pa sogs lha'i snyems pa nye tshe ba tsam zhig yod pa dang /bya ba'i rgyud chen po'am gnyis ga'i rgyud dam/ spyod pa'i rgyud du bdag nyid lhar bskyed pa yod pa dang / dkyil 'khor gyi lha bskyed chog gi bskyed pa yod pas/lha'i snyems pa cung zad rgyas pa'i tshul gyis 'jug pa yin la/ rgyud sde de gnyis char du/ lha dang sngags kyi dam tshig dang sdom pa tsam yod kyang / rigs lnga'i dam tshig dang / khyad par can gyi lha'i sdom pa sogs med la/ rnal 'byor gyi rgyud yan chad du ni de dag kyang yod cipa dang / khyad par rnal 'byor rgyud du thun mtshams su snang ba thams cad lhar sgom pa sogs med kyang / dang por ma dag pa'i snang ba thams cad stong pa nyid du sbyangs nas/ de nas bdag nyid dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo rgyas par bsgoms pa ste/ lha'i snyems pa khyab pa'i tshul gyis 'jug pa'o/ /gzhan yang 'di la mngon byang lngas lhar bskyed pa yod pas/ 'bras bu lam byed mchog kyang tshang ba yin no/ /rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i theg pa 'di la nang tshan du lam gyi 'gros mi 'dra ba cung zad yod kyang / gtso bo'i don la mtshungs pa kho na yin pas/ 'di la rgyud sde 'og ma rnams la yang med pa'i bskur bya dbang bzhi'i sgo nas khyad par du 'phags pa dang / rigs lnga'i dam tshig kyang rnal 'byor rgyud las ches lhag pa dang / bsrung bya'i dam tshig kyang shin —18

tu rgyas par yod pa dang / bde ba'i sdom pa yongs su rdzogs par thob pa dang /'bras bu lam byed kyang 'og ma las lhag pa dang / bskyed rim gyi skabs su 'khor ba'i rnam pa dang mthun pa'i lam bsgoms pas/ de sbyong ba'i gnad zab mo yod pa dang / snang ba thams cad dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo sgom pa'i thabs mkhas khyad par can dang / yan lag drug dang / rim pa lnga dang / phyag rgya bzhi la sogs pa/ rtsa thig rlung gsum la gnad du bsnun pa'i dmigs bcas kyi rdzogs rim dang / zhu bde lhan skyes dang / rang bzhin lhan skyes kyi bde ba sgom pa dmigs med rdzogs rim dang / bde ba chen pos brgyan pa'i lta ba rnam par dag pa dang / lam gyi grogs spyod pa dang nye rgyu sogs mdor na thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad par dpag tu med pa lhag pa yin la/ de dag kyang mdor bsdu na/ bde ba'i sdom pa tshul khrims dang / bag chags spyong ba dang / gong ma'i rnam pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang / bde ba khyab pa dang / spyod yul de nyid la dmigs pa'i shes rab dang / snying rje chen po dang / mnyam pa nyid dang rang bzhin med pa dang /bde ba dang / lha'i rnam pas khyab pa dang / des de dag nyid mchog la sbyor bas spyod yul la 'jug pa dang / tshul khrims ni thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa dang / rgya che ba dang / zab pa'i khyad par dang / ting nge 'dzin dang shes rab kyi thun mong dang ma yin pa dang / rgya che ba dang / zab pa'i khyad par du 'phags pa dang / gzhan yang bde ba chen po'i ye shes kyi rgyus tshogs gnyis myur du rdzogs par byed pa yin te/ de la bde ba ni snying rje'i rang bzhin/ de nyid rang bzhin med cing / dmigs pa med par mngon sum mam/ mngon sum gyi tshul gyis las —19

dang po pas bskyed pas/ bde bas stong pa phul du 'gyur ba mngon sum gyis rnam pa dang / des kyang bsod nams phul du phyin par 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa theg mchog gsang sngags kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i lam gyi rnam par gzhag pa la gnyis/ sngags rgyud kyi rab dbye bshad pa dang / lam gyi rim pa dngos bshad pa'o/ /dngapo la sngags rgyud kyi ngo bo bshad pa dang / de'i rnam grangs dang / 'jig rten pa'i rgyud bshad pa dang / sngags kyi theg pa'i rang bzhin bshad pa dang / de'i dbye ba bshad pa dang / 'jig rten pa'i theg pa la dngos btags kyi dbye ba bshad pa'o/ /dang po la sngags ni gsang sngags rnams dang bde ba chen po'i ye shes so/ khyud ni de'i sbyor ba ste las dang / dngos grub kyi tshogasarnams te/ ji skad du/ yid ni man zhes bya bar bshad/ /tra ni skyob par byed pa'i don/ /zhes sngags kyidon bde ba chen po'i ye shes kyis mtshan rtog las skyob pa'o/ /yang na gsang sngags zhes bya ba ni mas ste/ de las ma nu na yid yin la/ sgo lnga'i rnam shes rjes su 'brang ba'i yid dang bcas pa'o/ /tra sheya ni skyob pa ste/ bskyed rdzogs gnyis kyi thabs mkhas kyis/ sgo lnga'i rnam shes rjes 'brang dang bcas pa'i rnam rtog gi yid la skyob pas na gsang sngagasaso/ /bskyed rdzogs gnyis po de bzhen par byed pas na gsang sngags kyi theg pa'o/ /de skad du yang / ma ni de bzhin yid yin te/ /gang gang rgyu dang rkyen las byung / /yul dang dbang po yin no gsungs/ /tra ni de bzhin skyob par mdzod/ /ces dang / ma ni ston pa mtshan ma bral/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i dbugs dbyung ba/ shes rab chen po bdag gis bshad/ /tra ni de bzhin skyob par brjod/ /de bzhin —20

gshegs pa'i dbugs dbyung ba/ /snying rje chen po bdag gis bshad/ /stong pa dang ni snying rje gnyis/ /gnyis su med pa gnyis kyi tshul/ /gsang sngags zhes ni de la brjod/ /zhes so/ / ciyang na sngags rnams rgyud kyi nang du 'du ba yin te/ de la rgyud ces bya ba ni sngags rnams dang de'i cho ga'o/ /de ston par byed pa'i bka'i tshogs la rdo rje theg pa'i sde snod dang / rgyud cesabya ba yin pa'i phyir ro/ / gnyisapa ni/ rig pa 'dzin pa'i sde snod dang / sngags kyi sde snod dang / chos 'di pa rnams kyi rgyud dang / rdo rje theg pa'i sde snod zhes pa rnams rnam grangs dang / gzhan yang rdo rje theg pa dang / sngags kyi theg pa dang / rig pa 'dzin pa'i theg pa dang / 'bras bu'i theg pa zhes pa rnams rnam grangs yin no/ /gsum pa ni/ dbang phyug gis byas pa dang / drang srong gis byasapa dang / lha dang 'byung po dang / gsang ba pa dag dang / sngags mkhan dag gis byas pa dag yin te/ de dag ni rdo rje'i theg pa dang / sngags kyi sde snod ni ma yin te/ gzhan du sngags dang / rgyud ces bya ba yin no/ /bzhi pa ni/ rig sngags kyi sbyor ba gtso bor ston pa'i lam dang / de'i 'bras bu ni sngags kyi theg pa yin no/ /lnga pa la gnyis/ 'jig rten pa'i theg pa dang / 'jig rten las 'dasapa'i theg pa'o/ /dang po ni/ 'jig rten pa'i theg pa gang zhe na/ 'dod pa'i rig pa 'dzin pa dang / gzugs kyi rig pa 'dzin pa dang / de dag gi lam dang gzugs med pa'i khams su skye ba gzhan la sngags kyi sbyor bas bgrod par byed pa'i lam rnams so/ /gnyis pa ni/ theg pa gsum po dag go /'jig rten pa'i theg pa ni ming tsam ste/ go 'phang mi g.yo ba ma yin —21

pa'i phyir dang / de la nges par 'jug pa ma yin pa'i phyir dang / yul dus nyi tshe ba'i phyir ro/ /'jig rten las 'das pa'i theg pa ni dngos te/rdo rje'i theg pa'o/ /de'i yang nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa ni gtso bo ma yin no/ /drug pa 'jig rten pa'i theg pa la dngos btags kyi dbye ba bshad pa la/'jig rten pa'i theg pa yang rnam pa gsum ste/ 'jig rten pa nyid kyi theg pa dang / nges pa la 'jug pa'i 'jig rten pa dang / sems kyi rten 'jig rten pa'o/ /dang po ni/ so so skye bosabyas pa'o/ /gnyisapa ni rig pa 'dzin pa'i sde snod las 'byung ba 'jig rten pa'i thegapa'o/ /gsum pa ni/ tshogs kyi lam dang sbyor ba'i lam mo/ /de la phyi ma gnyisani 'jig rten las 'das pa'i sder gtogs te/ de ston par byed pa rnamasakyang de'i sde snod du gtogs so/ /'phags pa'i sems kyi rang dgar byasapa yang / de'i sder gtogs mod kyi/'on kyang sde snod ni ma yin no/ /gzhan yang sngags kyi tshul gsum ste/ mchog dang dman pa yan lag go /de gsum gyi ngo bo ni bde ba chen po dang / lha'i bsnyen pa dang / sngags dang spyor ba tsam dang bcas pa'o/ /dang po gnyis ni dngos dang / sngagasapa'i theg pa dang / rig pa 'dzin pa'i tshul dang / sdom pa dang 'brel ba yin no/ /phyi ma ni de rnamasam yin te/ gzhan du sngags zhes pa tsam mo/ /yang sngagasakyi tshul bdun te/ gtan du sa'i lam dang / cha shas can dang / khyad par du gyur pa dang / dang por bden pa dang / phal cher bde chen gyi tshul dang / 'ga' zhig bde chen dang / cung zad bde chen gyi tshul la sogs pa mang du yod kyang re zhig 'dir mi brjod do/ / —22

gnyis pa lam gyi rim pa dngos bshad pa la/ lam ston byed kyi gzhung gi tshogs nges par bya ba'i phyir du rjod byed citshig gi rgyud mdor bstan pa dang /nyams su blangs pa'i/ sgrub pa brjod bya don gyis rgyud rgyas par bshad pa gnyis las/ dang po la rjod byed tshig gi rgyud ngos bzung ba dang / de'i dbye ba cung zad bshad pa dang / gsang sngags kyi theg pa ji ltar byung ba'i tshul gsum las/ dang po ni/ gong du bshad pa ltar rig pa 'dzin pa'i sde snod rnams so/ /gnyis pa ni/ 'og tu 'chad pa ltar gtso bo rgyud sde bzhi po rnams yin mod kyi/rgyud sde thams cad bsdu na/ rtsa ba'i rgyud dang bsdus pa'i rgyud gnyis su 'du ba yin la/ yang na rtsa ba'i rgyud dang / phyi ma'i dang / bshad pa'i dang / cha mthun gyi dang / 'phros pa'i rgyud de lnga'o/ /yang mdo dang / rtog pa dang / cho ga zhib mo dang / gzungs te bzhi dang / de dag gi zlas phye ba'i rtsa ba'i rgyud de lngar dbye ba la sogs pa yod do/ /gsum pa/ sngags kyi theg pa ji ltar byung ba'i tshul ni/ 'di la ches snga rabs pa rnams/ dpal sdom pa'i rgyud phyi ma las/ nga ni 'di nas mi snang nas//lo ni brgya dang bcu gnyis na/ /bstan pa'i snying po dam pa zhig /lha gnas gsum du grags pa de/ /'dzam gling shar lho'i phyogs mtshams nas/ /dpal zhes bya ba'i ri bo la/ /thugs rje mthun pa'i byin rlabs kyis/ /rgyal po dza zhes bya ba la/ /lag na rdo rje snang bar byed/ /mi la skal ldan dam pa rnams/ /byang chub mchog tu 'grub 'gyur bas/ /de la rtag tu gus par byos/ /zhes ston pa mya ngan las 'das nas/ lo nyi shu rtsa bdun na/ rgyal po dza hi'i khang steng du sngags —23—

kyi mdo sde rnams bab par 'dod pa dang / yang ston pa mya ngan las 'das nas/lo brgya dang nyi shu na/ rgyal po sa ti'i khang steng du/ sngags kyi sde snod bab par 'dod pa dang / yang kha cig rgyal po rab gsal zla ba'i khyim du byung bar 'dod pa dang / dus kyi 'khor lo ni/ ston pas dpal ldan 'bras spung gi mchod rten du sngags kyi theg pa gsungs shing / de yang lha la sogs pa'i 'gro ba gzhan rnams kyi spyad byar gyur cing / re zhig 'dzam bu gling pa'i mi rnams la mi snang ba dang /'on kyang sham+bha la la sogs pa'i yul khyad par can 'ga' zhig tu dar ba yin no/ /gzhan yang rgyud sde so so nas grub pa'i slob dpon so sos spyan drangs pa'i lo rgyus kyang yod pa thams cad kyang mi 'thad pa med do/ /'on kyang rang lugs kyi rnam par bzhag pa la gnyis te/ spyir gsang sngags kyi theg pa ji ltar byung tshul dang / bye brag tu 'o skol gyi ston pas gsungs tshul lo/ /dang po ni/rdo rje 'chang gis dbugs dbyung ba dang / rigs lnga'i dbugs dbyung ba'i dkyil 'khor sprul zhing bshad pa mdzad pa rnams te/ sgrol ma 'byung ba'i rgyud las/dbugs dbyung rnam pa gnyis bstan to/ /'di la dang por rdo rje sems/ /phyi nas de bzhin gshegs pa'o/ /'das pa'i dus na sngon byung ba/ /rdo rje semasadapa' lhag pa'i lha/ /sangs rgyas bdag nyid rnam bsdus nas/ /rig ma btsun mo rnam par rol/ /chos 'byung nam mkha'i khams gnas pa/ /ye shes rgya mtsho'i rnam rol pa/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' ni/ /ma lus lus pa med par bskyed/ /bdag nyid bde ba che rang bzhin//—24

sems can khams la rjes zhugs pas/ /thams cad bde chen byang chub thob/ /bde bas mngon par chen rnams la/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyis stong nyid bstan/ /de des grangs med mngon byang chub/ /phyis nas stong par mngon zhen rnams/ /thams cad dmyal bar lhung gyur pas/ /rgyal ba rtag pa rnam sprul te/ /dbu ma la ni rnam par gzhag /rang dang gzhan don cher bsgrubs pas/ /dpag yas mchog tu dgrol bar byas/ /kun rdzob rjes zhugs ngar 'dzin can/ /rnam rtog du mas rnam dkrugs nas/ /de dag gzhan gyi bsam pa kun/ /rdzogs byed bya ba mchog la bskul/ /rin chen nyi ma rnam sprul pas/ /de dag bla med byang chub la//mchog tu dga' bas gzhol bar 'gyur/ /gzhan las rjes su chags ldan pa/ /de'i tshe 'dod chags kyis bcings pa/ /pad+ma gar dbang rnam sprul te/ /'dod chags bde ba'i lam gyis ni/ /brjod med 'gro ba mngon byang chub/ /phyi nas bde ba chags ldan rnams/ /le los mang por nyams gyur nas/ /blo ngan 'jig rten rnam par 'khrugs/ /rta mchog rgyal por rang sprul te/ /sems can brtson 'grus gnas la bzhag /byi bo rkun po dgra la sogs/ /rang rang tshul gyis mngon sprul pas/ /thams cad rdo rje'i gnas la bzhag /brtson ldan spyod pa sna tshogs pas/ zhan tu khro gtum gdug pa can/ /rab 'phros he ru gar sprul pa/ /drag shul gsod la dgyes par gyur/ /srin po gnod sbyin 'byung po gdon/ /ma mo bcom byas rig sngags dang / /rdzas dang mtshon cha 'brul 'khor dang / /sman gyis kyang ni thams cad bcom/ /zhe snang gdug rnon zhi ba'i phyir/ /slar yang bde chen mgon po la/ /ma 'ongs dus nas rab 'jug ste/ /dbugs dbyung —25

dkyil 'bor dam pa'o/ /'dir ni don dam kun rdzob ste/ /longs spyod rdzogs dang sprul pa zhes/ /gzhan ni rgyu dang 'bras bu ste/ /dbugs dbyung gnyis su bstan pa'o/ /'dir yang don dam rnam pa gnyis/ /bde ba che dang de nyid do/ /kun rdzob gnyis kyang 'jig rten dang / /dkyil 'khor zhes ni re zhig bzhag /zhes gsungs zhing / gzhan yang / dpal sangs rgyas thams cad mnyam par sbyor ba mkha' 'gro ma sgyu ma bde mchog gi rgyud dang / rdo rje mkha' 'gro la sogs pa nas gsungs pa bzhin shes par bya'o/ /'di la dpyad par bya ba la/ /mtshan brjod las/ 'das pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis gsungs/ /zhes sogs dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad gsang sngags gsungs par bshad pa dang / gsang ba 'dus pa sogs las/gsang sngags 'o skol gyi ston pas khyad chos su bshad pa mi 'dra ba mang po yod pa/ de rnamasaji ltar drang zhe na/ rgyal sras 'phags pa rnams dang / lha klu gnod sbyin la sogs pa'i 'khor gyi shekyil 'khor du ni/ dus gsum gyi sprul pa'i sku thams cad kyis gsang sngags gsungs pa yin la/ mi'i 'jig rten du ni/ smon lam gyi khyad par mchog dang ldan pa'i 'o skol gyi ston pa sogs 'ga' zhig tsam ma gtogs/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bstan pa la gsang sngags 'byung ba ma yin no/ /de la kha cig sprul pa'i skus gsang sngags gsungs pa dang / shākya seṅges gsang sngags gan+da/ngas zhes pa'i tshig la 'khrul te/ dkyil 'khor sprul zhing bshad pa mdzad pa zhes pa'i rnam dbye ma chags par/ sprul pa'i sku chags bral gyi rnam pa can gyis gsang sngags gsungs par 'dod pa sogs ni/ mun —26

sprul du shes par bya'o/ /gnyis pa la/ mi'i 'jig rten du ni/ sde snod kyi snga rol tu yang gsang sngags kyi theg pa gsungs pa yin te/ bdud btul ba'i tshe/gshin rje gshed kyi rgyud 'bum pa gsungs par bshad pa bzhin no/ /de yang 'o skol gyi ston pa'i sku tshe'i thog mtha' bar ma'i gnas skabs sna tshogs su gsang sngags gsungs pa yin pa las/ bya ba'i rgyud rnams ni/ gleng gzhi nas 'byung ba ltar/ lha dang mi'i gnas so sor gsungs pa dang / spyod pa'i rgyud dang / rnal 'byor rgyud kyang / 'og min dang / gzhan 'phrul dbang byed dang / ri rab kyi rtse mo la sogs par gsungs pa gleng gzhi las shes la/ rnal 'byor bla med kyi rgyud phal cher ni lha dang mi'i 'jig rten du gsungs pa nyung ste/ sangs rgyas nyid kyi byin gyis brlabs pa'i ye shes kyi rang snang las grub pa'i btsun mo'i bha ga chos kyi 'byung gnas sam/ chos kyi dbyings su gsungs pa yin no/ /de lta bu'i chos kyi 'byung gnas de yang / sangs rgyas rang snang gis bsdus pa'i zhing 'og min stug po bkod pa las gzhan du bsam par mi bya'o/ /bla med kyi rgyud 'ga' zhig ni/ u rgyan rdo rje'i gnas dang / sum cu rtsa gsum gyi gnas dang / dpal ldan 'bras spungs su gsungs pa'ang yod do/ /de ltar ston pas gsang sngags kyis theg pa mtha' dag gsungs nas/ mthar gsang ba'i bdag po phyag na rdo rje'am/ rgyal po in+d+ra bhu ti chen po la gtad par grags so/ /des na sngags kyi theg pa'i rgyud bsdu ba po ni/ gsangaba'i bdag po nyid yin zhing/ lha klu gnod sbyin mthu bo che rnams kyis gnas na rgyud rgyas pa rnams kyang bzhugs la/ dpal de kho na nyid bsdus pa la sogs pa'i rnal 'byor phyi —27

nang gi rgyud mang po zhig ni lha'i gnas nas mi'i yul du byon par grags shing /bla med kyi rgyud phal cher ni o rgyan rdo rje'i gnas he ru ka rang byung gi gtsug lag khang nas grub pa'i slob dpon so sos spyan drangs pa dang / dus rikyi 'khor lo la sogs pa'i rgyud sde 'ga' zhig ni sham+bha la nas spyan drangs pa yang yod do/ /'o na gsang sngags kyi theg pa 'di dus nam gyi tshe na dar bar gyur snyam na/'di la bka' bsdu ba gsum pa mdzad pa yan chod du ni/ theg pa chen po'i mdo rgyud nyi tshe ba tsam las gsal bar dar ba med la/ de'i 'og tu ring por ma lon par/ lha dang klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang / srin po rnams kyisaganas na/ theg pa chen po'i mdo rgyud dpag tu med pa bzhugasapa rnams yi ger 'dri ba sogs rtsol ba la ma ltos par/ sprul pa'i tshul gyis 'jig rten du cig car du byung ba yin no/ /bya spyod kyi rgyud rnams ni theg pa chen po dar ba dang dus mtshungs shing / gong du bshad pa'i lha yul nas 'byung ba'i rnal 'byor phyi nang gi rgyud rnams kyang dus de nyid kyi dar ba yin no/ kher phyin 'bum pa la sogs pa'i mdo sde 'ga' zhig dang / gsang sngags kyi rgyud sde 'ga' zhig ni phyi nas rim gyis dar ba dang / thams cad kyi tha mar 'byung ba ni/ dus kyi 'khor lo yin par grags so/ /gnyis pa nyams su blangs pa'i sgrub pa'i brjod bya don gyi rgyud rgyas par bshad pa la/ rgyud sde bzhir 'jog pa'i rgyu mtshan bshad pa dang / de dag gi lam rim bshad pa gnyisalas/ dang po la/ /'di la snga rabasapa'i bla ma dgagrub mtha' bzhi dang / phyi rol pa'i rgyud bzhi dang / rdzogasaldan la sogs pa'i —28

dus bzhi dang / mi rigs bzhi la sogs pa de rnams 'dul ba'i don du de dag dang mthun par rgyud sde bzhir gsungs pa/ phal cher mi 'thad pa med mod kyang /de dang de kho nas dbye bar nus pa yang ma yin la/ de dag gdul bya'i gtso bor byed na ni mi rung zhing/ khyed par spyod pa'i rgyud rnams zhe sdang gi rgyud ston pa 'dul bar sbyor ba ni mi 'grig go / des na rang lugs rnam par gzhag pa ni/ mi rigs bzhi dang / grub mtha' bzhi la sogs pa de dag mos pa'i dgos pa ni yod mod kyis/ rgyud sde bzhi kha'i gdul bya'i gtso bo ni/ theg chen gyi lam du zhugs pa kho na yin no/ /de la 'dod khams na 'dod chags mi 'dra ba rigs bzhi yod de/ mdzod las gnyis gnyis 'khyud dang lag bcang dang / /rgod dang bltas pas 'khrig pa yin/ /zhes so/ /de dag dang mtshungs par lam byed bzhi'i sgo nas dbye ba dang /lha'i rnal 'byor bzhi'i khyad par gyi dbye ba'o/ /dang po la/ bya ba'i rgyud ni lta ba'i bde ba lam du byed pa yin te/ de yang don yod zhags pa'i cho ga zhib mo las/ bcom ldan 'das zhal khro gnyer can la gtad par bya zhing / zhes dang /g.yas phyogs na lha mo sgrol ma 'dzem bag dang bcas shing lus btud pas mchog sbyin pa'i phyag rgya la mig gtod par bya'o/ /g.yon du pad+ma rigs mdzes ma 'dzem bag dang bcas pa gsang sngags kyi tshul dang rjes su mthun zhing / don yod zhags pa la mig gtod par bya'o/ /zhes dang / rdo rje gtsug tor las/dkyil 'khor lha rnams thams cad ni/ /dkar po'i ras la rtag gnas shing / /pho'ang mo la lta ba dang / /mo'ang pho la lta ba bri/ /zhes sogs bya rgyud kyi —29

cho ga zhib mo thams cad nas gsungs pa yin no/ /spyod pa'i rgyud ni rgod pa'i bde ba lam du byed par rnam snang mngon byang las/ rnam par snang mdzad rgyal po che/ /yid tsam 'dzum pa bzhin du bri/ /zhes dang / de yi g.yasasu lha mo ni/ /sangs rgyas spyan zhes bya ba ste/ /lha mo cung zad 'dzum pa'i zhal/ /'od kyi dkyil 'khor 'dom gang ba/ /mtshungs med sku ni rab tu dwangs/ /de ni shākya thub pa'i yum/ /zhes dang / spyan ras gzigs dbang dpa' bo ni/ /pad+ma dkar po'i gdan la 'dug /dung dang kun+da zla ba 'dra/ /dbu la 'od dpag med bzhugs pa/ /de ni bag tsam 'dzum par bri/ /de yi g.yagasu lha mo ni/ /sgrol ma grags pa chen mo de/ /dge zhing 'jigs pa sel ba ste/ /zhes sogs gsal bar gsungs la/ rnal 'byor rgyud lag bcang gi bde ba lam du byed par gzhan rnams na rgyas par ma gsungs kyang /rdo rje rtse mor gsal bar gsungs te/ de nyid las/ lha mo rdo rje ca co sgrog /pus khyud rang gi lha mo de/ /de yi glo na mgo bsgyur zhing / /'grum bcas kun tu lta ba ste/ /bcom ldan 'dasakyi phyag la 'jus/ /zhes pa dang / dpal mchog dang po las/ de yi logs la rdo rje che/ /mda' ni gsor ba la brtson pa/ /mnyen pa'i phyag gis yongs 'byud pa'i/ /tshul khrims rgyal mtshan bsgreng dang bcas/ /zhes gsungs shing / rnal 'byor bla med ni/ gnyis spyor gyi bde ba lam du byed par rang gi rgyud sde rnams nas yang yang gsungs te/ de yang / dpal gsang ba 'dus pa las/ de bzhin gshegasapa'i btsun mo mchog /spyan la sogs pa bsgom par bya/ /dbangapo gnyis ni mnyam spyor bas/ /sangs rgyas dngosagrub thob par 'gyur/ /zhes dang / sam —30

bu ṭa las/ bdag med lhan cig mnyam sbyor zhid ci/ /dga' ba'i gnyis gnyis snyoms 'jug pas/ /rba rlabs med pa'i rang bzhin can/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa la/ bya ba'i rmed/ mdun du lha spyan drangs nas bzlas brjod byed pa tsam las/ bdag nyid lhar bskyed pa med pa rjes dpon lta bu'i tshul gyis dngos grub len pa dang / spyod rgyud du bdag mdun grogs po lta bu'i tshul gyis dngos grub len pa dang / rnal 'byor rgyud du/ phyi rol gyi lha dmigs pa'i rten tsam du bzhag la/ gtso bor nang gi lha'i rnal 'byor la spyod pa dang / de gsum char gyi lha'i rnal 'byor la bskyed rim gyi tha snyad don mthun du mi 'jug pa dang / sbyang gzhi'i rnam pa lam du byed pa'i tshul gyis sgom pa yang med do/ /rnal 'byor bla na med par na de dag kyang yod pa dang / snang ba thams cad lhar sgom pa dang / bdag bskyed kyi lha gnas gzhan du gshegs gsol mi mnga' ba sogs khyad par du mas 'phags pa yin no/ /des na phyi'i bya ba gtso bor ston pas na bya ba'i rgyud dang / phyi nang gi bya ba gnyis cha mnyam du spyod pas na/gnyis ga'i rgyud dam/ spyod pa'i rgyud dang / phyi'i bya ba snying po med par shes pas/ nang gi rnal 'byor la gtso bor spyod pas/ rnal 'byor gyi rgyud dang / phyi nang mnyam pa nyid du shes te/ nang gi rnal 'byor kho na la spyod pa rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud de/ dgyes rdor don bsdus kyi 'grel pa las/ de kho na nyid sgom pa'i nus pa chung ba mtshan ma can gyi spyod pa la mngon par dga' ba rnams phyi'i spyod pa de dag shas cher ston pa bya ba'i rgyud rdo rje gtsug tor gyi zhes pa dang / yang de nyid las/ gang zhig bya ba'i khyad par la yang mos shing / thabs —31—

dang shes rab kyi spyod pa rgya chen po la yang sbyor ba'i nang gi bdag nyid can gyi tshul yang mi 'dor bar spro ba de dag ni bya ba dang rnal 'byor gyi cha gnyis la mthun pa gnyis ga'i rgyud/ phyag na rdo rje le dbang bskur ba zhes bya ba dang /zhes dang / de nyid snang ba las/ rgyud 'di ni sgom pa gtso bor gyur pa yin pas zhes pa dang / 'jig rten gsum rgyal gyi rtog pa'i 'grel pa las/ de la rnal 'byor zhes bya ba ni sems mnyam par bzhag pa'o/ /de'i mthus sngags kyi sgo nas byang chub sems dpa'i dgos pa bsgrub pa'i phyir/ sngags dang / phyag rgya dang / dkyil 'khor dang / dbang sbyin pa la sogs pa sna tshogs sbrel zhing /brgyud pas rnal 'byor gyi rgyud ces bya'o/ /zhes dang / rnam snang mngon byang gi tshig 'grel las/ 'phags pa de kho na nyid bsdus pa la sogs pa nang gi sbyor ba gtso bor gyur pa yin mod kyi/ phyi'i spyod pa rnams kyang med pa ma yin no//zhes dang / gsang 'dus rgyud phyi ma las/ e ma ho shin tu rnyed dka' ba/ /byang chub sgrub pa'i thabs 'di yin/ khyud kyi mchog gi mchog gyur pa/ /gsang ba 'dus pa zhes pa'i rgyud/ /ces dang / rdo rje snying po rgyan gyi rgyud las/ bcom ldan de bzhin gshegs kun gyi/ /ye shes chesko/pa dri med pa/ / byang chub sems ni rin po che/ bla na med pa bshad du gsol/ zhes dang / gur las kyang / e ma mkha' 'gro ma yi rgyud/ khyud rnams kun gyi bla ma ste/ / rtogs sla'ang rtogs par dka' ba dang / /rig na mi rig pa nyid do/ /zhesapa'i 'grel par/ rgyud rnams kun gyi bla ma ste/ /zhes bya ba ni rnal 'byor gyi rgyud bla na med pa ste/ bya ba dang spyod pa la sogs pa'i bla mar gyur pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes so/ /—32—
