gnyis pa/ de dag gi lam rim bshad pa la/ bya rgyud kyi lam rim dang /spyod rgyud kyi dang / rnal 'byor gyi dang / rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud kyi lam rim bshad pa'o/ /dang po la/ 'jug pa'i spyod pa/ sbyor ba'i spyod pa/ grub pa'i spyod pa/ grub pa chen po'i spyod pa ste bzhi las/ dang po la/ dbang dang dam tshig gnyis las/ de la dbang ni chu'i dbang bskur dbu rgyan dag /bya ba'i rgyud la rab tu grags/ /zhesapa ltar/ dam tshig sbyin pa'i dbang / chu dang / cod pan dang / bgegs zhi ba'i dbang bkru ba byab srung gsum dang / nus pa bskyed pa'i dbang sngags kyi bzlas lung sbyin pa dang / longs spyod la sogs phun tshogs 'phel ba'i dbang shis pa brjod pa ste/ dbang gi cho ga rnam pa bzhi ste/ de ltar yang / gsang ba spyi rgyud las/ lha yi rigs rnams mthong ba la/ /dbang bskur ba ni rnam pa bzhi/ /bla ma mnyam par bzhag pa yis/ /de dag shes nas ci rigs bya/ /slob dpon go 'phang thob pa'i phyir/ /dang po yongs su bsgrags pa yin/ /rig sngags rnams ni bsgrub pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa legs par bshad pa yin/ /rig gsum dbang bskur cho ga yang / /mdor bsdus nas ni bsgrags pa yin/ /bzhi pa 'byor pa thob pa'i phyir/ /cho ga rgyas par bshad do/ /zhes gsungs so/ /gnyis pa la thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa gnyis/ dang po la/ de'i bslab bya ni/ dkon mchog la dad pa dang / gsang sngags la dad pa dang / theg pa chen po la dga' ba dang / dam tshig dang ldan pa la gusapas bskur ba dang /'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lha la mi sdang ba dang / rang gi lha la —33

dus tshigs su mchod pa dang / ston pa gzhan gyi gzhung mi mchod pa dang / glo bur du 'ongs pa la mgron mchod byed pa dang / byams pa mi btang ba dang /sems can gyi don byed pa la brtson pa dang / bzlas brjod la brtson pa dang /dam tshig g.yin yang ci nus su bsrung ba dang / sngags dang phyag rgya snod min la mi ston pa dang / rang gi sngags rgyud bsrung ba'o/ /'di dag rgyas pa ni gsang ba spyi rgyud nyid las shes par bya'o/ / gnyis pa ni/ dpung bzang la gsungs pa'i bslab bya rnams dang / legs grub kyi 'dul pa'i le'ur gsungs pa'i bslab bya rnams yin la/ de dag ni bya rgyud spyi la 'gro ba yin la so so'i rgyud sde nas gsungs pa'i bslab bya rnams la/bya rgyud spyi la 'gro ba dang / dgos kyi bslab bya sna tshogs pa yod pas/ bye brag phyed par bya'o/ /gnyis pa sbyor ba'i spyod pa ni/ rigs drug so so'i bsnyen pa'i cho ga yan lag dang bcas pa rnams yin te/ de yang khyad chos bcu dang ldan pa'i bsnyen pa de kho na nyid bzhi dang ldan par bsgom pa'o/ khyad chos bcu ni/ dpung bzang las/ dngos grub phyir ni rnam pa bcur gsungs te/ /sngags pa dang ni rang sngags g.yog dang rdzas/ /brtson 'grus phyogs dang sa bzhin dus dag dang / /yan lag rdzogs pa'i lha dang sems stobs so/ /gzhan dag kha cig rig 'dzin grogs zhes zer/ /gzhan dag phyogs dang brtson 'grus dus rnams nyid/ /gzhan ni rdzas dang sa bzhin lha dang sngags/ kha cig sems stobs yin zhes rnam par smra/ /bsgrub phyir de ltar bcu dang brgyad dag lnga/ /de bzhin bzhi dang —34

gsum dang gcig nyid ces/ /sngags rigs rang rang blo yi rnam par 'chad/ /sangs rgyas rgyud la cho ga gnyis kyis 'grub/ /sgrub po gang zhig rang gi yon tan rdzogs/ /brtson 'grus mchog dang yang dag ldan pa dang / /gzhan gyis rnyed pa dag la phrag dog med/ /'dod la ma chags lus kyis nyon mongs bzod/ /gug bskyed klad kor tshang ba zur phyin la/ /gsang sngags dag cing shin tu cho gar bcas/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' bsten pa yi/ /gnas su bzlas nas yid 'ong dngosagrub thob/ /ces gsungs te/ sgrub pa po mtshan nyid dang ldan pa dang / sngags dag cing cho ga ma nyams pa gnyis gtso bor bzung la/gzhan rnams phal pa'i tshul du bstan no/ /de kho na nyid bzhi ni/ bdag nyid dang / lha'i dang / bzlas brjod kyi dang / bsam gtan gyi de kho na nyid bzhi'o/ /dang po bdag gi de kho na nyid ni/ ji skad du/ dang po khrus byas rnal 'byor pas/ / rdo rje gdan la gnas nas ni/ /mchod dang gsol ba lha drug sgom/ /stong dang yi ge sgra gzugs dang / /phyag rgya mtshan ma drug yin te/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar te/ sngon 'gro phyi nang gi khrus gnyis dang / bdag dang / gnas dang rnal 'byor bsrung ba dang / dngos gzhi ye shes pa spyan drangs shing bzhugs su gsol ba dang / mchod cing gsol ba gdab pa dang / lha drug gi rnal 'byor la sems 'dzin pa rnams so/ /gnyis pa lha'i de kho na nyid ni/ de'ang lha drug ste/ ye shes kyi lha dmigs pa'i rten du byas te/ de la stong pa nyid kyi rgyas 'debs pa ni stong pa'i lha dang /lha'i thugs gar sngags kyi yig 'bru la sogs pa bkod pa yi ge'i lha dang / 35

bzlas brjod kyi sgra grag stong du shes pa ni/ sgra'i lha dang / zhal phyag gi rnam pa can gyi sku ni gzugs kyi lha dang /rdo rje gtsug tor la sogs pa'i phyag rgya byin gyis brlabs pa ni/ phyag rgya'i lha dang / rdul tshon la sogs pa lha mtshon byed du bzhag pa'i rten ni/ mtshan ma'i lha ste/ de ltar na drug go /gsum pa bzlas brjod kyi de kho na nyid ni/ so so'i rgyud sde nas gsungs pa bzhin du bgrang phreng gi khyad par ni/ legs grub las/ rgyal ba'i rigs la bo te tse/ /sngags kyi nor bu rab tu bsgrags/ /pad+ma'i rigs la pad+ma'i snying / /rdo rje'i rigs la ru rag sha /zhes dang / gzhan yang dmigasapa'i khyad par dang / bzlas pa'i man ngag dang ldan pas sngags kyi bzlas brjod byed pa'o/ /bzhi pa bsam gtan gyi de kho na nyid ni/ ji skad du/ sngags kyi rnam par shes pa sgom/ /bsdams na ting nge 'dzin la gnas/ /srog dang rtsol ba rab tu bsdam/ /zhes pa ltar/ srog rtsol bsdam pa'i sbyor bas zhi gnas dang lhag mthong gi ting nge 'dzin bsgrubs pa ste/mtshan ma med pa'i rnal 'byor/ de kho na nyid bzhi'i nang nas kyang 'di kho na gtso bo yin te/ ji skad du/ ye shes grags pas/ mtshan mar bcas pa mtshan bcas kyi/ /dngos grub dam pa rgyal ba bzhed/ /mtshan ma med la gnas pas ni/ /mtshan mar bcas pa 'grub tu rung / /zhes so/ /de ltar sngags dang / bdag dang bzlas brjod kyi de nyid gsum shes nas bsgrubs na sangs rgyas thob ste/de nyid las/ sgra dang sems dang de nyid gzhol/ /gsang sngags mi 'gyur gzhi la gnas/ yan lag ma nyams gsang sngags bzlas/ /ngal na bdag la ngal gso zhig /mi 'gyur ba ni yi ger ldan/ /gzhi las gzhi 'gyur de bzhin te/ /—36

gsang sngags phyir ni gang brtag pa/ /yid kyis dag pa bsam par bya/ /slar bsdus pa yis bkug nas ni/ /srog dang rtsol ba bsdams pa'i yid/ /gsang sngags rig pa sngags la sbyar/ yid kyis bzlas brjod brtsam par bya/ 'di nyid kyis ni cho ga yi/ /yang na shub bur bya yang rung / /sngags rig dngos grub 'dod pa yis/ /bzlas brjod gzhan du mi bya'o/ /rig sngags de nyid ma lus dang / /bdag gi de nyid cho ga dang / /bzlas brjod de nyid mchog shes dang / /mis ni dngos grub thob par 'gyur/ /zhes dang / de gsum 'bras bu dang bcas pa yang / de nyid las/ gsang sngags mer gnas dngos grub ster/ /sgra gnas rnal 'byor ster bar ldan/ /sgra mthar thar pa ster pa nyid/ /de dag de nyid gsum po yin/ /zhes so/ /bsam gtan phyi ma la gsang ba'i bzlas brjod dang / bsam gtan ni 'ga' zhig gi sbyong rgyud kyi nyams len du'ang yod/ gsum pa grub pa'i spyod pa ni/ zhi ba la sogs pa'i las rnams dang / lus dang / longs spyod dang /rdzas kyi rig pa 'dzin pa te/ thun mong sgrub pa'i thabs rnams so/ /bzhi pa grub pa chen po'i spyod pa ni/ thun mong gi grub pa la gnas nas byang chub la sbyor ba'i phyir/ pha rol tu phyin pa bcu la sogs pa'i sgrub pa la rtsol ba'o/ /rgyud 'dir ni thun mong gi dngos grub grub nas/ mchog gi dngos grub rab 'bring tha ma gsum gyi dbye bas byang chubarnam pa gsum yin la/ 'di'i lam la brten nas/'phags pa'i gnas thob pa'i nyan rang de dag ni/ lta ba dang grub mtha' ni theg chen yin la/ rang rgyud la skyes pa'i lam ni theg dman yin par shes so/ khyud 'dir ni sku gsum gyi rnam bzhag kyang rgyas par gsungs te/ theg chen spyi dang —37—

mi 'dra ba'i khyad par yang gsungs/ bya ba'i rgyud kha cig las ni/ lam lnga sa bcu'i rnam bzhag theg chen spyi dang 'dra bar bshad pa yod la/ 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud kyi dngos bstan las ni/ bskal ba grangs med gsum du tshogs bsags te/ dga' ldan du dam pa tog dkar po gyur pa dang / de nas shākya'i rigs su skye ba zhes pa dang / khyim nasakhyim med par rab tu byung ba dang / lo drug dka' ba spyad pa dang / byang chub kyi snying po la 'dug pa ste/ de yan chad ni so so skye bo dang / de nas bdud bcom ste/ rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin gyi spang bya thams cad cig car spangs te mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas zhes theg dman gyi sde snod dang mthun par gsungs/ de nas zhi ba'i lam la 'god pa'i 'khor lo dang po dang / sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gsung 'khor lo bar pa dang / ston pa nyid kyi nyams myong mngon du mdzad pa 'khor lo tha ma rnams rim can du gsungs shing / de nas mnyan yod du mu stegs brtul ba dang / grong khyer me thab tu lha las bab pa dang / sum su rtsa gsum du gshegs nas lha la sogs pa'i 'gro ba dpag tu med pa bden pa la bkod pa dang / de nas gnas gtsang ma'i steng gi nam mkhar bzhugs te/ sngags kyi theg pa gsungs par bshad do/ /lam dang 'bras bu de lta bu ston pa'i rgyud la rigs drug tu yod de/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs/ rdo rje'i rigs/ pad+ma'i rigs te 'jig rten las 'das pa'i rigs gsum dang / nor bu'i rigs/ lnga rtsen gyi rigs/ 'jig rten phal pa'i rigs te 'jig rten pa'i rigs gsum/ de ltar na drug go / de dag la rgyas par phye na 'jig rten las 'das pa gsum po de dag re re la —38

yang rigs kyi gtso bo dang / rigs kyi bdag po dang / rigs kyi yum dang /gtsug tor ba dang / rigs kyi khro bo khro mo dang / rigs kyi pho nya pho mo dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs su bsdus pa'i byang sems dang / gnas gtsang gi lha la sogs pa'i rgyud sde brgyad dam bdun du phye ba dang / lhag ma rnams la 'di ci rigs par phye ba yod do/ /de thams cad bsdu na/ rigs bzhir 'du ba yin te/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i rigs gsum dang 'jig rten 'khyam pa'o/ /de ltar rigs drug kyang gsum du 'dus te/ dpung bzang gi bsdus don 'grel pa'i brjed byang las/nor can ni pad+ma'i rigs kyis bsdus so/ /rgyas pa ni rdo rje'i rigs kyis bsdus so/ /'jig rten pa'i rigs kyang de dag gi 'gab tu 'dus par rig par bya'o/ /de dag gis ma bsdus pa rnams ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i byin gyis brlabs las byung ba ma yin yang byang chub sems dpa' sa gnas pa ltar bde bar gshegs pa nyid kyi rigs su skyes pa yang ma yin pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs la brten pa zhes gdags te/ zhes bshad la/ mtshan nyid dang sngags la bltas na nor bu'i rigs dang / rgyas pa'i rigs gnyis ka rdo rje'i rigs su 'du ba 'dra'o/ /dpung bzang las/ kha cig nga'i rigs su gtogs pa ste/ kha cig kyang ni pad+ma'i rigs su gtogs/ kha cig nor gyis rigs su gtogs pa yin/ /gzhan yang kha cig gnas med rnam par 'khyams/ /nor spyod ces pa nor gyi rigs su gsungs/ /nga yis rdo rje'i rigs la rab tu bsten/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang pad+ma'i rigs yin te/ /rigs bzhi pa ni 'dir ni lnga —39

rtsen yin/ /ces gsungasal/ 'jig rten pas phul ba'i gsang sngags kha cig rigs bzhi la brten pa'i gnas med pas rnam par 'khyams pa ste/ rigs la sogs pa yin par bstan no/ /'o na de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyis ma bsdus sam zhe na/ de'i rigs su gtogs pa ni gtsug tor la sogs pa'i ye shes las byung ba yin la/ 'di dag rnam smin gyis bskyed pa yin pa'i phyir rigs dngos kyi ma bsdus kyang / dad pas sangs rgyas la rig sngags kyi cho ga phul ba yin pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa la brten pa zhes bya ba dngos su rigs lnga char gyis ma bsdus pas yongs su 'khyams pa yin te/ yongs su 'khyams pa'i rigs zhes tshig don 'grel pa'i brjed byang las bshad do/ /dpung bzang las kyang / gzhan yang 'di na kha cig gnas med cing / /bde bar gshegs la brten cing yongs 'khyams pa/ /mdo sde 'dir ni de dag thams cad kyang / /'byor ba 'dod pa'i mis ni rnam par sbyar/ /zhes 'phags pa'i rigs lnga 'jig rten pa'i rigs dang drug ka la dpung bzang nas 'byung ba'i cho ga bzhin sbyar bar bshad do/ khyud sde sgo drug gam/ gsum po yang / bsdu na gsang sngags dang / rig sngags gnyis su 'du la/ gsang sngagasani thabs lha pho gtso che ba'i rgyud/ rig sngags ni shes rab lha mo gtso che ba'i rgyud yin la/ gzungs ni de gnyis ga'i don ston pa dang / shes rab kyis rtogs nas mi brjed par 'dzin pa yin pas gnyis gar du 'dus pa'am/ yang na sngags gcig lha pho mo gnyis ga'i sngags su 'gyur ba ni gzungs sngagasayin no/ / gnyis pa/ spyod rgyud kyi lam rim la/ bskur bya dbang dang / bsrung bya —40

dam tshig dang / bsgom bya mngon rtogs dang / bgrod bya sa lam gyi rnam bzhag dang bzhi las/ dang po ni/ ji skad du/ rdo rje dril bu de bzhin ming / /spyod pa'i rgyud la rab tu grags/ /zhes pa ltar/ chu dang / cod pan dang / rdo rje dang /bdag po dang / ming ste dbang gi dngos gzhi rnam pa lnga dang / mig thur me long chos bshad sogs dbang gi cho ga yan lag dang bcas pa rnams so/ / gnyis pa dam tshig la/ bzung ba'i tshul/ thob pa'i dus mtshams/ bsrung bya dam tshig rang gi ngo bo bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ sta gon gyi tshe dus gsum sgrib pa med pa'i dam tshig gi lus dbul ba ste/ kun rdzob tu sems bskyed pa dang /'jug pa'i tshe/ zla ba rdo rje'i cho gas don dam du sems bskyed pa dang / mjug gi tshe/ khas blangs pa'i tshul gyis bzung ba'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ sems bskyed gnyis dang dbang gi dngos gzhi'i tshe'o/ /gsum pa ni/ nyes spyod sdom pa'i phyogs su gtogs pa mi dge ba bcu spong ba dang / sems can don byed kyi phyogs su gtogs pa dam pa'i chos spong ba/ byang chub kyi sems spong ba ser sna byed pa/ sems can blos spong ba dang bzhi ste/ gzhan yang spyod rgyud rigs gsum so so nas gsungs pa sna tshogs pa dag yod do/ /gsum pa bsgom bya mngon rtogs kyi rim pa la/ cha spyir spyod rgyud kyi lam thams cad 'jug pa/ sbyor ba grub pa'i spyod pa gsum du 'du tshul bshad pa'i dang po dang gnyis pa gang rung la chad lhag cung zad yod dam dpyod/cha spyir spyod rgyud kyi lam thams cad 'jug pa/ sbyor ba grub pa'i spyod pa gsum du 'du ba las/ 'jug pa la phyi 'jug dang / nang 'jug gnyis las/ dngapo ni/—41—

gong du bshad pa'i dbang thob nas dam tshig la gnas par byed pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ mtshan bcas dang / mtshan med kyi rnal 'byor gyi rnam bzhag legs par thob nas mkhas par byed pa ste/ rnam snang mngon byang las/ gsang ba'i bdag po de la lha'i gzugs kyang rnam pa gsum ste/ yi ge dang / phyag rgya dang /gzugs so/ /de la yi ge la yang rnam pa gnyis te/ sgra dang byang chub kyi sems so/ /phyag rgya'i gzugs la'ang rnam pa gnyis te/ gzugs dang bcas pa dang /gzugs dang bcas pa ma yin pa'o/ /gsang ba'i bdag po lha'i gzugs kyang rnam pa gnyis yongs su dag pa dang / yongs su ma dag pa'o/ /de la yongs su dag pa ni/ rtog pa'i ngo bo ste/ mtshan ma thams cad dang bral ba'o/ /yongs su ma dag pa ni mtshan ma dang bcas pa'i gzugs te kha dog dang dbyibs so/ /de la lha'i gzugs rnam pa gnyis kyi dgos pa rnam pa gnyis 'grub par 'gyur te/mtshan ma dang bcas pa ni mtshan ma dang bcas pace(/ /mtshan ma med pas ni mtshan ma med pa dang bcas pa'i dngos grub kyang 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs so/ /gnyis pa sbyor ba'i dpyod pa la/ mtshan bcas dang mtshan med gnyis las/ dang po ni lha yi ge'i gzugs mtshan ma gsum gyi rnal 'byor la gnas nas bzlas brjod byed pa ste/ ji skad bshad pa'i bsnyen pa yan lag dang bcas pa rnams so/ /gnyis pa mtshan med kyi rnal 'byor ni/ stong pa nyid kyi don nges par byas nas/ rigs pas dpyad pa'i don bsgom pa ni/ 'jug pa'i sems dang / rnam par mi rtog pa'i dbyings bsgom pa ni gnas pa'i sems dang / de —42

ltar ma rtogs pa'i sems can rnams la snying rje chen po bsgom pa ni ldang ba'i sems te/ zhi lhag zung 'jug gi ting nge 'dzin no/ /gsum pa grub pa'i spyod pa la/ thun mong dang / mchog gnyis las/ dang po ni/ rdzas la sogs pa'i rig pa 'dzin pa dang / 'dod gzugs kyi rig pa 'dzin pa dang / ting nge 'dzin gyi khyad par gyis rdzu 'phrul dang mngon shes sgrub pa la sogs pa'o/ /de dag kyang skye ba 'di nyid la 'grub pa dang / bar ma dor 'grub pa dang / skye ba brgyud nas 'grub pa dang gsum du yod do/ /gnyis pa mchog ni sku bzhi dang ye shes lnga sgrub par byed pa'i thabs pha rol tu phyin pa bcu dang / bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi la nan tan du byed pa'o/ /bzhi pa bgrod bya lam gyi rnam par gzhag pa la 'jig rten pa dang / 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lam gnyis las/ dang po ni/ sa bon lta bu'i sems dang / myu gu lta bu'i sems la sogs pa rtsa ba'i sems brgyad dang / 'dod chags dang bcas pa'i sems dang / 'dod chags dang bral ba'i sems la sogs pa 'jig rten pa'i sems brgya drug cu te/ mngon mtho'i lam dang / gnyis pa 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lam ni/ gang zag gi bdag med pa'i don sgom pa nges legs la 'jug pa'i lam ste/ lam de dag gis nyan thos dang thun mong gi mthong lam mngon du byed cing / 'di tshun chad du bskal ba chen po gcig thogs par bshad do/ /de nas nyan thos kyi zhugs 'bras brgyad dang / thun mong gi rtogs pa rgyud la rim gyis bskyed cing / 'di la yang bskal ba chen po phyed thogs shing / de nas theg chen thun mong ma yin pa'i mos pas spyod pa la 'jug cing / 'di'i —43—

mos spyod ni tshogs lam la byed cing / 'di la yang bskal ba chen po phyed thogs so/ /de nas mos spyod sa bcu sbyor ba'i lam la 'jug ste/ ji skad du/ mos pa'i spyod pa yis ni sa/ /sems gsum rnam par bsgoms byas nas/ /pha rol phyin pa drug rnams dang / /bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi rnams kyi/ /mos pa'i sa ni mtshungs pa med/ /zhes pa ltar sbyor lams bcu ste/ rim pa bzhin du/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug gi sgrub pa dang / bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi la rim gyis slob pa'i sa'o/ /de ltar mos spyod kyi sa bcu la bskal chen phyed dang / de nas theg chen thun mong ma yin pa'i mthong ma mngon du byas nas/ 'phags pa'i sa bcu bskal chen phyed kyis bgrod de/ mthar a khaṃ wi ra hūṃ zhes pa yi ge lnga'i gzungs kyi sgo la brten te/ rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon du byed do/ /'bras bu'i rnam bzhag ni theg chen spyi dang 'dra bar shes par bya'o/ /de ltar ston pa'i rgyud la rigs gsum du gnas te/ sku mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo/ gsung mi zad pa rgyan gyis 'khor lo/ thugs mi zad pa rgyan gyis 'khor lo'i rigs rnams ston pa'i rgyud gsum mo/ /dang po ni/ rtsa ba'i rgyud rnam snang mngon byang dang / mi g.yo ba brtul phod la sogs dang / gnyis pa/ gsung gi rgyud ni bod du ma gyur bar grags la/ gsum ba ni/ phyag na rdo rje dbang bskur ba'i rgyud la sogs pa rnams so/ /gsum pa rnal 'byor gyi rgyud kyi lam rim la/ 'jug sgo dbang gi dang / bsrung bya dam tshig dang / bsgom bya mngon rtogs kyi dang / bgrod bya lam gyis rnam bzhag dang bzhi las/ dang po ni/ ji skad du phyir mi ldog pa yi ni dbang / /rnal 'byor rgyud du gsal bar byas/ /de —44—

ni drug gi bye brag dbang / /de ni slob dpon dbang zhes bya/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar yin te/ de la gang du dbang bskur bya'i dkyil 'khor ni/ dug lnga cha mnyam du spyod pa rnams 'dul ba'i don du/ de bzhin gshegs rigs te/ rdo rje sems dpa'i dkyil 'bor dang / zhe sdang can 'dul ba'i don du/ khro bo'i dkyil 'khor dang / gti mug can 'dul ba'i don du/ 'gro ba 'dul ba'i dkyil 'khor dang / ser sna dang phrag dog can 'dul ba'i don du/ rin chen 'byung ldan gyi dkyil 'khor rnams te/ ji skad du/ sgeg pa'i rdo rje sems dpa' nyid/ /ces pa dang / rtse mor rdo rje can kun khro gnyer can/ /rin chen tshogs ni rab bzhed la/ /pad+ma chen po dul zhi zhing / /drag po zhi ba las 'dzin pa/ /zhes dang / kha dog ljang gu las 'dzin pa/ /zhes so/ /'di'i don yod grub pa ni rin chen 'byung ldan gyi nang du 'du ba'o/ /de dag re re la yang sku phyag rgya chen po'i rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor dang / gsung chos kyi phyag rgya chos kyi dkyil 'khor dang / thugs dam tshig gi phyag rgya gzungs kyi dkyil 'khor dang / 'phrin las las kyi phyag rgya las kyi dkyil 'khor rnams dang / de re re la yang / rgyas pa la dga' ba rnams kyi don du/ dkyil 'khor rgyas pa dang / 'bring po la dga' ba rnams kyi don du/phyag rgya bzhi po'i dkyil 'khor dang / bsdus pa la dga' ba rnams kyi don du/phyag rgya gnyis pa'i dkyil 'khor rnams gsungs so/ /dkyil 'khor de dag tu dbang bskur ba'i cho ga ni/ ye shes thig le'i 'grel par/ de ni drug gi bye brag dbang / /zhes pa chu la sogs pa lnga'i steng du slob dpon gyi dbang dang drug la 'dod pa ni mi 'thad de/ slob dpon gyi dbang rang la drug tshang dgos te/ ye —45

shes thig le nyid las/ bdun gnyis bye brag tu ni yod/ /ces chu nas dbang bzhi'i bar la dbang bcu bzhir bshad cing / phyag chen thig le las kyang / slob dpon dbang la bcu gcig dbye/ /zhes dang / rdo rje phreng ba las kyang / dang po'i dbang ni gtso bo ste/ /gnyis pa gsang ba'i ming can no/ /gsum pa kun nas sbyor ba ste/ /bzhi'i bdag nyid don dam pa'o/ /gtso bo'i dbye ba bcu gcig ste/ / bcu gnyis pa ni gsang ba'o/ /bcu gsum pa ni yang dag sbyor/ /bcu bzhi pa ni don dam ste/ /dbang bskur re re sa re'o/ /zhes bshad pas chu dang /cod pan dang / rdo rje dang / dril bu dang / ming ste thun mong gi dbang lnga dang /dam tshig gsum sbyin pa phyir mi ldog pa'i dbang dang / de kho na nyid gsum brjod pa gsang ba'i dbang / rjes gnang lung bstan dbugs dbyung gzengs bstod bzhi ste/ thun mong ma yin pa'i dbang drug go /yang na ye shes thig le las/ chu dang dbu rgyan rdo rje dang / /dril bu ming dang brtul zhugs dang / /lung bstan pa dang skyabs sbyin dang / /sngags dang phyag rgya ye shes so/ /rnal 'byor rgyud la mos pa la/ /dbang brgyad phye la sbyin par bya/ /rnal 'byor bla ma la mos la/ /bcu gcig bdag nyid sbyin par bya/ /zhes pa'i don 'grel par/ sngags phyag rgya ye shes rnams zhar byung du byas nas brgyad du byas nas/ de'i steng du dam tshig gsum bsnan nas bcu gcig tu byed do/ /sangs rgyas thod par/gsang ba phyi yi lnga dang ni/ /bdun pa bcu bzhir bshad pa dang / /gnyis ka gcig tu 'dus pa yi/ /zhes pa'i 'grel par/ phyi'i lnga ni rig pa'i dbang lnga dang / bdun ni sngags/ rdo rje'i brtul zhugs dang / spyod pa'i brtul zhugs dang —46

lung bstan pa/ phyir mi ldog pa'i dbang dang / rig ma'i brtul zhugs dang bdun no/ /gnyis ka dang ni gsum dang bzhi pa ste/ thams cad gcig tu bsdus nas bcu bzhir bshad do/ /gnyis pa bsrung bya dam tshig gi rnam bzhag la/ spyir btang gi dam tshigarigs lnga'i dam tshig bcu bzhi dang byang chub sems dpa'i phas pham pa bcu bzhi de/ rigs lnga so so'i dbang du byas te/ de bzhin gshegs rigs kyi dam tshigasems can thams cad la snying rje chen pos rjes su chags par bya ba dang / khro bo'i rigs la hūṃ mdzad kyi rnal 'byor gyis mngon spyod kyi las sgrub pa dang /pad+ma'i rigs la shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i rnal 'byor las ma g.yos bzhin du/ sems can rnams la gang la gang 'dul gyi chos ston pa dang / rin po che dang las kyi rigs la/ sbyin pa rnam bzhis sems can rnams tshim par byed pa sogs/ rgyas par rdo rje rtse mo las gsungs pa yin no/ /gsum pa/ bsgom bya mngon rtogs la/ bsnyen pa dang / sgrub pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ ting nge 'dzin gsum mam rnal 'byor bzhi ste/ de yang sngon byung dang mthun par dang por 'og min du 'tshang rgya tshul dang mthun par dang por sbyor ba/ bar du ri rab kyi rtser dkyil 'bor sprul bshad mdzad pa dang mthun par dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog /mthar rigs so so'i 'khor lo bsgyur bar byas ste 'phrin las mngon par 'du mdzad pa dang mthun par las rgyal mchog ste/ ting nge 'dzin gsum dang / rang nyid rigs kyi lha dam tshig par bskyed par rnal 'byor/ de la ye shes pa gzhug pa rjes su rnal 'byor/ brtan g.yo thams —47—

cad rang rigs kyi lha'i rnal 'byor du byed pa shin tu rnal 'byor/ de gsum sngon du 'gro ba'i snang stong la rtse gcig pa rnal 'byor chen po ste rnal 'byor bzhir gsungs te/ dpal mchog 'grel par/ de la de kho na nyid rnam pa lnga bsgoms pas bdag nyid rang gi lha'i ngo bo nyid du bskyed pa bsgom pa ni rnal 'byor zhes bya'o/ /ye shes sems dpa' bcug nas de dang lhan cig tu gyur par lhag par mos pa ni rjes su rnal 'byor zhes bya'o/ /rgyu ba dang mi rgyu ba thams cad ngo bo nyid kyi rang bzhin du bdag nyid sgom pa thams cad kyi rnal 'byor zhes bya'o/ /rnal 'byor dang rjes su rnal 'byor dang thams cad kyi rnal 'byor rnam par bsgoms pas sems rtse gcig tu gyur pa gang yin pa ni shin tu rnal 'byor zhes bya'o/ /zhes so/ /de dag la mtshan ma rnyed rnyed sgom pa bsnyen pa'o/ /gnyis pa bsgrub pa ni/ 'jig rten 'das pa'i dngos grub ting nge 'dzin la brten nas gtso bor sgrub pa dang / bzlas pa la brten nas 'jig rten 'das ma 'das kyi dngos grub gnyis rka'i thun mong ba'i sgrub pa'o/ /de'i dang po ni/lha'i snang ba dang / de nyid sgyu ma lta bu la gsal snang dang nges shes brtan po rnyed nas/ 'khor gsum yongs dag gi mchod pas lha rnams mnyes/ de nas phyag rgya sgrub/ grub nas phyag rgya'i las rab 'byams la sbyar/ de nas mtshan ma khyad par can thob nas mngon shes lnga sgrub/ de grub nas dpal mchog nas bshad pa'i rig pa'i spyod pa'i bla na med pa'i spros bcas kyi spyod pa dang phyogs 'dra zhig spyad pas/ mchog grub la/ lan gcig gis ma grub na lan bdun bskyar/ des kyang ma grub na drag shul sbyor bas 'grub pa yin no/ /gnyis pa bzlas pa la —48

brten pa la/ dbugs 'gro 'ong la brten pa kun rdzob dmigs bcas kyi rdor bzlas dang srog rtsol bkag ste bdag dang lha sngags skye med la sgom pa don dam dmigs med kyi rdor bzlas te/ dbang rnon la rdor bzlas gnyis dang / de bzhin gshegs rigs la sgra med/ rdo rje'i rigs la 'brug gi sgra lta bu/ pad+ma'i rigs la phra zhid gsal ba/ rin po che'i rigs la shin tu gsal bar bzla ba dbang brtul la tshig gi bzlas pa —ste/ rdor bzlas 'jig rten 'das pa'i dngos grub dang / tshig bzlas 'jig rten pa'i dngos grub kyi rgyu'o/ /bzhi pa ni/ bgrod bya sa lam gyi rnam bzhag la/ thob byed nyer len gyi rgyu/ thog mtha' med pa'i sems pa/ byang chub kyi sems kun tu bzang po/ lha dang sngags dang dkyil 'khor dang phyag rgya thams cad kyi 'char ba'i gzhi sems kyi de kho na nyid de/ rdo rje rtse mo las/ rgyud ni rgyun zhes bya ba ste/ /'khor ba brgyud du 'dod pa yin/ /ces rgyu rgyud do/ /thob bya 'bras bu ni/ sgrib pa kun bral gyi rnam snang sku bzhi'i bdag nyid can no/ /rgyu des 'bras bu mngon du byed pa'i thabs rgyud ni/ thabs phyag rgya bzhi dang 'brel ba'i lha'i rnal 'byor dang / shes rab sems kyi de kho na nyid mngon sum du rtogs pa/ so sor rang gi rig pa'i ye shes so/ /de la lha'i rnal 'byor ni/ kun gzhi rnam shes kyi gnyen por sku phyag rgya chen po'i rnal 'byor bsgoms pas/ me long ye shes mngon du byed/ nyon yid kyi gnyen por thugs dam rgya bsgomasapas mnyam nyid ye shes mngon du byed/ ye shes kyi gnyen por gsungs chos rgya bsgoms pas sor rtog ye shesamangon du byed/ dbang shes kyi —49

gnyen por 'phrin las rgya bsgoms pas/ bya grub ye shes mngon du byed/ chos dbyings ye shes de thams cad kyi rang bzhin du gnas so/ /gzhi lam 'bras bu'i chings de ltar nges nas/ lam skye tshul bshad na rtse mor/ bskal ba brgya phrag dag tu ni/ /ci ste mngon par brtson byas kyang / /gang zag bzhis ni 'jig rten du/ /bsgrubs kyang 'grub par nyid mi 'gyur/ /byang chub sems ni ma skyes dang / /the tshom ldan pa nyid dang ni/ /bka' bzhin du ni mi byed pa/ /dad pa med nyid grub mi 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pas/ sems bskyed ldan pa/ rgyud la yid ches pa/ dam tshig bka' bzhin sgrub pa/ lam dang lam ston la dad ya phun sum tshogs pa ste/ chos bzhi ldan gyi sgrub pa po/ bsnyen pa la brten nas/ lha'i gsal snang rab tu phyin pa na bzlas pa rtsal thon par gyur pa'i tshe tshogs lam chen po'o/ /de la stong pa'i gsal snang thob pa'i tshe sbyor lam drod kyi rtogs pa skyes/ de las mngon shes lnga thob pa rtse mo'o/ /de phan chad sa bcu pa thob kyi bar/ lam gyi ngo bo'i khyad par ma gtogs bgrod lugs mdo dang mthun/ 'on kyang myur du thob par 'dod pas brtson 'grus rtsom shing bar chad med na/dbang rnon dang / dbang brtul gyi bye brag gis/ tshe lo brgya pa'i mi nas mir skye ba bdun nam bcu drug gi yun tshad la sangs rgyas thob cing / de yang sa bcu pa thob nas bsam gtan bzhi'i rab mtha' sgrub par bshad la/ rab mtha'i snyoms 'jug 'jig rten pa mngon pa nas bshad pa dang ni mi gcig ste/ 'di ni sgyu ma lta bu dang / rdo rje lta bu dang / dpa' bar 'gro ba gsum tshogs pa'i ting nge 'dzin la rnam pa'i khyad par 'ga' zhig phyogs mtshungs pa la bsam gtan dang —50 ci

po nas srid rtse'i bar du ming btags te/ de la ltos pa'i bar mtha' yin la/de yang bsam gtan dang po'i nyer bsdogs mi lcog med pa dang / dang po tsam khyad gnyis gnyis pa sogs gsum/ gzugs med bzhi rnams la mthar chags su lugs 'byung lugs ldog /re re bor ba'i thod rgal du lugs 'byung lugs ldog tu byas nas/ yang mi lcogs med pa nas gsum pa'i bar du song bzhi pa la che 'bring chung gsum sogs dgur phye ba'i chen po'i chen po'i rab mtha' te/ de grub pa na/ byang chub sems dpa' de la ni don thams cad grub pa zhes bya ba ste/de'i 'og min du bzhugs/ mi g.yo ba'i ting nge 'dzin las sangs rgyas rnams kyis bslangs/ mngon byang lnga'i gdams ngag phog paṅge/ ye shes lnga'i ngo bor sangs rgyas te/ 'jig rten thams cad du 'khor ba ji srid par sprul pa'i sku'i 'phrin las 'jug pa yin la/ mdo lam nas sngags la 'jug tshul sogs kyang spyi dang 'dra ba'i rnam bzhag yod do/ /lam rim de lta bu ston pa'i rgyud lnga ni rnal 'byor rgyud de/ de la pha rgyud dang ma rgyud gnyis te/ dang po la rtsa ba'i rgyud de nyid bsdus pa/ bshad rgyud rdo rje rtse mo thams cad gsang ba/ khams gsum rnam rgyal te gsum/ grags tshod ltar na cha mthun gyi rgyud ngan song sbyong rgyud do/ /gnyis pa la rtsa ba'i rgyud/ sher phyin tshul la brgya lnga bcu pa'am/ dpal mchog dang po yin la/ grags pa dang bstun na cha mthun rdo rje snying rje rgyan/ gsang ba rgyan bkod/ gsang ba nor thig la sogs pa yin la/ dpal mchog la bshad rgyud yod du rung mod kyang bod du ma 'gyur zhing / 'phags yul na yang ma grags so/ /yang dpal mchog dang po/ de —51—

nyid bsdus pa'i cha mthun gyi rgyud yin gsung ba yod na'ang / phan 'dogs shing phyogs mthun la dgongs na rung la/ de'i tshe/ de nyid bsdus pa yang dpal mchog gi cha mthun du 'gyur la/ gzhan du na/ rang gis kyang pha rgyud ma rgyud gyi dbye ba mdzad pa dang 'gal lo/ kha cig 'dir bshad pha rgyud rnams dang /dpal mchog rnal 'byor tsam gyi rgyud/ rnam snang sgyu 'phrul drwa ba rjes su rnal 'byor/ snying rgyan gsang rgyan gnyis shin tu rnal 'byor/ nor thig rnal 'byor chen po zhes bya ba yin gsung na'ang / sgyu drwa tshigs rigs thams cad kyang gsang 'dus dang mthun pa sogs rnal 'byor rgyud ma yin pa'i rgyu mtshan mang po yod la/ yo gar 'grel mkhan mang du byung kyang rgyu mtshan du mi zung zhing / lhag ma rgyud de dag la tshig zin la zab khyad re snang la/ rnal 'byor bzhir 'byed pa yid ches byung na legs por yang 'gyur mod/ 'on kyang phyi ma gsum po 'di bshad rgyud rdo rje snying rgyan nas/ bla med rnams dang lhan cig bgrangs pa dang rgyud kyi rang bzhin la dpag na bla med yin la/ brda chad mang po rnal 'byor rgyud ltar bshad na'ang yo ge nas bla med la 'jug pa'i lam gyi mtshams sbyor du bshad pa yin par sems so/ /cha 'dir bshad ma thag pa'i dpal mchog dang po sogs bzhi ga rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud du rang lugs la bzhed dam dpyod/ bzhed na de dag gtso bor rnal 'byor bla med do/ /cha bzhi pa rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud kyi lam rim la/ lam rim dngos bshad pa/ de ston byed rgyud sde bshad pa/ rgyud sde 'chad tshul gyi man ngag bstan pa'o/ /dang po ni/ rgyud gsum gyis gtan la 32

dbab dgos te/ spyod pa bsdus pa'i 'grel pa/ slob dpon shākya bshes gnyen gyis mdzad par/ rgyal ba stobs can snying po yis/ /sngon 'gro 'grel pa kun brjod de/ /don ni rnam pa gsum du 'dus/ khyud dang thabs dang 'bras bu'o/ /rgyu ni theg chen rigs can te/ /dge ba'i chos kyis rnam par brgyan/ /thabs ni rnam pa gnyis yin te/ /dbang bkur de nyid spyod dang bcas/ /'bras bu sku gsung thun mong grub/ /ces rgyud kyi don thams cad rgyu thabs 'bras bu gsum du 'dus pa de nyid rnam par bshad par bya ste/ rgyu'i rgyud dang / thabs kyi rgyud dang / 'bras bu rgyud do/ /de skad du yang / rgyud ni rgyun zhes bya ba ste/ khyud de rnam pa gsum du 'gyur/ /gzhi dang de yi rang bzhin dang / /mi 'phrog pa yi rab phye ba/ /zhes pa 'di ni re zhig lung ngo / /dang po la sdom ni/ ngo bo gtso bo mtshan nyid dang / /rnam grangs ldan pa gnas skabs dang / /mi 'gyur bas kyang rgyu rgyud bsdus/ khrisa'i rgyud gang zhe na/thog ma med pa'i dus nas brgyud de 'ong ba/ sems rang bzhin gyi 'od gsal ba gang yin pa dang / sems dang sems las byung ba rnams dang / snod dang bcud kyi rang bzhin dang / rtsa dang / khams dang / chos kyi dbyings gang yin pa de rnams so/ /de rnams kyi gtso bo ni/ sems kyi rang bzhin 'od gsal ba'o/ /de nyid gang zhe na/ zhing dang / sku dang / ye shes la sogs pa 'bras bu'i chos dang mthun pa'i khyad par can/ rang bzhin bde ba chen po rgyun chad pa med pa/chos nyid kyis thob pa ste/ khyad par bzhi dang ldan pa'o/ khyu'i rgyud dang / sbyang gzhi dang / kun gzhi dang /snyedang po'i sangasargyas ni rnam grangs so/ khyu ni du/—53

gzhi ni du/ kunagazhinidu dngapo'isangasarnyesaniduzhen rgyu ni bcu bzhi ste/nyon mongs pa'i rgyu dang / las kyi rgyu dang / sdug bsngal gyi ste/ kun nas nyon mongs pa dang / snod dang / bca dang / lam gyi rgyu dang / stong pa dang / bde ba dang zung du 'jug pa'i rgyu dang / rags pa dang / phra ba dang / shin tu phra ba'i rgyu dang / gzugs kyi sku gnyis dang / chos kyi sku'i rgyu rnams so/ /gzhi ni bco lnga ste/ snod dag pa'i gzhi dang / bcud dag pa'i gzhi dang / nyer spyod dag pa'i gzhi dang / rnam par 'gyur ba dag pa'i gzhi dang / rang bzhin dag pa'i gzhi dang / 'khor ba'i gzhi dang / mya ngan las 'das pa'i gzhi dang / rang bzhin gyi gzhi dang / rnam grangs kyi gzhi dang / mthar gtugs pa'i gzhi dang / kun rdzob kyi gzhi dang / don dam pa'i gzhi dang / rags pa'i gzhi dang / phra ba'i gzhi dang / shin tu phra ba'i gzhi rnams so/ /dang po lnga ni las dang bya ba'i sgo nas ste/ sbyang bya'i rab tu dbye ba'o/ /de nas gsum ni bcings grol gyis rab tu dbye ba'o/ /de nas gnyis gnyis ni dngos dang btags pa dang / rdzas dang btags pas rab tu phye ba'o/ /tha mar gsum ni rtogs tshul gyis rab tu phye ba'o/ /de la rags pa'i gzhi gang zhe na/dgu po 'di dag ste/ gang zag tu btags pas yod pa dag la brjod de/ tsan dan dang / ut+pal dang / pad+ma dang / pad+ma dmar po dang / rin po che lta bu dang /nyon mongs pas rnam par phye ba dang / las kyisarnam par phye ba dang / lus kyis rnam par phye ba dang / rigs kyis rnam par phye ba'o/ /dang po lnga ni mtshan nyid kyis rab tu phye ba'o/ /phyi ma bzhi ni rnam grangs kyis rab tu phye ba'o/ /'dir kun —54

gzhi zhes bya ba ni/ sde snod kyi tshul las 'byung ba kho na bzhin no/ /dang po'i sangasargyas ni gnyis te/ rang bzhin gyi dang po dang / glo bur gyi dang po sangs rgyas so/ /'di la ji ltar na skyon dang / yon tan dang / rgyu dang 'bras bu dag dang 'brel bar ldan zhe na/ sad pa'i gnas skabs dang / rmi lam gyi gnas skabs dang / gnyid 'thug gi gnas skabs dang / bzhi pa'i gnas skabs kyi sgrib pa zhes bya ba gnas te/ dga' ba bzhi'am snang ba bzhi dang lhan cig gnas pa yin no/ /rlung bzhi dang / thig le bzhi dang / 'khor lo bzhi las dri bcas dang / cung zad dri bral dang / ches dri bral lam/ 'dzag bcas kyi dbang dang / 'dzag med kyi dbang dang / shin tu 'dzag pa dang bral ba'i dbang las/rigs bzhi dang / rgyud bzhi dang / 'gro ba bzhi dang / yon tan bzhi dang / thun tshod bzhi dang / bag chags bzhis rnam par rtog pa bzhi 'byung ste/ thams cad yod par rtogs pa dang / rdul phran tu rtogs pa dang / sems tsam du rtog pa dang / de yang mi dmigs pa ste/ grub mtha' bzhi dang / sde pa bzhi dang / skad cig ma bzhi dang / dga' ba bzhi dang / bden pa bzhi la sgro 'dogs pa'am de dag la ji bzhin du rtogs pa ste/ de bzhin du e waṃ ma ya dang / gnas bzhi dang / rigs bzhi'i phyag rgyas dri ma sbyong ba'i khyad par dang / sku bzhi dang / rdo rje bzhi la sogs pa ji ltar rgyud las rgyas par 'byung ba de ltar shes par bya'o/ /'dir gnas skabs gang zhe na/ thar pa'i cha mthun ma bskyed pa dang / skyed pa dang / so so skye bo'i lam dang / slob pa'i lam dang / mi slob pa'i lam rnams su/dang po'i sangs rgyas dang / rgyu'i rgyud dang / lam du zhugs pa dang / 'phags pa —55

dang / 'bras bu'i rdo rje 'dzin pa zhes ming gis btags so/ /de rnams su 'gyur ba med pa ji lta bu zhe na/ snga ma lasaphyi ma'i tshe ngo bor mi 'gyur ba ste/ skye ba dang / rga ba dang na ba dang 'chi ba dang / 'gro ba rnams dang / rten 'brel rnams dang / rig pa dang/ bden pa mthong ba dang / rnam par mi rtog pa la zhugs pa dang / rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin gyis kyang mi 'jig cing mi 'gyur ba'o/ / gnyis pa thabs kyi rgyu gang zhe na/ sdom ni/ dbang bskur dam tshig sdom pa dang / /ting 'dzin rgyud kyis sbyor ba'o/ /lnga po 'di dag ni thabs kyi rgyud de/dbang bskur ba dang / dam tshig rnams dang / sdom pa dang / ting nge 'dzin dang /las dang / dngos grub kyi sbyor ba'o/ /dbang bskur ba gang zhe na/ bum pa dang gsang ba dang / shes rab ye shes dang / bzhi pa dang / 'jig rten pa dang /'jig rten las 'das pa dang / slob ma'i dbang dang phyir mi ldog pa'i dbang dang / tha mal gyi dbang dang / mchog gi dbang dang / 'jug pa'i cho ga dang /dngos gzhi dang / rjes su gnang ba dang / lung bstan pa dang/ gzengs bstod dang / yon 'bul ba dang bcas pa rnamasaso/ /dam tshig gang zhe na/ ngo bo'i sgo nas/ bsrung ba'i dam tshig dang / sgrub pa'i dam tshig go /bsrung ba'i dam tshig gang zhe na/ rtsa ba'i lhung ba dang/ yan lag gi lhung ba la sogs pa bsrung ba nyid do/ /rtsa ba'i lhung ba gang zhe na/ bcu bzhi po rnamasate/ slob dpon smad par mi bya zhid / /bde gshegs bka' las 'da' mi bya/ /spun la smad par mi bya zhing / /sems can rnams la byams mi spangs/ /byang chub sems ni dor mi bya/ /—56

rang gzhan chos la smad mi bya/ /ma smin pa la gsang mi bsgrags/ /phung po rnams la smad mi bya/ /dag pa'i chos la som nyi spong / /gdug pa can la byams pa spangs/ /ming sogs bral ba der mi rtog /dad ldan sems ni sun mi dbyung / /dam tshig spong dang bud med smod/ /rtsa ba'i lhung ba zhes brjod do/ /'di dag mi shes mi rung bas/ /sngon gyi mkhan po'i lung las shes/ /zhes pa ni bsdu ba'i tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /yan lag gi lhung ba gang zhe na/ bskyar dam/ dgu po rnams so/ /sgrub pa'i dam tshig gang zhe na/ ting nge 'dzin dang / spyod lam dang / bza' ba'i dam tshig dang / mi 'bral ba'i yo byad kyi dam tshig go /rigs lnga po rnams kyi dam tshig gang yin pa de rnams ni ting nge 'dzin gyi dam tshig go /gzhan yang dam tshig ni gsum ste/ las dang po pa dang / brtan pa thob pa dang / brtan pa cher thob pa'i dam tshig rnams so/ /yang dam tshig ni gsum ste/ sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi rdo rje'i dam tshig go /yang gsum ste/ bum dbang gi dam tshig dang /gsang dbang gi dam tshig dang / shes rab ye shes kyi dam tshig go /gzhan yang bsnyen pa'i dam tshig dang / 'jig rten pa so so'i sgrub pa'i dam tshig dang / las so so'i dang / 'jig rten las 'das pa'i sgrub pa'i dang / sgrub pa chen po'i dam tshig go /de la dam tshig dam tshig ces bya ba ni brtul zhugs so/ /sdom pa ni thob par byed pa'i cho ga dang / thob pa'i dus dang /ngo bo dang / dbye ba dang /gtong ba'i dus dang / gso ba'i cho ga ste/ drug po de dag go /sdom ni/ cho ga dus dang ngo bo dbye/ /gtong dus gso ba'i thabs rnams so/ /de la sangs rgyas —57

kyis ma bshad pa'i cho ga las ni sdom pa med de brtul zhugs tsam mo/ /de'i phyir cho ga ni rig pa 'dzin pa'i sde snod las bshad pa'i dbang bskur ba'o/ /dus ni dbang so so'i dngos gzhi rdzogs pa na'o/ /ngo bo ni byin gyis brlabs pa'i sems kyi rgyun gyi khyad par nyes pa rnams bzlog par byed pa yon tan gyi rten thun brtas pa'o/ /dbye ba ni/ thun mong dang / thun mong ma yin pa'i sdom pa'o/ /thun mong gi sdom pa gang zhe na bya ba dang rnal 'byor phyi'i sdom pa'o/ /thun mong ma yin pa gang zhe na/ bde bas byin gyis brlabs pa ste/ slob ma dang /bum pa dang / gsang ba dang / shes rab ye shes kyi sdom pa rnams so/ /de dag thams cad kyang 'jig rten pa dang / 'jig rten 'das pa gnyis gnyis su rtogs par bya'o/ /'jig rten pa rnams kyang phal cher 'dod pas bsdus so/ /gzugs dang gzugs med pas bsdus pa dag kyang yod do/ /gtong ba'i dus ni rtsa ba'i lhung ba dag byung ba dang / sngags kyi theg pa spong ba de'i tshe'o/ /cha shas cha shas ni rang rang gi rtsa ba'i dam tshig las 'das pa na'o/ /gso ba'i cho ga ni/sdig pa yongs su sbyangs nas slar yang blang ba yin no/ /ting nge 'dzin gang zhe na/'dir ni bskyed pa'i rim pa dang rdzogs pa'i rim pa'o/ /de gnyis sgom dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan dang / sgra don dang / grangs dang / go rim nges pa ni sngon gyi mkhan po dag gis bshad pa dang gzhan du smra bar 'dod do/ /'dir re re yang / ngo bo dang yan lag dang / dbye ba dang / gnas skabs dang / dngos dang btags pa'i khyad par ro/ /bskyed pa'i ngo bo gang zhe na/ rnam par rtog pas gsar du sgom pa las byung ba'i lha sku'i rnam pa can srid pa gsum dang chos mthun du sgom pa'i zhu —58—

bde ting nge 'dzin no/ /yan lag gang zhe na/ /thun mtshams sam mchod pa'i bstod pa la sogs pa dang / rnal 'byor brgyad la sogs pa'o/ /ci'i phyir yan lag ces bya zhe na/ rang gi rang gi ngo bo'i srid pa dang 'bras bu'i rnam pa lam du mi byed pa'i phyir ro/ /dbye ba gang zhe na/ dang po sbyor ba dang / dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog dang / las rgyal mchog dang / bsnyen pa dang / nyer sgrub dang / sgrub pa dang / sgrub chen dang / rnal 'byor dang / rjes su rnal 'byor dang / shin tu rnal 'byor dang / rnal 'byor chen po rnams so/ /gnas skabs gang zhe na/ las dang po pa dang / ye shes phebs pa dang / ye shes la dbang ba dang ye shes la ches dbang ba rnams so/ /dang po ni yan lag bdun dang ldan pa yin la/gzhan rnams ni btags pa ba'o/ /bskyed rim gyi dpyad pa'i gnas drug gang zhe na/ smras pa/ sbyang gzhi gang yin mthar thug 'bras bu gang / /rje'ogs rim gang gi smin byed dgos pa gang / /ngo bo gang yin mthar phyin tshad gang yin/ /dpyad pa'i gnas drug yan lag kun la sbyar/ /rdzogs pa'i rim pa gang zhe na/sdom ni ngo bo dbye ba so so yi/ /rang bzhin dang ni dpyad pa'i gnad/ /ngo bo gang zhe na/ sems dang yid dang rlung dbu mar thim pas/ mngon du gyur pa'i bde stong ngo / /dbye ba gang zhe na/ dngos dang btags pa dang / mtshan ma can dang /mtshan ma med pa dang / khyab byed dang / khyab bya rdzogs pa'i rim pa'o/ /de la thog ma gnyis ni rang bzhin gyis dbye ba'o/ /tha ma gnyis ni tha snyad kyis phye ba'o/ /bar ba gnyis ni rnam pas rab tu phye ba'o/ /de rnams nyid kyi rang bzhin gang zhe na/ de yang zhu ba'i bde ba lhan skyes chen po dang / sgyu ma'i sku dang / rang —59

bzhin lhan skyes dang / zung 'jug gi sku dang / rlung dbu mar thim pa'i mthar thob pa kun nas nyon mongs pa dang / rnam par byang ba'i snang ba gsum dang /dga' ba gsum dang / de rnams dngos su 'thob pa'i lam gang yin pa de rnams rdzogs pa'i rim pa dngos zhes bya'o/ / btags pa gang zhe na/ rtsa'i rnal 'byor dang / rlung dang phra mo dang / thig le dang / phyag rgya'i rim pa rlung dbu mar 'jug pa dang / gnas pa dang / thim par byed pa'i las can rnams so/ /mtshan ma'i rdzogs pa'i rim pa gang zhe na/ngo bo nyid kyi mtshan ma dang / btags pa'i mtshan ma can no/ /ngo bo nyid kyi mtshan ma gang zhe na/ snang ba gsum sems dang / sems las byung ba'i mtshan nyid can 'od gsal bar gnas yongs su ma gyur pa ste so so'i skye bo thams cad dang gzhan la yang yod do/ /btags pa'i mtshan ma gang zhe na/ sgra don can gyi rtog pa dang mtshungs par ldan pa gang yin pa ste/ don gyi 'od gsal ma thob pa'i bar dag tu ci rigs par yod do/ /mtshan ma med pa gang zhe na/ ngo bo nyid kyi mtshan ma med pa dang / btags pa'i mtshan ma med pa'o/ /dang po ni/'phags pa kho na la yod do/ /phyi ma ni so so'i skye bo la yang yod do/ khyab byed rdzogs pa'i rim capa gang zhe na/ so sor sdud pa dang / bsam gtan dang / srog rtsol dang / 'dzin pa dang / rjes su dran pa dang / ting nge 'dzin dang / dga' ba bzhi dang / snang ba dang / snang ba mched pa dang / snang ba nye bar thob pa dang /'od gsal ba dang / snang phyogasadang / stong phyogasadang / bde ba'i phyogasadang /phyogs dang bral ba rnams so/ /de la dang po drug ni yan lag gis rab tu phye ba —60

dang / de nas brgyad ni ngo bo nyid dang / de nas gsum ni rnam pa dang / tha ma ni rang bzhin gyis rab tu phye ba'am/ yang na bzhi ga'ang rnam pas rab tu phye ba'o/ /ci'i phyir khyab byed ces bya zhe na/ gang rdzogs pa'i rim pa de thams cad la khyabopa'i phyir ro/ khyab bya gang zhe na/ lus rnam par dben pa dang / ngag dben pa dang / sems dben pa dang / bdag byin rlabs pa dang / 'od gsal ba dang /zung 'jug dang / rdzogs pa'i rim pa'i spyod pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang / bdag byin rlabs pa dang / sna tshogs rdo rje dang / nor bu 'gengs pa dang / dz+wa lan+dha ra dang /bsam mi khyab dang / rang byin rlabs pa dang / dkyil 'khor 'khor lo dang /rgyud kyi rim pa dang / sngags dang / ye shes dang / gsang ba'i rim pa dang / so sor sdud pa la sogs yang 'ga' zhig tu yod do/ / cigazhan yang sngags dang / dbyibs dang / chos dang / rtsa dang / rlung dang /thig le dang / me dang / las kyi phyag rgya dang / ye shes dang / dam tshig dang /phyag rgya chen po dang / snying ga'i thig le dang / nor bu dang / sprul pa dang / mi shigs pa'i rnal 'byor dang / de dag la sogs pa dpag tu med pa dag go /dpyad pa'i gnad rnams gang zhe na/ smras pa/ ngo bo gang yin gang la gnad du bsnun/ /ji ltar gnas bsnun de yi nyams rtags gang / /yon tan gang bskyed de yi rgyu mtshan gang / /dngos brgyud spangs bya gang spong mthar phyin tshad/ /sa dang lam gyi mtshams gang bgegs sel dang / /bogs 'don ci zhig gtso 'khor khyad gang yin/ /dpyad pa'i gnas bcu gcig gi sgo nas dpyad/ /rdzogs pa'i rim pa kun gyi gnad shes 'gyur/ /gang la gnad du bsnun pa lus kyi rnam —61

par bzhag pa gang zhe na/ lus chags pa dang / gnas pa dang / 'jig pa'i tshul lo/ /brjod pa/ ba spu'i bu ga'i grangs nyid kyi/ /rtsa ni bye ba phyed dang bzhi/ /de las stong phrag bdun bcu gnyis/ /de las brgya bcu gnyis lhag brgya/ /de bzhin brgya dang nyi shu dang / /sum cu gnyis dang rtsa gsum mo/ /bskyed dang sdud pa thams cad kyi/ /gnas ni snying ga yin pa'i phyir/ /grub pa rnams dang mkhas rnams kyis/ /snying ga kho na bsngags pa yin/ khams kyang so gnyis bcu drug dang / khu khrag 'khor lo gnasatshul dang / /dkar dmar 'phel grib 'pho ba'i 'gros/ /rlung yang nyi khri chig stong dang / khrug brgya brgyad lhag brgya dag la/ /bcu ni rnam par shes par bya/ /re re yang ni gnas dang grangs/ /rgyu tshul kha dog mgon po dang / /lha mo rnams kyi dbye ba dang / /'jug gnas 'byung dang 'pho tshul lo/ /phung khams dbang yul ye shes lnga/ /nyer lnga phra dang rags pa'i tshul//sems de'i bzhen par gyur pa ni/ /rlung yang phra rags rnam gsum mo/ /ji ltar gnad du bsnun zhe na/ /yul gyi gnad dang / dusadang / lus dang / rlung dang /dmigs pa'i gnad do/ /dmigs pa'i gnad kyang / gang la sems 'jog pa dang / rlung sdud tshul dang / dmigs pa dang rnam pa'i khyad par te/ bzhi po de dag gis yon tan mngon du byed cing / dri ma rnams sbyong bar byed de/ sa dang lam gyi mtshams gang zhe na/ lam ni lnga ste/ tshogasadang / sbyor ba dang / mthong lam dang / sgom lam dang / mi slob pa'i lamamo/ /ye shes phebs pa ni tshogs kyis lam chung ngu ste dran pa nye bar bzhag pa'o/ /ye shes la ches dbang ba ni yang dag spong ba ste tshogs kyi lam 'bring po'o/ /de nyid spyod pas mthar phyin —62

cing lta sta ngas rnams thogs pa med pa dang / sangs rgyas rnams mngon du gyur pa dang / skye ba gcig gis thogs pa 'di ni rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa can tshogs lam chen pa'o/ / rdzogs rim dngos kyi sems dben pa thob pa zhu ba'i bde ba mthar thug pa dbang po lnga'i rang bzhin drod dang rtse mo zhes bya la/ ye shes kyi sku nam mkha' mdzod thob pa stobs lnga dang ldan pa bzod pa dang chos mchog go /'dir rtsa dang rlung dang / thig le thim pa'i ye shes yon tan gyi gzhir gyur pa gong ma'i lam dang mthun pa bcu gnyis so/ /de'i tshe ye shes kyi sku la sangs rgyas zhes btags so/ /de las gzhan pa'i mos spyod kyi sa bcu yang yod do/ /'phags pa'i sa bcu dang / mos spyod kyi sa dang / sangs rgyas kyi sa ste bcu gnyis ni/ lam 'di'i sa'o cog pa bcu gnyis su sdud pa rgyud las 'byung zhing mkhan po rnams kyis kyang bshad do/ /don dam pa'i so sor rang gi rig pa thams cad stong pa 'od gsal ba ni dang por byang chub yan lag mthong ba'i lam mo/ /'di la dga' ba'i rang bzhin bden pa bcu drug dag go /slob pa'i zung 'jug rnam pa dgu ni sa lhag ma dgu'o/ /sa bcu tsam dang / rgyun mtha'i ye shes dag las/ rnam grol lam dang /khyad par lam ni sa bcu gnyis sam bcu gsum ste/ yan lag bdun dang ldan pa'i ye shes gong ma'i gzhir gyur pa'o/ /'di dag ni sgom pa'i lam 'phags lam yan lag brgyad do/ /mi slob pa'i zung 'jug ni mthar phyin pa'o/ /man ngag las ni thog mar rdzogs pa'i rim pa dang / gzhan yang sna tshogs par —63—

'chad do/ /de dag la ni rim pa mi 'dra ba dag 'byung ste/ gal te sbyor ba'i lam du zhugs na bye brag med pa kho na'o/ /mosapas spyod pa dang / lhag pa'i bsam pa dag pa la spyod pa/ mtshan ma la spyod pa drug dang / mtshan ma med pa la spyod pa bdun dang / mngon par 'du byed pa med par spyod pa gsum la sogs pa dang /pha rol tu phyin pa bcu la spyod pa dang / yon tan brgya phrag bcu la sogs pa ni thams cad du mdo sde bzhin te/ 'on kyang 'dir ni tshe gzhan du ma gyur pa kho na yin gyi skye ba gcig gis thogs pa'ang ma yin na/ bskal ba mang po ni lta smos kyang ci dgos/ de'i phyir dus myur ba kho nas rdo rje sems dpas yang dang yang du ma bstan no/ /gzhan dag ni rang rang gi man ngag nyid du rnam par bzhag gi 'dir mi brjod do/ /'dir smras pa/ grangs nges mtshan nyid go rim nges pa dang / /nges tshig yon tan sbyang bya 'bras bu dang / /rten dang shes bya spang bya nyams len tshad/ /dbye bsdu 'di rnams rim pa kun la sbyar/ /phung khams khams gsum 'dus byas rdzas yod dang / /kun rdzob yod dang lus sems rten gyi khyad/ /blo rig rten 'brel zag med rab dbye bcu/ /rim pa gnyis kyi khyad par gzhan yang ni/ /btags pa dang ni mngon sum 'gyur pa'i lha/ /rags dang phra ba'i sngags dang rig 'dzin gnyis/ /las dang dngos grub sgrub pa'i khyad par dang / /sngags dang ye shes sku zhesarnam par phye/ /tha mal bag chags dngos su gnon dang 'joms/ /rtog pa'i srid dang snang ba'i srid 'joms dang / /las dang ye shes sgrib sel rnam shes dang / /ye shes kyis rab phyed dang dngos grub gnyis/ /zhes —64—

pa ni bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ khuspyod kyi sbyor ba gang zhe na/ las kyi rgyud dang / dngos grub kyi rgyud do/ /de la las kyi rgyud gang zhe na/ khyad par bcu'am brgyad de/ phyogs dus lha dang cha byad bsam pa dang / /gnas dang yul dang zas dang cho ga sngags/ /de yang bzhi ste/ bsam gtan gyi las dang / sbyin sreg gi las dang / 'khrul 'khor gyi las dang / sbyor ba'i las phal pa'o de kho na ltar dngos grub kyi rgyud de/ 'on kyang dam tshig gi khyad par dang / thun mong ma yin pa'i rdzas ni lhag pa'o/ /las ni las chen bcu gnyis la sogs pa'o/ /dngos grub kyi rgyud ni gnyis ste/ thun mong dang mchog gi dngos grub so/ /thun mong gi dngos grub gang zhe na/ rdzas kyis rig pa 'dzin pa dang / lus dang / longs spyod dang / 'dod pa dang / gzugs kyi rig pa 'dzin pa dang /gzugs med par 'gro ba'o/ /ngang pa dang / mkha' lding dang / khyu mchog sogs bzhon pa dang / rin po che sna bdun dang / rdo rje dang / 'bor lo pad+ma la sogs pa dang / 'jig rten pa rnams kyi mtshon cha dang / yi ge dang / ming gi sngags kyi rig pa 'dzin pa la sogs pa dang/ lha dang klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / srin po la sogs pa bsgrubs pas gzhan la brten pa'i dngos grub mtha' yas pa yod do/ /'di las/ che 31nga tsam bsdus pa ni/ chung ngu ni brgyad de/ ril bu mig sman dngos grub dang / /sa 'og ral gri'i dngos grub dang / /mkha' la 'phur dang mi snang dang / khre ba med dang nad 'joms so/ /'bring ni 'dod pa'i rig pa 'dzin pa phal pa'o/ /chen po ni/ tshe dang longs spyod la sogs pa bskal ba —65

drug pa dpag tu med pa 'dod pa dang / gzugs kyi rig pa 'dzin pa'o/ /dngos grub gnyis gar yang spyod pas sgrub pa yin te/ thun mong dang mchog gi bsnyen pa la zhi gnas dag lhag mthong grub pa na'o/ / de la spyod pa gang zhe na/ gang zag dang / 'bras bu dang / dus dang /ngo bo dang / nges tshig dang / dbye ba dang / cho ga'o/ /de la dbye ba gang zhe na/ spros bcas dang / spros med dang / shin tu spros med dang / yang na gnyis spangs dang /kun bzang dang / phyogs las rnam rgyal dang / yang na 'dod 'jug dang / rten slob dang / rig pa brtul zhugs dang yang na re 'jog dang / mnyam par spyod pa dang / mnyam bzhag dang / rjes thob dang / chags bral dang / chags can dang /'dod chags chen po'o/ /de yang sgom bsam dang / dus dang / bya ba dang /ngo bo'i sgo nas spyod pa gsum du bzhag go /smras pa/ gnas dang phyag rgya'i grangs dbye ba/ /mtshan nyid cha lugs khyad par ro/ /cho ga dang /ngo bo dang / spyod tshul dang / dbang po sbyangs ma sbyangs dang / gnas skabs dang / rang bzhin gyi sgo nas de rnams su dbye ba'o/ /'di dag ni brjod par bya ba mang ngo / /mchog gi dngos grub gang zhe na/ 'bras bu'i rgyud do/ /sdom ni/ khyad par ngo bo dpe rnams dang / /de yi rig 'dzin gyi khyad dang / /rig 'dzin zung 'jug yon tan dang / /sku dang ye shes nye rgyu'i tshul/ /gsum pa ni/ 'bras bu'i rgyud gang zhe na/ dngos dang btags pa'o/ /dngos ni rdo rje'i 'chang chen po'o/ /btags pa ni sgyu ma'i sku dang / zung 'jug gi sems can no/ /'di gnyis dri ma can dang / dri ma med pa'i ye shes kyi sku ste/ rig pa —66

'dzin pa dang / 'ja' lus zhes brjod kyi khams gsum pa ma yin no/ /rdo rje sku'i dpe bcu gnyis gang zhe na/ sgyu ma chu zla mig yor smig rgyu dang / /rmi lam brag cha mig 'phrul dri za'i grong / /'ja' tshon glog dang chu bur me long gzugs/ / rig pa 'dzin pa gang zhe na/ 'di ni khyad par du ribadun dang ldan pa ste/ ting nge 'dzin la gnas pa dang / mngon shes lnga dang ldan pa dang / zhing sna tshogs su 'gro ba'i don spyod pa dang / 'dod cing 'chums pa med pa dang /'dod pa mtha' yas pa la bde ba chen por spyod pa dang / tshe tshad las brgal ba dang / yid kyi lus so/ /'dir rig pa 'dzin pa dang / ye shes kyi sku la khyad par ci/ phung po za ma tog ma nyams pa ni ye shes kyi sku tsam mo/ /las sam ting nge 'dzin gyis nyams pa de'i tshe rig pa 'dzin pa'i ye shes kyi sku zhes bya'o/ /rig pa 'dzin pa thams cad kyang / yon tan brgyad tshan gnyis te/ bcu drug dang ldan pa'o/ /zung 'jug gi yon tan gang zhe na/ ro myang brgyad dang / dbang phyug brgyad dang / kha sbyor bdun dang / yon tan brgyad ces bya ba ste/ rtag pa dang mi gdung dang / /bsil ba dang ni gcig pa dang / /bde ba dang ni dri med dang / /dga' ba dang ni yid dang ba/ sku yi dbang phyug dang ni gsung gi dbang phyug dang / /de bzhin du ni thugs kyi dbang phyug dang / /rdzu 'phrul kun 'gro gnas kyi dbang phyug dang / /ci 'dod byed dang yon tan brgyad pa'o/ /longs spyod rdzogs dang kha sbyor bde chen rang bzhin med/ /snying rjes yongs gang rgyun mi 'chad dang 'gog pa med/ /gzugs phra reg pa yang ba dang / khyab dang yang dag thob pa nyid/ /—67—

rab tu gsal ba nyid brtan pa/ /dbang phyug nyid dang 'dod dgur bsgyur/ /gzhan yang byang chub kyi phyogs dang / tshad med dang / dbang bcu dang / stobs bcu dang / shes pa bcu dang / ma 'dres pa bco brgyad dang / mi 'jigs pa dang /nyon mongs med pa dang / sngon gnas mkhyen pa dang / thugs rje chen po dang /zad par dang / zil gnon dang / rnam thar la sogs pa'ang bshad par bya mod kyi/ de dag ni sde snod gsum gyi tshul las 'byung ba ltar ro/ /sde snod 'dir yang mtshan yang dag par brjod pa la sogs par yang bshad do/ /sku gang zhe na/chos dang / longs spyod dang / sprul pa dang / bde ba chen po dang / sku bcu drug la sogs pa dang / rdo rje rnam pa bzhi yongs su mngon du gyur pa yin no/ /chos kyi sku gang zhe na/ de bzhin nyid kyi rang bzhin no/ /longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku gang zhe na/ kha sbyor yan lag bdun mthar thug pa gcig gyur pa/ chos thams cad la rdzogs par spyod pa'o/ /de yang brda dang don no/ /brda ni byang chub sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi mngon sum du gyur pa'o/ /don ni sangs rgyas rnams kyi ye shes kho na ste/ semasacan la snang ba med do/ /sprul pa'i sku gang zhe na/ brda dang don no/ /brda ni so so skye bo 'ga' zhig la snang ba'o/ /don ni bcom ldan 'das kyi bya ba sgrub pa'i ye shes thugs rje chen po'o/ /lhan cig skyes pa'i sku gang zhe na/ sems kyi rang bzhin bde ba chen po dang / ro myang brgyad dang ldan pa/ don dam par spros pa dang bral ba gang yin pa ste/ 'di yang chos kyi sku zhes bya ba'o/ /dbang phyug brgyad ni sku bzhi gas bsdus par rig par bya'o/ /sku bcu drug gang zhe na/ bzhi po de dag /thugs dang /—68

gsung dang / sku dang / ye shes kyis dbye bas bcu drug ste/ rlung dang / rdul dang /khu ba dang / rnam par shes pa dag pas 'dus ma byas kyi rang bzhin dang / sdug bsngal dang kun 'byung gi gdung ba med pa dang / rdo rje snying rjes sems can sgrol ba dang / bde ba chen po zung 'jug gi rang bzhin no/ /de yang / yang na gnyis su med pa dang / g.yo ba med pa dang / ris med pa dang / 'dod pa dang / mchog tu mi 'gyur ba dang / 'dod chags chen po dang / dngos po dang dngos med zad pa dang / ye shes dang / sems pa dang / kun tu bzang po dang / nyen mongs pa med pa dang / nyon mongs chen po dang / lhan cig skyes pa dang / byang chub kyi sems 'dzin pa dang / dus kyi 'khor lo rdo rje dang / thabs dang shes rab kyi rnal 'byor ro/ /yang na mnyam pa nyid dang / yid kyi gzugs gnyis snang spangs pa dang / lhun gyis grub pa'i 'phrin las dang / bag chags spangs pa ces pa ni sku bzhi'i don no/ /'dir tshigs su bcad pa yang bshad pa/ sprul pa yis ni sku gsung thugs/ /ye shes gcig sbyor sdom pa dang / /longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku gsung thugs/ /ye shes gcig sbyor sdom pa dang / /dpal ldan chos kyi sku gsung thugs/ /ye shes gcig sbyor sdom pa dang / /lhan cig skyes pa'i sku gsung thugs/ /ye shes gcig sbyor sdom pa ni/ /sad rmi gnyid sdug bzhi pa yi/ /dbang po gnyis skyes bde min zhing / /zhes 'byung ba'o/ /ye shes gang zhe na/lnga'am bdun no/ /lnga ni me long lta bu dang / mnyam pa nyid dang / so sor rtog pa dang / bya ba sgrub pa dang / chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes so/ /bdun gang zhe na/zab pa'i ye shes dang / rgya che ba dang / khyab pa dang / rtag pa dang / bde ba dang /—69

sku dang / zung 'jug rnams so/ /de dag so so'i mtshan nyid kyang / ji skad du/ de nyid bdun 'grel las/ rang bzhin med dang rang rig pa/ /'phel ba bri ba med pa dang / /rnam par mi rtog snang ba po/ /bsod nams ye shes yul dang ni/ /dmigs 〉pa 'jug pa las rnams ni/ /rgya che rab tu bshad pa yin/ /yul dang dus dang rgyud gsum dang / /stong dang mnyam pa nyid kyis khyab/ khrigran mi 'chad cing 'gog pa med/ /phra rab med cing 'gyur ba med/ /bsam yas ye shes rtag pa nyid/ kha sbyor rang bzhin bde ba dang / /snying rje chen po gsum rang bzhin/ /yid ni rlung bcas thim pa dang / /zhu ba dang ni mi 'dzag bde/ /stong pa las skyes sdug bsngal 'gog /gar yang phyin dang mi g.yo ba/ /yid dang rlung gi lus can dang / /skad cig gcig gis kun ston dang / /mtshan dang dpe byad sprin spro ba/ /de ni rdo rje'i sku ru gsungs/ /gnyis min mi rtog rang bzhin zhugs/ /snang med kun nas kun tu snang / /nam yang g.yo ba med pa'i phyir/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i zung 'jug go /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /nye rgyu gang zhe na/ mchog gi dngos grub la dang por dngos su reg pa dang / mthar thug par dngos su reg pa dang /gnyis dzir brgyud mar reg pa'o/ /dang po ni sangs rgyas rnams kyi yang dag par dbang bskur ba las 'byung ba'i spyod pa'i ye shes so/ /gnyis pa ni longs spyod rdzogs pas dbang bskur ba'o/ /gsum pa rig pa'i brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa thams cad de/ de yang tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur bar byas te/chu dang cod pan la sogs pa gsang ba'i dbang gi bar du sbyin nas/ nyi ma dmar thag chod pa ni/ shes rab ye shes sbyin te rig ma dang lhan cig tho rangs mngon —70

par byang chub pa thob par 'gyur ro/ /de ltar yang / rdo rje nyi ma nub nas ni/ /sgrub pa kun tu brtsam par bya/ /skya rengs 'char ba'i dus su ni/ /sgom pa mchog ni 'grub par 'gyur/ /zhes pa 'di ni re zhig lung ngo / /'di la dang po dang tha ma la ni/ phyag rgya gsum ga yang yod do/ /bar pa la ni las kyi phyag rgya dang /phyag rgya chen po kho na yod do/ /tha ma kho na bde chen gyi lam la ni/ de dag phyag rgya chen po kho na'o/ /gnyis pa de ston byed kyi rgyud bshad pa la/ pha rgyud ma rgyud 'dod tshul la dpyad pa/ rgyud sde rigs gang du gtogs ngos bzung ba 'phros dang bcas pa/bzhi pa'i ye shes la dpyad pa ste gsum mo/ /dang po ni/ bla na med pa'i rgyud gang zhe na/ zhu ba dang / rang bzhin gyi bde stong gnyis su med pa ston pa gang yin pa ste/ de'i phyir 'di kho nas skye ba 'di la sangs rgyas sbyin par bya'o/ /dbye ba gang zhe na/ rnal 'byor dang rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud do/ /bu ni bu mo dang / bu pho'i dbye gzhi ste/ 'on kyang bu ni pho kho na la brjod pa ltar rnal 'byor gyi rgyud do/ /gang du rnal 'byor ma rnams kyi dkyil 'khor dang / sngags dang sbyor ba rgyas pa de ni rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud do/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi dkyil 'khor dang / sngags dang / sbyor ba kho na rgyas pa de ni rnal 'byor gyi rgyud do/ /rdzogs pa'i rim pa dngos ni thams cad kyang dbye ba med do/ /don 'di ma rtogs par/ phyogs 'dir mkhas pa dang mi mkhas pa dag kha cig ni cha chung ngus dbye bar 'dod/ kha cig ni rnam grangs du mar byed/ gzhan dag don bzang por rlom pa dag gi dbye bar 'dod de/ de yang 'di ltar dgug gzhug la sogs pa pho mos byed pa'i don —71

zer ba/ de mtshon byed du byas pa yin gyi de kho na ma nges te/ dkyil 'khor dgug gzhug mos byed kyang / 'phrin las phal cher phos byed na pha rgyud du 'jog dgos pa lta bu'o/ /des na dgug gzhug bcings mnyes 'phrin las byed pa'i dpe tsam mo/ /gzhan yang thabs mi g.yo shes rab rgyu ba de yin na rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud kyis khyab par gsungs kyang / rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud las des khyab par yang ma gsungs/ rgyu ba'i don/ ye shes pa dgug gzhug kho na la 'chad na/ da lta'i gdan bzhi'i rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor ye shes dbang phyug ma yin pas/ gdan bzhi pha rgyud ma rgyud gnyis ka ma yin par thal bar 'gyur te/shes rab rgyu bas pha rgyud ma yin pa dang / thabs mi g.yo ba ma tshang bas ma rgyud kyang ma yin par 'gyur bas so/ /dgug gzhug la 'dod pa 'di dus 'khor ba snga rabs pa 'ga' re dang / phyogs mchan dang / bu mchan gnyis ka na yod/'khrul gzhi sems 'grel gzhan gyi'ang byas so/ /gzhan yang mar do'i rjes 'brang sogs dkyil 'khor gyi dbus gtso bo'i gnas na pho mo mang nyung la 'chad pa dang / gzhan dag pho mo gtso che chung la 'chad pa dang / lha grangs pho mo'i mang nyung dang / gzhan dngos gsung ba po yab yum gyi khyad dang / kha cig zhu ba po pho mo'i khyad dang / 'ga' zhig gleng gzhi 'di skad sogs dang gsang ba sogs kyi khyad du 'dod pa dang / gzhan yang cha phra ba g.yas brkyang g.yon brkyang dang / zhi khro'i nyams so so ba dang / 'dres pa dang / rgyan dang / phyag mtshan na bza' la sogs pa dang / dur khrod yod med sogs 'dod pa dang / dus 'khor las dpal ldan rgyu snar gyi dkyil 'khor gyi dag pa'i 'grel tshig 'ga' las 'brul —72

gzhi byung nas/ lha bzhugs bzhedas shas che chung dang / yab yum zhal phyag grangs mnyam mi mnyam dang / gzhal yas khang 'byung bzhi las bskyed pa dang /'byung bzhi'i steng du bskyed pa'i khyad par du 'dod pa sogs byung ste thams cad ma nges pa sha stag yin no/ kha cig rdzogs rim phyag rgya'i lam gtso bor 'don pa ma rgyud/ rang lus kyi gtso bor 'don pa pha rgyud yin zer te/ gsang 'dus nas chags lam zhal gsal la grol lam pa'i rdzogs rim bsdus shing gab par yod pa dang / ma rgyud phal cher gnyis ka gsal bar cher ma nges/ gzhan rlung gtso bor ston pa pha rgyud rtsa'am thig le gtso bor ston pa ma rgyud zer yang / rdo rje 'jigs byed gnyis ka ma yin par thal ba dang / gsung 'dus rdor phreng gnyis gar thal ba sogs 'byung zhing / sdom byung sam bu ṭi sogs kyang gnyis yin du 'gyur ro/ /sa skya pa rnams bskyed rim gtso bor 'don pa pha/ mi zab pa'i rdzogs rim gtso bor 'don pa ma rgyud phal pa/ zab mo'i rdzogs rim gtso bor 'don pa gnyis med ces gsungs/ gzhan 'ga' yang de mtshungs la gnyis med mi 'dod par rim gnyis pha ma so so sbyar ro/ /'di ni legs par brtags na/ gang na bskyed rim gyi rnam bzhag rgyas par ston pa phal cher na rdzogs rim rgyas par ston pa rang mang la/ rdzogs rim bsdus tsam las mi ston pa rnams na bskyed rim yang mi rgyas pa kho na mthong bas spyir yang mi 'thad/ pha ma gnyis kyi khyad du 'dod pa la/ brtag gnyis sam bu ṭa sdom byung gdan bzhi gsang 'dus rdor phreng sogs gnyis gar thal ba dang / gsang 'dus dgongs pa lung ston dang / lha mo bzhi zhus kyi rgyud ma rgyud du thal ba dang / rdo rje gur dang sangs rgyas —73

thod pa sogs pha rgyud du thal bar 'gyur ba dang / ku ru kul+le'i rtog pa dang / rdo rje 'jigs byed la sogs 'ga' zhig gnyis ka ma yin par thal bar 'gyur ro/ /sa lugs de ltar na yang / thal ba de dag phal cher 'jug cing / 'di'i lugs la mnyam sbyor sogs ma rgyud phal pa dang / phra thig gi rnal 'byor rdzogs rim mi zab pa dang / tsāṇ+ḍali dang pho nya la rdzogs rim zab mo dang / gnyis med kyi ngos 'dzin kyi rdor la mdzad/ bde mchog gi rgyud de dag gang yin de skabs mi smra la/ 'di skabs ma rgyud khyad par can la gnyis med du btags par don gyi khas len cing / bde mchog gi chos skor du ma rgyud spyi dang gsang mtha' zer nas/ ma rgyud khyad par can ma rgyud dngos su yang 'chad do/ /phra thig gsang 'dus dgra nag rdo rje gur rnams las rgyas par 'chad pas/ ma rgyud phal par thal ba dang / zab mo'i rdzogs rim gtso bor ston pas bde mchog kyang gnyis med du thal ba dang / khyed kyi bzhed pa'i zab mo'i rdzogs rim gyi pho nya'i lam ni phal bar gsal zhing gsang 'dus kyang gnyis med du thal lo/ /ma rgyud khyad par can la gnyis med zer ba dang / ma rgyud kho nar 'chad pa'ang 'gal lo/ /yang 'di skad ces/ kyi rdor gnyis med yin pas gnyis med la shes rab kyi cha dgos pas/ mkha' 'gro ma drwa skre sdom pa sogs dang / mkha' 'gro ma yi rdo rje gur/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa yin skad/ de ltar na gnyis med yin pas pha rgyud du yang ci'i phyir mi 'chad/ yang ma rgyud khyad par can phung gsum pa gnyis med yin na/ pha rgyud khyad par can yang der thal bar 'gyur/ yang ma rgyud khyad par can bde mchog yin/ kyi rdor gnyisamed yin/ gnyis gas kyang zab mo'i —74

rdzogs rim ston na/ ma rgyud khyad par can dang / gnyis med kyi khyad par da gdod ston dgos so/ kha cig thabs rgya che ba pha rgyud/ shes rab zab pa ma rgyud zer ba yang / bde dgyes las stong nyid gsang 'dus zhal gsal zhing / dkyil 'khor cho ga'i las rim sogs/ gsang 'dus las/ dgyes rdor zhal gsal ba sogs 'gal ba mang ngo / /gsal stong ston pa dang / bde stong ston pa khyad par du 'dod pa'ang yod de/ 'di gnyis bla med thams cad nas rtsal du ston pa mnyam mo/ /gdul bya skyes pa 'dul ba la pha rgyud/ bud med 'dul ba ma rgyud zer rdo rje gur gyi lung 'dren no/ /lung don ni skyes pa 'dul ba gtso bo'i don la lha yab gtso bor gyur pa'i cho ga dang / bud med gtso bor 'dul ba la yum gtso che ba'i dkyil 'khor dang cho ga gsungs zhes pa'i don yin gyi gsang 'dus las kyang bud med 'tshang rgya tshul gsal bar gsungs la/ bde mchog gdan bzhi sogs las kyang skyed pa sgom pa'i dbang du byas pa gtso che bas de mi 'thad do/ /yang kha cig gur gyi tshig las 'khrul nas dang po nang pa kho na la zhugs pa dang / thog ma mu stegs la zhugs pa rjes su 'dzin pa'i don du rim pas pha ma gsung zer ba rgyu mtshan ye med cing / nang pa thabs dang / phyi pa shes rab dang rigs mthun ye med pas 'brel med kho na'o/ /sbyor sgrol sogs mu stegs dang phyogs mtshungs so snyam pa 'dug na'ang sbyor ba'i phyogs nas pha rgyud kha zin che'o/ /des na ches ma nges/ rngog pa rnams/ brjod bya thabs dang shes rab/gdul bya skyes pa bud med kyi khyad par du 'dod pa'ang de rnams kyis bgag zin pa de'o/ /de dag ni bod snga rabs pa'i 'dod pa la rnam par brtags —75

pa'o/ / phyis byung la bu ston rin po chesade dag phal cher drangs/ pha ma gnyisal gzhan zer thams cad 'thad ldan du mdzad/ gnyis med phung gsum pa'i 'jog lugs re re thugs bzo mdzad nas mthar de dag re res 'jog mi thub/thams cad tshang ba'ang dkon pas/ shas cher tshang ba la bya'o gsungs nas/ the tshom med g.yol le bzhugs so/ /bo dong pas kyang de dag thams cad bskyed nas re re zhing snga rabs pa'i lugs la dgag pa cung zad re mdzad nas/ rang lugs de dag dang 'dra min re mdzad/ gnyis med phung gsum pa'i 'jog byed re re thugs bzo ma re mdzad nas/ re res kyang 'jog thub thams cad tshang zhing gsungs te zhib tu yi ges 'jigs so/ /kyai rdor gnyis med yin te/ rgyud gzhan las rkyang ma thabs ro ma shes rab du gsungs/ 'dir de go zlog nas thabs shes phan tshun rgyas btab byas pa dang shes rab zla ba 'bab bshad pa sogs phran tshegs mang rab gsungs gur las/ kyai rdo rje rnal 'byor rgyud/ /dang po rgyal ba rnams kyi bshad/ /phyi ma rnal 'byor ma rgyud ni/ /de nyid bud med bzung phyir ro/ /zhes brtag pa dang po thabs rgyud/ gnyis pa shes rab rgyud du bshad pas gnyis med yin gsungs yang bshad rgyud sam bu ṭa kyi rdor rang gtso che gnyis med yin/ lam 'bras kyang sam bu'i ṭi'i man ngag rang gtso che/gur dang thig le skor bzhi brtag gnyis kyi bshad rgyud yin yang ma rgyud yin gsung / pha rgyud ma rgyud gnyis med gsum phyi ma phyi ma mchog tu bzhed do/ /de yang ye mi 'thad de/ rgyud gzhan las rkyang ma thabs kho nar dang ro ma shes rab kho nar bshad pa'i nges pa mi snang ba dang / gsang 'dus rim lnga dang / spyod —76

bsdus su 'byung ba ltar 'dus pa'i rgyud mang po las gsal ba/ snang ba zla ba'i chos shes rab dang / mchod pa nyi ma'i chos thabs su bstan pas de dag kyang gnyis med phung gsum du thal ba dang / brtag pa dang po chos can/ gnyis med phung gsum pa ma yin pa thal/ pha rgyud yin pa'i phyir/ phyi ma chos can/ der ma yin par thal/ ma rgyud yin pa'i phyir/ brtag gnyis gnyis med phung gsum ma yin par thal/ brtag pa gnyis pa de ni pha ma phyogs re yin pa'i phyir/ brtag gnyis la brtag pa gnyis po ma yin pa'i tshigs bcad kyang med pa'i phyir/sdom pas thabs shes gnyis ka yod pa'i phyir de'o snyam na/ gsang 'dus kyi rgyud dang bde mchog gi rgyud chos can/ gnyis med kyi rgyud phung gsum pa yin par thal/ sdom pas pha rgyud ma rgyud gnyis ka yod pa'i phyir/ re re ba pha ma phyogs re ma yin na ni/ lung de'i dang po pha rgyud gnyis pa ma rgyud du bshad pas zhes pa las 'brel ma byung ste/ de dag gnyis med kyi pha rgyud ma rgyud sogs su 'chad dgos pas/ yang na gnyis med yin ste gnyis med kyi pha ma yin pa'i phyir zhes grub zin sgrub pa'am/ sgrub byed bsgrub pa dang mtshungs so/ /yang na pha ma thams cad gnyis med du 'dod dgos pa las 'os mi 'byung ngo / /lung de 'brog 'gyur du snang la/ de la 'bru de ltar bod snga ma 'gas byas pa tshad ldan byas na de ltar khas len dgos srid na'ang / de'i don rdo rje gur gsung ba po kyai rdor gyis dang po rnal 'byor rgyud mang du gsungs/ phyi'i bu med de mkha' 'gro ma rnams 'khor du bsdu ba'i phyir rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud gsungs zhes pa'i don yin pas/ spyir sangs rgyas kyis bla med gsung tshul la pha rgyud las ma rgyud phyi mar —77

ston pa yin gyi/ brtag pa sum cu rtsa gnyis pa'i phyi ma gnyis kyi skabs kyang ma yin/ da lta'i brtag gnyis la zer ba'ang ma yin te/ de gnyis la brtag pa'i 'gros kyang med la/ 'brog 'gyur yi ge nyams pa'i 'gyur nor pas rdo rjes zhes pa sgra chad dang por zhes pa'i don ra sgra chad/ rnams la zhes pa rnams kyis zhes 'byung kyang / 'gos 'gyur dang de las mar pas bcos pa gnyis ka la dgyes pa'i rdo rjes rnal 'byor rgyud/ /dang por rgyal ba rnams la bshad/ /phyis nas rnal 'byor ma rgyud ni/ /de nyid mo gzugs bsdu phyir ro/ /'gyur 'di legs te/ 'brog 'gyur ltar na/ dang po nyan pa po ma gsungs pas/ rjes ma la de nyid zer ba gang la snyeg ma byung / kyai rdor zer ba rgyud brtag gnyis la zer na brtag gnyis pha rgyud du thal bar 'gyur zhing / dang po kyi rdor zer ba'i pha rgyud gcig rgyal ba mang pos gsung / rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud phyi ma de ni bud med bzung phyir yin zer ba las ma byung ngo / /des na gur las mi bskyod pa dang / rdo rje 'chang bsres pa la dgyes rdor ces mtshan brtags pa yang yang byung ba yin mod/ dgyes rdor zer tshad brtag gnyis yin na/ a ka ru nag cadagyes rdor la zer ba yang brtag gnyis la a ka ru 'bul ba lags sam/ des na dgyes rdor gyis zhes pa rdo rje 'chang gi zhes pa yin/ dang por rgyal ba rigs lnga pho gzugs 'dzin pa la gsungs/ phyi ma zer ba ma 'brel la/ phyis nas ma rgyud ni/ rgyal ba de rnams nyid mo gzugs 'dzin pa'i 'khor bsdu phyir yin/ /ces pa yin no/ /yang mar do'i 'gyur las dges rdor la sogs rgyal rnams kyis/ /sbyor ba'i rgyud ni bzhad pa las/ /de rnams —78

bud med gzugs 'dzin pa/ /rnal 'byor ma rgyud mchog la'o/ /zhes bsgyur ba ltar bshad kyang legs par 'ong ngo / /yang brtag gnyis chos can khyod ma rgyud yin par thal/ khyod rdo rje gur sogs kyis ma rgyud du bkral ba'i phyir/ ma khyab na/ bshad rgyud kyis rtsa rgyud kyi don log par bkral bar thal/ rtsa rgyud kyi don chog gnyis med du gnas pa de bshad rgyud kyis/ dman pa la ma rgyud tu bkral pa'i phyir ro/ /dge lugs la ni/ bla med nges pas ma khyab kyang / de'i 'jog byed gzhan tsho nor/ snang gsung 'od gsal/ sgyu lus kyi sku dang bcas rtsal du 'don pa pha rgyud thig le dbab zlog gi dga' bzhi rtsal du 'don pa ma rgyud zer/ mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho las/ rnal 'byor rnams la rgyud du ni/ /'od gsal sgyu ma zhes bya ba/ /sgyu ma'i 'jig rten la bshad do/ /zhes pas pha rgyud kyi khyad par bstan/ ma rgyud kyi khyad par mngon sum gyis grub gsung bar gda'/ lung de'i don 'od gsal dang sgyu ma sgom pa las shes pa rnams te/ de de'i cho ga ste thabs shes pa'i rnal 'byor pas rgyud la 'jug ces pa'i don tsam zhig yin pas de'i khungs su mi rung la/ gsang 'dus rtsa rgyud chos can pha ma gnyis ka ma yin par thal/tshig zin la de gnyis ka la gsal ba dang rgyas par ma bstan pa'i phyir bshad rgyud rdor phreng chos can pha ma gnyis ka yin par thal/ de gnyis ka rtsal du bton nas 'chad pa'i phyir/ des na dgongs pa lung ston sogs dang sbyar nas sgron gsal gyis 'chad lugs la sgyu lus 'od gsal snang gsum ston pa'i tshig rnams de dang der 'chad pa'i tshe shin tu gab tshul du snang la/ 'grel pa gzhan —79

gyis 'chad tshul gzhan du bshad pa na/ de dag gi tshig don la gsal bar zhugs pa sha stag snang ba dang / zhabs lugs lta bu la rjes mthun yod du chug kyang gsang 'dus kyi lugs gzhan rtsa rgyud kyi dgongs pa rdzogs par 'grel pa'ang snang bzhi dang sgyu lus kyi tha snyad ye med don yang 'phags skor lugs bzhin med pa shin tu mang ba dang / phug rang zhig gi don gcig pa tsam la bsam na pha rgyud ma rgyud thams cad gcig cing / khyed rang yang sgyu lus dang snang bzhi kyi rdor bde mchog lugs la yang 'dod pas dbye ba mi 'byung zhing 'jigs byed sogs mang po zhig la gnyis ka mi gsal bas/ gnyis min du 'gyur ba dang / khyad chos de gnyis pha rgyud la 'phagasaskor gyi gzhung kho na dang / ma rgyud brtag gnyis lta bu gcig gi tshig zin la 'grig rung tsam las gzhan la ma khyab khyab ches mi srid gsum tshang ba la lags so/ khres rab rin chen pa ni las dbang dang sgyu lus gtso bor ston pa pha rgyud/ sher dbang dang 'od gsal gtso bor ston pa ma rgyud bzhi pa dang zung 'jug gtsor ston gnyis med/ gnyis med dngos dus 'khor ro/ /kyi rdor yang mi 'gal te/ bzhi pa shin tu gsal bas so zer/ yid bzang rtse ba yang / bzhi pa rgyud gzhan las sbas par rgyud 'grel/ bi ma la pra bha ra gsungs pa la bde gsang the/ kyi rdor mi the ye shes 'di ni sogs bzhi pa gsal bas so/ /gsang 'dus rgyud phyi ma sher dbang gsal ba dang / rtsa rgyud las kyang gsal ba dang / rdo rje phreng bar dbang mtha' dag gsal ba dang / sam bu ṭi sogs las gsang dbang shin tu gsal ba dang /dus 'khor lugs kyi bzhi pa de kyi rdor las kyang bde gsang na med pa'i gsal —80

po rang mi snang ba dang / ye shes 'di ni sogs dgongs pa gzhan du 'dren sla zhing 'dren pa mang ba dang / dbang bzhi'i ye shes ston byed sdom 'byung dang mngon brjod bla ma sogs dang sangs rgyas thod pa sogs mang por gsal po gsungs pas dbang la sbyor ba mi 'thad la/ sgyu lus pha rgyud kyi 'jog byed gong du bkag zin/ 'od gsal gtso bor ston pa ma rgyud du 'jog pa'ang mi 'thad de rang bzhin 'od gsal tsam la bsam na mdo sde kun yang der thal/ pha rgyud kyang thal rlung sems snying gar thim pa'i de ni ma rgyud mang po las kyang gsal po ma bshad/ pha rgyud rdor phreng la sogs pas gsal por bstan pas so/ /'o na zhu bde rtsal du ston pas de 'od gsal yin no snyam na/ de la yang 'od gsal du 'jog dgos pa'i skabs yod na'ang / 'od gsal chos sku lam dang / de bde chen spyi bo sku'i lam dang / gnad du bsnun pa sogs mi 'dra'o/ /zhu bde pha rgyud kyi lam gyi skabs su rgyas pas de yang mi rung ngo / /des na rang lugs ni rnal 'byor bla med thams cad gnyis su med pa'i rgyud yin cing / de la pha ma gnyis su phye ba ni dus 'khor 'grel chen na ches gsal ba yin/ rgya gar na na'ang de kho na ltar grags/ bod rnams gsum du 'byed pa ni/ rang gang la gtso bor byed pa de gnyis med du 'bad de sgrub pa'i dge ba las/ rgyud mchog gzhan rnams thabs thegs ya bral du phab pa'i sdig pa che ba gcig lags/ des na pha thre/da la rigs lnga yod cing yod par snga rabs pa mang po'ang bzhed/ bu ston gyi bzhed pa la ngor phyogs pas khrel rgod byas te/ rin po che dang las rig bod du ma 'gyur bas ma mthong gsungs pa de bden te med pas so zer te/ bshad rgyud rdo rje —81—

snying rgyan las/ dam tshig mngon brgyad stong phrag gsum/ /zhes dang / rin chen sdong po dgu brgya bdun/ /dus kyi thig le brgya brgyad bcu/ /zhes 'byung ba la lta lung nyan lung ma byung ba'i 'chal gtam yin la/ dug gsum can 'dul ba'i dbye ba gsum du pha rgyud pa rnams byed pa ni chos legs kyang mtshan gzhir gsang 'dus rnam snang sgyu drwa gshin rje gshed gsum la byed pa mi 'thad de/ sgyu drwa chags can gyi rgyud du bshad nas zhe sdang gti mug logs su rgyud sder bshad pa'i phyir te/ snang mdzad sgyu 'phrul stong dang brgya/ /zhes gsungs/ de rnams bshad zin pa na/ 'di rnams dgos pa'i bye brag gis/ /nga yis yang dag bstan par bya/ /'di ni gnyis med 'byud pa yis/ /rgyud kyi dbye ba bstan pa yin/ /de bzhin du ni lag bcangs dang / /dgod dang bltas pa'ang shes par bya/ /de bzhin zhe sdang gti mug gi khri(da rnams kun kyang shes par bya/ /mkha' 'gro ma yi rgyud kun yang / /'di yi rim pas shesapar bya/ /phyi nang dbye ba shes par bya/ /zhes gsungs/ 'dis ni ri dwags rgyal po seng ge /kha cig gsang sngags phyi nang bya ba rnying ma pa la grags khungs med gsung ba yang / lan re zung re tsam gyis gzhud lugs kun shes so/ /zhes thugs khengs pas rgyal nas rgyud grags chen po tsho la yang gzigs long ma byung snang bas/ rjes 'brangs phyis 'byung wa skyes long ba tsho la ni re med/ —gnyis pa/ rgyud sde rigs gang du gtogs ngos bzung ba 'phros dang bcos pa ni/ rgyud sde'i don —spyir dug gsum 'dul ba'i rgyud yod/ 'dod chags rjes su 'dzin pa kho na la yang 'dod chags bzhi'i dbye bas rgyud sde bzhi —82

yod/ bla med gsang 'dus dang 'brel ba chags can 'dul ba pha rgyud shes che ba tsam dngos su bgrangs/ rgyud sde 'og ma'i chags can 'dul ba'i rgyud kyang 'dis mtshon/ de bzhin du zhe sdang gti mug gi rigs la'ang rgyud sde bzhi char yod/ yab gtso bor ston pa tsho la de ltar yin par ma zad/ ma rgyud la yang dug gsum 'dul ba'i dbye ba yod/ des na dug gsum 'dul ba dang / pha ma'i dbye ba 'di gsang sngags phyi nang gnyis ka la yod gsungs par snang ba la/ ngor phyogs pa rnams la rgyud la dug gsum gyi rigs gsum dang ma rgyud la lnga'am/drug kho na 'thad kyi gzhan min zer ba dang / drug kyang mi methad lnga 'thad zer ba sogs ni rgyud gzhung gi dgongs don shod mkhan ni ma byung / rang gis ni phal cher ma mthong / cung zad mthong kyang ma go /blo gros kyi mthu ni med/ bla ma'i gsung rgyun rnam dag gi lde mig med kyang gsung rab kyi bltas pas ka chog pa zhig yod par 'dug bsam nas 'ga' zhig bltas pas/ de rnams rang gi mgo ma go ba de rang gis ma shes nas dpe sgrog 'dra byas pas thugs yus/mkhas pa tsho dang nga 'dra snyam nas blo chung tsho mgo bsdums nas bsam mod rigs dras byas pa'i chos skad du gda'o/ / des na pha brgyud la rigs kyi dbye na rigs lnga dang / gdul bya 'dul tshul gyis phye na rigs gsum ste/ lnga char la phyi ma gsum char yod cing / don la ni rgyud sde go 'phang mnyam po la lam rim mi 'dra ba med do/ /rgyud nang phan tshun kha skong dgos pas so/ /'on kyang dngos bstan la dkyil 'bor lha la kha sbyor yod med sogs lha'i rnam pa dang / drag po'i lasagatso bor ston mi ston —83

dang / stong nyid dang rten 'brel zhib mor ston mi ston/ phyag rgya'i lam dngos su gsal mi gsal sogs kyis 'byed de/ de yang rigs lnga'i dbang du byas na/gsang 'dus dang gshed skor rdo rje'i rigs dang / sgyu drwa rnam snang gi rigasayin la/ rigs gsum ltar na gsang 'dus bshad rgyud dang bcas pa dang / rnam snang sgyu drwa dang / 'jam dpal dpa' bo 'bum phrag gcig /ces gsungs pa ltar/ dgra nag gshed dmar le'u bcu drug pa gdong drug pa rnams chags can dang / 'jigs byed zhe snang can 'dul ba yin te/ lha kha sbyor dang yab rkyang phyag rgya'i lam bshad ma bshad/ drag las gtso bor mi ston dang ston pas so/ /gshed dmar nyer gnyis pa dang / mi g.yo ba bla med ni ma rgyud yin par mngon la/ bde chen ral gcig dang phyag rdor gyi rgyud du grags pa 'ga' re'ang 'dug ste re zhig btang snyoms su bzhag go /ma rgyud la rigs drug gi rdor sems kyi rigs ni mnyam sbyor dang / zla gsang thig le/ rtag pa'i rigs ni gdan bzhi/rdo rje nyi ma'i rigs rdo rje bdud rtsi/ lasakyi rigs 'jig rten gsum rgyal rta mchog dang / pad+ma'i rigs pad+ma drwa ba'am 'bar ba/ sogs te 'di gnyis bod na med/ sgrol ma 'byung ba dang / phyag 'tshal nyer gcig sogs rta mchog gi rigs yin la/ rigs 'jigs lnga bcu pa pad+ma gar dbang gi rigs su grags/brtag gnyis a ṛ '-i rigs gnyis/ thig le skor bzhi sangs rgyas thod pa ma hā ma ya rnams he ru ka kho na'i rgyud yin/ gshed dmar le'u nyer gnyis pa dang /mi g.yo bla med kyang he ru skar gartags/ bde mchog gtso bor he ru ka yin la/rdo rje sems dpa'i rigs dang lhag par 'brel/ sam bhu ṭi yang de dang 'dra/ 84
