dus 'khor rdor sems dang he ru ga'i rigs ci rigs su 'dod pa yod pa/ mi 'gal ba lta bu snang na'ang re zhig 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin pa mi bskyod pa yin par thams cad zhal 'chams pa dang / res 'ga' he ru gar rgyud las gsungs pa ltar na he ru ka gtso che bar bsdu rdo rje gur dang mngon brjod la sogs rigs lnga'am drug gi dkyil 'khor cha mnyam pa 'dra yod kyang / gang gi dbang du byas te he ru ka yin pas de kho nar bsdu/ mnyam sbyor dang zla gsang yang de 'dra bas rigs drug cha mnyam du d+me bya rdo rje sems dpa'o/ /yang zla gsang ma rgyud 'dra ba tsam snang na'ang pha rgyud du grags pa ltar na brtag dgos la/ gal te pha rgyud yin na/ pha rgyud la yang rdo rje sems dpa'i rigs logs su byas te/ rigs drug tu byed dgos so/ /de ltar pha rgyud la/ rin chen sdong po rin chen rigs/dam tshig mngon rgyan dang / rdo rje lnga 'dus las kyi rigs/ dus kyi thig le'i pad+ma'i rigs yin par mtshan tsam las kyang shes so/ /rgyud sde de dag bod du ma 'gyur yang / rdo rje snying rgyan du ming smos pa de dag sngon 'phags yul du dar nges pa dang / phyis kyang ci rigs pa yod do/ /gti mug can 'dul ba'i rgyud ni 'jam dpal sgyu drwa mtshan brjod yin nam snyam pa bdag ni rnam par rtog pa'o/ /zhes gsungs/ pha rgyud ma rgyud ces bya ba bya rgyud dang spyod rgyud la don tsam gnas pa srid na yang gsal kha ma bshad/ rnal 'byor phyi nang gnyis la yod/rnal 'byor rgyudal/ sher phyin brgya lnga bcu pa'i 'grel pa las/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi yum shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dpal dam pa phreng ba zhes bya ba 'di yin no/ /yum smos pa las ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i —83

yab kyang smos dgos te/ gang zhe na yab ni tran+t+ra ta tā saṃ gra ha zhes bya ba sngags kyi mdo sde zab mo yin par bshad de zhes gsung / gsang ba rgyan bkod yo ga yin pa ltar na/ de las rgyud kyi mtshan nyid 'chad dus/ shes rab yum du legs bshad de/ /thabs ni yab tu legs bshad pa'o/ /zhes gsungs/thabs shes su 'jog tshul mtshan nyid mtshungs pas/ bla med kyi yang 'di go dgos so/ /bla med kyi dbye ba'i skabs 'dir/ nges pa'i lam la ltos na thams cad thabs shes gnyis med kyi rgyud yin pas khyab/ gnas skabs kyi khyad chos kyis phye ba'i dbang du byas na/ thabs shes gang rung gi rgyud yin pas khyab/ de la rang lugs dkyus na gsal ba ltar mtshan nyid gsang ba rgyan bkod kyi lung gis grub/ pha rgyud ma rgyud so sor nges pa'i mtshan gzhi'i steng du khyad chos de dag tshang ba mngon sum gyis grub bo/ /rnal 'byor bla med kyi rgyud thams cad lam gyi cha rkyen ma tshang ba med par ston pa yin pa gang zhig sngags dang rgyud kyi sbyor ba sogs/ yab kho na'i dbang du byas pa gtso bor ston pa pha rgyud kyi mtshan nyid/ yum gtso che ba'am yab yum cha mnyam du ston pa gang rung yin pa ma rgyud kyi mtshan nyid/ yang na yum gyi dbang du byas pa rtsal du 'don pa zhes byas kyang chog go /de la kyai rdor bde mchog mi g.yo ba bla med sogs thams cad yab yum cha mnyam/ mnyam sbyor/ ma ya/ bdud rtsi/ ar raslo/ sangasargyasathod pa rnams nas/ yum gtso bor gyur pa'i dkyil 'khor da lta'i rgyud chung 'di dag tu mi gsal yang / sngags dang las tshogs mkha' 'gro ma'i gtso che bar rgyud las gsal/ gdan bzhi dang sgrol ma 'byung ba sogs/ yum kho na rtsal du 'don/—86

mtshan nyid kyi zur dang pos bya rgyud sogs dang / rgyud kyi cha shas dam dum bsgyur ba rnams dpyod do/ /dus 'khor yang sdom chen gyi yum gyi skabs dang /rigs brgya sogs rnal 'byor ma'i dkyil 'bor ci rigs pa ston cing / sngags dang las tshogs rnal 'byor ma'i dbang du byas pa rtsal du 'don te/ yang na/mtha' dag yon tan gter ba ni bstan pa'i slad du rnal 'byor ma rnams dag la mchod par bya/ /mchod pa med na lo gcig tu ni rgyud kyi rgyal po dag ni bla mas bstan par mi bya'o/ /zhes gsungs cal 'grel par bgegs zhi ba'i don du rnal 'byor ma la nges par mchod pa bya dgos pa dang / bsod nams kyi don du 'byung po la'ang gtor ma sbyin par bshad de/ 'dis rgyud 'di'i bdag mo rnal 'byor ma yin par bstan pas ma rgyud do/ /de ltar ma yin na lha yab khro bo sogs kyis bgegs zhi mi thub pa lags sam/ khro bo dang / klu dang / phyogs skyong sogs snyad 'dog chung / mkha' 'gro ma ko long dam pas yin lags/da ni dus 'khor rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud ma yin zer ba rnams la thog mgo bor babs pa 'dra ba gcig yod de/ nang le'i tshig tshigs bcad lnga bcu nga gcig pa/ dus kyi lo ni mi grangs lo/ /zhes pa nas/ :sto ka nga bdun pa'i tshig gnyis pa phyi rol gyi phyag rgya drug ces pa'i bar gyis 'grel pa mthong ba tsam gyis so/ /de yang nang le'i mdor bsdus gsum pa'i stod kyi cha la gtogs te/da ni nyin zhag gi tshogs stong brgyad cu po de las zhes pa nas/ rigs gsum cu rtsa drug ni rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud kyi nges pa'o/ /zhes dpal ldan rgyu skar gyi dkyil 'khor nang gi dus 'khor sku gsung thugs yongs rdzogs dang / sdom chen dang —87

sdom chung gi dag pa bshad nas rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud kyi nges pa'o/ /da ni sgyu 'phrul drwa ba zhes pa nas brjod par bya'o zhes pa rnal 'byor rgyud kyi nges pa'o zhes gsung / 'di'i 'phro mthud nas slar yang mi gsal dang bcas rgyas par gsungs gda'/ pha ma gnyis su gartags pa ma yin na/ sdom chung la rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud kyi nges pa'o/ /sdom chen la rnal 'byor ma dang gnyis med bsres pa'i nges pa'o/ /dus 'khor yongs rdzogs la gnyis med kyis nges pa'o/ /zhes gsungs tsang / kyai rdor gnyis med yin na ma rgyud ma yin zer ba la/ brtag gnyis dang gur dang phyogs mthun du 'dod pa thig le skor bzhi a rislo gnyis rnams nas rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud ces yang yang gsungs pas rang gi lung dang 'gal lo/ /ma rgyud kyi mtshan gzhi yin yang yin la mkhas pa dang grub pacho grags kyang grags pa'i dbang du mdzad nas 'grel chen dri med 'od kyis le'u lnga pa'i mdor bsdus dang por/ rang gi ngo bos ni shes rab dang thabs kyi bdag nyid sbyor ba'i rgyud nyid de/ de skad du yang / kyi rdor las gsungs pa he yig rnying snying rje nas/ bshad kyis nyen zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ kyi'i rdo rje ni shes rab kyi rgyud du mi 'gyur te/ shes rab kyi rgyud nyon ces gsungs pa med pa'i phyir/de bzhin du 'dus pa la sogs pa nas/ 'di ni thabasakyi rgyud du mi 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin du dang po'i sangs rgyas la sogs gsung zhing / de kha'i gong du kun rdzob kyi sa gang du rnal 'byor ma rnams yang dag par rgyu zhing / gtso bo mi g.yo ba de ni rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud do/ /gang du thabasayang dag par brgyu zhing / shes rab mi g.yo ba de ni thabs kyi rgyud do zhes gsungasapa gnyis ma yin pa'i —88

gnyis med yod na de 'di lta bu'o gsungs tsang / kyai rdor de 'dra'i mtshan gzhi yin cing ma rgyud ma yin na rang gi ngo bos kyi rdor ma rgyud du mi 'gyur gsungs ga la dgos te/ ma rgyud ma yin par gnyis med du grags pa la grub zin sgrub par thal bas so/ /des na tshig 'dis bla med la pha ma gnyis kyi khyab pa dang /gsang 'dus gnyis med pha rgyud yin pa bzhin/ kyai rdor gnyis med dang ma rgyud kyi mtshan gzhi yang yin pa dang / gsang 'dus pha rgyud kho nar grags pa bzhin/kyi rdor ma rgyud kho nar grags pa rnams shugs bstan la gsal por byung / kyi rdor ma rgyud dang pha rgyud gang rung ma yin pa phung gsum gnyis med du 'dod pa 'di sham+bha la dang rgya gar la sogs su ye ma grags pa'i bod pa'i ngan rtog tu gsal bar byas so/ /gzhan yang bla med la gsum du 'byed pa'i khungs rgya gar nas bsgyur ba gang na yang med/ bod kyi lo ts+tsha ba/ 'gos/ gyi jo/ mar pa/ nag tsho/ dpyal chag /mar do/ lo chung / rwa skyo zhing gnyis sogs kyi rjes 'jug tshun chad kyi yi ge gang na'ang med la/ 'brog mi 'bro ba/ dngos slob dang bcas pa'ang mi bzhed/ sa skya rnying pa dang / ngor pa phal cher kyai rdor gnyis med dus 'khor ma rgyud zer/ rje btsun gong mas kyi rdor gnyis med gsung ba las gzhan mi gsal/ rong pa dang / shong dpang / bu ston rnamasakyi rdor ma rgyud/ dus 'khor gnyis med ces rgyu mtshan du ma gsung / jo nang pa yab sras gsum dpyad pa ma mdzad par de'i rjes su 'brang / kun mkhyen rin po ches gsal kha ma gsungs/ phyogs pas ma rgyud du bzhed zer na'ang de 'dra'i yi ge ma mthong /khrid yig na gzhan gyi rjes su 'brang gda'/ rdzong pa tsho dang / ngor pa ci rigs —89

kyang bo dong pa'i rjes su 'brangs nas zab pa gnyis med kyi kyi rdor/ rgya che gnyis med dus 'khor zer/ chos rje shes rab rin chen dang / bla ma dam pa rjes 'brang dang bcas pa de dang mthun pa las zab dang rgya che ba'i tha snyad mi byed do/ /rang lugs stong pa dang snying rje/ bskyed rdzogs bde stong / sku dang ye shes sogs dang / dngos po'i gnas lugs shes rab dang / rtogs byed kyi thabs sogs kyi sgo nas/ bla med thams cad thabs shes cha mnyam pas/ rang gi ngo bos shes sam/ don dam par zhes pa/ thabs dang shes rab dngos sam/don gyi thabs dang shes rab kyi cha nas gnyis med ces kyang bya/ thabs shes sbyor ba'i rgyud ces kyang bya/ shes rab dang thabs kyi bdag nyid ces kyang bya'o/ /thabs kyi rgyud dang shes rab kyi rgyud ces mi bya/ thabs shes dngos ma yin kyang btags pa'i thabs shes so/ /don gyi thabs shes ma yin kyang / brda'i sgo nas mtshon pa'i thabs shes gnyis kyi dbang du byas na rgyud gnyis su 'gyur/ de yang gdul bya gzhan snang la snang ba yid kyis sgom pa'i lha yab de thabs snying rje dngosam yin kyang / de'i brda yin pas der btags pa yin no/ /de'adra'i lha yum de stong nyid rtogs pa'i shes rab dngos ma yin kyang de'i brda yin pas der btags pa yin pas so/ /mdor na thabs mi g.yo ba ni lha yab kyi dkyil 'khor dang sngags sogs gtso bo'am grogs su dgos kyang des bya ba gtso bor mi byed/ 'phrin las gtso bor rnal 'byor ma'i sngags rgyud kyi byed pa'i don yin/ des gcig shos kyang rigs 'gre'o/ /de la bod snga phyi mang pos rang gang la gtso bor byed pa gnyis med du bsgrubs/ gzhan rnams phyogs re bar gnas —90

na rang gi de gzhan las mchog tu 'grub bo snyam nas bla med la gsum du 'byed par snang ba/ sngon sngags rnying ma pa'i rdzogs chen pa bstan pa snga dar gyi dus na nges kyi rdzogs chen 'di mdo sngags ma yin de bas lhag byas pa/ ban de ye shes sdes lhag mthong ba bskyed thabs chen mor bkag /de nas snga dar phyi dar gyi mtshams las mdo sngags gang dang bstun yang ma shes/ mdo sngags gnyis ka ma yin byas na chos ma yin par song dgos nas/ rdzogs chen a ti yo ga la logs su rgyud mang po bsgrigs te/ mahā dang a nu las khyad par du gyur pa/ a ti'o zer/ mahā pha rgyud/ a nu ma rgyud/ a ti gnyis med zer/ gsar ma ba bla med pa rnams/ bde dgyes gsang 'dus/ dus 'khor gshed skor la gtso bor byed pa kho na dar/ gzhan tsho la zhar byung byed pas/ gzhan rnams gnyis med phung gsum pa yin zer mkhan ma byung / bde gsang mkhan pos bde gsang gnyis med phung gsum yin zer mkhan ma byung bar mngon/ kyai rdor 'brog mi lugs pa dang dus 'khor ba mang po dang / rgya ston sogs gshed skor ba 'ga' res de ltar 'chad mod/ mdor na phung gsum pa mi srid pas de 'dra bsgrub pa ngal ba 'ba' zhig tu zad de/ ma rgyud yin pas mi zab pa dang ngan par 'gro ba ma yin/ gnyis med yin byas pas de las zab par 'gro ba'ang ma yin te pha rgyud kyang gnyis med yin pa dang / gnyis med phung gsum pa ri bong rwa dang mtshungs pas so/ /des na rang gi bdag gir byas pa'i rgyud la bstod pa byas pa tsam yin kyang / don la ma zhugs pas phan yon med gcing rdzun gyis gzhan mgo bskor —91

ba'i nyes pa dang / rgyud sde gzhan smod pa'i nyes pa ma bsogs cig /des na gzhi bden gnyis sam/ shes bya gtan la 'bebs tshul dang gsag /'bras bu sangs rgyas pa'i bzhugs tshul gtan la 'bebs pa dang gnyis/ thabs la lam/mos pa/ nges 'byung gsum/ las 'brasakyi blong dor bzhi/ bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab/ skyon dang bral ba'i zhi gnas/ brtse ba snying rje chen po smon 'jug gi sems bskyed/ spyod pa phar phyin sogs dang / lam thun mong ma yin pa/ smin byed dbang / bsrung bya dam tshig dngos bsgom bya rdzogs rim yongs rdzogs bskyed rim gyi ngo bo dang rim pa rnams kyis sgo nas pha ma'i dbye ba med/ thams cad gnyis med yin pa'i rgyu mtshan de yin/ bskyed rim gyi rnam pa'i khyad par dang / bskyed rim gyi yan lag sngags dang 'phrin las kyi khyad par las pha ma gnyis su 'byed pas de las phung gsum pa med do/ /de'i rigs 'gros las spros bcas spros med kyi spyod pa'i skabs dang khyad par cung zad 'byung ngo / /dngos bstan tshig zin gyi dbang du byas na/ pha rgyud las ma rgyud cung zad zab/ rgyud so so la'ang zab mi zab yod/ rgyud ni rgyud gzhan gyis shes pa'i nges pa dang / mthar thug gi dgongs don la mtho dman med/ slob dpon so sor byas pa'i dgongs 'grel la zab mi zab dang bzang ngan khyed shin tu che/ des na don dam par bla med thams cad gnyis med kyi rgyud yin/ kun rdzob dbye gsungs pa yang / blun ngor bzang bzang 'dra yang ma brtags nyams dga' tsam ste/ gsang 'dus kun rdzob tu pha rgyud don dam par gnyis med/ bde mchog kun rdzob tu ma rgyud don dam par gnyis med/ dus —92

'khor sogs kun rdzob don dam gnyis skar gnyis med ces gsung dgos par gda' ba la/ de ltar du 'jog pa'i rgyu mtshan shin tu ma grub pa'i phyir ro/ /gsum pa ni bzhi pa'i ye shes la dpyad par bya ste/ rgyud gang las mthar thug gi lam gyi gtso bo brjod bya'i snying po bzhi par byed pa la bsam na bla med thams cad de yin la/ de min bzhi pa dang dngos kyi mtshan nyid ston byed gsal po sho lo ka re re gnyis gnyis yod pas/ rgyud de bzhi pa tsam du 'don pas kyang ma khyab cing / dbang chog gi skabs dang dbang bkur ba bzhi pa zer ba'i ming 'dogs gsal po med na bzhi pa rgyas par mi ston pas kyang ma khyab bo/ /des na 'dus pa'i byang chub sems kyi le'us las kyang bzhi pa rgyas par bstan) pa yin la/ bde mchog yang dbang po gang dang sogs dang / sngags bzla pa dang sogs/ pho nya lhan cig skyes grub sogs dang / 'phel 'grib spangs pas gnas pa yin/ /sogs kyis kyang bzhi pa gsal bar bstan cing / de bzhin du gshin rje gshed dmar nag sogs las kyang ste bshad rgyud rnams las smos ci dgos/ 'on kyang dus kyi 'khor lo la ltos na de dag shin tu mi 'gal tshul ba la dgongs so/ /des na 'dir dbang bzhi pa'i ye shes go chod pa de dus 'khor dang sems 'grel skor gsum gyis 'chad pa yin/ rgyud thams cad kyi dgongs pa'ang de yin/ dgongs 'grel mkhan po grub chen gzhan rnams kyis dgongs pa'i gnad dang mi 'gal lo/ /bzhi pa cho gas bskur ba/ brda thabs yin pas gang ltar byas kyang 'dra ba zhig yod/ dngos la zhabrul ba 'phags yul du mang du byung / bod du yang mang /—93

lam 'bras kyi rdo rje'i rba rlabs kyang dbang po gnyis skyes bzhi par 'dod pa'i lugs yin/ mngon rtogs ljon shing na dbang po gnyis skyes bzhi bar 'dod pa la dgag pa yang mang po mdzad kyang / rang lugs stong nyid du ngo 'phrod pa'i dbang po gnyis skyes la ka ngos 'dzin cing / de'i yas bab kyang bzhi pa yin pas ni 'dod la mas brtan gtso bor mdzad do/ /bo dong pa yang lam 'bras kyi mthar thug tu mdzad/ bod phyi ma ni/ dbang po gnyis skyes kyi bde stong bzhi par byed pa rgyud spyi'i dgongs pa yin la/ stong gzugs phyag chen gyis drangs pa'i zhu bde bzhi par byed pa dus 'khor gyi lugs yin/ gnyis po lugs tha dad yin pas mi 'gal zer yang / snga ma mi 'thad la/ lugs tha dad yin pa yang mi 'thad cing / 'thad na bzhi sgo gnyis su thal ba bzlog tu med la/ phyi ma yang stong gzugs yid ngor shar ba'i 'khrul snang du 'dod pa dang / mi 'gyur bde ba'i rten thig le bem chos sogs chos skad bsil na nor pa shin tu che/ rjes dpag gi rtsis zin pa dgos tshul sogs grub mtha'i skyon dang / stong gzugs dang bde chen ngo bo ngos ma zin cing sbyor tshul rnams la spyi ma shar ba du ma yod do/ /sgom chen pa gzhan mang dag dang / bka' brgyud pa rnams stong pa phyal yul la bzhi par ngos 'dzin pas phal cher gyis bzhi pa'i don ma rtogs la/bzhi pa'i don la/ jo nang pa dang / bu ston sogs dang / de yan chad kyi dus 'khor ba rnams la gnad ma nor ba de yod de zhib tu zhal las shes so/ /gsum pa rgyud sde 'chad tshul gyi man ngag bstan pa la lnga/ bsdus pa'i don 'chad tshul dang / rdo rje'i tshig bshad thabs/ rgyud bshad pa'i dgosapa/ 'chad —94

dus kyi bya ba'i rim pa/ legs par bshad pa'i phan yon no/ /dang po ni/ rgyud kyi gnas lnga gang zhe na sdom ni/ las rim dngos grub dam tshig sdom/ /ting 'dzin rgyud kyi sbyor ba'o/ /las kyi rim pa ni dpag tu med de/ che long che long bsdus pa ni/ de nyid bcu phyi yi dang / gsang ba'i de nyid bcu'o/ /yang bcu gcig ste/ sdom ni/ sa chog sgrub dang mchod pa dang / /sbyin sreg dbang bskur rab gnas dang / /yo byad dkyil 'khor mtshan nyid dang / /tshogs 'khor bsnyen pa las tshogs so/ /yo byad ni/ rdo rje dang / dril bu dang / phyag mtshan dang /rgyan dang de dag la sogs pa'o/ /dkyil 'khor gyi mtshan nyid bri ba dang / slad pa dang lus dang / bsam gtan no/ /sngags kyi stobs las bsod nams 'phel tshul dang / bde bas stong pa rtogs pa'i tshul mchog dang / bde dang myur dang thabs mkhas khyad par dang / /bslab gsum nyon mongs lam spyod 'bras bu citshul/ /dmigs pas dam tshig rgyud gzhan bskul ba yis/ /lam 'di khyad par 'phags par kun gyis bshad/ /bcu gcig po 'di gzhan la yod ma yin/ /'di gnyis byang chub mchog la khyad par med/ /zhes pa 'di bsdu ba'i tshigs su bcad pa'o/ / gnyisapa ni/ rnal 'byor bla na med pa la ni rgyud bdun dang / de'i gtam gyi sbyor skre la ni sngon byung dang rjes 'jug dang / rgyud 'ga' zhig la ni/ phyi nang gsang ba de bzhin nang / /de bzhin nyid don rnam pa bzhi/ /zhes dang / phyi dang nang dang / gzhan dang / rton pa bzhin bshad pa dag go /na tu sbas pa'i rgyud la ni tshul bzhi'o/ /mtha' drug ni thams cad la ste/ nges pa dang drang don la —95

lhag ma bzhi bzhis phye bas brgyad do/ /de bzhin du gzhan la yang ste nyi shu rtsa bzhi yod do/ /tshul bzhir 'chad pa med pa la ni tshogs dang slob ma'i dbye ba med do/ /yi ge gsang chen du bshad pa ni yi ge'i don ma yin zhes kho bos smra'o/ / tshig gcig la don gcig gam gnyis su ston pa ni mtha' drug dang/don rnam grangs du ma ni tshul bzhis 'chad do/ /de yang mtha' gcig tu ni ma yin te/ spyi'i don du gsum mam bzhi la sogs par bshad pa yang yod de/ de dag rgyud gsum gyi sgo nas bshad pa la sogs pa man ngag yod par yang 'dod do/ /gsum pa ni/ gal te tshe 'di nyid la sangs rgyas thob par 'dod pas rgyud mnyan par bya'o/ /bzhi pa ni/ de la slob dpon dang slob ma'i mtshan nyid shes pas brtags nas blangs la dbang bskur ba nod par bya'o/ /dam tshig dang sdom pa la gnas pas/ rim pa gnyis la zhib mor mkhas par byas la rgyud nyan no/ /bsrung ba'i 'khor lo yang sgom pa dang / gtor ma yang sbyin pa dang / thams cad dkyil 'khor du bltas la slob dpon rdo rje sems dpa' la yon dang / maṇ+ḍal byas la/ sngon byung ji lta bar sgom pa ni/ slob dpon dang slon ma gnyis gas so/ / lus dang / ngag dang / semasakyi skyon bcu gcig spangasate/ de dag gang zhe na/ nyal ba la sogs pa lusakyi gnasangan len dang / rtsed mo deng / kyal ka dang / zhe sdang ba'i brgal lan dang / ca co dang / ha cang rtog ge la dga' bas gtan tshigs dang / thal 'gyur gyi rnam bzhag thal ba dang / man ngag med pa dang / rdzun gyi man ngag dang / ma smin pa'i skye bosathos pa dang / 'gran pa dang / rnyed pa'i sems so/ /gzhan yang smra ba'i rgyan dang ldan pasabarjod par —96

bya'o/ /lnga pa ni rnal 'byor la mi g.yo bas 'chad pa dang / mnyan pa la ni rdo rje 'dzin pa rnams lhag par yang gzigs so/ /'di'i dge ba yang / skye ba 'di kho na la rdo rje sems dpa' zhes bya ba 'gro ba la phan pa'i rgyur bsngo'o/ /rgyud sde spyi'i rnam par gzhag pa'i snying po tsam 'di ni/ sde snod gsum dang rgyud sde mtha' dag gi drang nges ma nor bar 'chad pa dang rtsod pa dang / rtsom pa dang / de dag gi don bsam pa dang sgom pa'i don la tshad ma'i skyes bur gyur pa rigs brgya'i bdag po rdo rje 'chang chen po/ don gyi slad du mtshan nas smos te rje btsun tā ra nā tha kun dga' snying po bkra shis rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i gsung las slob ma 'ga' zhig gis zin bris su byas pa'o/ /dar rgyas 'phel/gcig zhus dag bo/ /bkra shis dgra dang 'jigs pa kun las brgal/ /rnam par gzigs ni gzi brjid che/ /rdzu'aphrul ngo bo gtsug tor ro/ /thamasacad skyob pa'i shes rab dang / /log dang sel ba'i stobs nyid dang / /gser sdug la ni bslab pa dang / /'od bsrung gi ni yon tan dang / shwakya thub pa'i brtson 'grus kyi/ /bdag ni rtag tu bde bar sgormeg/ // bkra shis//—97—

rang byin rlabs pa'i man ngag bzhugs/rgya gar skad du/ bha ga lhan badz+ra satwa sa dha ni swā tiṣ+ṭha no pa de sha kunā maḥbod skad du/ bcom ldan 'dasardo rje sems dpa'i sgrub thabs rang byin rlabasapa'i man ngag rim pa zhes bya ba/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa' laphyaga'atshalago /rdo rje snyems ma'i thugasadagyes pa/ /de nyid chu 'khor shugs drag 'gro ba la/ /'jug 'gyur 'di la snying nasamed byung ba/ /bla ma'i zhal snga'i rim pa mdo tsamabri/ /yid du 'ong ba'i sa phyogs su/ /bde ba'i stan la 'dug nas ni/ /rangabazhin ldan pa'i lasakyis ni/ /mkhas pa yis ni bsgom par bya/ / snying khar zla ba dang nyi ma/ mchog gi yi ge las dang po'i rdo rje bsamal/hrīḥlas lkog mar pad+mar zla ba la hūṃ las byung ba'i rdo rje oṃ dang bcas pa/ lce'i bdag nyid du bsam mo/ /a sum̐ hūṃ sum̐ hūṃ āḥ si rnyasna yam̐ rgyu de las zla ba dang nyi ma g.yon dang g.yas kyi lag pa la lha mo yu klurlu dgu dang rnam par snang mdzad rdo rje sems dpa'am/ yang na rdo rje dang pad+ma ste 'di la zla ba'i lha mornams kyi skyes bur 'gyur te/ 'dis ni dang por nga rgyal bya'o/ /de nasardorje sems dpa' rang nyid bskyed nas sa bon 'god pa dang / sku dang gsung dngathugasabyin gyis brlab par bya'o/ /oṃ ཿphaṭa bdag bsrung ba ste/ slarayangaganas bsrung ba ni/ oṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/rdo rje semasadapa'i phyag rgya las/ dud pa dri —98

gsumabasgrengabarani sermesamardorjemayin te/ phyogs bcu bcingasaparabyed pa'i mchog phur ba'i sa gzhi dang / rdo rje'i rwa ba gur rab tu 'bar ba dgabasam mo/ /oṃ /e swāhā/ rigs lnga po dag dbu rgyan du byasal/snyingakhyadang/ltag pa dang / spyi bo dang / rna ltag la dar dpyangs te/ oṃ rnyu oḥswāhā chabadz+ra tu ṣā ho/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnamasaspyan drangasate mchod pa dang / phyaga'atshal ba dang / skyabs su 'gro ba la sogs pa cho ga thams cad bya'o/ /snying ga'i thugs kyi yi ge'am/ hūṃ yig 'bar ba'i 'phreng ba dang mnyam pas lus banadaste/ gzugs la sogasapa thams cad stong par bsam nas/ snying kharasabon lhag ma skra tsam mi snang ste/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dha sarba dharma swa bhā wa shud+dhi3nyi/ de nasasmon lam gyi dbang gis khu tshur dkur brten pas snyems pa can/ rdorje malasogs pas yang dag par bskul te/ dzaḥbazhi rdo rje sems dpa' bdag langesapar 'jug par 'grub par mdzod/ ha bzhi hūṃ gi yi ge sgrog pa'i dam tshigalasabyung ba bdag gi mgon/ ba bzhi rdo rje gsang bar gsang ba lasani byung ba'i sku'adzin pa/ a bzhi a ho shin tu mnyes pa'i rdo rje ā li gcig tu thim pa'i hūṃko gī la'i sgra ltar snyan pa'i hūṃ gi glu dang bcas pa de rnamasaslar yang nam mkhar sgra tsam la thim par bya'o/ /de nas chosakyi 'byung gnasasu rlung ste/ rlung gi nam mkha' ltar dgapa/sems nyid rlung bzhin nam mkhar brjod/ ā li kā li'i sbyor bsazla ba dang/nyi ma dmar po dang / steng du ā li'i sa bon khamasagasum du 'od zer sprob dang / bsdu ba dang / de ni dang po'i rdo rje'i rdo rje nyid du byazho yobadz+ra —99

yang dbang bskur te/ sngon du brjod pa'i cod pan dang go lo dbang bskuraro/ /sgeg mo ma la sogs pa dang / mardzo pa dang / gtorasladang/ bzhi pa dang / bza' ba'i dam tshig byasal/ dam tshig gsum bzung bar byasanasade yang 'od gsal du bcug sto/ dri za'i hūṃ dang sku yongasasu rdzogasapa'i zunga'ajug tu sgom pa dang / yang na gal te rdo rje dang pad+ma hūṃ dang āḥlas dang po'i rdorje dang pad+ma oṃ ཿphaṭa dang bcas pa/ dbyig pa rdo rje 'jam pa'i mgon/ /'ogadapag shes rab kyi ni gzhi/ /rdo rje dril bu rab sbyor bas/ /mchogagigolangabasgrub par bya/ /de nas thig le'i rnal 'byor bsgom/ /rdo rje gsangaba'i chas nasani/ /gnyis ka 'khyud nas bzlas pa bya/ /dbus su ā li'i sabon ni/ /rtag pa mchoge tu phra ba nyid/ /phyag 'tshal sreg pa mthar bzhag nag /bde ba'i sems kyisabasgrub par bya/ /de nas bzlas par bya ste/ oṃ gyiswāhā 65swāhā.oṃ badz+ra satwa hūṃ/ snying khar zla ba la bsam nasabazlas pa bya ste/ phyi nasa'od gsal du bcug nasaldang ste/ yi ge brgya pa dang dag pa gsum dran nasakhyon lam gdab par bya'o/ /'dir rnal 'byor nam mkha'i phyag rgya gang yin pa ni/ rdo rje semasadapara'agyur la/ ye shesadabang phyug mar ni sems ma rdo rje'o/ /gzhan bsasaparamibya ste/ /lha dang sngags ni rtag tu bsam/ /gtor ma dang ni lasogasal/ /nganapa bsam par bya ba min/ /de ltar lasadang po'i rim pa ste/ de nasagazhan yangasmras pa/ 'di la ni yid kyisartag tu bsam pa las/ sngags dang phyagargyadangabral bar mi bya'o/ /sngar brjod pa de ṣ+ka las/ 'dir rdor semasatswakho —101—

bltas la/ hūṃ gis stong par 'jug pa ni snying kha ru'o/ /'dir ni rangabacin gyis dag pa/ bde ba dang / bsil ba dang / mi gdung ba dang/ stongapa chen po/thams cad stong pa/ gzung 'dzin dang bral ba/ shesapa las 'dasapa med pa mayin pa/ bem po lta bu/ yongs su spangs pa/ gcig dang du mabralab/chosathamasacad rang bzhin dang bral ba/ de nyid bsgom par bya'o/ /de lasarlungabazhi po 'byung ba'i bdag po'i rang bzhin rnamasanam mkha' las byung ba/ lta burashin tu phra ba ldang ste dzaḥzhes dang por bskul te/ nā da nag po dang / nyi ma dang zla ba lta bu'i sems bde ba'i rang bzhin/ kho na lasardo rje'i dag pa de nyid rnala'abyor gyi dag par bya ste/ rdo rje sems dpa' rang snang gi rig pa chen modangaganyisaka bsgomasanas ye shesakyi sku'i nga rgyal du bya'o/ /'di ni mtshan dngadapebyad dang ldan par yud tsam gyis yan lag thamasacad yongs su rdzogs par skad cig gisabaskyed de/ zla ba dang rdo rje la sogs pa ni 'dir 'gogaste/ de tsidagosapa med dam zhe na/ de ni dbangapo dman pa dag gis yin te/ mchod rten las ni mi bya zhing / /glegs bam klog par mi bya'o/ /lag pas phyagargyami bcings shing / /sngags kyi ye ge bzla mibya/ /zhes gsungs go /srid pa b.rama'i ji lta ba de bzhin du khamasaphra ba/ bcad du med pa/ chu gtsangagonangadu zla ba'i gzugs brnyan ltar snang gis/ yid kyi rtog pa goms pa las ni mi'agyuraro/ /de yang yi ge hūṃ gisanā das/ ragasapa'i khams la lha mo sgyu 'phrulachen mo'i lhumasasu 'jug pa lta bu ste/ de ni skye ba ltar snang yang skye ba ni ma yin la/ji ltar mig 'phrul mkhan gyis med pa'ang sprul pa ste de ltar yang ma yin te/102—

rags pa'i khams la ni 'jug par byed do/ /'on kyang de ni 'gro ba la snangab nyid yin gyis/ de bzhin gshegs pa la ni rnam par rtog pa yang mi mnga' lasnang ba yang med do/ /'ga' zhig gzugs sgyur bar byed pa de ltar ma yin te/ 'di ni skye babasam gyis mi khyab pa zhes bya'o/ /ye shes kyi snang ba'i rnam para'aphrulapago /de ltar rnal 'byor ba dag gis yang / bde ba dam pa spros pa dang bral ba yangayin la/ de nyid dkyil 'khor la sogs bkod pa mtha' yas pa dang / 'dod pa dag tu snang ba dang / de yang shesapa dang shes bya ba nam du yang tha mi dad pa'i ting nge 'dzin 'di ni rags pa'i khams la gnasapa dang 'jug mod kyig de ltar snang ba ni med la/ 'on kyang de dag gi rang bzhin dang / dzitsasadu chosasugyur pa de tsam du ji lta ba dang ji snyed pa thams cad dus gcig la shes pa ste/'di yang bsam gyisami khyab pa kho na zhesabya'o/ /rim pa 'dis so so'i skye bo dang / srid pa bar ma dang / rmi lam gyi lus dang / thog mamed pa nasabargyud de 'ong ba/ kun gzhi'i rnam par shesapa rlung dang bcas pa rnams yang dang yabadu khams ragasapa la 'jug ste/ de ni byisapa dag gis mi shesapasa'akhorab zhes bya la/ gang rim pa de nyid shes pa ni rnal 'byor chen po ste mya nganalasa'adas pa'o/ / de ltar slob dpon gyi zhal snga'i yang rim pa 'di yin te/ thams cad du rdorje sems dpa' rang snang gi rig sar bcasade ni zla ba dang rdo rje 'od zer 'phro ba/ sprob dang bsdu bas mngal du 'jug pa'i bya ba de ni/ phyis nasalhagapar—103

rol pa mo dang til+li pa/ /lwa ba'i zhabasadang dpal mo dang / /gā yizhabasakyangabached pa ste/ /rā hu dang 'phags pa'i zhabs/ /jing ga la pa'i zhalasngadang / /de bzhin bung ba'i pad+mas bshad/ /brtul zhugs zhal snga nas kyisani/ /rimapa bzhin yang bshad par bya/ /gnyis med sbyor ba 'di nyid ni/ /rdo rje drilabusaphyag rgyas dag /so sor bzung ba'i de kho na/ /bdag ṣ+ka de ṣ+ka rdo rje ste/ /dril bu chos kyi gzung ma'o/ kha sbyor sbyor ba phyag rgya ste/ /de la thabs ni thimapara'agyur/ /de yang de bzhin 'di yin te/ /bden gnyis sbyor ba'i gde nyid/ /skyes pa dngos po snying rje ni/ /rdo rje bud med dril bu ste/ /stong pa dang ni chosanyid do/ /phyag rgya mnyam par sbyor ba yis/ /bdag nyid mang po mdzesabyasapas/ /sgyu ma rdo rjer bshad pa ste/ /kun rdzob don dam thim pago /bdagarna las gzhan rdo rje med/ /chos rnams stong pa'i rang bzhin ni/ /lha mozhesasurnamapar bshad/ /bde dang dag pa'i semasadang ni/ /lus ni bud med sbyorabacasadang / /bden gnyis kha sbyar sbyor ba'i don/ /yang na rang girigamabartagag /de ni thim pa zhes su gsung / /'ba' zhig gzung bar mi bya ste/ /phyagargyazungadu 'jug pa yin/ /chos rnams dag pa spro med pa/ /rdo rje yul dang yulag stong / /lha dang ye shesasnying po brjod/ /bcosama'i zung khrug rdo rjes spros/ /rdo rjesaye shesadagug par bya/ /rdo rje mar me'i ye shes dang / /snang ba rgyasaparagyur pa dang / /gnyis med lam gyi rdo rje lnga/ /gsang ba kun da ye shesadang/ /lte ba bha ga stong pa dang / /ye shesadam tshig gsum du rig /'byubabaphungapo ye shesasu/ /rnam dag shes rab dang ni thabs/ /rtse dgu pa yi de khona'o/ /nam—106—

mkha' dbyingasakyi mthas gtugs par/ /stong nyid ye shes dbyug gu'i sgra/ /khams gsum phyi rol phyin ma'i gzugs/ /phyag rgya'i bha ga mi snangab/ khrilabu stong pa'i lce dang ldan/ /lte ba gdong sogs mnyam par sbyor/ kha sbyoragasusadu rdo rje'i sku/ /dril bu stong pa lhan skyes ni/ /rdo rje dang por gsupasapa yin/ /phyag rgya gcig pa nyid du rig /ā li lte ba nyid yin te/ /zur brgyad pa ni norabu yin/ /de dbusakun da rdo rje'o/ /dril bu shes rab ma'i rtog /dbyugaguze'u 'bru rtsa brgyad ni/ /dbus su mkha' 'grogadong gi spras/ /klu yi sgornamasadabye ba ni/ /mthe bong mtha' ltag gisablang te/ /phyogs brgyad rjod cingadakrolabar bya/ /ro'adzin ro 'dzin bcings snyoms 'jug /kā li ā li sbyor phyag rgya/ /ye shes 'khor ba gcod par byed/ /miphyed dbyer med rdo rje gsum/ /rdorje drilabu sgra rnam dag /ye shes sku dang stong pa'i sgra/ /rim pa dang polhagamosacan/ /rdzogs pa yi yang sems tsam ste/ /dang po'i lasani thabs dpa' bo/ /rnamapa dang bcas stong ye shes/ /lha mo phyag rgya snyomasa'ajug yin/ /thabasadangashesarab mnyam pa'am/ /rang gi phra mo bcug nas kyang / /bud med dgala'adod spyod pa/ /rdorje sems dpa' mchod byed yin/ /'byung ba dbang po yulalo'i ba/ /rdo rje thal mo'i don du brjod/ /sbyin pa de bzhi tshulakhrisasadag /bzod pa gsum ni bsrung ba ste/ /bdud bzhi nyen mongs dgra 'jomasayin/ /semasakyi dkyil 'khor tshul khrimasabyug /bzod pa'i me tog mnyam nyid thog /'od gsal mar me 'di la yod/ /rnam par dag pa'i rim par phye ba'o/ /da ni bsgrub pa'i thabasabarjod par bya ste/ bde ba'i stan la 'duganas—107

su//dang por re zhig rnal 'byor pas//rdo rje thal mo dam bcings la sems can kun la rjes brtsebs/de nasasnying kha'i hūm̐ gis bos pa'i dkyil 'khoralaphyag 'tshal ba dang /mchod pa dang /skyabs su 'gro ba dgasemasabaskyed pa/bsngo ba dag byasal/hūṃ gis 'bar ba'i rjes su bzhugs pa bsgomamo//chagabhā wa shud+dha sarba dharmā swa bhā bā shurnyo3lha/gzung ba dang 'dzin pa las grol zhing/dngosapo thams cad mnyam par blta/mig gi rnam shes dang /migadangagazugs la sogs pa brten pa dang 'brel ba/rang bzhin dang 'bral ba/gcig dang du ma dang bral ba/gang las skyeb med pa/rang bzhin mkhasapasabasgom par bya/rdorje rwa ba dang drwa ba dang /guradang phur ba'i sa gzhi/skad cig gis rnam par dag pa dang bcas pa'i de kho na nyid bsam par bya'o//de'i dbus su hro dang me dang chu dang dbang wo gyi steng du/ri rab la pho gokhabartsegs yangs pa mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogasapar/seng ge'i gdan la/hūṃ las dang po'i rdo rje lha nyi shu rtsa brgyad pa skad cig gis bltasanas/de'i lte ba la rdo rje sems dpa' rig mar bcas pa'i snying khar hūṃ zlab laganasapa 'od zer 'bar ba sna tshogs pa/oṃ badz+ra shud+dhi sarba dharmā badz+ra shud+dhitshu/de las bdag nyid rdo rje sems dpa' phyag gnyis pa sngon du bshad pa'i rnam pa ste/'on kyang thabs gcig tu bsgom par bya'o//zhabs nisemasadapa'i skyilakrung sangasargyas kyi sprin spro ba/de bzhin gshegs pa lngas dbu lasprasapa/oṃyo ga shud+dhaḥsarba dharma yo ga shurnyo3 haṃ/de'i spyi bo dang mig dang sna dang lce chungadang mgrin pa dang/dpung pa dang snying ga dang lte ba rnamasasu hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ sum̐ sum̐ sum̐ —108

bh+rūṃ sne snro nyu de nas mi shigs pa'i hūṃ gisayi ge snying kha'i chu shing gi me tog lta nu bu la bsgosdasanas/ oṃ urnyisne gis sngags sam/ thog mamed pa'isngags kyi de nyid shes pas bzla bar bya'o/ / stong pa'i ngang las zla ba la cho ga de nyid kyi rdo rje sem dpa' la/ stongapa cirnam pa dang bcas pa'i de nyid mi mo'i phyag rgya dag la yongs su bcug nas/dman par mos pa dang snang ba 'di yongs su brtul nas so/ /'on kyang khyad par ni/ lha nyi shu gsum pa'i bdag nyid/ dril bu āḥlas byung ba yangabud med kyi rtags dang cha lugs su bya'o/ /ā li kā li las byung ba'i sabon oṃ e āḥswāhā/ zhes rlung dang dbye ba dang bye brag med pa nyid du yong ye bzlasapa bya'o/ /gal te rdo rje dang dril bu sa bon dang bcas pa kho nas kyang 'di skyed pa'ang rung mod kyi/ de la yang lha thamasacad kyi lhag par mosapa brtan pa bya'o/ /'di ni khru gang tsam gyis bar chod par gnas par 'dod chagasakyi sems kyi stobs kyi ni/ btso ma gser gyi 'od dang mnyam/ /semasacan bsgralaphyir kun tu 'byud/ /nu ma rtse zhing zhal gnyis 'jig /rdo rje'am soramo'i rtse mor ni/ /bdud rtsi yi ge hūṃ bsam mo/ /lha mo'i bha ga'i g.yon phyogasasā /brtan pa'i rtsemor a bzung ngo / /lce yi bya ba de bzhi du/ /bcobasaganasakyi bdud rtsini/ /'di yi rab sbyor sid kyi sgra/ /bdud rtsi chu ni lagopara'agyur/ kha sbyor 'dod pa lnga la spyad/ /gzugs mchog sgra snyan dngapo lnga/ /nangagi 'byung ba lnga bdag nyid/ /'di las sa ni rnams 'byung ste/ /sangasargyasamustegs kyi mi shes/ /'dod pa'i ka ra na bcings nas/ /rlung ni 'phrad pas 109

gsum thim pa/ /tshangasapa'i bdud rtsi 'dzag par byed/ /steng 'og rangadang gzhan la yang / /rtsa dang rlung dang zla nyi sbyor/ /dga' ba mchogadaga' de bzhin du/ /dga' bral lhan skyes zhes bya ba/ /de la mchoge gi dga' ba ldan/ /skyesadang mnyam pa'i dga' bral gyi dbusasu lhan cig skyes pa mar me lta bu mtshon par byed do/ /de ltar steng 'og gi rim pa gnyis kyi dga' ba bzhi dang/ yangan bsam gtan gyi rang dang 'dod ma 'od gsal du bcug ste mngon par byang chub pa bsgrub par bya'o/ /de las ldang ba na bsam gtan gyi snga ma ltar ldang ste/ de ltar na bde ba chen po'i rdo rje sgrub pa ste/ yang na shin tu spros pa med pa nang gi bdag nyid bsgom par bya'o/ /bar du go cha dgod pa dang / dmigs pa med pa'i smon lamadag bya'o/ /'dir rtsa ba'i mdor/ las kyi tshogs kyi bud med dang / pad+ma can la sogs pa dngosagrub kyi don can bshad pa'i mdor 'byung ba rnams dang /phyogs bzhir semasacan sgrol ba'i bstan bcos dang / go bzlog gi sbyorab dang / mchod pa'i rkang stabasabaco brgyad dang / tshul gyi bye bragaposasacad shesapar bya ste/ gsang ba'i rdo rje dang bral nas/ /dril busaji ltar 'grub paragyur/ /rdo rje'ang dril bu dang bral na/ /rdo rjes 'grub pa'ang ringabara'agyur/ /rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya dag /dmigs na pha rol sgrol bar 'gyur/ /desanirdorje dril bu dag /mnyam pa de nyid bsal bar byed/ /'dod la dga' ba mayin zhing / /longs spyod phyir ni bstan mi bya/ /semasacan don bya'i phyiradu ni/ /rosatu 'bad pasade nyid dmigs/ /mi bzad 'khor ba'i 'jigs pa ni/ /chags—110

pasasrid par lhung bar 'gyur/ /chags pas srid par lhung ba dang/ rten pasa'abor bar 'jug pa ra byed/ /rmongs pa'i bdag nyid ring du spangag /'dod chags spangs pa'i lus kyisani/ /rgyun du brtul zhugs yang bzungaro/ /dben par shin tu mnyam bzhag pas/ /dngosapo thams cad mdor bsdusapakho /dngapor sems brtan mi brtan zhes bya ba las brtan na spyod pa bya'o/ /mtshan moni bzhi mdo la sogs par spyad nasanyin par shin tu gsang ngo / /de yang brtanapar shes shing nus na bla ma la phyag byas te/ 'jigs pa med pa dpa' bo seng ge bzhin du rgyu ste/ de kho na nyid kyis sems dag par byas la 'dod pa lnga laspyod cing sgrib pa lnga'i go skabs skad cig kyang spangs te/ gzung ba dang/ 'dzin pa dang / bzang ba dang/ ngan pa'i rnam rtog mtha' dag spangs pa deng /mongasasugazung ba ni nam yang mi 'dod par mtshan mo shin tu 'jigs pa'i dur khrod du rgyu'o/ /dbyug pa dang lhung bzed gos dmar po dag gis bas mtha'i 'brogadagon pa dag grong dag tu yang bsod snyomasabya'o/ /'di ltar smyon pa'i spyod pa bya ste/ rig ma dang lhan cig spyod pa'am/ yang na nang gi bdaganyid ye shesakyi phyag rgya mo sgrub bo/ /nyen mongs sdig pa'i spyod pas ni/ grub pa nam yang yod ma yin/ /rnying ba'i gosasogasabasgrub par bya/ /milpags ras ni rnying pa bgos/ /dbyug pa thod pa lag na thogs/ /srog chags yan lag lasabyungargyan/ /snod chen po ste 'od gsal ba/ /gzung ba 'dzin pa dbang por bzung / /dziltarabashad pa'i brda rnamasadang / /tshogs kyi 'du ba khyad par du'o/ /yulani nyi shu rtsabazhi po/ /dur khrod wo por zhing skyong ba/ /rdo rje ma mo dag dngas/ /de k+ṣiṃ—111—

grub pa'i zhal lung mchog /'phags yul mkhas pa'i gsung dri med/ /yi ge'i lam du mtshon pa'o/ /skyed swā sti/ bla med gabla ma'i bla ma la/ /gus par gus pas gus phyag 'tshal/ /dpal ldan dpal ster dpal sgrub thabs/ /legs par legs 'dri legs par nyon/ /sgrub pa'i slob dpon rta mchog zhabs/ /de yi bstan pa'i man ngag mchog /rdo rje slob dpon bsgrub pa ni/ /da ni rab tu bshad par bya/ /de la gzhung dgod par bya ste/ oṃ na mo bud+dha ya/ dngos grub slob dpon rjes 'brang bar/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa nyid gsungs te/ /dang po dkyil 'khor byas nas ni/ kha dog sna tshogs me tog dgod/ /der ni bla ma rdo rje sems/ /spyan drangs nas ni phyag byas nas/ /rang ming sngags bzlas gsol gsum gdab/ /rang nyid bla ma brtan gnas la/ /skyabs su 'gro ba rtag tu dran/ /de nas gsang sngags bzlas nas ni/ /de la ut+pa lhusma rtag /rnam par rtog pa gcod par bya/ /khrus byas pad+ma'i lte ba rnams/ /sbyangs nas mtha' dag sdig pa bshags/ /dkyil 'khor rim gro yon 'bul dang / /bla mas gsung kun 'bad de bya/ /gsang sngags ting 'dzin lha'i sbyor bas/ /las rnams thams cad rab tu sgrub/ /—115

dge dang sdig dang dngos po kun/ /de de'i mthu las rab rnyed de/ /gus pas zla ba drug na ni/ /dngos grub thams cad rab grub pa'o/ /bla ma dgyes dang ma dgyes rab 'dod pa'i/ /dngos grub dang ni dmyal bar rtogs byas la/ /blo bzang bdag nyid don kun legs par bya/ /slob dpon dpa' bo rdo rje'i zhal lnga'i rim pa bla ma sgrub thabs rdzogs so// //tsi ti stun+ti ri zhal las chorme kyi zhabs kyi'o/ /de la rim pa 'di yin te/thog ma maṇ+ḍal gyi cho ga rgyas bsdus gang yang rung ba sngon du 'gro bas/ stong pa'i ngang las mdun gyi maṇ+ḍal gyi steng du/ skad cig gi bla ma dur khrod la dgyes pa'i bde mchog /'khor lo he ru ka phyag gnyis rdo rje dang thod pa 'dzin pas/ yum rdo rje phag mo la 'khyud pa g.yas brkyangs kyi stabs kyis pad nyir drag po dang u ma mnan pa/gru mor zung 'jug gi rang bzhin kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dkar po 'chang ba/ rgyan dang mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa la 'khyud pa'i phag mo ni/ dmar mo rdo rje dang thod pa 'dzin pa byin pa gnyis kyis 'khyud pa/ gnyis ga'ang me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na rol pa de nyid sa gsum gyi rdo rje pho nya mo rnams dang /dpa' bo thams cad mnyam par 'dusapar mos la/ gang gi drin chen nyid/ /sogs kyi bar/oṃ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs kyi pad+mo yang dag pa'i ye shes gsal bar byed pa de phyag 'tshal lo/ /hūm̐/ ad+dha sid+dha mi/ lan mang du/phyag bya/ gu ru sha ra gats+tsha mi/lan mang du brjod/ mchod pa rgyasabasdus ji ltar rigasapa'i mchod nas/ oṃ hriḥha ha hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ kyi bla ma'i mtshan/ a hūṃ swāhā/ mang du bzla zhing / thugs gar nyi ma'i steng du hūṃ —116

yig sngags 'phreng dang bcas pa la rtse gcig tu mnyam par bzhag /dpal ldan bla ma dam pas byin gyis brlakha tu garbedul/ zhes gsol ba lan gsum btab pas/ bla ma rang gi spyi bo nas thim/ rang dang dbyer med du gyur/ rang phyi he ru ga'i snying ga chos 'khor gyi lte bar bla ma he ru ka de'i thugs gar nyi ma la hūṃ/ sngags 'phrong gsal btab la/ sngar bzhin skyabs 'gro dang bzlas pa bya/ de nas bla ma'i thugs ga'i 'od kyis sa gsum gyi mkha' 'gro ma rnams rang la bstim/ khams dpa' bo rtsa dpa' mo'i rdul phra rab tu gyur/ bla ma 'od du zhu/ sku gsung thugs kyi gsang ba dang rang gi sgo gsum ro mnyam du gyur/ de nas sprosapa gang yang mi bya bar lhod de bzhag /dran pa'i thag pas rtog pa'i gling po bag med du mi btang / sgo lnga'i rnam shes rtog med 'od gsal ba'i char sgo sbyor ba rnams ni dngos gzhi'i rnal 'byor ro/ /de nas bsngo ba byas la ci rigs par spyod/ spyir sgrub thabs 'dir rang gang la mos pa'i yi dam la sbyar bsarung mod kyi/ kho bo la bla mas gnang ba ni 'khor lo sdom pa'i nges gsang mchog dang sbyar ba 'di dag go/'di'i gdamasangag gi yan lag ni/ u ta ma zhesapa rlabs dang / rngur ma zhesapa ngu ba ste/dang po ni/ bla ma sgrub pa'i gnas skabs su/ rnam par g.yengs bsabasam gtan mi 'phel ba dang /rgod pa shas che na 'di bsgomasaste/ rang yi dam du gsal ba'i dhu ti'i 'khor lo lngar khyab pa/ spyi bo'i bla ma 'od du zhu/ dbu ma'i lam brgyud rtsa'i 'khor lo thams cad dag par byas/ spyi mgrin snying lte rnams su dbang bzhi thob par mos lte 'og tu chos 'byung gru gsum gyi dbus su bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas gang ba'i nang du hūṃ yig skar ma'i gzugs can bla mar mos la gsol ba ci rigs su btab/ de 'od du zhu nas yal ba'i ngang du rnam par rtog pa med pas rtsegacig —117

tu bsgrims te bzhag pa na du ba la sogs pa'i mtshan ma mthong gsungs/gnyis pa shes pa mi gsal ba dang / 'gal rkyen mang ba la/ lte ba'i 'khor 61'i dbus su bla ma de la gsol ba drag tu btab pas 'od du zhu steng du byon ste snying spyi mgrin spyi rnams su dbang bzhi thob/ smin mtshams nas 'thon/ mdun gyi nam mkhar sku snga ma bzhin du gyur pa la gsol btab cing mnyam par bzhag la/yang dang yang du mos gus drag po bya'o/ /khrus bya ba ni bla ma mdun du bsgom la/ nyes lhung mtha' dag bshags/spyi bo'i bla ma 'od du zhu ste thim pas/ sdig sgrib thams cad bu ga kun nas thon pas sangs kyis dag par bsam/ yang lte ba bla ma he ru ka ser po rgya sran gyi tshad tsam/ de la mos gus drag pos gsol ba btab pas/ he ru ka yab yum byang chub kyi sems su zhu ba'i chu rgyun gyis sprul pa'i 'khor lo'i rtsa'i gnas thams cad bkrus/ bdud rtsi thams cad gcig tu 'dus pa 'khor lo'i lte bar zil ba chags pa ltar 'od 'phro ba la rtse gcig tu dmigs/ de bzhin du snying khar sngon po mgrin par dmar po/ dpral bar dkar po/ spyi bor sna tshogs/gsang bar ljang khu'i kha dog can gyi bla ma sgom pa sogs sngar bzhin bsgoms pas phung po lnga/ khams lnga/ dbang po lnga/ yul lnga rnamasakyi dri ma sbyong zhing /gnas skabs su 'byung ba lnga'i nad gdon sel ba dang / rlung dbu mar 'jug pa'i gnad dam pa'o/ /'di'i byin rlabs kyi cho ga ni/ gnasabazang por bla ma nyid kyi khrus byas sdig pa bshags/ rtsa khrus sngon du 'gro bas sngon du brjed pa'i bla ma'i sgrub 118

thabs rdzogs par bya zhing / gtso bo dang mkha' 'gro ma rnams la gtor ma'ang nges par dbul lo/ /de nas slob mas maṇ+ḍal dbul/ slob dpon dgongs hūṃ gsol/ bdag la dngos grub thams cad kyi 'byung gnas bla ma'i dbang bskur ba 455 du garbe1la/ gsum/ maṇ+ḍal gyi dbus su sgrub thabs ltar bla ma bskyed/ phyag 'tshal skyabs 'gro bzlasapa rnams bya/ de nas skyed sarba ta tha ga ta ka ya waka tsit+ta swa bhā bā tsārta ya tsa rā ṇa na ma ste na mo/ ad+dha sid+dha me/ gsum/ bum pa'i chu'i dbang bskur bar mos/ oṃ badz+ra abhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ 1 sbyor mtshams nas 'od dkar dmar byung mgrin par phog /oṃ āḥ&/ 2 rang lha sku kha sbyor la mnyam par bzhag / 3 de yang yal nas stong nyid du bsgom/ 4 bla ma'i dpral mgrin snying kha nas he ru ka dkar dmar mthing gsum gnas gsum du rim bzhin bstim pas dbang gsum/ gsum ga bstims nas lus gang stong pa nyid du bzhag pa'i bzhi pa'o/ /de nas yang skyabs 'gro phyag 'tshal sngar bla ma spyi bor byon 'od du zhu/'khor lo bzhi dbang bzhi thob/ bde gsal mi rtog pa la mnyam par bzhag /dbang bzhi tshan gsum mo/ /slob ma'i spyi bor me tog bzhag la/ oṃ badz+ra sirnyi bha ban+tu/ brjod/ de nas slob mas maṇ+ḍal dbul/ bla ma'i dkyil 'khor rjesabasdus pa spyi dang mthun la/ 'grub na maṇ+ḍal rgyas pa rgya gar ba'i phyag len bzhin bya/ dbang bskur thob ma thag rim gnyis bsgom zer na slob ma mchog dman bla ma rab tu gus sam mi gus brtag /gus na thog mar byin rlabs byas/ bla ma bsgrubs na phyis ting nge 'dzin shugs la myur du skyes la/ de min gsang ba dam por bya'o/ / pyilegs tshogs gzhan yang brjod dang rtsa 'khor gyi lte ba so sor sbyor te zhi ba la bla ma bud+dha he —119

ru ka dkar po dang / oṃ sogs sngags kyi mthar/ pā paṃ ro ga shīn+ti ku ru swāhā/ tshe rgyas pa la ser po bdud rtsi'i bum pa 'dzin pa dang ā yu puṣ+ṭi ku ru oṃ/ nor rgyas pa la brjid bag can/ rin chen snye ma bsnyems pa dang / dha na puṣ+ṭi sogasadang / dbang dgug la dmar po sgeg nyams can lcags kyu zhags pa 'dzin pa ba shaṃ ku ru ho/1 ba ྅ze 2 a rak+ṣa ya hri dza dang / drag po la nag po khro bo rdo rje can bsad bskrad dbye rmongs/ rengs mnan/ sogasala'ang / rnam pa dang sngags rnams ji ltar mthun mthun du sbyar te de ltar so so'i 'byung ba'i gnas la gnas pa la/sngags bzlas pa dang / gsol ba drag tu gdab cing las la sbyar bas thogs pa med gsungs/ gzhan yang bya ba thams cad la 'di ltar rten 'brel 'grigs dgos te/ zhib mor bla ma'i zhal snga nas rtogs par bya'o/ /thams cad dri mo'i dus su yis bya nus/ 'dir 'phags yul gyi slob dpon rnams kyis phyag len mdzad tshul ni/ slob ma mchog gi bla ma sgrub thabs 'di dus zla ba drug gi bar du byed cing / de'i bar du nyin re bzhinaci thun gsum du maṇ+ḍal 'bul phyag 'tshal lan stong stong / bzlas pa drug stong re dang / zas dang yo byad gsar du byung ba thams cad kyi phyed bla ma'am/ de mi zhugs na dam tshig gcig pa'i rnam 'byor pa rnams la 'bul ba ste/ 'di ni ma mtha' bkag pa'i phyag len du mdzad do/ grub pa'i slob dpon rta mchog dang / /paṃ waṃ zhabs dang 'jo sgeg zhabs/ /lhu na ti pa dharma pa/ /byā nga la dang char sprin zhabs/ /dga' ba sbas pa de bzhin du/ grub chen shirnyi gup+ta dang / /sangs rgyas kun gyi ngo bo nyid/ /sbas pa'i mgon po'i zhal lasa'ongs/ /tshul 'di rnal 'byor spyod —120

pa'i tshul 'chang ba/ /kun dga' snying pos sems can kun la sbyin/ /ma gyur 'gro kun sgrol la ma bzhin du/ /brtson pas byang chub mchog la brtson par shog /ces bla ma sgrub thabs rgya gar ba'i paṇa grub kyi zhal lung dri ma med pa snying por phyung ba 'di ni/tā ra nā thas bla ma'i gsung bzhin bcos bslad med par sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni kun dga' legs rgyal lo/ /rang lo nyer gcig gi rtser son pa'am tshe li khe tam/ maṅga lo/ brte ku sa dge'o// //bkra shis//

ces bya ba bsdokyigs/na mo gu sa 'dir lam 'bras bur grags pa'i man ngag gi rtsa ba/ lam dus kyi dbang dang bcas pa nyams su blang ba'i rim pa la/ las dang po pas phyi dkyil dang sbrags te sgom dgos pa las/ phyi bskyed pa'i rim pa rgyas 'bring bsdus pa gang yang rung ba'i dam tshig pa bskyed/ ye shes pa spyan drangs pa la mchod cing bstod nas/ tshodze badz+ra go ri akar+ṣa ya dza/ oṃ badz+ra tso ri pra be sha ya hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra be+e ta li ban+ta baṃ/ oṃ badz+ra ghasma ri wa shaṃ ku ru ho/ gnyis su med par thim pa'i rkyen gyis/ skad cig gis rang gi lus rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'bor yongs su rdzogs par gyur pa ni/ spyi bor sna tshogs rdo rje/rkang mthil rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ rtsib ma rdo rje'i rwa ba/ lpags pa rdo rje'i gur dang bla bre/ ba spu mda'i drwa ba/ sen mo me ri 'bar ba ste bsrung ba'i 'khor lo dang /rkang mthil rlung / sum mdo me/ lto ba chu/ snying kha sa/ sgal tshigs ri rab/mgo bo ri rab kyi stod kyi cha/ lus mi mnyam pa med pa/ gru bzhi ni gzhal yas khang gru bzhi/ snying kha nas 'byung ba bzhi'i rlung rgyu ba ni sgo bzhi/ mig pañtsa re ga'i rtsig pa/ sna rin po che'i pha gu /so drwa ba dang drwa ba phyed pa/ lce dang mchu 'dod yon gyi snam bu/ rna ba rta babs rkang rnams ka ba brgyad de rten gyi dkyil 'khor dang lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lo rtsa 'dab drug cu rtsa bzhi pa'i lte bar e las nga rgyal dang ser sna dang / tshor ba'i phung po rnam par dag pa/ bcom ldan —122

'das yon tan rin chen 'byung ldan sku mdog ser po/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas rin po che dang / g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum sa rnam par dag pa sangs rgyas spyan ma ser mo dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ yum dang 'dra ba'i lha mo drug cu rtsa bzhis bskor ba/ mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes/ gsang gnas bde ba chen po'i 'khor lo rtsa 'dab so gnyis pa'i lte ba'i ha las phrag dog dang 'du byed kyi phung po rnam par dag pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'phrin las don yod grub pa sku mdog ljang khu/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas ral gri dang / g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum rlung rnam par dag pa dam tshig sgrol ma dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ yum dang 'dra ba'i lha mo sum cu rtsa gnyis kyis bskor bar bya ba grub pa'i ye shes/ snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo/ rtsa 'dab brgyad kyi lte ba'i hūṃ las zhe sdang dang rnam par shes pa'i phung po rnam par dag pa/ bcom ldan 'das thugs rdo rje mi bskyod pa sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas rdo rje dang g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum chu rnam par dag pa mā ma gī sngon mo dang mnyam par sbyor ba/yum dang 'dra ba'i lha mo brgyad kyis bskor ba/ me long lta bu'i ye shes/ mgrin pa longs spyod 'khor lo rtsa 'dab bcu drug pa'i lte ba'i oṃ las 'dod chags dang 'du shes kyi phung po rnam par dag pa/ bcom ldan 'das gsung rdo rje 'od dpag med sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas pad+ma dang g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum me rnam par dag pa gos dkar mo dmar mo dang mnyam par spyor ba/ yum dang 'dra ba'i lha mo bcu drug —123—

gis bskor ba so sor rtog pa'i ye shes/ spyi bo bde ba chen po'i 'khor lo/ rtsa 'dab sum cu so gnyis pa'i lte ba'i haṃ las/ gti mug dang gzugs kyi phung po rnam par dag pa/ bcom ldan 'das sku rdo rje rnam par snang mdzad sku mdog dkar po/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas 'khor lo dang / g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum nam mkha'i khams rnam par dag pa rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma dkar mo dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ yum dang 'dra ba'i lha mo sum cu rtsa gnyis kyis bskor ba chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes/ gtso bo lnga po thams cad mtshan bzang po sum cu rtsa gnyis dang / dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus brgyan pa/ g.yas brkyang gi gar stabs can/ spyan gsum pa/ yab lnga po gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ yum lnga g.yon brkyang gi gar stabs kyi yab la 'byud pa/ thams cad kyang rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa 'khor rnams g.yas pa'i phyag mtshan 'phyar thabs dang / g.yon pas thod pa thugs gar gtod pa'o/ /gzhan yang mig tu sa snying dkar po 'khor lo 'dzin pa/ rna bar phyag rdor sngon po rdo rje 'dzin pa/ snar mkha' snying ser po nor bu 'dzin pa/ lcer spyan ras gzigs dmar po pad+ma 'dzin pa/ dpral bar sgrib sel ljang khu ral gri 'dzin pa/ snying khar kun bzang dkar po rdo rje 'dzin pa/ gzhan yang mig tu gzugs go ri/ rna bar sgra tso ri/ snar dri be+e ta li/ lcer ro ghasma ri/ dpral bar reg saspyod ma/ snying gar chos khamasamakha' spyod ma/ de rnamasasku mdog nag po 'dab ma'i lha dang mtshungs pa'o/ /lag pa g.yas par gshin rje mthar byed sngon po —124

thod pa 'dzin pa/ lag pa g.yon par shes rab mthar byed dkar po be con 'dzin pa/ lcer pad+ma mthar byed dmar mo pad+ma 'dzin pa/ gsang gnas su bgegs mthar byed sngo bsangs rdo rje 'dzin pa/ dpung pa g.yas par mi g.yo ba sngo skya ral gri 'dzin pa/ dpung pa g.yon par 'dod pa'i rgyal po sngon po lcags kyu 'dzin pa/ pus mo g.yas par dbyug sngon can sngon po dbyug pa 'dzin pa/pus mo g.yon par stobs po che dud nag rtse gsum 'dzin pa/ spyi gtsug tu gtsug tor 'khor lor bsgyur ba ser po 'khor lo 'dzin pa/ rkang mthil gnyis su gnod mdzes rgyal po sngon po gtun shing 'dzin pa/ de thams cad g.yon brkyang gis ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ lha de dag thams cad sku'i dbyibs rnam par bde ba/ rang bzhin gsal stong / ngo bo zunga'ajug /gzhan yang lus rtsa sprul pa'i sku/ rtsa yi ge longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku/ khams bdud rtsi chos kyi sku/ snying po ye shes rlung /ngo bo nyid kyis skur gyur/ rang gi snying kha'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas/ dbang gi lha de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga/ yum bzhi/ byang chub sems dpa' brgyad/ lha mo drug khro bo bcu dang bcas pa/ skyed bha ga wan mahā ka ru ṇi ka he badz+ra pañtsa ku la sa pa ri wa ra badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dkar mo'i ri dwags/ nas/ g.yung mo sku la 'byud pa nyid/ /zhe sdang rdo rje phyag 'tshal bstod sogs/oṃ badz+ra bhā mi āḥsnyi/ dbang chen gser gyi sa gzhi/ oṃ badz+ra re khe āḥsnyi/ phyi lcags ri lusar yug gis bskor ba'i dbus su/ hūṃ ri'i rgyal po ri rab/ sharalusa'aphags po/ lho 'dzam bu gling / nub ba lang spyod/ byang sgra mi snyan/ nyi ma —125

zla ba/ dbus su lha dang mi'i dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa gang yang ma tshang ba med pa/ 'di nyid dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la dbang bskur zab mo zhu ba'i yon du dbul bar bgyi'o/ /thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol/bzhes nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ byang chub rdo rje/ sogs/ lan gsum/ oṃ swa bhā wa bdag dang dbang rdzas rnam rgyal bum pa'i chur mi dmigs te stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang / raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ hūṃ las rdo rje sngon po lte ba la hūṃ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od 'phros tshur 'dus gcig tu gyur pa las gnyis ka mi bskyod pa sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas rdo rje g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum mā ma gī sngon po gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ gnyis ga'ang rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i mig tu gti mug rdo rje ma/ rna bar zhe sdang rdo rje ma/ sna la ser sna rdo rje ma/ kha la 'dod chags rdo rje ma/ lus la phrag dog yid la bdag medaḥ spyi bor sku mgrin par gsung thugs gar thugs rdo rje ma/ thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas/ phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad mi bskyod pa yab yum gyi rnam par oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥ& baṃ hoḥganyis su med par thim/ oṃ badz+ra bha wa bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ dbang rdzas la dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag /chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/ dbang rdzas kyi mi bskyod pa yab yum snyoms par zhugs te/ zhu ba las byung ba'i dbang rdzas rnam rgyal bum pa'i chur gyur/ zhes brjod/ de nas bcom ldan de bzhin gshegs pa kun/ /sogs dang / o.a bhi ṣiñtsa hu me sarba ta thā ga —126

ta/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyi/ /zhes sogs brjod cing / oṃ badz+ra bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ zhes gsungs shing / de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ rig ma rnams kyi rdo rje glu len/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis bkra shis rjod/ khro bo rnams kyis bgegs bskrad/ lha mo rnams kyis ni mchod/ dbang gi chu rgyun gyis smin mtshams yan chad gang bas bum pa'i dbang thob/ mgrin pa yan chad gang bas gsang ba'i dbang thob/ snying kha yan chad gang bas shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ lus thams cad gang bas mchog tu bde ba chen po bzhi dbang thob/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma dag /chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pa'i dbu brgyan nyer spyod lngas mchod/ de ltar na chu'i dbang thob/ zhe sdang dag /rnam par shes pa'i phung po gnas gyur/ me long lta bu'i ye shes mngon du byas/ mi ribaskyod pa'i go 'phang mngon du gyur pa'i skal ba can du byas pa yin no/ /cod pan nas/brtul zhugs kyi bar la rgyas par ni chu dbang dang 'dra la/cung zad bsdu na/ oṃ swa bhā wa bdag dang dbang rdzas dbu rgyan stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang / raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ e las rin po che ser po e gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od 'phros 'dus gcig tu gyur pa las/ gnyis ka rin chen 'byung ldan sku mdog ser po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas rin po che dang / g.yon desayu ba byas pa'i yum rin chen sgrol ma ser mo g.yas gri gug dang tsha gnyis ga'ang rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par ā/ thugs rkar hūṃ/ thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer —127

'phros pas phyogs bcu'i rin chen 'byung ldan yab yum gyi rnam par oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dbang rdzas la dbang bskur/ rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbu brgyan/dbang rdzas kyi rin chen 'byung ldan yab yum snyoms par zhugs/ zhu ba las byung ba'i dbang rdzas rin po che'i dbu rgyan du gyur/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ sangs rgyas rnams ni thamasacad kyi/ /nas/ rin chen dbang bskur chen por sbyin/ /oṃ badz+ra rat+na mu ku ṭa abhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ lusathams cad gang / dri ma thams cad dag /chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las rin chen 'byung ldan gyi dbu brgyan/ oṃ badz+ra puspro 40PROB/ sogs/ de ltar na cod pan gyi dbang thob/ nga rgyal ser sna dag /tshor pa'i phung po mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes ba rko swa bhā wa sogs/ bdag dang dbang rdzas rdo rje stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang / raṃ las nyi ma'i steng du/dzo las pad+ma dmar po dzo gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od 'phros/ gnyis ka 'od dpag med sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas pad+ma dang /g.yon des yu ba/ yum gos dkar mo dmar mo gri gug thugs ga'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i 'od dpag med yab yum gyi rnam par oṃ badz+ra sa mā dza 'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan dbang rdzas kyi 'od dpag med yab yum snyoms par zhugs/ zhu ba lasabyung ba'i dbang rdzas rdo rjer gyur/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la sangs rgyas kun gyi rdo rje'i dbang / /de ring khyod la bskur bar bya/ /sangasargyasakun tu rab bsgrub phyir/ /—128

rdo rje 'di ni khyod kyis long / /oṃ mahā badz+ra hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra bhā wa 'od dpag med kyi ba o badz+ra puskro nas/ shabha āḥ// de ltar na rdo rje'i dbang thob 'dod chags dag /'du shes kyi phung po gnas gyur/ so sor rtog pa'i ye shes mngon du byas/'od dpag med kyi go oṃ swa bhā wa bdag dang dbang rdzas dril bu stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang / raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ khaṃ las ral gri sngo bsangs sam ljang khu khaṃ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od 'phros/ gnyis ka don yod grub pa sku mdog ljang khu zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas ral gri dang g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i yum dam tshig sgrol ma ljang gu g.yas gri gug thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i — don yod grub pa yab yum gyi rnam par badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ don yod grub pas dbu brgyan/ dbang rdzas kyi don yod grub pa yab yum snyoms par zhugs/ zhu ba las byung ba'i dbang rdzas dril bur gyur/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis rma badz+ra a dhi pa ti s+t+waṃ/a bhi ṣiñtsa me/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra sa mā ye s+t+waṃ/ oṃ badz+ra bha wa don yod grub pas dbu brgyan/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+ṭi sogs/ de ltar na dril bu'i dbang thob/ phrag dog dag /'du byed kyi phung po gnas gyur/ bya ba grub pa'i ye shes mngon du byas/ don yod grub pa'i oṃ swa bhā wa rang nyid mi dmigs te stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang / a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ bh+rūṃ las 'khor lo dkar po bh+rūṃ gyis mtshan pa/ de las 'od 'phros bdag nyid rnam par snang mdzad sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas 'khor lo dang g.yon des yu baḥ yum sangs rgyas spyan ma dkar mo g.yas gri gug thugs ga'i hūṃ las —129

'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i rnam par snang mdzad yab yum gyi rnam par oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥ& baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis skyed badz+ra satwa s+t+waṃ/ a bhi ṣiñtsa badz+ra na ma a bhi ṣe ka ta/ kyai dpal chen che ge mo rdo rje zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa'o/ /oṃ badz+ra bha wā chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las rnam par snang mdzad kyi dbu brgyan/ oṃ badz+ra puposogs nas/ de ltar na ming gi dbang gti mug gzugs kyi phung po chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes rnam par snang mdzad kyi go 'phang mngon du gyur pa'i skal ba can du byas pa yin no/ /dngos kun gang dang gang snang ba/ /gtso de rang gi lhag pa'i lha/ /chos rnams rang bzhin rnyog med dag /sangs rgyas ye shes lta bar gyis/ /oṃ swa bhā wa paṃ las pad+ma dang / a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūṃ las rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa lte ba la hūṃ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od 'phros 'dus gcig tu gyur la las/ bdag nyid rdo rje sems pa sku mdog dkar po g.yas rdo rje dang g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum rdo rje snyems ma sku mdog dkar mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ gnyisaka'ang rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i/ dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs gar hūṃ/ thugs rka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas/ phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum gyi rnam par oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥ& baṃ hokhya gnyis su med par thim/ oṃ badz+ra bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ nas chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las/ mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/ 'di ste sangs rgyas thams cad de/ /sogs dad /—130

brtul zhugs brtan/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta hi hūṃ/ zhesabarjod/ de nas/ maṇ+ḍal gling bzhi ri rab nyi zla zung gcig /lha mi'i dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs dpal ldan bla ma dam pa la bum pa'i dbang bskur ba zhu ba'i yon du 'bul ba brlab tu gsol/ ces brjod/ de nas/ mi ldog 'khor lo'i dbang bskur ba/ /mgon pos bdag la stsal nas kyang / /'khor lo lha yi de nyid dang / /slob dpon 'phrin las yongs su gsungs/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi dam tshig dang / /sdom pa'ang bla na med pa stsole/ /lan gsum/ 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad de/ /nas/ brtul zhugs brtan/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga hi hūṃ/ zhesabarjod/ thog mtha' med pa'i dang po'i skyes bu la'o/ /oṃ badz+ra mahā hūṃ/ zhogabarjod/ 'di ni rnal 'byor ma kun gyi sogs/ rgyal bas bached/ a srid pa ngo bo sogs/ dam pa byed par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra garnye a/ bdag nyid rdo rje 'chang chen po sku mdog sngon po/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas rdo rje dang / g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/yum rdo rje snyems ma sku mdog sngon mo gri gug dang / thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ gnyis ga'ang rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i mig tu gti mug rdo rje mtsha nas/ thugs gar thugasardo rje ma/ thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas/phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad rdo rje 'chang yab yum gyi rnam par oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥ/ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ rdo rje che dang dril bu che/ /sogs/ slob ma'i tshogs rnams bsdu bar gyis/ /shes rab bcu drug lon pa la/ /sogs nas/ yid kyi lus ni bstan phyir ro/ /sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyi/ /gsang gsum nas/ rdo rje dbang bskur chen po sbyin/ oṃ badz+ra bha wa a —131—

bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las/ rdo rje 'chang chen pos dbu brgyan/ oṃ su pra oṃ badz+ra puṣ+ṭi āḥlha/ nas/shabha āḥlha/ de ltar na bla ma'i sku'i dkyil 'khor du bum pa'i dbang thob/ lus kyi dri ma dag lam bskyed rim bsgom pa la dbang / 'bras bu sprul pa'i sku'i go 'phang mngon du 'gyur ba'i skal ba can du byas pa yin no/ /spyo brjod de bum pa'i dbang ngo / /de nas gsang ba'i dbang gi don du/ maṇ+ḍal phul/ khyod ni rnal 'byor ma tshogs yongs su bskor/ /nas/ he ru ka dpal rdo rje yid kyis dges/ /de nas/ bcom ldan zhi ba/ nas/ bying ba skyabs med bdag la stobs/ /oṃ āḥ&/ gdong bcings/de nas bla ma he ru ka yab yum thabs shes snyoms par zhugs pa'i sgras/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams spyan drangs nas zhal du zhugs/ rjes chags kyi mes 'od du zhu/ rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi mkhar babs pa'i byang chub sems kyi thig le mu tig gi rdog ma lta bu bdag gi lce thog tu bzhag /ji ltar 'das pa'i sangs rgyas kyis/ /byang chub sras la dbang bskur ltar/ /sogs/ dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ āḥ lha/ thig le mgrin par thim pas bde ba chen po'i ye shes skyes par bsam mo/ /oṃ āḥlha/ gdong bsal/ de ltar na rdzas gsang ba byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du gsang ba'i dbang bskur ba thob/ ngag gi dri ma dag /lam tsaṇ+ḍali sgom pa la dbang / 'bras bu longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku'i zhes brjod/ gsang dbang ngo / /de nas shesarab ye shesakyi dbang gi don du/ maṇ+ḍal gling bzhi ri rab nas/shes —132

rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur sogs/ gong ltar/ bstod pa gsol btab gsang dbang ltar byas la/ skyed āḥlha/ gisagadong bcings/ bla mas/ dga' ster/ sogs/ rtag tu gyis/zhes rig ma sbyin/ rig masabashang gci dag ni/sogs/ spro gyur tam/ dris pa'i lan du/bshang gci dag ni/ sogs/ spro gyur to/ /rig mas/ e ma nga yi pad+ma sogasamachog gi dngos grub med/ bhardzi mo k+ṣa ho/ /zhes pang du byon/ yum gyi mkha' mi dmigs nas/ āḥs mtshan pa/ yab kyi gsang gnas mi dmigs nas/ hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ bdag nyid he ru ka yab yum rjes su chags pas snyoms par zhugs nas lugs 'byung dang lugs bzlog gi dga' bzhi mngon du byas par gyur/ oṃ āḥsnyi/ gdong g.yogs bsal te/ de ltar na bha ga'i dkyil 'khor du shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur ba thob/ yid kyi dri ma dag/lam pho nya'i lam sgom pa la dbang / 'bras bu chos kyi sku/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang ngo / / de nas dbang bzhi pa'i don du/ /maṇ+ḍal bsdusapa phul/ mgon po thugs rje che ldan pas/ /dbang bskur gsum po bdag la gnang / /rnam pa kun gyi mchog gyur pa'i/ /bzhi pa yang ni byin gyis rlobs/ lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ oṃ 40PROB/zhes gdong g.yogasabacings/ ye shes 'di ni ches phra sogs/ khyod rang yang ni de yis pha/ /zhes mnyam par bzhag go/skyed āḥlha/ gdong g.yogs bsal lo/ /de ltar na don dam byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bzhi pa thob/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma bag chags dang bcas pa dag /lam rdo rje'i rba rlabs sgom pa la dbang / 'bras bu ngo bo nyid sku'i go 'phang mngon du 'gyur pa'i skal ba can du byas pa yin no/ /dbang bzhi pa'o/ /gtso bos ji ltar sogs lan gsum/ maṇ+ḍal bsdus —133

pa phul ba las/ bka' drin gtang rag gi /zhesa'adon pa spos/ deng nas brtsam ste sogs lan gsum/ de ltar na dbang gi chu rgyun gyis lus thams cad gang / dri ma thams cad dag /chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las/ gtso bo yab yum gnyis/ go ri dang puk+ka si la mi bskyod pa/ tso ri dang sha ba ri la rnam par snang mdzad/ be+e ta li dang tsaṇ+ḍa li la rin chen 'byung ldan/ ghasma ri dang ḍom+bhi ni la 'od dpag med/lus dkyil gyi lha thams cad la rdo rje sems dpas dbu brgyan pa'am/ so so'i rigs bdag gis rgyas btab/ dbang 'bring du len na/ dbang lha spyan drangs mchod cing gsol ba btab pa yan chad rgyas pa bzhin byas la/ rdo rje che dang / sogs/ slob ma'i tshogs rnams bsdu bar gyis/ /zhes pas bla ma 'i sku'i dkyil 'khor du bum pa'i dbang thob/ lus kyi sogs/ sprul pa'i sku'i bag chags rgyud la bzhag /ji ltar 'das pa'i/ sogs/ rgyun gyis dbang bskur ro/ /zhes kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi zhes sogasagong ltar ro/ /dga' ster sogs/ rtag tu gyis/ zhes phyag rgya'i bha ga'i dkyil 'khor du/ sogs/ gong ltar ro/ /ye shesa'adi ni sogs/ de yi pha zhes sogs/ don dam byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du/ zhes gong ltar ro/ /dbang bsdus pa len par 'dod na/ dbang lha spyan drangs/ mchod pa dang gsol btab snga ma dang 'dra bar byas la/ bcom ldan de bzhin gshegs pa nas ṣiñtsa tu me gyi bar dang /sangs rgyas rnams kyiḥ nas/ ṣiñtsa hūṃ gi bar sgrub thabasabazhin las/ zhes gsungs zhid / sangs rgyas rnams kyi nas/ dbang gi chu rgyun gyis smin mtshams yan chad gang / bum pa'i dbang thob/ spyi bo'i 'bor lo mi bskyod pa/ /rna cha'i bdag nyid 'od dpag med/ /mgul gyi phreng ba rin chen bdag /lag pa rnam par snang —134

mdzad brjod/ /ska rags la ni don yod gnas/ /yan lag kun la rdor 'dzin 'god/ /mgrin pa yan chad gang / gsang ba'i dbang thob/ lte ba sprul pa'i 'bror lo las kyi phyag rgya/ snying kha chos kyi 'khor lo chos kyi phyag rgya/ mgrin pa longs spyod kyi 'bor lo phyag rgya chen po/ spyi bo bde chen gyi 'khor lo dam tshig gi phyag rgya'o / /snying ga yan chad gang / shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ mig tu gti mug rdo rje ma sogs/ bdag med rnal 'byor ma/ /lte ba nas brgyud lus thams cad gang / bzhi pa'i dbang thob/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma bag chag dang bcas pa dag /chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las gtso bo yab yum dang go ri zhes sogs gong bzhin bsams te/ 'dir de tsam zhig go/zhes pa lus dkyil dang lam dus kyi dbang gi chu bo ma nub bar len pa'i rim pa 'di yang / rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas bsgrigs pa ste/ dpal rtag brtan du'o// // zhus so// ri—135

na mo gu ru we/ rnam kun mchog dang ldan pa'i ye shes dang / /dpal ldan 'gyur ba med pa'i bde ba che/ /zung 'jug 'khor lo'i mgon po bla ma la/ /mchog tu gus pa chen pos phyag 'tshal lo/ /de yi go 'phang sgrub byed bdud rtsi'i bcud/ khuspyab brnyes brgyud pa'i lam las 'ongs pa 'di/ /brjed nges rtog pa spang phyir legs bshad kyi/ /chu dwangs nor bu'i 'phreng ba spel bar bya/ /'dir brgyud kyi rgyal po dpal kyi rdo rje las brtsams te rim gnyis kyi rnam par gzhag pa 'chad pa la gnyis te/ rgyud kyi mngon par rtogs pa mdo tsam bstan pa dang / rim pa gnyis bye brag tu bshad pa'o/ /dang po la/ rjod byed tshig gi rgyud rnam par gzhag pa dang / brjod bya don gyi rgyud nges par bya ba'o/ /dang po la/ rgyud 'di nyid rgyud sde gang du gtogs pa dang / gsungs pa po'i ston pa gang yin pa cadang / rgyud nyid du ngos bzung ba'o/ /dang po ni bdag cag gi ston pas dam pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo bsam gyis mi khyab pa bskor ba thams cad theg pa dman pa'i sde snod dang / theg chen gyi sde snod gnyis su 'dus la/ theg chen gyi sde snod kyang rgyu pha rol tu phyin pa'i sde snod dang / 'bras bu rdo rje theg pa'i sde snod gnyis su 'dus/ gnyis pa rdo rje theg pa'i sde snod thams cad kyang rgyud sde bzhir 'dus te/ rdo rje gur las/ dman pa rnams la bya ba'i rgyud/ /bya min rnal 'byor de lhag la/ /sems can —136

mchog la rnal 'byor mchog /rnal 'byor bla med de lhag pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar rgyud sde bzhi las 'di rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud do/ /de la yang thabs kyi rgyud dang / shes rab kyi rgyud dang / thabs shes gnyis su med pa'i rgyud gsum las/ 'di thabs shes gnyis su med pa'i rgyud yin te/ 'di nyid las/ he ni snying rje chen po nyid/ /badz+ra'ang shes rab brjod par bya/ khres rab thabs kyi bdag nyid rgyud/ /de ni nga yis bshad kyis nyon/ /zhes gsungs so/ /gnyis med rgyud de'i yang snying por gyur pa kyai rdo rje'i rgyud do/ /gnyis pa ni/ spyir rgyud sde thams cad rdo rje 'chang chen pos gsungs shing /khyad par du rgyud 'di nyid thog ma med pa'i dus nas ston pa he ru mo'i rnam pas dag pa'i 'khor tshogs rgya mtsho las gsungs pa/ bar skabs bar skabs su nub par gyur pa las/ bdag cag gi ston pa mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa'i tshul bstan pa'i tshe 'og min du longs sku zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa dang / 'dzam bu'i gling du sprul sku zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa'i rnam pas gsungs so/ /gsum pa ni/ kyai rdo rje'i rgyud rgyas pa 'bum phrag lnga pa zhig yod do/ /rdo rje gur las/ 'bum phrag lnga bdag kyi rdo rje/ /lus ni dkyil 'khor lnga gsungs pa/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ rdo rje rigs kyi dum bu/ sngags kyi dum bu/ dbang bskur ba'i dum bu/ lha'i dum bu/ de kho na nyid kyi dum bu ste de re re la/ blo ka 'bum phrag re re ste 'bum phrag lnga'o/ /de las bsdus pa'i rgyud la/ rtsa ba'i rgyud/ bshad pa'i rgyud/ cha mthun gyi rgyud gsum las/ dang po ni rtsa ba'i rgyud —137

brtag pa gnyis pa yin la/ /gnyis pa thun mong ma yin pa'i bshad rgyud rdo rje gur/ thun mong ba'i bshad rgyud sasna ṭi'o/ / ci ci gsum pa ni/ phyag chen thig le/ ye shesathig le/ ye shesasnying po/ rnal 'byor ma thams cad gsang ba sgron me'i rgyud de thig le skor bzhi/ rdo rje a skre li dang / ri ṣi a ra li dang / rnyog pa med pa'i rgyud rnams so/ /de yang rtsa ba'i rgyud brtag pa gnyis pa 'di rgyud rgyas pa brtag pa sum cu rtsa gnyis pa las byung ba yin cing / de la 'dod tshul mi 'dra ba du ma byung na'ang brtag pa phyi ma gnyis phyung bar bla ma gong ma rnams kyis bzhed do/ /'di la 'grel bshad tshad ldan mang du byung mod/ 'phags yul du shing rta'i srol 'byed tha dad du grags pa ni med la/ bod yul 'dir lugs srol mang du byung ba las/ dpal ldan sa skya ba yab sras la bka' babs pa ni/ slob dpon mthu stobs kyi dbang phyug birlu pa'i man ngag gi lugs dang / grub chen ḍom bhi he ru ka rjes 'brang dang bcas pa'i lugs dang / slob dpon mtsho skyesakyi lugs dang / nag po dam tshig rdo rje'i lugs de bka' bab bzhir grags pa dang / gzhan yang nā ro pa dang / mi tri pa'i lugs te drug go /de la dang po ni snyan rgyud gtso zhing / skabs 'dir gtan la dbab bya'i gtso bo yin la/ ḍom+bhi lugs sogs phyi ma gsum la ni/ ji skad du/ snying po'i don gyi kyi rdor ni/ /birnya'i rjes 'brang ḍom+bhi'i skor/ /yan lag med cirjes pad+ma'i skor/ /dam tshig rdo rje nag po'i skor/ /gtso che'i chos sna sum cu dgu /zhes pa ltar gtso che ba'i chos sna sum cu rtsa dgu yod cing / nā ro pa yi lugs pham thing —138

nas brgyud/ mal lo tsā ba la skya pa chen po'i gsan cing / mi tri pa'i lugs la bsgrub thabs dang yid la mi byed pa'i chos skor nyi shu rtsa drug bzhugs so/ shan+ti me tri snyan grags bzang / /zhes gsungs pa'i shan ti pa'i lugs ni nag po lugs su 'dus so/ /de rnams las slob dpon birlu pa'i lugs 'di rje btsun gong mas mdzad pa rags rim smos na/ bshad pa la nye bar mkho ba'i gzhung bdun te/ rgyud sde'i dum bu/ rgyud de'i spyi rnam/ rgyud kyi mngon rtogs/ de gnyis kyi bsdus don stong thun/ yab kyi bstod pa/ yum gyi bstod pa/ bdag med bstod 'grel lo/ /ji skad du/ rgyud sde'i dum bu rnam bzhag mngon rtogs dang / /stong thun gnyis kyi bsdus don bstod pa gnyis/ /bdag med bstod pa'i rnam 'grel dang bcas pa/ /kun tu dgos pa'i gzhung bdun 'thor mi bya/ /zhesagasungs so/ /gzhung bdun po'i steng du/ rgyud gsum la 'grel pa gsum/ bsdus don gsum te drug bsnan pas bshad pa spyi 'gros chos bcu gsum ste/ ji skad du/ rgyud don so so'i rnam 'grel dang bcas pa/ /gang la gang dgos de de blang bya ste/ /de ltar bcu gsum legs par rab bltas na/ /rnam par phye ba'i rgyud gsum shes par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs so/ /spyir lag tu blang ba'i chos bcu bzhi ni/ ji skad du/ smin byed lhung ba'i rnam bshad sgrub thabs bzhi/ /rab gnas sbyin sreg tshogs kyi cho gar bcas/ /rdo rje dril bu bgrang phreng dgang blugs dang / /tha ma'i cho ga mchod rten sgrub pa ste/ /de ltar bcu bzhi dang po'i lus can nas/ /brtsams te gang zag kun gyis gzung bar bya/ /zhes so/ /de yang dbang bcu/—139

rtsa lhung 'khrul spong / mngon rtog rgyas pa yan lag bzhi pa/ 'bring po yan lag drug pa/ bsdus pa lhan skyes/ yum gyi sgrub thabs dang bzhi/ 'ga' zhig mngon rtogs bsdus pa med/ mtsho skyes lugs kyi mngon rtogs tshigs bcad ma 'dren zer te ha cang thal bar 'dra'o/ /bsdus pa'ang da lta bka' 'bum na bzhugs pa 'di yin pa'i nges pa med/ yin na yig sna drug ci'i las dang po'i chos kyi nang du 'dren rig pa las ma bgrangs/ des na kyai rdor gyi sgrub thabs yin pa'i nges pa med pas man ngag lugs kyi rgyud 'chad pa la mkho ba'i sgrub thabs gzhan yod pa deng sang dpe ma rnyed pa'ang yin srid gsungs so/ /rab gnas bzang po dang drug sbyin bsreg zhi ba dang las bzhi/ rdo rje dang dril bu'i de nyid dus tha ma'i cho ga rnams la yig cha re re yod cing / bgrang phreng dgang blugs mchod rten sgrub pa rnams la yig cha zur dang lnga par yod pa dang deng sang nub pa'i/yang na yig cha che ba rnams kyi nang na cha shas kyi gsungs pa rnams la dgongs zer ro/ /zhar la 'ongs pa sbas pa'i brtul zhugs la nye bar mkho ba'i chos drug ni/ji skad du/ rus rgyan btags pa'i snod dang gzung bya'i zas/ /rol mo'i cho ga stan dang bgo ba'i gos/ /'di dag he ru ka dpal chas drug ste/ /rnam par phye na bcu bzhir 'gro ba yin/ /zhes so/ /bcu bzhi po gang zhe na/ rgyan la bzhi dang /btung ba'i snod dang lnga/ lag cha gnyis dang rol mo'i cha byad gsum/ stan dang gos la gnyis gnyis te/ de ltar bdun du dbye ba'i rnam grangasabacu bzhi'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i rgyan bzhi ni/ rusargyan/ khrag gi thig le/ zhag gi rdze ris/—140

thal chen gyi tshom bu rnams so/ /btung ba'i snod thod pa/ lag cha gnyis ni gri gug dang kha ṭaṃ ga'o/ /rol mo'i cha byad gsum ni/ cang teg gsang ba'i rnge'u chung / mi rkang gi gling bu rnams so/ /stan gnyis ni/ stag lpags dang ro gdan no/ /gos gnyis ni stag lpags dang / ro'i chas gos so/ /gzhan yang gdan gyi rnam grangs sogs mang du yod cing / sbas pa'i don rnams gsung rab rin po che las 'phros nas dkar chag sogs su mdzad do/ /gnyis pa brjod bya don gyi rgyud nges par bya ba ni/ /ji skad du/ gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud phyi ma las/ rgyud ni rgyun chags zhes bya ste/ /rgyud de rnam pa gsum du 'gyur/ /gzhi dang de yi rang bzhin dang / /mi phyogs pa yi rab dbye ba/ /rang bzhin rnam pa rgyu yin te/ /gzhi ni thabs shes bya ba yin/ /de bzhin mi phyogs 'bras bu'o/ /gsum gyis rgyud kyi don bsdus pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ brjod bya don gyi rgyud la dbye na/ rgyu rgyud sngon du 'gro ba rten gyi gang zaganyams su blang bya thabs kyi rgyud/ nyams su blangs pas thob pa 'bras bu'i rgyud dang gsum mo/ /dang po la/ rgyu rgyud kyi ngo bo/ gang zag gi rang bzhin/ de'i rgyud ji ltar sbyangs pa'i tshul dang gsum/ dang po ni/ sems rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal ba kun tu 'gro ba de yin la/ de'i snang cha 'khor ba'i chos thams cad kyang rgyu rgyud du bsdus pa yin te/ rdo rje rtse mo las/ rgyud ni rgyun zhes bya ba ste/ /'khor ba rgyud du 'dod pa yin/ /zhes so/ /gnyisapa gang zag gi rang bzhin ni/ slob dpon gar+bha ri pas/ rgyu rigs spang bya rkyen la ltos/ /gang zag rnam pa bzhi yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ gang zag la dbye na/ rgyu la ltos —141—

pa/ rigs la ltos pa/ spang bya la ltos pa/ rkyen la ltos pa dang bzhi'o/ /gsum pa ni/ spyod pa'i tshul khrims kyi rim pasasbyang ba/ lta ba'i rim pas sbyang ba dbang gis smin par byed pa ste/ ji skad du/ skal dman sems can 'dul dka' ba/ /gang gis 'dul bar 'gyur ba lags/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /dang por gso sbyong sbyin par bya/ /de rjes bslab pa'i gnas bcu nyid/ /de la bye brag smra ba bstan/ /mdo sde pa yang de bzhin no/ /rnal 'byor spyod pa de la phyes/ /de yi rjes su dbu ma bstan/ /theg pa'i rim pa kun shes nas/ /de rjes kyi rdo rje bstan/ /ces gsungs so/ /de yang skal dman rim 'jug pa'i dbang du byas pa yin la/ skal ldan cig car ba la ni dbang bskur ba kho nas rgyud sbyang ba 'grub pa yin no/ /spyir dbang la/ rgyu dus kyi dbang / lam dus kyi dbang/ 'bras dus kyi dbang gsum yod/ /de gsum ngo bo'i sgo nas thabs rgyud yin kyang / ma smin pa smin par byed pa'i dbang ngam/ rgyu dus kyi dbang ni/ rang gang la bskur ba'i sems rgyud de rgyu rgyud khyad par can du byed pa'i phyir rgyu rgyud kyi mngon rtogs yin no/ /ji skad du/ thabs la smin byed dbang dang nyams myong dang / /zhes thabs rgyud du gsungs pa'ang yod/ de la gang du dbang bskur ba'i dkyil 'khor/ gang la dbang bskur ba/ ji ltar bskur ba'i tshul dang gsum/ dang po ni/ sam+bha ṭi las/ dkyil 'khor lusasu gsungs pa ste/ /dkyil 'khor bha ga zhes su brjod/ /dkyil 'khor byang chub sems yin te/ /dkyil 'khor gsum du gsungs pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ bum dbang gi dkyil 'khor lus kyi —142

dkyil 'khor dang / rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor dang/ dbyibs su bkod pa'i dkyil 'khor gzhan dang / ting nge 'dzin gyi dkyil 'khor te bzhi yod pa las/'dir gtso bor gyur pa lus kyi dkyil 'khor smos shing / bha ga'i dkyil 'khor du gsang dbang / byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor la gnyis las/ kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du shes rab ye shes kyi dbang dang / don dam byang chub sems kyis dkyil 'khor du dbang bzhi pa bskur ba yin no/ /gang zag rab 'bring tha ma gsum kha la spyir btang la smin byed kyi bum dbang rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur dgos shing / ras bris dang / rdo rje dril bu pas smin byed lus dkyil du bskur bar gsungs pa sogs dmigs bsal yin no/ /gnyis pa ni/ slob ma'i lus rtsa'i dkyil 'khor la bum dbang / rtsa ba'i yi ge dkyil 'khor la gsang dbang / khams bdud rtsi'i dkyil 'khor la shes rab ye shes kyi dbang / snying po ye shes rlung gi dkyil 'khor la dbang bzhi pa bskur ba yin/ gsum pa ni/ mngon par rtogasapa bdun dang ldan ste/ de yang sngon du 'gro ba bsnyen pa ni slob dpon gyis bsgrub par bya ba yin zhing dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga la dngos la slob ma rjes bzung / sa chog brtag bslang sbyang bzung srung ba sta gon rnam pa bzhi'i rim pa/ dris shing rgyan bkram pa/ sgrub cing mchod/ bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blang ba/ slob ma gzhug cing dbang bskur ba'o/ /rjes chog ni slar bsdu ba'i cho ga'o/ /gnyis pa thabs rgyud kyi mngon par —143

rtog pa bcu gcig ste/ mchog sgrub pa'i mngon rtogs lnga/ thun mong sgrub pa'i mngon rtogs lnga/ gnyis ka la dgos pa'i grogs dam tshig dang sdom pa'o/ /dang po lnga ni las thams cad lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes su shes par bya ba'i phyir rtogs pa'i lta ba dang / rdzogs rim gyi brten bskyed pa'i rim pa/ lhar snang ye shes su rtogs par bya ba'i rdzogs pa'i rim pa/ rim gnyis brten nas bogs 'byin pa spyod pa/ 'bras bu la mtshams sbyor ba nye rgyu ā li kā li byang chub kyi sems rnams so/ /gnyis pa lnga ni/ yi dam lha'i thugs brgyud bskul ba'i phyir bzlas pa/bar chad la sogs pa zhi bar bya ba'i phyir gtor ma/ sku gzugs byin gyis brlabs pa'i phyir rab gnas/ las thams cad 'grub par bya ba'i phyir sbyin sreg /dman pa la mos pa'i gang zag rjes su bzung ba'i phyir las rab 'byams rnams so/ /de gnyis kyi dang po/ lta ba la thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i lta ba gnyis las/ dang po ni pha rol tu phyin pa'i lta ba yin la/ de'i thos bsam gyi lta ba ni lta ba dug can du bzhed do/ /gnyis pa thun mong ma yin pa sngags kyi lta ba ni/ spros pa thams cad dang bral ba'i stong nyid de yul can dbang gi ye shes kyis myong bar byas pa la ngos 'dzin pa yin no/ /rim pa gnyis kyi rnam bzhag 'og tu 'chad la/ spyod pa de la a wa dhu ti kun 'dar gyi spyod pa/ kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa/ phyogs las rnams rgyal gyi spyod pa ste gsum mo/ /nye rgyu ni spyod pa dang 'brel ba yin mod/thun mong min pa'i khyad par ni/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sprul pa'i sku dang /—144—
