dang po ni/ rdo rje gur las/ dri za rnam par zhugasanas ni/ /zhu ba rjes su dran par bya/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don de/ slar yab yum snyoms par zhugs pas/bar srid mtshon byed kyi yi ge rnams zhal du bzhugs pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ yab yum gnyis rjes chags kyi sems kyis zhu ba ste dkyus bzhin no/ /de yang mngon byang lnga bskyed nas ye shes pa bstim pa'i bar rjes chags kyi yan lag yin kyang / rjes chags kyi gtso bo rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa zhu ba nyid yin pas/ nga rgyal bzung ba'i sngags skabs 'dir brjod dgos pa yin/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu ra ga ṇa/ rjes su chags pa/ badz+ra swa bha wa āt+pa konyunya/ zhes pa'o/ /gsum pa ni/ mtshams kyi lha mo puska si sogs bzhi ni spyan ma sogs bzhi dang / tshad med bzhi'i ngo bo yin pas de rnams kyis sems can gyi don la bzhengs par glus bskul ba la/ puska sis thugs rje chen po'i sgo nas bskul ba ni/ rje btsun zhes bos nas/ khyed snying rje chen po'i rang bzhin can gyi yid yin pas/ thig le las lha sku zhal phyag gi rnam par bzhengs shig bzhengs nas puska sī bdag la skyobs shig /stong pa nyid la bzhugs pa'i ting nge 'dzin rang bzhin 'di nyid spongs la/ bdag la bde ba chen po'i sbyor ba'i sa la longs spyod bzhed par mdzod cig ga ba ris gnad la bor ba'i tshul gyis bskul ba ni/ kyai rdo rje khyod med pa ste zhal phyag gi rnam par mi gsal na/ sha ba ri bdag 'gum par 'gyur bas/ stong pa'i rang bzhin nyid spongs la ri khrod ma bdag gi 'dod pa'i 'bras bu grub par mdzod cig /tsan+d+ra lis sngon gyi thugs dam rjes su rab tu dran pa'i sgo nas bskul ba ni/ dga' gtso zhes bos nas khyod kyis sngon thugs bskyed —198

pa'i skabs su 'jig rten thams cad mgron du gnyer ba ste gzhan don byed par dam bcas te/ da stong pa nyid kyi don la bzhugs sam ci/ khyod med na bdag gis phyogs ni mi 'tshal bas te blang dor gyi gnas mi shes na kyai rdo rje khyod la zhal phyag gi rnam par bzhengs zhes gdol pa mo bdag zhu ba bgyid do/ /g.yung mos thugs yongs su mkhyen pa'i tshul gyis bskul ba ni/ g.yung mo bdag ni sems sgrim pas bdag gis khyod kyi thugs 'tshal gyis/ mig 'phrul mnga' ba ltar sprul pa sna tshogs su 'gyed nus shing / sna tshogs su snang ba'i g.yo sgyu can 'tshal gyi/ de bas na khyod bzhengs shig /snying rjes rgyun chad ma mdzad cig ces pa'o /de dag las bar do'i rnam shes gzhug pa ni/ bar srid kyi sems can skye gnas la dmigs nas 'jug pa dang/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'gro don gyi dus mkhyen pa mtshon pa dang / yab yum zhu ba ni mngal du srog chags pa dang / 'gro don gyi rgyu thugs rje chen po'i ting nge 'dzin bde ba chen po'i ye shes su gnas pa dang mtshungs pa yin cing/ glus bskul ba ni/ mngal du chags pa nas rgyu khu khrag 'dres pa la yod pas 'byung ba bzhi dang / grogs ma'i mngal gyi 'byung ba bzhi'i/ sas sra bar byed/ chus sdud par byed/ mes smin par byed/ rlung gis rgyas par byed pa dang / tshad med bzhis thugs rje chen po'i ting nge 'dzin bskul ba ma31na cerdzo/ /bzhi pa/ 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin pa bzhedas pa ni/ yan lag bzhi pa sogs mngon rtogs rgyas pa'i phyogs la mngon byang lnga bskyed yod pa ltar na/ sbyang gzhi —199

sbyong byed sbyor tshul snga ma'i rim pas 'gre'o/ /skabs 'di'i mngon rtogs phal che ba la/ 'od kyi gong bu las sa bon dang/ de las 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin pa bskyed par bshad pa yin te/ rgyud las/ hūṃ dang e gi rdo rje che/ khu ba'i gzugs las bzhengs nas ni/ /zhes dang / bdag po'i sa bon bdag nyid ni/ /e hūṃ sngon po 'bar 'jig pas/ /zhes gsungs pas glus bskul ba'i rkyen gyis 'od kyis gong bu las sa bon hūṃ dang e sngon po 'bar zhing 'jig par bsgom/ de nyid 'od zer dang bcas pas mngal gyi gnas skabs bcu char mtshon pa yin no/ /de yang 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sku mdog phyag mtshan sogs ni/ rgyud las/ zhal brgyad pa la 'khas bzhi pa/ /phyag ni bcu drug dag gis brgyan/ /bdud bzhi rnam par mnan pa nyid/ /'jigs pa'ang 'jigs par mdzad pa po/ /mgo bo'i phreng ba'i do shal mdzad/ /nyi mar bzhugs shing rol par bcas/ kha dog sngon po 'jigs chen po/ /sna tshogs rdo rje spyi bor 'dzin/ /nyid kyi zhal nas hūṃ spro zhing / /thal ba'i lus la byugs pa nyid/ /ces dang / rtsa ba'i zhal ni nag po che/ /g.yas pa'i zhal ni kun+da mtshungs/ /g.yon pa dmar po cher 'jigs pa/ /spyi bo'i zhal ni gtsigs pa can/ /spyan ni nyi shu rtsa bzhi che/ /lhag ma'i zhal ni bung ba bzhin/ /zhes dang / glang po rta bong glang rnga mong / /mi dang sha ra bha byi la/ /g.yas pa'i thod pa brgyad po la/ /gnyis 'thung la sogs rim shes bya/ /sa dang chu dang me dang ni/ /rlung dang zla ba nyi ma nyid/ /mthar byed dang ni gnod sbyin nyid/ g.yon pa'i thod pa brgyad na'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /mngon —200

rtogs dkyus go sla zhing / steng zhal dud kha ni spos dud kyi kha dog lta bu sngo bsangs yin la/ steng zhal gtsigs pa ste mche ba cher mdon pa am gcigs lta bu'o/ /rje btsun gong ma rnams kyi yig cha las rgyab zhal bzhi nag po zhes pa kho nar gsungs/ bar gyi bla ma rnams g.yas g.yon gyi zhal ma yin gyi/ rgyab zhal mi byed par lhag pa cung zad yod par byas par bzhed/ sha ra bha ni seṅge rkang pa brgyad pa zhes pa sogs dang dbyi gnyis su yang gshog pa re re yod pas rkang pa brgyad par btags la/ dbyibs seṅge lta bu la lug gi rwa lta bu'i rwa dang ldan pa kha dog sngon po yod pa'o/ /sa'i lha ni sa'i lha mo yin la/ gzhan rnams ni lha pho'o/ /zhabs g.yas gnyis brkyang ba'i brla la g.yon gnyis bskum pa'i sor mo rnams bstad pa'i skyil krung phyed pa dang / mdun ma gnyis brkyang bskum/ rgyab ma gnyis skyil krung phyed pa'i gar stabs mdzad pa gnyis ka la lung rnam par dag pa yod pas gnyis ka 'thad pas/ phyogs gcig la a la 'thad par gang bde bya zhid / sa lugs pa ma gtogs pa'i gzhan bod kyi kyi rdor ba thams cad ni zhabs kyi bzhugs stabs phyi ma 'di kho na bzhed cing / sa lugs la yang rje btsun gong ma rnams kyi thugs dam bris sku yid ches pa can sogs las ni phyi ma 'di kho na 'byung / rgyud 'dir rus pa'i rgyan lnga gsal te/ phyag rgya lngas ni rnam par brgyan/ /zhes chos sku rdo rje 'chang la yang phyag rgya lngar bshad/ spyod pa'i skabs su thal ba yang bshad pas/ ser ral kha yang man ngag gis sbyar nas rgyan drugs skya ba phyi ma rnams dbu gcig la zhal brgyad du bzhed kyi/ dbu brgyad gtan —201—

nas mi 'thad par 'dod kyang / de ma thag tu dbu re re lu mi mgo skam po lnga lngas dbu brgyan pa zhes 'don pa dang 'gal/ des na dbu brgyad 'dod pa dang zhal brgyad du 'dod pa'ang gnyis ka phyogs rer ma lhung ba bya zhing / rje btsun gong ma rnams dbu brgyad du 'dod pa shas che'o/ /phyag bcu drug re re la'ang dpung pa re/ de re re la sog pa re re'o/ /bdag med ma'ang dkyus bzhin no/ /de ltar 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin pa zhal phyag gi rnam pa can du bskyed pa ni/ ma'i mngal nas btsas pa mtshon pa dang/ sprul pa'i sku yum gyi lhums su zhugs pa dang sku bltams pa mtshon no/ /lnga pa 'od zer spro bsdu'i zhing sbyong ba ni/ yab kyi thugs gar nyi ma'i steng du hūṃ/ zhes sogs lha rnams kyi thugs gar sa bon gdan dang bcas pa tsam bsgoms pas kyang sems dpa' sum brtsegs don gyis sgom pa yin te/ de yang sa bon gyi yi ge gdan dang bcas pa ni ye shes sems dpa' dang / zla phyed thig le nā dwa rnams ni ting nge 'dzin sems dpa'o/ /'di la slob dpon mi thub zla ba'i sgrub thabs yan lag drug par sems dpa' sum brtsegs dngos su bskyed par bshad de/ 'dis ni mngal nas btsas pa'i sems can gyi sems kyi nus pa gong nas gong du 'phel ba dang/ sprul pa'i sku bstim nas ye shes lhag par spro ba mtshon pa yin no/ /de rnams las 'od zer 'phros/ snod thams cad gzhal yas khang / bcud kyi sems can re re bzhin yang lha dgu dgur mos pa bya/ de ltar 'od zer spro bsdu'i zhing sbyangs pa ni/ snod bcud du 'dzin pa'i 'du shes rags pa lhag par rgyas pa dang / rdzogs smin sbyang gsum gyi lhag ma'ang ci —202

rigs par spyod pa mtshon pa yin no/ /drug pa skye mched byin gyis brlabs pa ni/de thams cad kyi mig la sogs pa nang gi skye mched kyi dbang rten so so dang /dpral ba mgrin pa snying ga rnams su lha rnams kyi ming yig dang po la sogs pa rnams thig les brgyan pa las gti mug rdo rje ma sogs skye mched so so'i lhar bsgoms shing / de yang mig sogs su lha mo de dag gis spros par sgom pa yin gyi/ mig sogs nyid de dang der bsgom pa ni ma yin la/ sku mdog phyag mtshan dkyus bzhin no/ /de rnams kyi lus ngag yid gsum gyi nus pa 'phel ba dang /sku gsung thugs kyi mdzad pas gdul bya yongs su smin par mdzad pa mtshon no/ /gnyis pa ye shes pa gzhug pa ni rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas ye shes kyi dkyil 'bor spyan drangs pa la mchod de dgug gzhug bya ba sogs dkyus bzhin no/ /de rnams kyis lo bcu drug gam bcu gnyis lon pa na/ 'dod pa'i yul rnams la bye brag phyed pas lus sems kyi mthu yongs su rdzogs pa dang / khyim nas khyim med par rab tu byung ste chags bral brnyes pa'i tshul ston pa mtshon pa yin no/ /de dag ni rjes chags kyi yan lag yin te/ mngon byang gi tshe nyi zla kha sbyor gyi rjes chags dang / rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa dang 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin pa zhal sbyor gyi rnam pa can gyi rjes chags dang / dam tshig sems dpa' la yeshes sems dpa' bstims nas bde ba chen po skye ba dang / 'khor gyi lha mo spro ba rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa yab yum zhu ba gnyis ni rjes chags dngos yin pas so/ /de ltar rjes chags de rnams rdo rje sems dpa'i yan lag yin te/ rdo rje sems —203

dpa' ni bde ba chen po'i ngo bo dang rigs thams cad kyi khyab bdag yin la/yan lag 'di yang bde ba chen po'i lam dngos dang yan lag drug gi gtso bo yin pa dang / yang rdo rje sems dpa' sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rtsa ba yin pa dang / yan lag 'di yang sgrub thabs kyi rtsa ba yin pas de dang cha mthun pa'o/ /gsum pa dbang bskur ba mi bskyod pa'i yan lag la/ dbang bskur ba dang /rgyas gdab pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer nag po lcags kyu lta bu 'phros/ dbang gi lha rigs lnga sogs gdan gsum tshang ba'i lha tshogs spyan drangs la mchod de gsol ba btab dbang bskur te/ de yang rgyud gzhan las rigs lngas dbang bskur ba'i dgongs pa mdzad/ yum bzhi'i dbang bskur ba sogs bshad mod/ 'dir rigs lnga nyid kyis dbangabaskur/ rig ma rnams kyis rdo rje'i glu len/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis bkra shis brjod/ khro bo rnams kyis bgegs bskrad/ lha mo rnams kyis mchod pa byas par bshad do/ /rgyud las/ sangs rgyas de rnams he ru ga'i rnam pas gzugs kyi de bzhin gshegs pa lnga'i bdag nyid kyis/ bdud rtsi lngas gang ba'i bum pa lngas dbang bskur bya'o/ /dbang bskur ba na me tog gi char 'bab par 'gyur ro/ /rnga'i sgra 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /gur gum gyi char 'bab par 'gyur ro/ /gzugs rdo rje ma la sogs pa rnams kyis mchod par bya'o/ /rdo rje'i glu spyan ma la sogs pa rnams kyis blang ngo / /zhes gsungs so/ /de yang smin mtshams kyi 'khor lo dang / mgrin pa dang / snying ga rnams rim pa bzhin du lus ngag yid gsum gyi —204

snang ba 'byung ba'i rtsa yig gi gnas yin pa'i phyir sku gsung thugs kyi gnas su 'jog pa dang / lus kyi dri ma dag byed bum dbang / ngag gi dri ma dag byed gsang dbang / yid kyi dri ma dag byed shes rab ye shes kyi dbang yin pas dbang gi chu rgyun gyis smin mtshams yan chad gang / bum pa'i dbang 11ba/ bum dbang gi lam gyi mthar thug pa bskyed rim gyi rgyan phra mo tshun chad gsal 'debs pa yin la/ de mtshon don du/ spyi bo'i 'khor lo mi bskyod pa sogs brjod do/ /mgrin pa yan chad gang / gsang dbang thob pa'i de'i lam rang byin rlabs kyi mthar thug pa 'khor lo bzhi phyag rgya bzhir mos pa ste/ lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lo zhes sogs kyi brjod/ snying ga yan chad gang bas sher dbang thob ste/ skye mched sku gsung thugs byin rlabs dran par bya ste de'i don dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i lam bsgoms pas mthar thug tu rtsa rnams byang chub kyi sems kyi skye mched dbang po'i sgo thams cad kyang gang bas 'jug shes drug bde stong gi ye shes 'char tshul yin no/ /mig tu gti mug rdo rje ma sogs brjod/ dbang bzhi pa dri ma mtha' dag sbyong byed yin pa'i phyir bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyis lus thams cad gang ba la sbyor zhing / de'i mthar rgyas gdab byed pa yin pas chu de'i nang nas dwangs ma'am gtso bo zhig yar byung spyi bor 'khyil ba las rigs bdag 'byung ba ni/ dbang bzhi pa'i lam rdo rje'i rba rlabs kyi skabs su byang chub sems kyi bsgrod pa dang /rtsa rnams gtsug gtor tu thims pa mtshon/ de ltar sngar bshad pa rnams kyi steng du dbang bskur bas/ lha'i rnal 'byor ma tshang ba med pa yin zhing / de nyid rang —205

rang gi rigs dang rjes su 'brel nas las kyi mtha' la gnas pa dang / byang chub chen por sangs rgyas rnams kyi dbang bskur ba'i rkyen gyis mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa'i mdzad pa ston pa mtshon no/ /gnyis pa ni/ spyir rgyas gdab la/ngo bo nyid kyi rgya/ lus la sems kyi/sems la lus kyi/ rgyu la 'bras bu'i/ 'bras bu la rgyu'i rgyas gdab ste lnga po 'disachos thams cad la rgyas gdab par bya ba yin/ /de yang chos thams cad rang bzhin gyi rnam par dag pa ni ngo bo nyid kyi rgyas gdab pa'o/ /gzugs can du snang ba thams cad rnam par rig pa tsam yin pas lus la sems kyis rgya/sems nyid khams gsum gyi dngos por snang ba ni sems la lus kyi rgya/ dngos po thams cad rgyu 'bras phan tshun 'brel ba can yin pa ni rgyu la 'bras bu dang /'bras bu la rgyu'i rgya'o/ /'dir gtso bo yab yum la mi bskyod pas rgyas gdab pa ni ngo bo nyid kyi rgya ste/ gtso bo yab yum zhe sdang rnam par dag pa dang rdo rje'i rigs yin la/ mi bskyod ba'ang de yin pas so/ /go rī dang puska sī la mi bskyod pas rgyas gdab pa ni lus la sems kyi rgya ste go rī ni rnam par snang mdzad lha mor bstan pa yin la/ rnam snang ni gzugs phung dag pa yin/ puk+ka sī ni sa khamasarnam dag yin/ de yang gzugs su 'dus pa'i lus yin la/ mi bskyod pa ni rnam shes rnam par dag pa sems yin pas so/ khyud las rdo rje snying pos gsol ba/ sa ni puk+ka srir bshad pa/ /gang phyir gti mug sra ba nyid/ /sku ni rnam snang nyid gsung na/ /ji ltar mi bskyod phyag rgya la/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ sems spangs nas ni lus kyi ni/ /mdzes pa —206—

gzhan du mi 'gyur ro/ /de phyir rnam par snang mdzad sems/ /sku la thugs kyi phyag rgyas gdab/ /ces so/ /tso rī dang sha ba ri la rnam snang gi rgyas gdab pa ni/sems la lus kyi rgya ste/ tso rī ni sgra rnam dag yin/ sgra rdo rje ma mi bskyod pa'i rigs yin pas de dgongs shing / shā bā ri chu rnam dag /don du de gnyis rnam shes rnam dag gi ngo bo sems yin la rnam par snang mdzad lus rnam par dag pa yin pas so/ tāspyid las/ lus spangs nas ni sems kyi ni/ /gnas pa gzhan du mthong mi 'gyur/ /gang phyir sems ni gti mug 'gyur/ /thugs la gti mug phyag rgyas btab/ /ces so/ /be+e ta lī dang tsan+d+ra lī la rin chen 'byung ldan gyis rgyas gdab pa ni rgyu la 'bras bu'i rgya ste/ bai tā li 'dod chags rnam dag 'od dpag med lha mor bstan pa dang / tsan+d+ra lī me rnam dag yin pas de gnyis ka 'dod chags rnam dag yin la/ rgyu 'dod chags las 'bras bu longs spyod la brkam pa'i ser sna dang / 'dod pa'i dngos po de snyam du nga rgyal skye/ rin 'byung ni nga rgyal dang ser sna rnam dag yin pas so/ khyud las/ gang phyir 'dod chags khrag bshad pa/ khrag ni rin chen 'byung ldan nyid/ /drod ni khrag gi rang bzhin phyir/ /'dod chags ser snas phyag rgyas gdab/ /ces so/ /ghasma rī dang ḍom+bhi ni la 'od dpag med kyi rgyas cigadab pa ni 'bras bu la rgyu'i rgya ste/ ghasga rī phrag dog rnam dag dang / ḍom+bhi nī rlung rnam dag ste gnyis ka phrag dog rnam dag yin la/ rgyu bdag nyid la chags pa'i rkyen gyis/ 'bras bu gzhan gyi phun sum tshogs la sdang ba'i phrag dog 'byung / 'od dpag med 'dod chags rnam dag yin pas so/ khyud las/ 'dod chags ma gartags phrag dog ni/ /gzhan du —207

'byung ba ma yin te/ /de'i phyir 'dod chags phyag rgya yis/ /mkhas pas g.yung mo phyag rgya gdab/ /ces so/ / oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta/ mngon par dbang bskur ba/ badz+ra swa bhā wa at+pa ko3nya/ zhes nga rgyal bzung ngo / /de ltar dbang bskur ba mi bskyod pa'i yan lag yin te/ dbang bskur ba ni bum pa'i chu'i bya ba dang 'brel ba yin la/chu khams rnam par dag pa ma mā ki dang / ma mā ki mi bskyod pa'i yum yin pas so/ /lha la dbang bskur ba'i bya ba yongs su rdzogs pa na/ de nyid kyi nga rgyal bzung bar bya ba yin te/ dbang bskur ba'i yan lag gis mtshams shes pa'i ched yin pa'i phyir ro/ /'di ni 'og nas 'byungaba'i yan lag phyi ma gsum la'ang rigs 'gre'o/ /bzhi pa bdud rtsi myangs pa 'od dpag med kyi yan lag ni nang mchod dngos su yod na de'am bsam pas kyang rung ste/ gsang ba 'dus pa las/ sha rnams thams cad med na yang / /thams cad bsam pa'i rnam par gzhag /rdo rje'i sbyor ba 'di yis ni/ /sangs rgyasathams cad byin gyis brlabs/ /zhes bya'o/ /gang ltar de la dmigs te/ a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bha was sbyangs/stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po gzhu brdung ba lta bu ste zla gam 'chang zung dang mchog ma la yaṃ dang ba dan gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum 'bar bas mtshan pa/ oṃ āḥ& las mi mgo'i skyed bu la gnas pa'i thod pa dkar po dum bu gsum pa dpral bar rang la bstan pa yangs shing rgya che ba/ de'i nang du a las zla ba'i steng du —208

sa bon las sha lnga dang bdud rtsi lnga bskyed/ de rnams kyi mtho gang tsam gyi nam mkha' la de rnams byin rlabs byed/ ye shes lnga'i sa bon rnams bskyed/ zla ba'i mthar ā li kā li bsgom/ 'di la gzhung gi zin po med kyang man ngag yin/ de rnams kyi steng gi nam mkhar oṃ dkar po/ de'i steng du nyi ma'i dkyil 'bor/ 'di la ā dmar po don gyis dgos/ de'i steng rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa hūṃ gis mtshan pa ste yig 'bru gsum ga'ang bdud rtsi'i 'dzag pa'i phyir mgo bo thur bstan yin/ rdo rje'i lte ba'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'og tu 'phros/ rlung g.yos me sbar/ sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga ye shes lnga rnams 'od du zhu zhing bskol bas kha dog dmar ser du 'gyur/ de'i rlangs pa gyen du la song ba sogs dkyus bzhin yin cing / de rnams dam tshig pa'i bdud rtsi'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs ka nas yang dag pa'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi rnams he ru ka ste kyi rdo rje zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdo rje dang thod pa/ gru mor kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'dzin pa ni ye shes kyi bdud rtsi ste/ de spyan drangs bstims nas bdud rtsi rgya mtsho chen por gyur gyi bar du dkyus bzhin/ sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga'i ma dag pa'i cha rnams dag ste mi snang bar byas pa ni sbyangs pa/ de nyid ye shes su rtogs pa ni rtogs pa/ rgya che shing zad mi shes par spel ba ni sbar ba/ de yang khol zhing lud pa'i skabs ma dag pa'i cha shas dang rags pa rnams phyir bo ba'am med par bsam pa gang rung bya/ oṃ āḥ& gsum ni sbyangs rtogs spar gsum gyi sngags yin la/ ha zhes brjod pa'i skabs bdud rtsi'i steng du ha ser po bsam ste bdud rtsi la thim pas kha dog phun sum tshogs par bsam/ ho dkar po bsam nas hoḥzhes brjod cing thim pas —209

dri phun sum tshogs pa/ hrī sngon po bsam brjod byas shing thim pas ro phun sum tshogs par bsam la phyag rgya rnams dkyus bzhin no/ /'bul ba ni/ rgyas par na rtsa rgyud kyi bla ma rnams kyis mtshan nas smos te 'bru gsum sbyar ba dang / lha so so'i sngags kyis phul/ bsdu na lha rnams kyi ljags kyi rtse rdo rje nas 'bras bu tsam las byung ba'i 'od kyi sbu gus drangs nas gsol bar bsam zhing / oṃ āḥ& zhes brjod/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta amṛ te/bdud rtsi/ swa da na/ myang ba/ badz+ra swa bha wa urma ko3nya gi nga rgyal bzung ngo / /bdud rtsi myang ba nang gi mchod pa yin na yang mchod pa'i yan lag las 'dir bzung du phyung ba yin/ rgyal ba rigs drug gi dag pa'i mngon rtogs yan lag drug 'jog dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis so/ /de ltar na bdud rtsi myang ba 'od dpag med kyi yan lag yin te/ bdud rtsi ni mgrin par myang ba yin la/mgrin pa ni ngag gi gnas yin pa'i phyir dang / ngag rnam par dag pa 'od dpag med yin pas so/ /lnga pa mchod pa don yod grub pa'i yan lag ni/ rang gi snying ga nas mchod pa'i lha mo rnams spros te mchod par bsam zhing / dkar mo ri dwags sogs brjod/ don ni brjod zin to/ /oṃ sarba ta thā gā ta pū dza/ mchod pa/ badz+ra sogs kyis nga rgyal bzung ngo / /mchod pa don yod grub pa'i yan lag yin te/ lha rnams 'phrin las la bskul pa ni mchod pa la rag las shing / don yod grub pa'ang sangs rgyas thams cad kyi 'phrin las kyi ngo bo yin pas so/ /drug pa bstod par rin chen 'byung ldan gyi yan lag ni/ khyod ni sogs brjod cing bstod par bsam la/ don ni/ dkyil —210

'khor gyi gtso bo khyod kyi rdo rje bdag med rnal 'byor ma tshogs lha mo rnams kyis yongs su bskor nas zag med kyi bde ba la longs spyod pas na longs spyod rdzogs pa dang kha sbyor dang bde ba chen po longs sku'i yan lag gsum dang /khyod ni/ nyid kyi thugs kyi mchog te de kho na nyid brnyes pas rang bzhin med pa chos sku'i yan lag dang / khyed kyis rgyu ba sems can dang mi rgyu ba'i snod kyis 'jig rten rbestogs sna tshogs pas sprul pa sna tshogs pa sprul nas 'askrete ba kun brgyan de don mdzad cing / snying rje'i thugs kyi sems can rnams sdug bsngal las sad par mdzad cing / sgyu ma'i spros pa rdo rje ste chos kyi skur sgrub pa mdzad pa'i yid he ru ka dpal zhes pa de rnams kyi snying rje chen po dngos su bstan cing / rgyun mi 'chad pa dang 'gag pa med pa'ang don gyis bstan pas sprul pa'i sku'i yan lag bdun dang ldan pa/ bde stong zung du 'jug pa'i rdo rje lus ngag yid kyis bstod pas dgyes par mdzod/ de ltar mchod bstod byas nas thugs ka nas sprul pa'i lha mo rnams slar thugs gar bsdu ba'o/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta stu ti ra/ bstod pa badz+ra sogs kyi nga rgyal bzung ngo / /bstod pa rin chen 'byung ldan gyi yan lag yin te/ rin chen 'byung ldan sangs rgyas thams cad kyi yon tan gyi ngo bo yin cing / bstod pa yang yon tan brjod pa'i tshig yin pas so/ /de ltar bdud rtsi myang ba dang mchod pa dang / bstode pa ste yan lag gsum bsgoms pas gzhi 'khesar ba'i chos la sems can rnams gnas dang longs spyod dang nye bar longs spyod pa rnams la rang dbang du gyur pa'i longs spyod pa mtshon pas sbyongs la/ 'bras bu'i chos la mngon par rdzogs —211—

par sangs rgyas nas lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten gyis mchod pa dang / bstod pa'i bkod pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'byung ba lam du byed pa yin no/ /de ltar na bskyed rim gyi dmigs pa'i gtso bo thams cad la sbyang bya 'khor ba'i rnam pa dang mthun pas de sbyong ba dang / sbyang 'bras mya ngan las 'das pa'i rnam pa dang mthun pas 'bras bu lam du byed pa gnyis tshang dgos shing / de dag bla ma gong ma rnams kyis mar bltas 'khor ba'i 'dra 'bag dang mthun pa dang / yar bltas rnam byang gi 'dra 'bag mthun pa zhes gsungs so/ /de dag kyang 'phags pa rin po ches/ khams drug yul drug dbang po drug /rnam shes drug dang nyon mongs drug /kha dog drug dang rigs drug dang / /phung po dbyibs dang bcas pa drug /sbyangs nas rgyal ba rigs drug go /thob byed yan lag drug pa 'di/ /rgyal bas rdo rje gur las gsungs/ /zhes gsungs so/ /gnyis pa lha'i rnam pa la dmigs pa ni/ lha yi rnam pa la bslab pa dang /nga rgyal la bslab pa dang gnyis su 'dus shing / lha'i rnam pa la bslab pa la/gtso bo dkyil 'khor thams cad cig car du gsal 'debs pa dang / rim gyi gsal 'debs pa gnyis las/ gnyis ka la gsal 'debs lugs mi 'dra ba mang na yang / brgyud pa 'di dang rjes su 'brel ba ni mtsho skyes lugs kyi bskor nas 'byung ba ltar dmigs thun sum cu so gnyis dang / dag pa gsum gyi khrid nas 'byung ba ltar dmigs thun bdun dang / birnya pa'i thun mong ma yin pa'i lugs la dmigs thun bcu bdun 'byung ba ste lugs gsum du yod/ gnyis pa nga rgyal la bslab pa ni/ bdag nyid bcom ldan 'das kyi rdo rje dngos yin snyam —212

pa spyir bslab pa dang / bye brag tu sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las dang bcas pa'i cha shas re re la bslab par bya ba yin zhing / de yang bdag nyid kyis sgom pa'i zhal brgyad ni/ kyai rdo rje'i thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bo rnam thar brgyad kyi ye shes yin pa sogs thams cad la so so nas bslab par bya ba yin no/ /de la tha mal gyi snang ba'i gnyen po lha'i rnam pa la bslab pa dang / tha mal du 'dzin pa'i gnyen por lha'i nga rgyal la bslab pa yin no/ /lam 'di gnyis bsgoms pas gsal snang thob pa'i tshe/ sdug bsngal bden pa'i snang ba mngon gyur pa 'gag cing 'khor ba spong ba yin te/ slob dpon sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs kyis/ tha mal rnam rtog rgyun 'di ma gtogs pa/ /srid par sdug bsngal gzhan ni yod ma yin/ /de dang rnam pa 'gal bar gyur pa'i yid/ /des ni mngon sum du ni rtogs par 'gyur/ /zab cing rgya che ba yi rang bzhin can/ /gang yin des ni kun rtog 'char mi byed/ /ces gsungs so/ /gzhan yang lha'i rnam pa dang / mos pa bsgoms pas grol bar 'gyur ba ni lam byed bzhi tshang ba'i rgyu mtshan gyis yin no/ /lam byed bzhi mngon byang gi skabs su'ang bshad zin mod/ 'dir bskyed rim spyi la sbyor tshul la spyir bshad na/ 'bras bu lam du byed pa/ rnam pa lam du byed pa/ mos pa lam du byed pa/byin rlabs lam du byed pa ste bzhi/ dang po ni/ bskyed rim gyi dmigs pa la/'brasabu sangs rgyas kyi sku gsung thugs kyi 'phrin las dang bcas par mos shing zhen pas de nyid thob par 'gyur ba yin te/ nor bu'i 'od la nor bu zhen pas nor bu thob pa bzhin no/ /gnyis pa ni/ sangs rgyas kyi sku gsung thugs kyi tsho 213

rnam pa yid la byas pas de rnams thob par 'gyur ba yin te/ dper na bsam gtan pa 'ga' zhig gis me'i rnam pa yid la byas pas zad par me'i ting nge 'dzin thob nas bdud kyi gnas su me sprul nus pa bzhin no/ /gsum pa ni/ de ltar sgom pa'i dkyil 'khor la de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis dkyil 'khor dngos su mos pa mthar phyin pa na de nyid thob par 'gyur ba yin te/ shā ri'i bus dmyal ba'i gnas pakhro'i tshal du mos pas dngos su pakhro'i tshal du 'gyur ba bzhin no/ /bzhi pa ni/ de ltar bsgoms pas lhag pa'i lhas byin gyis brlabs shing de'i stobs kyis grol bar 'gyur te/ byin gyis brlabs pa'i thabs su sangs rgyas kyis gsungs shing / yi dam lha'i byin gyis brlabs pa tsam gyis ting nge 'dzin bzang po skye shing / sa dang lam gyi mngon par rtogs pa rgyud la skye bas mthar sangs rgyas nyid du 'gyur te/ gang gis lci ba'i phung po gser du byin gyis brlabs pas gser du 'gyur ba bzhin no/ /de ltar lam byed bzhi po 'di dag bskyed rim thams cad kyi dmigs pa'i gtso bo kun la tshang ba dang / bskyed rim thams cad kyi rnal 'byor pa la 'jug pa nas brtsams te lha sku la sems 'dzin pa'i bar thamasacad du lha'i rnam pa la bslab pa dang /nga rgyal la bslab pa gnyis tshang dgos shing / gnyis ga'ang rgya che ba dang gsal ba'i ngo bo yin la/ de dag stong nyid rtogs pa'i lta bas zin pa'i tshe/ zab pa'i rnam 'byor yang yin pas zab pa dang rgya che ba'am/ zab gsal gnyis su med pa la bslab pa yin no/ /gnyis pa rdzogs rim ni/ gang la gnad du bsnun pa'i gzhi rten dkyil —214

'khor bzhi'am/ gnas pa rtsa/ g.yo ba rlung / bkod pa byang chub sems te gsum du grags pa'o/ /dbang gong ma gsum dang 'brel ba'i rdzogs rim gyi rnam bzhag zhib mor gtan la dbab dgos mod/ rgyas par g.yin du shes par bya'o/ /skabs 'dir dkyil 'khor bsdu ba'am bzlas pa'i mthar bsdu bas kyang rung ste dag pa dran pa dang / bzlas pa ni rjes spyod yin pa'i phyir dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo yongs su rdzogs pa gsal gdab dgos pa'i nges pa med la dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo yongs su rdzogs pa gsal bzhin pa'i ngang nas de nyid bsgoms shing bzlas na shin tu legs pa'ang yin pas so/ /gnyis pa mnyam par ma bzhag pa'i rnal 'byor la/ dag pa dran pa/ bzlas pa'i rnal 'byor/ gtor ma'i rnal 'byor/ zas kyi rnal 'byor/ spyod lam gyi rnal 'byor/ nyal ba'i rnal 'byor/ ldang ba'i rnal 'byor/ khrus kyi rnal 'byor dang brgyad do/ /dang po ni/ snying rjes spyan ni dmar po la/ /zhes pa la sogs pa ngag tu brjod cing don zhib mor bsam pa yin la/ yan lag kun la rdor 'dzin mgon/ /zhes pa mtsho skyes kyi sgrub thabs nas 'byung ba yin cing /gzhan rnams ni rtsa rgyud nas 'byung ba ltar nye bar bsdus pa'o/ /de yang chos thams cad de bzhin nyid kyi ngo bo ro gcig pa'i bdag nyid kyi sku la spyan gsum dmar ba ni snying rje chen pos 'gro ba la rjes su chags pa/ 'brog mi'i 'gyur du/byams pa'i thugs la yan lag kenag /ces 'byung ba/ lus kyi skad dod yan lag la bsgyur ba yin la/ sku mdog gnag pa ni thugs byams pa chen po la 'gyur ba med pa/ zhabs bzhi ni sbyin pa dang / snyan par smra ba dang / don spyod 213—

pa dang / don mthun pa ste bsdu dngos bzhi'o/ /de dag gis phung po'i bdud dang /lha'i bu'i bdud dang / 'chi bdag gi bdud dang / nyon mongs pa'i bdud ste/gdul bya gzhan rgyud la gnas pa de dag mtha' dag 'joms pa ni rim pa bzhin du tshangs pa/ dbang po/ nye dbang drag po rnams so/ /mdun gyi zhabs g.yon bskums pa ni/ stong nyid rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis 'khor ba'i mtha' la mi gnas pa dang / g.yas brkyang pa ni thugs rje chen pos mya ngan las 'das pa'i mtha' la mi gnas pa dang / rgyab ma gnyis skyil krung phyed pa'i gar stabs kyis gnas pa ni/ thabs shes zung du 'jug pas/ rtag chad kyi mtha' dang bral ba dbu ma la gnas pa dang / mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa yin no/ /zhabs bzhi char skyil krung phyed pa'i gar stabs su mdzad pa ltar na/ g.yon gnyis bskum pas 'khor ba la mi gnas pa dang / g.yas gnyis brkyangs pas/myang 'das kyi mtha' gnyis la mi gnas pa dang / de gnyis bsdoms pas thabs shes zung 'jug tu mtshon pa yin no/ /zhal brgyad ni rnam thar brgyad/ de la sngags dang pha rol tu phyin pa nas bshad pa gnyis ming mthun shing don khyab par cher med mod/ 'dir theg pa thun mong gi dbang du byas nas sangs rgyas kyi sa'i gzugs can gzugs la blta ba sogs brgyad las/ rtsa zhal ni gzugs can gzugs la blta ba'i rnam thar/ g.yas zhal gzugs med gzugasal blta ba'i rnam thar/ g.yon zhal khyad par sdug pa'i rnam thar/ steng zhal 'gog pa'i rnam thar/ zhal lhag ma ni bzhi ni gzugs med gyi rnam thar bzhi'o/ /phyag bcu drug ni stong nyid bcu drug—216

bcu drug po sher phyin gyi mdo dang 'grel pa che chung nas 'byung ba lta bur rung mod/ saṃ bhu ṭa nas 'byung ba dang / dbus mtha' rtsa 'grel nas 'byung ba dgongs pa gcig tu yod pas de bzung ngo / /bcu drug ni nang stong pa nyid dang /phyi stong pa nyid dang / phyi nang / chen po/ stong nyid dang / don dam pa 'dus byas/'dus ma byas/ mtha' las 'das pa/ thog ma dang tha ma med pa/ dor ba med pa/ rang bzhin / rang gi mi stong gi mtshan ma nyid/ chos thams cad/ dngos po med pa/ dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid rnams so/ /de la dang po drug ni mthong bya dang mthong tshul gyi sgo nas bzhag pa yin la/ stong nyid phyi ma gnyis ni rang gi ngo bo stong mi stong gi tshul gyis sgo nas bzhag pa yin cing / de brgyad ni/ g.yas kyi phyag brgyad do/ /stong nyid bar ba brgyad ni g.yon gyi phyag brgyad do/ /thod pa bcu drug ni phyag bcu drug dang sbyor rgyu'i bde ba chen po bcu drug ste dga' ba bcu drug gi rnam pa can no/ /g.yas pa'i phyag na gnas pa'i srog chags brgyad ni/ rdo rje gur las/ glo dang 'bur dang de bzhin spyo/ khong skam mdze dang shri dzi ka /mchin pa mtsher pa'i nad rnams la/ /glang po la sogs rim shes bya/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar sems can gyi nad brgyad mtshon pa yin la/ de rnams kha nang du blta ba ni/ sku la bsdu ba'i tshul gyis nad de rnams sel bar mtshon/ g.yon gyi thod pa'i nang gi lha brgyad ni dbang phyug brgyad mtshon pa dang / de rnams sems can la stsol ba ni gdong phyir bstan pas mtshon pa yin/ 'di la bla ma gong ma'i yig cha 'ga' rer yang / sku yi dbang phyug dang ni gsung gi dbang phyug dang / /de bzhin sdi ni —217

thugs chokyi dbang phyug dang / /rdzu 'phrul kun tu 'gro ba'i dbang phyug dang / /ci 'dod 'phrin las yon tan brgyad pa'o/ /zhes pa 'di bris pa tsam mdzad/ phyis kyi sa lugs pa'i rnam bshad thams cad la phyag mtshan gyi dag sbyor yon tan brgyad de la ngos 'dzin mdzad/ g.yas g.yon gyi dag pa che chung ngo snyoms pa 'dra zhing / yang kha cig /phra zhing yang lasaphra bar nus pa dang / /spyod par nus dang bdag nyid chen po dang / /dga' bar mgu byed thams cad dbang du byed/ /ci 'dod byed dang dbang phyug don brgyad do/ /zhes pa ltar gyi phra yang la sogs pa thun mong gi dngos grub brgyad la sbyor ba ni sbyor tshul mi bde'o/ /des na bla ma gong ma phal cher gyis bzhed pa ltar/ khams brgyad rnam par dag pas dbang phyug brgyad kyi yon tan mtshon pa yin no/ /de ltar na khams brgyad po de rnams kyi snyigs ma'i cha rnams zad cing dwangs ma rnams stobs su gyur te/ de lasas stobs su gyur pas ni lus sred med kyi bu'i stobs dang mtshungs par 'gyur ba dang / chu stobs su gyur pas ni lus kyi nad kun byang zhing nyams dang ldan par 'gyur pa dang / me stobs su gyur pas gcig dang du mar snang ba sogs cho 'phrul ston cing lus bkrag mdangs dang ldan pa/ rlung stobs su gyur pas lus yang zhing rlung ltar mgyogs pa dang / nam mkha' stobs su gyur pas snod bcud kyi khyab par mang po skye 'jig byed nus pa dang / zla ba ste byang sems stobs su gyur pas lus kyi dkar cha 'phel zhing snyigs ma dag lus kyi grib ma sogs med par 'gyur ba dang / nyi ma ste rdul stobs su gyur pas gzi brjid che zhing 'od 'bar rdzu 'phrul sna tshogs —218—

ston nus pa dang / rnam shes kyi khams stobs su gyur pas gsal stong gi ting nge 'dzin gyi nus pas mngon par shes pa 'thob bo/ /gug skyed ni phyag rgya'i don yin pas phyag rgya lnga ni sangs rgyas lnga'o/ /de yang ye shes lnga'i dag par gnas pas ye shes lnga yongs su rdzogs pa mtshon no/ /thal chen gyi sku lus thams cad brgyan pa ni rdo rje 'chang dang / bde ba chen po'i ye shes la gnas pa mtshon/ de yang spyi bo'i 'khor lo mi bskyod pa/ /zhes sogs kyis rgyas par bshad do/ /phyi rol du lha dang lha mo la sogs pa'i gdug pa can rnams 'dul ba dang / nang du rnam par rtog pa 'dul ba'i phyir du khro bo'i skur ston pa dang / spyan gsum ni rdo rje gsum rnam par dag pa/ sha puska sī/khrag ri khrod ma/ gdol ba mo khu ba/ g.yung mo rkang dang tshul rnam par dag pa/lpags pa rim pa bdun ni/ dran dang chos rab 'byed dang brtson 'grus dang / /dga' dang shin tu sbyang dang btang snyoms dang / /ting nge 'dzin yan lag byang chub kyi yan lag bdun no/ /rkang lag gi rus pa bzhi ni/ sdug bsngal/ kun 'byung / 'gog pa/ lam gyi bden pa ste bzhi'o/ /'khor rnams kyi dag pa ni/ rtsa rgyud dngos bstan las bdag med lha mo bco lnga'i dag par gsungs pa rnams/ skabs 'dir rnal 'byor ma lha dgur bsdus pa'i dag pa la sbyor/ de yang sa spyod ma dang mkha' spyod ma ni rdo rje bdag med ma dang / rdo rje ma dang / dkar mo dang / chu ma dang /rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma ni rim pa bzhin du go ri la sogs pa phyogs kyi lha mo bzhi dang sbyor ba yin no/ /desan rnam par shes pa'i phung po dang / reg bya dang /—219

chos khams dang / nam mkha'i khams rnam par dag pa ni bdag med ma dang /gzugs kyi skye mched dang gzugs phung rnam par dag pa go rī dang / sgra dang tshor ba rnam par dag pa tso rī dang / dri dang 'du shes rnam par dag pa be+e tā li dang /ro dang 'du byed rnam par dag pa ghasma rī dang / sa khams rnam par dag pa puska sī dang / chu khams rnam par dag pa sha wa rī dang / me khams rnam par dag pa tsan+d+ra lī dang / rlung khams rnam par dag pa ḍom+bhi ni rnams so/ /ji skad du/ rgyud las/ gzugs phung rdo rje ma yin te/ /tshor ba la ni dkar mo bshad/ /'du shes chu'i rnal 'byor ma/ /'du byed rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ /rnam shes phung po'i tshul gyis ni/ /bdag med rnal 'byor ma gnas so/ /zhes dang /gzugs la dkar mor rtag tu bshad/ /sgra ni chom rkun mar rab grags/ /dri yi cha la ro langs ma/ /ro la ghasma rī rab grags/ /reg la sa spyod ma zhes brjod/ /chos kyi dbyings la mkha' spyod ma/ /zhes dang / sa ni puk+ka sī zhes bshad/ /chu ni rngon pa ma zhes brjod/ /me ni gtum mor shes par bya/ /rlung ni g.yung mor rab tu gragarme/ /zhes gsungs so/ /dug lnga rnam par dag pa ye shes lnga yi bdag nyid ni/ phyogs kyi lha mo rnams dang bdag med ma la sbyare ba'ang rung mod/ yab he ru ga'i dkyil 'khor 'dir gtso bo nyid la sbyor ba yin cing / lha mo bco lnga'i dkyil 'bor gyi tshe 'phar ma nang ma'i lha rnams la sbyor ba yin no/ /de ltar bdag med ma sku mdog nag mo ni chos nyid 'gyur ba med pa mtshon/ g.yas kyi gri gug gis ni rtsa nyon drug gcod/ g.yon gyi thod pa ni dngos po dang dngosapo med pa'i rnam par rtog —220

pa mtha' dag 'joms pa dang / nang gi khrag ni bdud bzhi'i khrag ste de btul ba dang / de bzhin nyid kyi bdag nyid zhal gcig /thabs shes kyi bdag nyid kyi phyag gnyis ma'o/ /go rī sku mdog nag mo ni chos nyid mi 'gyur pas nag mo/g.yon gyi nya 'dod chags/ g.yas kyi gri gug gis de gcod pa mtshon no/ /tso rī ni sems can la rjes su chags pa'i kha dog dmar mo/ g.yon du gti mug gi rang bzhin phag pa/ g.yas kyi ḍa ma rus gti mug gi gnyid nas slong ba/ ro langs ma sku mdog ser mo ni yon tan rgyas pa/ g.yas kyi rus sbal ni phrag dogacigayon gyi bdud rtsis de sel ba mtshon/ ghasma rī sku mdog ljang gu ni 'phrin las sna tshogs kyis 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa/ g.yas pa'i sprul gyis zhe sdang dang /g.yon gyi thod pa'i bdud rtsis de sel ba mtshon/ puk+ka sī sku mdog sngon mo ni chos nyid mi 'gyur ba/ g.yas kyi seṅge ni nga rgyal/ g.yon gyi dgra stas de gcod pa mtshon/ ri khrod ma sku mdog dkar mo ni rang bzhin gyi rtog pa dang bral ba/g.yas kyi dge slong ni bdag lta 'joms pa/ g.yon gyi gsil byed ni ser sna'i mdud pa/ gdol ba mo sngo bsangs ni sems can gyi don la chags pa/ g.yas kyi 'bor lo ni chos 'bor bskor ba/ g.yon gyi thod pa ni nyon mongs pa'i thal ba rlog pa mtshon no/ /g.yung mo 'phrin las sna tshogs pas sems can gyi don mdzad pas kha dog sna tshogs pa/ rnam rtog gi ri bo bdag med pa'i rdo rjes bsnyil bas g.yas rdo rje/ g.yon gdug pa can la bsdigs pa'i sdigs mdzub bo/ /gtso 'khor thams cad skra gyen du brdzesapa ni/ ye shes gong nasagong du 'phel ba/ thod pa —22 —

skam po lngas dbu brgyan pa ni rigs lnga'i rang bzhin gyis rgyas gdab pa dang /mi mgo rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal ni sems byung lnga bcu rnam par dag pa/ ye shes kyi me dpung 'bar ba ni ji lta ba dang ji snyed pa la ye shes lhag par rgyas pa'o/ /skabs 'dir gdol ba mo ni/ rtsa rgyud las/ gtum mo nam mkha'i sngo bsangs ma/ /zhes gsungs pa dkyus ltar yin la/ rgyud rgyas pa'i rjes su 'brangs nas sgrub thabs mtsho skyes las sku mdog sngo dmar du bshad/ de'i rjes su 'brang ba'i sgrub thabs kyang mang du yod pas/ de ltar na des na stong nyid snying rje'i snying po can gyi chos bstan pa mtshon/ gdol pa mo'i g.yon gyi thod pa ni the tshom gyi tha ba rlog pa dang / g.yung mo'i g.yas kyi rdo rje chos kyi bdag med rtogs pa'i ye shes mtshon par bla ma gong ma'i gsung rgyun 'ga' zhig las 'byung ba shin tu legs par yang mngon no/ /g.yung mo kha dog sna tshogs par bshad pa la/ 'ga' zhig gis ljang gur 'dod pa dang / 'ga' zhig gis phug ron gyi mgrin pa ltar mdangs sna tshogasapa 'char bar 'dod pa dang / 'ga' zhig gis thig le sna tshogs pas lus thams cad khyab par 'dod pa dang / 'ga' zhig gis tshon sna lnga gcig tu 'dres pa'i kha dog sna tshogs dang mtshungs par 'dod pa dang / 'ga' zhig rkang mthil rlung sogs kyi rim pa dang bstan pa'i kha dog dang mtshungs par 'dod pa dang /'ga' zhig rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor las 'byung ba'i rdo rje'i las kyi kha ridog dang mthun par 'dod pa dang / 'ga' zhig sum mdo dang zhale ras dkar ba/ sku stod nag pa/ rked pa dmar ba/ bar lhu gnyisadang brla gnyisaser ba/—222

phyag ngar gnyis dang zhabs ljang gu yin par 'dod pa ste lugs bdun ga yang bla ma'i man ngag dang 'brel na 'gal ba med do/ /de ltar lha mo brgyad kyi zhabs kyi 'og gi lha rnams la tshangs pa ni zhi ba'i las/ dbang po rgyas pa'i las/ nye dbang dbang gi las/ drag po drag po'i las ste/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa las phyi rol tu gyur pa'i sngags rgyud la/ las bzhis rang don kho nar gnyer zhing / sdig pa'i sems dang ma bral ba mtshon pa yin/ gshin rjes dus ma yin par 'chi ba/ nor bdag ni longs spyod la rnam par g.yeng ba/ srin po ni 'chi ba sna tshogs pa/ thags bzang ris ni yid sgyur bar byed pa ste de rnams mnan pa ni de rnams bcom pa mtshon/ de ltar na yab kyi zhabs 'og gi bdud bzhi dang / phyogs kyi bdud bzhi rnams gnas dang byed las rnams tha dad pa ste/gtso bo'i zhabs 'og gi bdud bzhi ni gzugs khams kyi bdag po tshangs pa dang / sum cu rtsa gsum gyi bdag po brgya byin dang / bdud kyi gtso bo gzhan 'phrul dbang byed pa dang / lha gsum gyi nang gi dbang phyug chen po'o/ /phyogs kyis bdud bzhi ni/ steng gi phyogs skyong 'dod pa'i khams kyi tshangs pa dang / dri za'i gdon gyi gtso bo shar phyogs skyong ba brgya byin dang / lha chen po khyab 'jug dang / byang shar gyi phyogs skyong dbang ldan 'byung po rnams yin no/ /zhes bla ma gong ma rnams gsungs so/ /sems can yongs su smin par byed pa'i nyi ma'i gdan/ nyon mongs pa'i tsha gdung zhi bar byed pa zla ba'i gdan/ nyes pas ma gos pa pad+ma'i gdan gyis mtshon no/ /de ltar gtso bo'i gdan nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor du nges shing / lha mo rnams la rgya gzhung rnams las nyi zla so sor bshad —223

pa sna tshogs yod kyang skabs 'dir nyi zla 'dam gar bzhed do/ kha cig bdag med lha mo bco lnga'i tshe/ thams cad drag mo yin pa'i phyir nyi ma'i gdan/ yab kyi dkyil 'khor la lha mo rnams cung zad zhi ba'i phyir zla ba'i gdan du nges so zhes pa ni yang dag pa ma yin te/ 'byung po 'dul byed dang / nag po chen po dang lha mo tsan+d+ra ka la sogs pa shin tu khros pa'i lha rnams la'ang zla ba'i gdan yod pa mang du yod pa'i phyir dang / yab kyi dkyil 'khor lha mo brgyad lha mo bco lnga las zhi ba yin pa'i rgyu mtshan med pa'i phyir ro/ /gzhal yas khang gi dag pa brjod pa ni/ mnyam pa nyid kyi phyir gru bzhi pa/tshad med pa bzhi'i rang bzhin gyi zur bzhi pa/ rnam par thar pa bzhi'i rang bzhin gyi sgo bzhi pa/ dran pa nye bar bzhag pa bzhi ni 'dod yon gyi snam bu bzhi/yang dag par spong ba bzhi ni ka ba bzhis btegs pa'i rta bab bzhi/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi ni sgo khyud dang bcas pa'i sgo khang bzhi/ dbang po lnga dang stobs lnga ni rtsig pa rim pa lnga/ byang chub yan lag bdun ni me rtago phreng ba/ 'phags lam yan lag brgyad ni ka ba brgyad/ nyon mogs pa'i sgrib pa spangs pa drwa ba drwa phyed/ tshul khrims gsum gyi rang bzhin gyi rgyan thams cad kyis rnam par brgyan pa'o/ /gzhal yas khang gi gdan sna tshogs rdo rje ni gang zag gi bdag med pa mtshon la/ de nyid rwa bcu gnyis su byas na rten 'brel bcu gnyis rnam par dag pa mtshon zhing / rwa nyi shur byas na 'jig tshogs la lta ba nyi shu 'joms pa mtshon/gdan pad+ma ni pad+ma chu'i nang du gnas kyang chus ma gos pa ltar/ kun rdzob sna tshogs pa'i snang ba 'char yang des ma gos pas chos kyi dbyings stong pa nyid de/—224

chos kyi bdag med kyi don yin la/ bdag med de gnyis la ye shes kyi snang ba lhag par rgyas pa ni/ de gnyis kyi bar na gnas pa'i nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyis mtshon/ dur khrod kyis ni 'khor ba mtshon zhing / de brgyad ni rnam shes tshogs brgyad kyis bsdus pa mtshon no/ /phyi rol tu bsrung ba'i 'khor lo ni sangs rgyas rnams kyis bdud bzhi dang sgrib pa gnyis bcom zhing gtan mi skye bar byed pa mtshon no/ /gnyis pa bzlas pa'i rnal 'byor la/ bzlas pa'i yo byad/ bzlas pa'i dmigs pa/ bzla bya'i sngags/ zhar byung bzlas pa'i dbye ba bshad pa dang bzhi'o/ /dang po la 'phreng ba'i rgyu grangs/ 'phreng thag /mdo 'dzin/ rgyu brgyu ba'i tshul/ byin rlabs bya tshul/ bgrang tshul dang / /bdun no/ /dang po ni/ rgyud las/ shel gyis rengs pa'i bzlas pa nyid/ /dbang la tsan+dan dmar po nyid/ /lung thang gis ni mngon spyod nyid/ /ni ring shu ni sdang pa la/ /rta yi rus pas sgrod pa la/ /glang po'i rus pas chags pa la/ /bram ze'i rus pas dgugs pa nyid/ /ma ni yis kyang bsad pa la/ /zhes dang / sasbu ṭi las/ shel dang nya lcibs mu tig dang /khams ni dkar po la sogs gzhan/ /zhi ba'i las la khyad par du/ /'phreng ba yi ni mtshan nyid du/ /gser dang dngul dang zangs ma dang / /pad+ma'i sa bon khyad par du/ /rgyas pa la ni 'phreng ba nyid/ /rnam par mkhas pas bgrang bar bya/ /gur gum la sogs dri sogs kyis/ /dri ni thams cad khyad par du/ /sgrub shing ril bu byas nas ni/ /dbang la yongs su rab tu grags/ /ru raka dang lung thang dang / /de bzhin skyes pa'i rus pa nyid/ /drag po'i las la sbyar bar bya/ /mngon —225

spyod la ni rab tu grags/ /zhesadang / zhi rgyas dbang dang mngon spyod las/ /bo dhi tsis ni las kun byed/ /ces gsungs shing / rgyud mang po las mchog sgrub pa la mi'i thod phreng sngags so/ /gnyis pa ni/ sasna ṭi las/ sngags kyi bzlas pa lnga bcu ste/ /dbang la de yi phyed nyid do/ /brgya phrag gcig ni zhi ba la/ /de bzhin rgyas pa lhag par bya/ /mngon spyod las ni drug nyid do/ /zhes so/ /gsum pa ni/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro las/ yang na ras ba la skud pa ni/ zhes gsungs shing / sems dpa' brgyad dang rdo rje sems dpa' mtshon pas dgu sgril du byas te/ sa ṭi las/ lha ni dgu sogs srad bu la/ /lha dgus byin gyis brlab par bya/ /zhes gsungs shing / sdom 'byung las/ las so so la srad bu'i khyad par yang sna tshogs gsungs so/ /bzhi pa ni/ mdo 'dzin nyis brtsegs bya zhing / gong mas chos dbyings ye shes/ 'og mas stobs sogs mtshon pa dang / sku gnyis kyang mtshon no/ /sam+bha ṭi las/ mchod rten chos dbyings phung po'i ri/ /steng du yang ni chos kyi dbyings/ /zhes so/ /lnga pa ni/ 'phreng thag sangs rgyas byang sems 'phreng rdog rnams dgra bcom par mos pa lus/ ngag tu hūṃ glu len cing rgyu ba brgyus par bya ste/ sasna ṭir/ hūṃ gis srad bure brgyus pa nyid/ /ces so/ khrug pa ni rang lha'i rnal 'byor dang ldan pa'i lag pa g.yon pa'i sor mo rnams pad+ma 'dab ma lnga pa/ lag mthil du zla ba'i dkyil 'bor dbyangs yig bcu drug g.yon bskor de'i lte ba la āḥlag pa g.yas pa'i sor mo lnga rdo rje rtse lnga pa/ lag mthil du nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la gsal byed so bzhi g.yas skor du gnas pa'i lte ba la hūṃ bsam la/—226

pad skor sngon du 'gro ba'i 'phreng ba blang ba lag gnyis dbus su bzhaga'aphreng ba la bdud rtsi yi ge sum̐/ dkar po 'od zer 'phro bar bsam/ rdo rje pad+ma snyoms par zhugs pas byang chub kyi sems kyis sum la khyab de 'phreng ba dang gnyis su med par bsam la/ oṃ pa de pa de mahā dzñā nī sarba mā la dharma saṃ bho ta hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ ho ho a khaṃ swahā/ zhes sngags 'di 'phreng skor gcig bzlas la byin gyis brlabs/ phyis bzlas na nam byed kyi dus su lan gsum mam bdun la sogs par bzlas na sngags kyi nus pa brtan par 'gyur ro/ /sasbu ṭi las/ sor mo rdo rje rtse mo ste/ /g.yon pa pad+ma'i rnam par bsgom/ /pad+ma rdo rje snyoms 'jug byas//kha sbyar dbus su 'phreng gzhag la/ /kun gyi de nyid bsgom bya zhid / /'phreng ba byin gyis brlab par bya/ /zhes so/ /bsdus par na dkyil chog rdo rje 'phreng ba nas 'byung ba ltar yang mdzad do/ /bdun pa ni/ saṃ bhu ṭi las/ sor mo la sogs bye brag la/ phyi nas sngags pas bzlas par bya/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ zhi ba la mdzum mo/ rgyas pa la gung mo/ dbang la srin lag /mngon spyod la mthe'u chung gi steng du bzhag go /mthe bong rdo rje lcags kyus lha dgug pa'i bsam pas bgrang ste de nyid las/mthe bong rdo rje lcags kyu yis/ /sgom pa'i lha rnams dgug par bya/ /zhes so/ /de ltar 'phreng ba'i de nyid shes pa'i sgo nas sngags bzlas na dngos grub thob la/gzhan du na mi thob ste/ de nyid las/ mnyam bzhag bzlas dang bsgoms pa yis/ /'grub 'gyur 'di la the tshom med/ /ces dang / de nyid mi shes 'phreng ba ni/ /bud med rnams kyi do shal 'dra/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa bzlas pa'i —227

dmigs pa ni/ 'khor lo'i bzlas pa/ spro bsdu'i bzlas pa/ bkod pa'i bzlas pa dang gsum las/ 'dir 'khor lo'i bzlas pa nyid gtso bor bshad pas/zhal nas zhal dang / gsang ba nas gsang bar 'khor ba yin la/ phar 'god dang tshur 'god gnyis ka bla ma gong mas bshad pa'i gang bde bya la/ yi dam lha'i thugs brgyud bskul ba mchog bsgrub pa gtso bor gyur pa dang / zhi rgyas dbang drag so so la kha dog dkar ser dmar nag dang / dmigs pa'i khyad par so so la byas la/ rje thams cad mkhyen pas sngags 'phreng ngo bo kha dog sngon po la 'od zer dkar ser dmar sngo so sor byed pa yin gsung ngo / /rgyun bzlas la sdig pa zhi ba'i phyir 'od zer dkar po bya'o/ /'khor gyi sngags bzla ba'i tshe/ gtso ba yab yum gyi zhal du 'khor gyi lha rnams kyi sngags 'phreng zhugs/ yab yum kyi sku la 'khor ba'i dmigs pa sngar bzhin la/sngags kyi 'od zer des lha mo gang gis bzlas pa byed pa'i lha mo de la phog pas/de dbang du 'du zhing 'phrin las bskul bar bsam la bzla/ yang na rang rang gi thugs ga'i sa bon las 'khor bar bsam zhing bzla'o/ /gsum pa la/ bzla bya'i sngags dngos/ bzlas pa'i go rim/ ji tsam bzlas pa'i grangs/ de ltar bzlas pa'i dgos pa'o/ /dang po ni/ rtsa sngags/snying po/ nye snying / rnal 'byor ma rnams kyi 'phreng sngags su grags pa dbyangs yig gi sngags rnams rtsa rgyud dngos bstan las gsal bar gsungs shing /rgyud sde spyi'i 'gros kyis yum dang 'khor gyi lha mo rnams la sa bon nam mtshan sngags la de nyid gsum spel lam bzhi spel lam lnga spel la sogs pa mdzad pa —228—

yin no/ kha cig skabs 'di'i nye snying du grags pa rdo rje'i gri gug gi las tshogs su bshad pa'i phyir nye snying du mi 'thad cing / rgyud gzhung khungs ma las kyang nye snying du bshad pa med do/ /zhes zer ba mi 'thad de/ mar me mdzad kyi sgrub thabs la sogs gzhung khungs ma rnams las nye snying du bshad cing / sgrub thabs mtsho skyes las kyang sngags 'di nyid nye snying du mdzad par gsal te/las tshogs kyi sngags mtha' dag sgrub thabs su bri bar mi lang ba'i phyir ro/ /las tshogs kyi sngags yin pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis nye snying du mi 'thad pa'i skyon med de/ gzhan du na/ rtsa rgyud las/ bud med rnams kyi dbang byed sngags/ /de bzhin gdug pa bsdigs pa dang / /zhes gsungs pa ltar aṣ+ṭa yang dbang dang drag po'i las sgrub pa'i sngags su bshad pa'i phyir/ rtsa sngags ma yin pa'i skyon du 'gyur ro/ /rtsa sngags kyi don ni/ /oṃ ni bkra shis pa'i don/ aṣ+ṭa brgyad/ a na nā zhal/ ya dgos ched kyi don no/ /si dmar ser/ gorta gyen du/ ke sha /skra/warnya ma ne+e brdzes pa/ na'i 'bring bu ni dgos ched kyi don no/ /des na dbu skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa la/ /zhes pa'o/ /tsa tur/ bzhi/ bi sha ti nyi shu/ ne+e drwa spyan/ ya dgos ched/ nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i spyan ni/ zhes pa'o/kho ṭa sha /bcu drugabhu dza lag pa/ ya la ba'i don/ phyag bcu drug pa la/ zhes pa'o/ /kriṣ+ṭha nag po/dzi mū ta char sprin/ wa pū ga sku lus/ 'greng bu pa la zhes pa'i don/ sku mdog char sprin ltar gnag pa la zhes pa'o/ /ka pā la thod pa/ mā la 'phreng ba/ a ne kai du ma/ dhā ri ṇa/ 'dzin pa/ 'greng bu dgos ched/ thod pa'i 'phreng ba du ma 'dzin pa la/ zhes pa'o/ /āt+pa ta/ khung / kru ra/ 'khrugasapa/ tsit+ta ya thugs —229

la/ khung nas 'khrugs pa'i thugs la/ zhesapa'o/ /arje/ phyed/ na du/ zla ba/don ṇi/ mche ba can la/ 'greng bu bzhi pa'i dgos ched de/ zla ba phyed pa lta bu'i mche ba can/ /zhes pa'o/ /oṃ ni dam bca' ba'i don/ mā ra ya gnyis ni sod cig gnyis/ kā ra ya/gnyis bya ba'i las gyis gyis/ gardza ya/ khug cig gnyis/ tardza ya/ gnyis sdigs mdzub bsdigs/ sgordzo ṣa ya gnyis skems shig gnyis/ sap+ta bdun/ sa gā ra na rgya mtsho/ a na gnyis sha'i zas byin pa/ bhan+ta bhan+ta chings shig gnyis/ nā ga klu/ aṣ+ṭa kā na/ brgyad/ asno/ zas su za ba/ grit+na grit+na zung gnyisashigasha hrun/ dgra bo rnams so/ /ha hā hi tī hu hu he lha ho ho haṃ haḥ zhes pa rnams ni bzhad pa'i nyams bcu gnyis sogs dang / phaṭa dag pa/ swa hā gzhi tshug ces pa ste/ de yang oṃ zhes dam bca' dran par mdzod la/ zhi rgyas dbang dgug bsad bskrad sogs bya ba'i las gyis shig gyis shig ces bskul nas/ khams gsum 'khor ba'i las nyon bag chags dang bcas pa rnams dang / rgya mtsho bdun la gnas pa'i klu gdon brgyad la sogs pa'i gnod byed rnams/ zungs shigazungs shig /khug cig /khug cig /chings shig /chings shig /spyan 'phrul sdang mig gis gzir la sdigs mdzub bsdigs pa'i mtshon chas/ sod cig/sod cig sha khrag bdud rtsi'i gtor ma'i zas byin pa khyed kyis zas su za bas dgyes bder bzhad pa'i nyams dang ldan par mdzod cig /'khor ba rnam shes dag pa bde stong gi dbyings su thim pa'i gzhi tshugs shig ces so/ /de rnams kyi bshad pa gzhi bshad du blta bar bya'o/ /oṃ sngags kyi mgo 'dren/ de wa lha/ bi —230

tsu 'joms pa/ badz+ra rdo rje dang / badz+ra garta ri rdo rje gri gug /ces pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ rtsa sngags snying po/ nye snying rnams rim pa ltar sku gsung thugs bskul byed yin cing / de gsum yang snga ma snga ma las phyi ma phyi ma phra zhing bskul dka' bas/ bskul sla ba'i rim pa las bzla ste/ rtsa sngags thog mar bzla ba sogs yin la/ yab kyi rjes la yum gyi dang / de nas 'khor gyi sngags bzla'o/ /gsum pa ni/ dkyil 'khor bdag po bzlas pa 'bum/ /dkyil 'khor can gyis de bzhin khri/ /zhes dang / sdom 'byung las/ rdzogs ldan la ni bzla bya gcig /gnyis 'gyur gsum ldan la bzlas bya/ /gsum 'gyur gnyis ldan la rab brjod/ rtsod ldan bzlas pa bzhi 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs pas/ bsnyen pa rab la gtso bo la bzhi 'bum / yum la yab dang 'dra la/ ma grub na 'khor dang mnyam pa bzlas kyang rung / 'khor rnams la bzhi khri re/ bsnyen pa 'bring la gtso bo la bzhi khri/ 'khor rnams la bzhi stong re/ tha ma gtso bo la bzhi stong /'khor la bzhi brgya re'o/ /'bring tha ma gnyis ni bsnyen pa gso ba yin gyi gzhi'i bsnyen pa la dang po kho na bzung la/ de 'grub na rdo rje slob dpon gyi las mtha' dag la 'jug par dbang zhing / mchog grub pa la ni grangs kyi tshad med do/ /bzhi pa ni/ bzlas pas sangs rgyas kyi thugs rgyud bskul bas mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub 'grub pa yin te/ rdo rje gur las/ sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang / /mkha' 'gro ma dang rang btsun mo/ /mngon sum du ni bya ba'i phyir/ /sngags ni snyan gsan 'beb par brjod/ /dper na skyes bu la la zhig /skad kyi nga ros bos pa na/ /mngon sum du ni 'ong bar 'gyur/ /de bzhin —231—

de bzhin gshegs kun gshegs/ /zhes so/ /rtsa rgyud las/ bzlas pa khri yis gsal ba dang / /sgra ring ba dang bzang ba yi/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ ha cang myur bul gnyis dang / ha cang sgra che cung gnyis te skyon bzhi spangs nas/ gsal la dal ba dang shin tu dag par bzla dgos pa yin no/ /bzhi pa zhar byung bzlas pa'i dbye ba bshad pa ni/ bzlas pa la dbye na/ rgya bod kyi slob dpon gzhan rnas kyi man ngag las 'di ltar 'byung ste/ khyogs kyi bzlas pa/ 'khor lo'i bzlas pa/ bkod pa'i bzlas pa/ spro bsdusabazlas pa ste dmigs pa'i dbye bas bzhi dang / khro ba'i bzlas pa/ shub bu'i bzlas pa/'gog pa'i bzlas pa/ yid bzlas te ngag gi byas pa'i khyad par gyis bzhi dang /bskul ba'i bzlas pa/ gong bu'i bzlas pa/ rdo rje'i bzlas pa ste sngags kyi khyad par gyi dbye bas gsum ste bcu gcig tu yod cing / rgya gar gyi slob dpon phyi ma rnams kyis bzhed pa khyogs kyi bzlas pa dang 'khor lo'i bzlas pa gcig tu bzhed pas de ltar na bcu'o/ /de ltar na/ dag pa dran pa dang / bzlas pa ni rjes sbyor kyi yan lag tu bsdu ba'i phyir sbyang gzhi sbyong byed ma sbyar kyang rung mod/rgyud sde gzhan gyi rigs 'gres sbyar kyang mi 'gal te/ de yang 'khor ba'i chos la sbyar na dag pa dran pa ni yid kyi rnam par rtog pa mtha' yas pa dang / bzlas pa ni ngag gi brjod pa sna tshogs pa dang dkyil 'khor nyer bsdu ni/ tshe de nyid kyi las zad pa na slar 'chi ba mtshon zhing / thun mtshams lha skur sdang ba ni slar bar do dang skye ba brgyud mar 'byung ba mtshon/ 'bras bu'i chos la sbyar na dag pa dran pa ni/ sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad mnyam pa nyid du gnas pa mtshon —232

pa dang / bzlas pa ni chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba dang / dkyil 'bor nyer bsdu ni/ dngos kyi gdul bya med pa'i zhing 'ga' zhig tu mya ngan las 'das pa'i tshul ston pa mtshon pa dang / thun mtshams lha skur ldang ba ni gzhan du sprul pa'i sku 'byung ba mtshon pa yin no/ /gsum pa gtor ma'i rnal 'byor ni/ rtsa bshad kyi rgyud rnams las 'jig rten pa'i gtor ma 'ba' zhig gsal na yang / gtor chog rgya gzhung tshad ma rnams dang bla ma gong ma'i man ngag gis 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lha thams cad la thun mong du 'bul ba yin la/ 'di la chos 'byung sum brtsegs byed pa dang / chos 'byung gcig tu pad+ma 'dab brgyad sum brtsegs byed pa ltar yang rung ngo / /gtor ma'i sngags don ni/ oṃ bha ga lhan mahā ka ru ṇi ka he badz+ras pa ri wa ra kā ya wāka tsit+ta/ zhes pa ni/ bcom ldan snying rje chen po kyai rdo rje'i sku gsung thugs 'khor dang bcas pa zhes pa'o/ /oṃ in+da/ dbang po dza ma gshin rje/ dza la chu lha/ dzak+ṣa/ gnod sbyin/ bhu ta/ 'byung po/ bsna/ me lha/ bā yu rlung lha/ rak+ṣa/ srin po/ tsan+da zla ba/ pudz+dza nyi ma/ mā ta sa'i lha mo/ /bā spa tshangs pa/ tā la pā ta le aṣ+ṭa saspa klu/ swā hā/ sa 'og nas gnas pa'i klu chen brgyad/ i dam 'di/ ba liṃ gtor ma/ bhuñdza zo zhig /dzigha sdoms shigaphul+la/ me tog /dhu pa/ bdug spos/ me sa sha che na/ shrīgha/ chang gisargyas par gyis/ alpa/ bdag gi sam+bha thams cad/ gadz+dza bye ba/ swabhā/ bsgrubs shigakharnyi kha ṇi bzod par gsol/ phe ṭa ga da gnod pa sol/ oṃ ā kā ro sogs a yig ni dang po'i sgo'i chos thams cad kyi ma skyes pa nyid kyi phyir ro/ /zhes so/ /—233—

gtor ma'i phan yon ni/ e waṃ rnam par zhugs nas ni/ /bgegs dang log par 'dren pa las/ /sems can rnamasakyi srog bsrung phyir/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i gtor ma bstan/ /zhes so/ /bzhi pa kha zas kyi rnal 'byor ni/ bza' btung ji snyed pa rnams nang mchod ltar byin gyis brlabs nas 'bul ba yin zhing / de yang phud dkon mchog dang 'dod pa'i lha rnams la gtor ma'i sngags kyi 'bul ba dang / nang gi sbyin sreg gi tshul du longs spyod pa yin no/ /mjug gi cho ga la/ gtor ma dang ma 'brel na/ rdo rje'i glu/ shis brjod/ smon lam bya zhing / gtor ma dang 'brel na de'i steng du gtor mgron gshegs gsol bya'o/ /lnga pa spyod lam gyi rnal 'byor ni/ gzugs snang thams cad kyai rdo rje/ sgra thams cad sngags kyi sgra/ sems can thams cad kyi sems kyi rdo rje'i thugs su mos pa bya zhing / gzhan yang gzugs sogs yul drug gzugs rdo rje ma la sogs pa dang / mig sogs skye mched drug gti mug rdo rje ma la sogs par mos pa byas nas thun mtshams su 'jug pa ste/ 'dis ni spyod lam gyi khyad par sna tshogs pa yang / tshogs rdzogs pa'i thabs su 'gyur ba yin no/ /drug pa nyal ba'i rnal 'byor la/ rang bzhin lhan skyes su nyal ba'i dmigs pa ni dkyil 'khor nyer bsdu dang mthun zhing / de la thun mtshams kyi lha zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa de yang 'od du zhu/ thugs ga'i hūṃ la thim/ de yang nā dwa'i bar du thim/ de yang nam mkha' la 'ja' ltar yal ba'i 'od gsal gyi ngang la nyal ba yin la/ zhu bde lhan skyes kyi ngang du nyal ba'i dmigs pa/ rgyu rdo —2ma

rje 'dzin pa yab yum zhu ba ltar yin pas/ gnyis ka gang ltar yang mi rtog pa'i ngang du nyal ba yin no/ / bdun pa ldang ba'i rnal 'byor ni/ nyal ba'i tshe rang bzhin lhan skyes kyi ngang du nyal ba yin na/ thun mtshams kyi lha skur skad cig gis ldang ba yin cing / zhu bde lhan skyes kyi ngang du nyal na/ zhu ba glus bskul bar byed par bsam zhing tshig ngag tu brjod nas 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin pa bzhengs pa ltar ldang ba yin no/ /brgyad pa khrus kyi rnal 'byor ni/ rnal 'byor la 'jug pa'i sngon du bsam gtan gyi grogs su 'gro ba khrus bya zhing / dmigs pa dbang len pa ltar byas la/ 'on kyang rgyas gdab sogs byed mi dgos/ de ltar rjes spyod brgyad kyi steng du rjes chags kyi rnal 'byor bsnan pas dgur 'gyur bas/ spyir rnal 'byor bcu pa'am bcu gcig go /yang na dag pa dran pa rjes spyod du ma bgrangs na rjes spyod brgyad do/ /rjes chags kyi rnal 'byor ni longs su nges par bsgom dgos pa ma yin la/ gal te bsgom na dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i nang du 'dus pa'am/ gsang ba'i mchod par 'dus pa'i phyir logs su ma bgrangs kyang rung ngo / /de rnams gzhi bshad nas gsungs pa dang sbyar na/ bskyed pa'i rnal 'byor la cho ga'i sgo brgyad/ cho ga'i gtso bo nyi shu rtsa bzhi/ cho ga'i yan lag bcu drugacho ga'i chings bzhi/ zhes gsungs pa'i sgo brgyad ni/ sngon 'gro bsrung 'khor/dngos gzhi yan lag drug /rjes bsdu ba ste brgyad dam/ yang na sngon 'gro tshogs gnyis bsags pa/ dngos gzhi yan lag drug go /cho ga'i gtso bo nyi shu —235

rtsa bzhi ni/ yan lag drug la phye ba ste/ gzhal yas khang bskyed pa rnam snang gi yan lag la/ gzhi'i yan lag /rgyu'i rkyen gyi/ gnas pa'i/ gdan gyi yan lag sgom pa dang lnga/ rjes chags kyi yan lag la mngon byang lnga/ mkha' gsang byin rlabs/ snyoms par zhugs pa/ 'khor dbyung ba/ rgyu rdo rje zhu ba/ glus bskul ba/'bras bu rdo rje 'chang bzhengs pa/ snod bcud sbyangs pa/ skye mched byin rlabs/ye shes gzhug pa ste bcu bzhi/ dbang la/ dbang bskur dang / rgyas gdab gnyis/ bdud rtsi myang ba/ mchod pa/ bstod pa'i yan lag rnams re re ste bsdoms pas nyi shu rtsa bzhi'o/ /cho ga'i yan lag bcu drug ni/ snying ga nas 'od zer spro ba/ tshogs zhing spyan drangs pa/ de la phyag 'tshal ba/ mchod pa/ yan lag lnga pa/ sdom pa bzung ba/ tshad med bzhi/ bsrung 'khor/ yang na spyan drangs shing mchod pa/ bsod nams tshogs la yan lag lnga/ tshad med/ ye shes tshogs te sngon 'gro la brgyad/mnyam par bzhag pa'i rnal 'byor brgyad de bcu drug go /cho ga'i chings bzhi ni/bsnyen sgrub yan lag bzhi'o/ /gsum pa bsgoms 'bras sa lam gyi rnam bzhag bshad pa la/ bskyed rim la gtso bor bzhag pa'i sa lam dang / rdzogs rim la gtso bor bzhag pa'i sa lam mo/ /dang po ni/ ḍom+bhi pa rjes 'brang dang bcas pa'i lugs la/ las dang po pa/ bde ba cung zad thob cipa/ bde stong gi nyams skyes pa / de cher skyes pa ste bzhir bzhag pa dang / mtsho skyes lugs las 'byung ba ni/ 'ching ba mtha' dag dang ldan pa'i gang zag tha ma'i tha ma dang / tha ma dang / 'bring dang / rab ste —236

bzhir grags pa dang / slob dpon sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs rjes 'brang dang bcas pa'i lugs la/ las dang po pa dang / ye shes phebs pa dang / ye shes la dbang ba dang / ye shes la ches dbang ba ste/ gang zag bzhir grags pa rnams ming tha dad pa ma gtogs don la khyad par med do/ /ngo bo lam bsgoms pa'i gang zag rnam pa bzhir rim gyis 'pho ba yin no/ /de yang dkyil 'khor rags pa la gsal snang ma thob pa de srid du gang zag dang po yin la/ gsal snang thob pa'i tshe gnyis pa dang / go cha'i lha la sogs pa phra mo rnams la gsal snang thob pa'i tshe gsum pa'o/ /yungs dkar gyi gong bu tsam gyi nang du yang dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs skad cig la gsal thebs pa nus pa de'i gang zag bzhi pa yin no/ /de ltar ye shes phebs pa sogs gsum dang / tshogs lam che 'bring chung gsum sbyor zhid / de rnams ni bskyed rim kho nas thob pa yang yod la/ bskyed rdzogs gnyis gar gyis thob pa yang yod do/ /de ltar gang zag dang po gsum ni tshogs lam par nges shing /sbyor lam drod kyis ye shes skyes pa phan chad sbyor mthong sgom pa'i lam gsum la gnas pa ni gang zag bzhi pa yin no/ /gnyis pa rdzogs rim la gtso bor bzhag pa'i sa lam gyi rnam bzhag bshad pa la/ sgrub byed lam gyi rang bzhin dang / sgrub bya 'bras bu'i ngo bo'o/ /dang po la lam gyi ngo bo ngos bzung ba dang / lam dag las 'byung ba'i rnam bzhag gi kha bskong ba'o/ /dang po la/ sgom bya byang phyogs dang / bgrod bya lam gyi rnam bzhag go /dang po la thun mong dang / thun mong ma yin pa gnyis las/—237—

dang po ni/ byang phyogs so bdun theg pa chen po spyi dang mtshungs pa yin te/tshogs lam chung ba nas dran pa nye bzhag bzhi/ 'bring po nas yang dag par spong ba bzhi/ chen por rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi/ sbyor lam drod dang rtse mor dbang po lnga/ bzod pa dang chos mchog la stobs lnga/ mthong lam la byang chub kyi yan lag bdun/ sgom lam la 'phags lam yan lag brgyad rnams sbyor ba yin no/ /gnyis pa/ thun mong ma yin pa'i byang phyogs so bdun la/ sa dang por dran pa nyer bzhag bzhi/ gnyis pa rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi/ bcu pa'i bar lhag ma brgyad la byang phyogs kyi chos gnyis gnyis/ bcu gcig pa dang bcu gnyis pa la bzhi bzhi/ yang dag pa'i las kyi mtha' la sogs pa phyi ma lnga ni bcu gsum pa'i phyed 'og ma dang sbyor ba yin cing / de dag ni byang phyogs dngos dang rjes su mthun pa ni sbyor lam sa bcu gnyisakyis gnas skabs su 'byung ba yin no/ /gzhan yang thun mong gi byang phyogs kyi chos so bdun ni pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa dang mthun pa yin la/ thun mong ma yin pa'i byang phyogs so bdun ni rtsa sum cu so bdun dang / yi ge sum cu so bdun dang / khams so bdun dang / rlung so bdun dbu mar thim pa las byung ba'i ye shes yin no/ /gnyis pa bgrod byed lam gyi rang bzhin la/ so so'i skye bo'i lam dang /'phags pa'i lam gnyis/ dang po la/ dkyil 'khor rags pa la gsal snang cung zad thob cing / theg pa gzhan gyis dkri bar mi nus pa de'i tshe tshogs lam chung ngu dang / gsal snang cung zad mched pa na tshogs lam 'bring po dang /—238

gsal snang rgya cher mched cing yi dam gyi zhal lta bar nus pa dang / las tshogs thogs med du grub pa dang / thun mong gi dngos grub chen po 'grub tu rung ba de'i tshe tshogs lam chen po yin no/ /de ltar bskyed rim sgom pa mthar phyin pa'i yon tan la gnas pa'i steng du/ rtsa a wa dhu tir rlung sems thim pa'i rkyen gyis zhu bde'i rang bzhin can gyi bde stong gi ye shes chung 'bring chen po gsum thob pa de'i tshe/ sbyor lam drod chung 'bring chen po gsum du 'jog pa yin/ de nas ye shes kyi sku zhes bya ba rnam rtog dang bral ba'i sku/ dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo rgyun mi chad par snang ba de'i tshe sbyor lam rtse mo dang / rang bzhin brgyad cu'i rnam rtog mngon 'gyur ba gtan nas 'gag pa de'i tshe sbyor lam bzod pa dang /rten de la mthong lam gyi ye shes skye ba'i sbyor ba bde stong gi ye shes bsgom par rtsol ba de'i tshe sbyor lam chos mchog chen po yin no/ /de yang sngon du bskyed rim ma bsgoms par rdzogs rim bsgoms pas rlung sems dbu mar thim pas bde stong gi ye shes chung 'bring che gsum thob pa des tshogs lam las ma 'das la/ der bskyed rim gyis bogs dbyung ba'i rkyen gyis sbyor lam drod kyi ye shes skye bar bshad pa ni dmigs gsal yin no/ /gnyis pa 'phags lam ni sa bcu gnyis sam phyed dang bcu gsum gyis bsdus pa yin cing / de yang theg pa spyi dang thun mong gi brda chad rab tu dga' ba la sogs pa'i ming dang / rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i brda chad gnas la sogs pa'i ming gis gsungs pa yin te/ ji skad du/ rgyud las gnas ni rab tu dga' ba'i sa/ /de bzhin nye gnas dri ma med/ /zhing ni 'od —239

byed shes par bya/ /nye ba'i zhing ni 'od 'phro ba/ /tsusdo mngon du gyur pa ste/ /nye ba'i ts+tshan+dho sbyangs dka' ba/ /'du ba ring du song ba ste/ /nye ba'i 'du ba mi g.yo ba/ /dur khrod legs pa'i blo gros de/ /nye ba'i dur khrod chos kyi sprin/ zhes dang / mngon brjod bla ma las/ dpe med pa dang ye shes ldan/ /rdo rje sa ni bcu gsum pa/ zhes pa lhag ma gsum gyi ming yang gsungs shing / de yang gong gi 'phros dang sbyar na/ 'thung spyod dpe med ye shes che/ /nye ba'i 'thung spyod ye shes ldan/ /bcu gsum rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa/ /zhes bla ma gong ma rnams kyi gsung 'phros las 'byung ngo / /de ltar na sa rab tu dga' ba'i thog ma dang gnas kyi dang po ni mthong lam yin la/ lhag ma bcu gcig dang bcu gsum pa'i phyed 'og ma ni sgom lam yin no/ /de ltar sa de rnams thob pa'i rgyu ni/ rtsa dang khams dang rlung rnams dbu mar thim pa las 'byung zhing / de yang spyod pa dang nye rgyu la rag las pa yin te/ ma dag sa bdun du phyogs las rnam rgyal gyi spyod pa kho na dang / de nas bcu gnyis pa'i bar phyogs las rnam rgyal kho na'am nye rgyu'i bgrod pa'ang yod la/ bcu gsum pa'i byed 'og ma ni nye rgyu kho na la ngesapar stos pa yin no/ /de yang phyi rol du dza lan dha ra la sogs pa'i yul chen bzhi bgrod pa dang / de dag na gnas pa'i dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma rnams kyi 'du ba khyad par can gyi kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa spyad pas nang du mi phyed ma la sogs pa bzhi dang / khams dang rlung rnams dbu mar thim pas sa dang po'i rtogs pa skye ba yin cing / gzhan la'ang rigs 'gre'o/ /de ltar sa dang po dang gnyis pa gnyis su yul chen dang /—240

rtsa dang khams dang rlung gi 'pho ba bzhi bzhi dang / de nas bcu'i bar lhag ma brgyad la gnyis gnyis dang / bcu gcig pa dang bcu gnyis pa la bzhi bzhi dang / bcu gsum pa'i phyed 'og ma la sbas pa'i rtsa lnga dang / bdud bral ba'i khams dang rlung rnams dbu mar thim dgos pa yin no/ /de ltar sa rnams kyi yon tan phal che ba ni theg pa spyi dang mtshungs shing / bcu gcig pa dang bcu gnyis pa ni sa bcu'i yon tan yar 'phel gyi steng du/ chos sku'i zhing khams la dbang 'byor pa zhes bya ba ji lta ba'i chos rnams rtogs pa'i ye shes lhag par rtogs pa yin no/ / bcu gsum pa phyed 'og ma ni ngo bo nyid sku'i zhing khams la dbang thob pa zhes bya zhing ji lta ba dang ji snyed pa'i chos rnams kyi gnas lugs ma lus pa rtogs pa'i ye shes dpag tu med pa ldan pa yin no/ /sa bcu gcig pa dang bcu gnyis pa'i ngo skal gyi phyi'i yul chen po brgyad ni/ dur khrod brgyad la ngos 'dzin pa dang / bcu gsum pa'i phyed 'og ma'i ngo skal gyi phyi'i yul chen lnga ni/rdo rje gdan dang de dang nye ba'i phyogs bzhi'i yul rnams so/ /de ltar rtsa rgyud dngos bstan la yum chen sum cu rtsa gnyis dang / nang gi lus la sbyar ba yod kyang / bde mchog la nyer bzhir gsungs pa rtsa mi phyed ma la sogs pa dang rim pa bzhin du sbyar ba ni/ sam bhu ṭi nas gsungs pa dang gung bsgrigs pa las shes par bya'o/ /gnyis pa man ngag gi kha bskang ba la/ lta grub brgyad ngos bzung ba dang /de la ji ltar khrid pa'i tshul lo/ /dang po la so skyes lam du lta ba bzhi dang /—241—

'phags lam du 'grub mtha' bzhi'o/ /dang po bum dbang gi lta ba mi rtog pa gtso che ba ngo bo nyid dang / gsang dbang gi lta ba gsal ba gtso che ba rang byung gi ye shes dang / shes rab ye she dbang gi lta ba bde ba gtso che ba yas brtan gyi dga' ba bzhi dang / dbang bzhi pa'i lta ba bde stong gnyis su med pa mas brtan gyi dga' ba bzhi'o/ /dang po la dbye na/ snang phyogs kyi ngo bo nyid kyi/stong phyogs kyi ngo bo nyid dang / zung 'jug gi ngo bo nyid gsum mo/ /de dag ni dkyil 'khor bsgoms pa dang 'brel ba'i snang nyams dang / stong nyams dang /snang stong zung 'jug gi nyams rnams so/ /de gsum char yid kun btags dang bral ba'i chos nyid/ mi rigs pa las log pa'i chos can/ ngo bo gcig tshul gyi ldog pa tha dad pa ste mtshan nyid gsum du gsungs so/ /gnyis pa la rang byung zhes pa'i don phyi rol gyi rkyen gzhan la ma ltos pa yin la/ de la snyen mongs rang byung / rnam rtog rang byung dang / sbrel gzhi rang byung / gsal zhing yangs la rang byung chen po'i ye shes so/ /dang po ni/ rtsa rlung thig le'i khyad par 'ga' zhig dbang bskur thob pas rten 'brel gyis nyon mongs dug lnga shugs drag po ltar snang ba'i lam gyi ye shes dang gnyis pa rnam rtog shugs drag po ltar snang ba'i lam gyi ye shes dang / gsum pa nyamasamatho dman gsal mi gsal/ bde sdug 'dres mar snang ba dang / bzhi pa gsal stong gi ye shes mtha' dbus med par 'char ba rnams so/ /gsum pa ni yas brtan gyi dga' ba bzhi ste/ de dag la yang / gnas la ltos pa bzhi dang / lusal ltos pa/ spang bya la ltos pa/ ngo bo nyid la ltos par dbye bas bcu drug go /dang po ni/ spyi bo'i haṃ yig zhu ba —242

las byung ba'i byang chub kyi sems mgrin pa/ snying ga /lte ba/ gsang gnas rnams su brtan par bya ba'i dus su bde ba 'char ba yin no/ /gnyis pa lus la ltos pa ni/ phyi rol gyi bya ba la ltos pa'i bde ba dang / gnyis sbyor gyi bya ba las thob pa'i bde ba dang / bsrubs pa las byung ba'i bde ba dang / byang chub kyi sems brtan par byas pa'i bde ba ste skad cig ma rim pa bzhi la ltos pa yin no/ / gsum pa spang bya la ltos pa ni phyi rol gzung ba'i rnam rtog rags pa 'gags pa dang / rig mar 'dzin pa'i rnam rtog 'gagame pa dang / bdag tu 'dzin pa'i rnam rtog mngon gyur pa 'gags pa dang / gzung 'dzin gyi rnam rtog phra rags mngon gyur pa 'gags pa ste bzhi'o/ /bzhi pa ngo bo nyid la ltos pa ni/bde stong gi ye shes chung ngu dang / 'bring dang / chen po dang/ chen po'i chen po rnams yin no/ /bzhi pa dbang bzhi pa'i lta ba bde stong gnyis su med pa'i mas brtan gyi dga' ba bzhi ni/ ji skad du/ rgyu mthun pas ni skra dkar 'joms /rnam par smin pa'i stobs ster byed/ /skyes bu byed pas rnam par 'phel/ /dri ma med pas 'chi med 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar 'bras bu bzhi ste/ de yang nor bu nas lte ba'i bar byang sems kyis gang zhing brtan par byas pa ni rgyu cimathun pa'i 'bras bu ste/ skra dkar la sogs pa rgas pa mi 'byung ba dang / de nyid snying gar brtan par byas pa ni rnam smin gyi 'bras bu ste/ sems ye shes kyi stobs su gyur pas lus sred med kyis bu'i stobs dang ldan pa yin no/ /de nyid mgrin pa'i bar du brtan par byas pa ni/ skyes bu byed pa'i 'bras bu ste/ chos —243

thams cad la blo gros 'phel shing thogasamed du chos ston nus pa dang / de nyid spyi bo'i bar du brtan par byas pa ni bral ba'i 'bras bu ste/ tha mal pa'i lus gnas gyur nas 'ja' lus rdo rje'i sku 'gyur pa yin no/ /gnyis pa 'phags lam du sbyo/ba mtha' bzhi zhes bya ba ni grub 'bras te/ so so'i skye bo'i gnas skabs su dbang bzhi'i lam bsgoms pa'i 'bras bu yin pas so/ /rnam pa gcig tu na/ grub pa ni mchog gi dngos grub yin la/ mthar thug gi 'bras bu de dang nye bas grub pa'i mtha' zhes bya'o/ /de la dbye na/ bum dbang gi grub mtha' 'khor 'das dbyer med/ gsang dbang gi grub mtha' ma 'dres yongs rdzogs/ sher dbang gi grub mtha' bde stong rgya chung ba/ dbang bzhi pa'i grub mtha' bde stong rgya che ba dang bzhi'o/ /dang po ni/ sa dang po nas drug pa'i bar yin te/ 'khor 'das mnyam pa nyid du rtogs pa'i ye shes la gtso bor byed pas 'khor 'das dbyer med ces bya'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ sa bdun pa nas bcu'i bar rnams yin te/ so sor ya( dag par rig pa bzhi la dbang 'byor bas sems can so so'i bsam pa dang mthun pa dang/ 'gro ba so so'i skad dang mthun pa'i chos so sor ma 'dres pa ston par nus pas na ma 'dres pa yongs su rdzogs pa zhes bya'o/ /gsum pa ni/ sa bcu gcig pa dang bcu gnyis pa yin te/ 'di dag ni bde stong gi ye shes kyi yul tshad dang bcas pa'i phyir bde stong rgya chung ba zhes bya'o/ /bzhi pa ni/ bcu gsum pa'i phyed 'og ma ni skad cig ma gcig gis brtan g.yo thams cad la khyab par nus pa'i phyir bde stong rgya che ba zhes bya'o/ /sa 'di dag tu yon tan dpag tu med pa dang ldan pa'i phyir —244

grub mtha' la rtags su shar ba zhes bya'o/ /gnyis pa de la ji ltar 'khrid tshul ni/ tshogs sbyor gyi lam mtha' dag khams 'dus pa gsum dang / 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lam grub mtha' bzhi'i bsdus pa ltar te/ de la khrid lugs gsum dang / bsgrod lugs gnyis kyis dang po rlung gi lam khrid pa'i tshul ni/khams 'dus pa dang por gnod pa dang bcas pa'i lam khrid pa dang / 'dus pa gnyis pa phan gnod med par lam khrid pa dang / 'dus pa gsum par phan pa dang bcas pa'i lam khrid pa ste de dag ni 'jig rten chos mchog man chad kyi lam chod pa'o/ /'jig rten las 'das pa'i gnas skabs su yang grub mtha' dang por zag pa med pa'i rlung gi lam khrid pa dang / gnyis par dbang po lnga'i rlung gi lam khrid pa dang / gsum par stobs lnga'i rlung gi lam khrid pa dang /bzhi par srog rtsol rab tu thim pa'i rlung gi lam khrid pa ste/ de ltar rlung gi bgrod pa ma lus pa thim pas sangs rgyas kyi sar ye shes kyi rlung 'ba' zhig tu gyur pa yin no/ /gnyis pa thig le'i lam khrid tshul la/ 'dus pa dang por khams dwangs snyigs ma phyed par lam khrid pa dang / gnyis par cung zad phyed pas khrid pa dang / gsum pa dwangs snyigs phyed par khrid pa ste gsum du yod cing / 'jig rten las 'das pa'i skabs su'ang grub mtha' dang por khams dwangs ma'i lam khrid pa dang / gnyis pa thig le'i bdud rtsi lam khrid pa dang / gsum par dwangs ma chen pa'i lam khrid pa dang / bzhi par dwangs ma'i dwangs mas lam khrid pa ste/ de nas thig le'i bgrod pa thams cad thim pas/ khams dwangs ma mchog —245

'ba' zhig tu gyur pa yin no/ /gsum pa rtsa yi ge'i lam khrid tshul ni/ 'dus pa gsum la ma nges pa 'khrul snang la brten nas lam khrid tshul dang / nges pa mthong snang la brten nas lam khrid tshul dang / shin tu nges pa gsal snang la brten nas lam khrid pa'o/ /'jigs lam skabs su grub mtha' bzhi la/ yi ge'i stobs cung zad dag pa'i lam khrid tshul dang / yi ge'i stobs phal cher dag pa'i khrid tshul dang / yi ge'i stobs dag pa'i lam khrid pa'i tshul dang / yi ge'i stobs cher dag pa'i khrid tshul te bzhi yod cing / de nas rtsa yi ge'i bgrod pa thim pas mi shigs pa mchog tu gyur pa yin no/ /gnyis pa bgrod lugs gnyis ni/ lam ltar na lam lnga dang sa bcu gsum mo/ /byang phyogs ltar bgrod na byang chub kyi phyogs dang mthun pa'i chos sum cu rtsa bdun no/ /gnyis pa bsgrub bya 'bras bu'i ngo bo ni/ bla ma gong ma'i man ngag las/ ji skad du/ gnas yongs gyur dang ye shes sku/ /mi gnasamya ngan 'das nyid dang / /gnyis su med pa nyid dang ni/ /mdzad pa rgyun mi 'chad pas bsdus/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar don tshan drug dang / sku dang ye shesakyi yan lag bshad pa brtsi ba ste bdun no/ /dang po gnas yongs su gyur pa ni/ chosakyi dbyings rang bzhin gyi cha nas gnas gyur pa med kyang kun rdzob kyi cha nas gnas gyur pa ste/ kun gzhi'i rnam shes gnas gyur pa me long lta bu'i ye shes/nyon yid gnas gyur pa mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes/ yid kyi rnam shes gnas gyur pa sor rtog ye shes/ sgo lnga'i rnam shes gnas gyur pa bya ba grub pa'i ye shes/chos kyi dbyings shin tu dri ma med par gyur pa chos dbyings ye shes te mdo dang —246—

thun mong gi gnas gyur gyi rnam bzhag dang / phung po lnga rgyal ba rig lngar gnas gyur pa dang / nyon mongs pa dug lnga ye shes lngar gnas gyur pa dang / skye mched bcu gnyis sems dpa' sems ma'i dkyil 'khor du gnas gyur pa dang / lus rtsa gnas sprul skur gnas gyur pa dang / yi ge longs skur gnas gyur pa dang /khams chos skur gnas gyur pa dang / snying po ye shes ngo bo nyid skur gnas gyur pa ste/ thun mong ma yin pa'i gnas gyur gyi rnam bzhag go /gnyis pa ye shes ni/ gong du mngon byang gi skabs su bshad zin pa'i ye shes lnga dang / stobs bcu la sogs pa sangs rgyas kyi yon tan dpag tu med pa yin la/ de yang ye shes lnga sku gsum gyi bsdus pa yin te/ chos dbyings ye shes ni chos sku dang / bya grub ye shes ni sprul sku/ ye shes gzhan rnams ni longs skus bsdus pa yin no/ /de yang bde mchog stod 'grel las/ yang sangs rgyas kyi sa de nyid la rdo rje gur dang sangs rgyas kyi sa'i dgongs pa ltar ye shes lngas sangs rgyas kyi sa thams cad bsdus par gsungs/ zhes gsungs shing / ljon shing las kyang de bzhin du gsungs la/ 'di'i skabs kyi sangs rgyas kyi sa'i dgongs pa zhes gsungs pa ni/ mdo sde sangs rgyas kyi sa yin pa'i phyir mdo lugs la ye shes lnga med par 'dod pa ni/ rje btsun gong ma rnams kyis dgongs pa bskangs pa ma yin no/ /gsum pa ni/ sku gsum gyi steng du ngo bo nyid sku'i bsnan pas bzhi'o/ /de'i steng du bde ba chen po'i sku bsnan pas lnga'o/ /bzhi pa ni mi gnas pa'i myang 'das ni chos skus srid pa'i mtha' la mi gnas pa dang / longs sku ston pa'i sgo 247

nas myang 'das kyi mtha' la ma gnas pa nyid yin no/ /lnga pa gnyis su med pa ni zung du 'jug pa ste/ sku dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo snang ba dang / thugs rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes ldog cha tha dad kyang ye shes gcig gi rnam rol yin no/ /drug pa ni/ sku gsung thugs kyi mdzad 'phrin te/ gdul bya gang la gang 'dul du ston pa cadang / brtan g.yo thams cad kyi rnam par ston pa dang/ dus srid pa ji srid kyi bar du rgyun mi 'chad par 'byung ba'o/ /bdun pa ni/ ye shes lnga dang yan lag bdun yang sku gsum gyis bsdus pa yin te/ ji skad du/ slob dpon ngag dbang grags pas/ longs spyod rdzogs dang kha sbyor bde chen rang bzhin med/ /snying rjes yongs gang rgyun mi 'chad dang 'gog pa med/ /yan lag bdun bshad don dang ldan pa'i bsgrub bya 'dir/ /bdag 'dod tshad mas yongs sgoms blo can rnams kyis bsngags/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ kha sbyor la sogs pa yan lag dang po gsum longs sku dang/ rang bzhin med pa'i yan cilag ni chos sku dang / phyi ma gsum ni sprul pa'i sku'o/ /de lta bu'i yan lag bdun ldan tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dngos dang rdo rje 'chang zhes bya la/ pha rol tu phyin pa'i lam gyi rang 'bras kyi sangs rgyas ni/ sangs rgyas kyi mtshan dang ldan pa tsam ste/ sa bcu pa lasami 'da' ba'o/ /so: ṭi las/ gang dag bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i gnas thob pa de dag bde bar gshegs pa ste/sangs rgyas yin la mtshan gzhi mtshon pa ni rdo rje sems dpa' yang dag pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /'di'i skabs kyi bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i gnas ni kha sbyor —248—

dang bde ba chen po'i gnas yin cing / mtshan gzhi mtshon par byed pa ni/ chos thams cad gzigs shing mkhyen pa'i don to/ /thams cad mkhyen pa'i lam bzang bdud rtsi'i mtsho/ /yi ge'i sar 'khod dge ba gang bsags des/ /'gro ba'i yid mkhar kun mkhyen zla 'od rgyas/ /dgyes pa'i rdo rje rab rgyas rgyur gyur cig /ces pa 'di ni rje btsun thams cad mkhyen pas 'jam dbyangs kun dga' snying po'am mtshan gzhan tā ra nā tha'i zhal snga nas gsungs pa ji ltar zin pa bzhin dam pa de nyid kyi zhabs rdul spyi bos len pa'i dge slong dpal ldan shākyu bstan 'dzin gyis bris pa'o// //dge'o// bkra shis//—249

gzhon nu'i rol rtsed ces bya ba rgyud don mtha' dag gabasdo05 ba bsdokyigathaṭa/dza yan+tu/ rgyal kun thugs rje'i rang gzugs ngur smrig gi /tshon rgyas rab dkar sbags pa'i bzlos gar mkhan/ /snying po'i don mchog rtsol ba'i dpa' bo ste/ khyab bdag rigs brgya'i mgon por phyag bgyi'o/ shigs bya'i mtha' gru 'jam pa'i mkhyen pa la/ /blo gros gter ba'i lha zhes 'od stong can/ /rmongs pa'i smag rum 'joms la zla bral ba/ /yongs 'dzin rta bdun rgyal po khyod min su/ /gang yang 'di ni rnam dpyod yangs pa'i gzhu/ /gyen du blangs las legs bshad nyag phran sogs/ /dpung pa'i yal gar bzung nas sngon rabs kyi/ /gzhung lugs rnam par 'bigs 'di lan brgyar 'phang / /gsang chen rgyud sde'i zab don dus bhi/ /bskul mkhas dbyug gu'i 'byed pa mang bsten kyang / /'khrul med lam 'dis lugs ngan 'brug sgra'i brug /'gog nus 'di la grogs dag yi rang byos/ / rizhes mchod par brjod cing bshad par dam bca' ba sngon du btang nas/'dir rgyud kyi rgyal po kyai rdo rje las brtsams te/ rim pa gnyis kyi rnam bzhag cung zad 'chad pa la/ rgyud kyi mngon par rtogs pa mdo tsam bstan pa dang /rim gnyis bye brag tu bshad pa'o/ /dang po la rjod byed tshig gi rgyud rnam par —250

gzhag pa dang / brjod bya don gyi rgyud nges par bya ba'o/ /dang po la/ rgyud 'di nyid rgyud sde gang du gtogs pa dang / gsung pa po ston pa'i che ba/ rgyud nyid ngos bzung ba'o/ /dang po ni/ 'o skol gyi ston pas legs par gsungs pa'i chos thams cad kyi snying po/ gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i rgyud thams cad kyang rgyud sde bzhir 'dus pa yin te/ rdo rje gur las/ dman pa rnams la bya ba'i rgyud/ /bya min rnal 'byor de lhag la/ /sems can mchog la rnal 'byor mchog /rnal 'byor bla med de lhag la'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar las/ 'di rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud do/ /de la yang thabs kyi rgyud/ shes rab kyi rgyud gnyis sam/ pha rgyud/ ma rgyud/ gnyis med kyi rgyud gsum du grags pa la/ 'di ma rgyud khyad par can ni/ gnyis med kyi rgyud yin ces 'chad la/ de las kyang snying por gyur pa kyi rdo rje'i rgyud do/ /gnyis pa la spyir gsang sngags kyi rgyud thams cad kha sbyor ba la sogs pa'i yan lag bdun ldan gyi rdo rje 'chang chen pos gsungs pa yin cing / de las kyang rgyud 'di nyid ni dag bya dag byed kyi chos du mas khyad par du 'phags pa'i snying po kyai rdo rje zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa'i rnam pa can gyis gsungs par bla ma gong ma rnams bzhed do/ /de yang dag pa'i 'khor gyi nang du 'das pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis kyang he ru ga'i/ rnam par gsungs pa yin kyang /bar bar du nub par gyur pa las/ 'o skol gyi ston pas bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa'i tshul bstan pa'i tshe 'og min du longs sku'i rten dang / byang chub kyi snying po rdo rje gdan du ri 251—
